title: PA technician specialist
description:
If you are looking to make an impact on a meaningful scale, come join us as we embrace the Power of One!

We strive to be an employer of choice and establish a reputation for being a talent rich organization where Associates can grow their career caring for others. For over a century, we’ve served the health care needs of the people of Memphis and the Mid-South.

Responsible for precertification of eligible prescriptions. Ensures complete documentation is obtained that meets insurer guidelines for medical necessity and payment for services. Models appropriate behavior as exemplified in MLH Mission, Vision and Values.


Working at MLH means carrying the mission forward of caring for our community and impacting the lives of patients in every way through compassion, a deliberate focus on service expectations and a consistent thriving for excellence.

A Brief Overview
Responsible for precertification of eligible prescriptions. Ensures complete documentation is obtained that meets insurer guidelines for medical necessity and payment for services. Models appropriate behavior as exemplified in MLH Mission, Vision and Values.

What you will do
  • Responsible for precertification of eligible prescription medications for inpatient and outpatient services based on medical plan documents and medical necessity. Ensures medical documentation is sufficient to meet insurer guidelines for medical necessity documentation and procedure payment.
  • Reviews clinical information submitted by medical providers to evaluate the necessity, appropriateness and efficiency of the use of prescription medications.
  • Assists with patient assistance and grant coordination for Patients for outpatient pharmacies from designated areas.
  • Proactively analyzes information submitted by providers to make timely medical necessity review determinations based on appropriate criteria and standards guidelines. Verifies physician orders are accurate. Determines CPT, HCPCS and ICD-10 codes for proper Prior Authorization.
  • Contacts insurance companies and third party administrators to gather information and organize work-flow based on the requested procedure.
  • Collects, reads and interprets medical documentation to determine if the appropriate clinical information has been provided for insurance reimbursement and proper charge capture.
  • Serves as primary contact with physicians/physician offices to collect clinical documentation consistent with insurer reimbursement guidelines. Establishes and maintains rapport with providers as well as ongoing education of providers concerning protocols for pre-certification.
  • Communicates information and acts as a resource to Patient Access, Case Management, and others in regard to contract guidelines and pre-certification requirements.
  • Performs research regarding denials or problematic accounts as necessary. Works to identify trends and root cause of issues and recommend resolutions for future processes.

Education/Formal Training Requirements
  • Required - High School Diploma or Equivalent

Work Experience Requirements
  • Required - Pharmacy (clinical, hospital, outpatient, or specialty) 3-5 years

Licenses and Certifications Requirements
  • Required - Pharmacy Technician - Tennessee - Tennessee Board of Pharmacy
  • Required - Certified Pharmacy Technician - Pharmacy Technician Certification Board
  • Preferred - Certified Pharmacy Technician- ExCPT - National Healthcareer Association
  • Preferred - Pharmacy Technician - Mississippi - Mississippi Board of Pharmacy

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
  • Basic understanding of prescription processing flow. Expertise in utiliizing EMRs to document clinical critieria required for third party approval.
  • Knowledgeable of medical terminology, drug nomenclature, symbols and abbreviations associated with pharmacy practice.
  • Strong attention to detail and critical thinking skills.
  • Ability to speak and communicate effectively with patients, associates, and other health professionals.
  • Ability to diagnose a situation and make recommendations on how to resolve problems.
  • Experience with a computerized healthcare information system required. Familiarity with fundamental Microsoft Word software.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

Supervision Provided by this Position
  • There are no lead or supervisory responsibilities assigned to this position.

Physical Demands
  • The physical activities of this position may include climbing, pushing, standing, hearing, walking, reaching, grasping, kneeling, stooping, and repetitive motion.
  • Must have good balance and coordination.
  • The physical requirements of this position are: light work - exerting up to 25 lbs. of force occasionally and/or up to 10 lbs. of force frequently.
  • The Associate is required to have close visual acuity to perform an activity, such as preparing and analyzing data and figures; transcribing; viewing a computer terminal; or extensive reading.
  • The conditions to which the Associate will be subject in this position: The Associate is not substantially exposed to adverse environmental conditions; job functions are typically performed under conditions such as those found in general office or administrative.

Our Associates are passionate about what they do, the service they provide and the patients they serve. We value family, team and a Power of One culture that requires commitment to the highest standards of care and unity.


Boasting one of the South's largest medical centers, Memphis blends a friendly community, a thriving and growing downtown, and a low cost of living. We see each day as a new opportunity to make a difference in the lives of the people in our community.

title: Scientist I
description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Adherence to all Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP) Safety Standards

Job Description

Join us as a Scientist I

At Thermo Fisher Scientific, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life - enabling our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while taking science a step beyond through research, development and delivery of life-changing therapies. With clinical trials conducted in 100+ countries and ongoing development of novel frameworks for clinical research through our PPD clinical research portfolio, our work spans laboratory, digital and decentralized clinical trial services. Your determination to deliver quality and accuracy will improve health outcomes that people and communities depend on – now and in the future.

Our PPD® Laboratory Services team has a direct impact on improving patient health through the expertise of scientists, industry thought-leaders and therapeutic experts. As the world leader in serving science, our laboratory professionals bring their commitment to accuracy and quality to deliver groundbreaking innovations.

As a Scientist I your role will be to oversee the operations of clinical laboratory testing, ensure the accuracy and reliability of results, manage and mentor lab staff, and uphold the highest standards of quality and compliance in all laboratory practices.

What You’ll Do:
• Perform lab work in accordance with client protocols, methods and requirements.
• Prepare study protocols, project status reports, final study reports and other project-related technical documentation.
• Design experimental study and participates in technical troubleshooting.
• Review, interpret and analyze data for technical quality and compliance to protocols, methods and SOPs. Review laboratory investigations and deviation.
• Organize, schedule and supervise laboratory resources for group's project activities and updates project status.
• Respond to client questions and needs, coordinate client communication and records meeting minutes.
• Assist group leaders in their responsibilities.
• Assist in preparation and implementation of PPD/client SOPs and company operational policies. Ensure adherence to SOPs, safety standards and company policies.

Education and Experience:
• Bachelor's degree or equivalent and relevant formal academic / vocational qualification
• Previous experience that provides the knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job (comparable to 0 to 1 years).

In some cases, an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities:
• Knowledge of routine operation, maintenance and theory of analytical instrumentation, SOPs and regulatory guidelines
• Knowledge of applicable regulatory authority, compendia and ICH guidelines
• Excellent manual dexterity skills
• Good written and oral communication skills
• Time management and project management skills
• Proven problem solving and troubleshooting abilities
• Ability to cross-train on sample preparation techniques with another laboratory group
• Ability to work in a collaborative work environment with a team

Working Conditions and Environment:
• Work is performed in a laboratory and/or a clinical environment with exposure to electrical office equipment.
• Occasional drives to site locations, occasional domestic travel.
• Exposure to biological fluids with potential exposure to infectious organisms.
• Rare exposure to skin and lung irritants, radiation, toxic materials and hazardous waste.
• Personal protective equipment required such as protective eyewear, garments and gloves.
• Exposure to fluctuating and/or extreme temperatures on rare occasions.

Physical Requirements:
• Ability to work in an upright and /or stationary position for 6-8 hours per day.
• Repetitive hand movement of both hands with the ability to make fast, simple, repeated movements of the fingers, hands, and wrists to operate lab equipment.
• Occasional mobility needed.
• Occasional crouching, stooping, with frequent bending and twisting of upper body and neck.
• Light to moderate lifting and carrying (or otherwise moves) objects including luggage and laptop computer with a maximum lift of 15-20 lbs.
• Ability to access and use a variety of computer software developed both in-house and off-the-shelf.
• Ability to communicate information and ideas so others will understand; with the ability to listen to and understand information and ideas presented through spoken words and sentences.
• Frequently interacts with others to obtain or relate information to diverse groups.
• Works independently with little guidance or reliance on oral or written instructions and plans work schedules to meet goals. Requires multiple periods of intense concentration.
• Performs a wide range of variable tasks as dictated by variable demands and changing conditions with little predictability as to the occurrence. Ability to perform under stress. Ability to multi-task.
• Regular and consistent attendance.

Why Join Us?
When you join Thermo Fisher Scientific, you become part of a global team that values passion, innovation, and a commitment to scientific excellence. You’ll work in an environment where collaboration and development are part of the everyday experience – and where your contributions truly make a difference.

Apply today to help us deliver tomorrow’s breakthrough.

title: Mejerist - Fredericia
description:
Location

Fredericia, DK

Korsvej mejeri søger en mejerist til omgående ansættelse.

Som Mejerist på Korsvej Mejeri kan du se frem til en afvekslende hverdag blandt 80 gode kolleger. Mejeriet er løbende i udvikling, og vi har brug for din hjælp i vores produktion.

På Korsvej mejeri laver vi dekorerede flødeoste i forskellige varianter i høj kvalitet. Desuden produceres Paneer. Vi producere årligt ca. 4000 tons ost.

Om jobbet

Din opgave bliver at indgå i vores lille team i produktionen på 18 ansatte og være en del af de forskellige processer i produktionen af både flødeost og Paneer.

Vi har stor fokus på Arbejdsmiljø og prioritere sikkerheden højt. Hverdagen er drevet af Lean og faktabaseret problemløsning og vi arbejder i coreteam for at optimere dette arbejde.

Vi forventer at du selvstændigt kan tage fat i opgaverne, har gå på mod og er løsningsorienteret i samarbejde med både produktion, pakkeri og vedligehold.

Du vil få en afvekslende hverdag med mange forskellige opgaver og en stor kontaktflade i organisationen. Du kan desuden se frem til at samarbejde med dygtige kolleger i et sikkert og behageligt arbejdsmiljø. Vi har fokus på trivsel, gode arbejdsforhold og mulighed for efteruddannelse.

Hvem er du?

Du er uddannet mejerist, mejeritekniker eller procesteknolog

  • Du er en teamplayer og går ikke på kompromis med sikkerhed og kvalitet
  • Samtidig skal du kunne arbejde selvstændigt
  • Det falder dig naturligt at være struktureret og have overblik
  • Du går til opgaverne med højt humør og en positiv indstilling, og du trives godt i et dynamisk miljø, hvor vi lægger stor vægt på nøjagtighed og orden.

Vi anvender LEAN i vores hverdag på mejeriet, så har du erfaring med dette, er det en fordel. Dine arbejdstider vil variere, men de er primært placeret mandag-fredag på daghold og mandag-torsdag på aftenhold.

Hvad tilbyder vi?

Arbejdsmiljøet er noget, vi prioriterer meget højt, hvilket gør, at du skal være en del af det proaktive arbejde i forhold til egen og kollegaers adfærd, arbejdspladsens opbygning og procedure for arbejdsprocesserne, så vi undgår ulykker. På Korsvej mejeri har vi et rigtig godt arbejdsmiljø og ligger generelt meget højt i den årlige trivsels undersøgelse.

Ansøgning og kontakt

Hvis du drømmer om at blive vores nye mejerist, bedes du sende din ansøgning hurtigst muligt via nedenstående link. Der vil blive afholdt samtaler løbende.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte produktionschef Søren Borup på tlf. 9131 4935

title: Johtava asiantuntija, ympäristö- ja lupahankkeet
description:
Olisitko yksi meistä?

Johtava asiantuntija, ympäristö- ja lupahankkeet

Johtavana ympäristö- ja lupahankkeiden asiantuntijana työsi on ensisijaisesti vastata vaativista ympäristö-, lupa-, PIMA- ja kunnostushankkeiden johtamisesta ja asiantuntijatyöstä sekä niiden asiakas- ja tarjoustyöstä.

Tehtävässä toimit ympäristöalan johtavana asiantuntijana, projektipäällikkönä tai projektinjohtajana hankkeissa, joissa voivat yhdistyä esimerkiksi ympäristö- ja vesilupien valmistelu ja muiden viranomaismenettelyiden läpivienti, pilaantuneet maat, maa-ainesten ja jätteiden hyödyntäminen, ympäristöriskien hallinta ja ympäristökunnostukset, ympäristögeotekniikka, sekä ympäristörakennuttaminen ja ympäristövastuut (EDD).

Sijoitut noin 40 ympäristöasiantuntijan ympäristökonsultointiosastolle. Osana noin 180 ympäristöalan ammattilaisen Ympäristö ja kestävä kehitys -toimialaa saat tueksesi laajan ja monialaisen osaajaverkoston vaativiin ympäristö-, lupa- ja kunnostushankkeisiin.

Roolissasi pääset kokoamaan monialaisia projektitiimejä ja työskentelemään yhdessä muun muassa ympäristö-, luonto-, melu-, geotekniikka-, aluesuunnittelu- ja rakennuttamisasiantuntijoidemme kanssa. Työsi painottuu tilanteen ja osaamisesi mukaan projektien johtamiseen, asiantuntijatyöhön, tarjousten valmisteluun, asiakassuhteiden kehittämiseen ja uusien toimeksiantojen tunnistamiseen ja hankintaan sekä muiden asiantuntijoidemme sparraamiseen ja työn laadun varmistukseen.

Työsuhde on vakituinen ja alkaa sopimuksen mukaan. Voit sijoittua esimerkiksi Espoon, Turun, Tampereen, Lahden, Kuopion, Oulun tai Rovaniemen toimistollemme, myös hybridityö on mahdollinen.

Millainen tausta sopii tehtävään?

Toivomme sinulta:

  • Soveltuvaa korkeakoulututkintoa

  • Vähintään 10 vuoden kokemusta ympäristöalan asiantuntijatehtävistä

  • Vahvaa ja laaja-alaista kokemusta ympäristön kunnostushankkeista

  • Pitkää kokemusta ympäristölainsäädännön ja viranomaismenettelyjen soveltamisesta

  • Kokemusta pilaantuneista maista sekä ympäristö- ja vesiluvista

  • Näyttöä vaativien ympäristöasiantuntijaprojektien johtamisesta

  • Kykyä hahmottaa asiakkaan kokonaisuus yksittäistä selvitystä tai suunnitelmaa laajemmin

  • Sujuvaa suomen kielen kirjallista ja suullista taitoa sekä hyvää englannin kielen kirjallista ja suullista taitoa

  • Yhteistyökykyistä, käytännönläheistä ja ratkaisuhakuista työotetta

  • Vahvoja alan asiakas- ja yhteistyöverkostoja

Katsomme lisäksi eduksi, jos sinulta löytyy kokemusta seuraavista:

  • Ympäristögeotekniikka ja kaatopaikkarakentaminen

  • Ympäristörakennuttaminen ja rakentamisen aikaisten ympäristöriskien hallinta

  • Teollisuushankkeet tai kaivosympäristöt

  • Sedimentit ja ruoppaushankkeet

  • Kiertotalousratkaisut, jätteiden hyödyntäminen ja EEJ-prosessi

Emme kuitenkaan luoneet sinulle täydellistä työpaikkaa valmiiksi - sinähän olet itse oman työsi, osaamisesi ja hyvinvointisi paras asiantuntija ja meillä voit kehittää uraasi haluamaasi suuntaan.

Sinulle:

Meillä ei ketään jätetä yksin. Onnistumistasi varmistaa ja tekemistäsi tukee koko Sitowisen värikäs työyhteisö. Täällä saat olla ihan oma ainutlaatuinen itsesi, niin me muutkin olemme. Pyrimme työyhteisön monimuotoisuuteen ja toivotamme tervetulleiksi kaikenlaiset hakijat, jotka vastaavat tarpeitamme.

Tarjoamme myös kilpailukykyisen palkan ja tulospalkkiojärjestelmän, joustavat työajat ja hybridityöratkaisun, kattavat vakuutukset sekä muita etuja.

Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden ottaa näkyvä asiantuntija- ja projektinjohtorooli monipuolisessa ympäristöalan osaajayhteisössä. Tässä roolissa olet ympäristö- ja lupahankkeiden avainhenkilö ja tärkeässä roolissa koko toimialan kehitykselle. Pääset työskentelemään vaativissa ja yhteiskunnallisesti merkittävissä hankkeissa sekä vaikuttamaan siihen, miten ympäristö-, lupa- ja kunnostuspalvelujamme kehitetään. Rooli ei sisällä esihenkilövastuuta, vaan voit keskittyä asiakas-, projekti-, tarjous- ja asiantuntijatyöhön.

Olemme ylpeitä osaamisestamme ja toisistamme. Emme perusta turhasta pönötyksestä. Mutkattomuus ja kaverin auttaminen ovat meille hyvän työpäivän perusta.

title: Project Manager
description:
Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract.


We put delivery dates in contracts and carry the overage risk ourselves. That only works if someone owns the delivery-scope, timeline, budget, and sprint execution and treats a slipping date as their problem, not a status-report line item. That someone is you.

As our Project Manager, you'll run distributed engineering teams across India and three US time zones on customer engagements where the date is committed. You'll run the daily, sprint, and client cadences, translate fluently between engineering and business stakeholders, and push back on scope creep with data. Agents compress the repetitive engineering work, which makes delivery faster and makes your job sharper: shorter timelines leave no room for blockers that sit in a log for days. We're looking for the PM who gets things done who personally removes blockers, drives escalations to closure, and makes sure no risk reaches the client as a surprise.

This role is not for you if:

  • Your default is to forward messages between the client and engineering.
  • Your role has primarily been reporting and coordination without delivery ownership.
  • You've only facilitated agile ceremonies without driving delivery outcomes.
  • Sprint ownership and execution were largely driven by a Business Analyst or Product Owner in your previous roles.

What you will do?

  • Build the project plan in Smartsheet from the Solutions Architect's scope of work, real dependencies, a defensible critical path, sprint boundaries overlaid on the timeline.
  • Track scope, hours, and budget in real time. Flag burn-rate risk early and push back on scope creep with numbers, not gut feel.
  • Maintain a live risk register. Spot risks before they become issues, surface the right ones to the client at the right time, and drive mitigation actively.
  • Maintain a live RAID log (Risks, Assumptions, Issues, Dependencies) and an action tracker with clear ownership, accountability, and timely closure.
  • Run crisp daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives that produce decisions, not discussions.
  • Remove sprint blockers personally. Chase the client-side data dependency, escalate the stuck cloud permission, redirect pulled resources don't let "waiting on" sit in a log for days.
  • Handle sprint-level risks in real time: reprioritize, descope, swap stories, or escalate before commitments slip.
  • Keep trackers honest. Action items have owners and dates; delays are visible and followed up on time.
  • Translate technical progress into business language for the customer, and business priorities into clear, estimable requirements for engineers.
  • Facilitate internal and external architecture reviews across India and three US time zones; document decisions and circulate them the same day.
  • Produce weekly customer status updates a senior business leader can absorb in 90 seconds — RAG colors backed by evidence, not sentiment.
  • Own customer escalations and drive them to resolution. Communicate status, risks, and decisions needed — proactively, not reactively.
  • Onboard engineers on customer systems, scope, process, deliverables, and documentation standards.
  • Create kick-off presentations, project charters, and tracking mechanisms in collaboration with the customer.
  • Maintain meeting notes, recorded calls, and a clean project documentation library.
  • Review and approve timesheets and leaves; keep capacity planning and team calendar management accurate.
  • Negotiate scope changes with data. Produce formal change requests with impact analysis hours, timeline, trade-offs, options before anyone commits the team to additional work.
  • Drive sprint predictability with velocity planning and burndown tracking; commitments are realistic and consistently met.
  • Run backlog refinement with Principal Consultants or Technical Leads so stories are clear, prioritized, and estimable.

What are we looking for

  • 3+ years of delivery experience on cloud engineering or data engineering projects.
  • Hands-on fluency with Smartsheet, Jira / Confluence, and Clockify — you can stand up the tooling on day one.
  • Excellent written and spoken communication, facilitation, negotiation, and coaching skills — you can hold your ground with a skeptical client engineering director and coach a junior engineer in the same afternoon.
  • Strong prioritization and problem-solving instincts. You make trade-offs explicit rather than quietly absorbing them.
  • A demonstrable track record of driving outcomes, not just reporting on them.
  • Demonstrated experience managing at least one fixed-bid project from kickoff through closure, including scope change negotiation with clients.
  • A strong grasp of Agile delivery metrics — velocity, burndown, sprint predictability — and the ability to use them to drive execution.
  • Comfort operating in ambiguous, fast-changing environments where requirements evolve; you bring structure proactively.

You will be preferred if you posses

  • Experience managing Data Lake projects on AWS.
  • Professional Scrum Master™ (PSM) certification.
  • Managing Jira Projects certification.
  • Smartsheet certification.

How we work?

Aedeon absorbs scale. Engineers absorb judgment. The contract absorbs risk fixed-date delivery, with Mactores covering overage cost for delays inside our control. You're the person who keeps those three honest on a live engagement: the plan defensible, the burn visible, the risks surfaced before they cost anything. Our engineers embed with the customer's team and carry the delivery commitment personally. You carry the date.
Life at Mactores
We care about creating a culture that makes a real difference in the lives of every Mactorian. Our 10 Core Leadership Principles that honor Decision-making, Leadership, Collaboration, and Curiosity drive how we work.
1. Be one step ahead
2. Deliver the best
3. Be bold
4. Pay attention to the detail
5. Enjoy the challenge
6. Be curious and take action
7. Take leadership
8. Own it
9. Deliver value
10. Be collaborative

The Path to Joining the Mactores Team

title: Käyttöönottoasiantuntija
description:
Oletko kenttäkokemusta omaava rakennusautomaation ammattilainen, ja haluaisit päästä yhä syvemmälle vaativien projektien käyttöönottoihin?

Haemme nyt Helsinkiin tai Pirkkalaan

Käyttöönottoasiantuntijaa varmistamaan, että suunnitellut automaatioratkaisut toimivat myös käytännössä.

Tehtävä

Käyttöönottoasiantuntijana työskentelet teknisesti vaativien rakennusautomaatioprojektien parissa yhdessä kokeneiden asiantuntijoidemme kanssa. Pääset mukaan laajoihin hankkeisiin (esim. datakeskukset), joissa rakennusautomaation onnistuneella käyttöönotolla on kriittinen merkitys koko kohteen toiminnalle.

Tehtävänäsi on varmistaa, että suunnitellut automaatioratkaisut toimivat myös käytännössä. Tulkitset suunnitelmia ja arvioit niiden toteutettavuutta, osallistut käyttöönottotestaukseen ja seuraat, että järjestelmät ja laitteet toimivat oikein. Vastaat tarvittavan dokumentaation laatimisesta sekä varmistat käyttöönottoprosessin etenemisen sovittujen vaatimusten ja aikataulun mukaisesti.

Työskentelet tiiviisti järjestelmäasiantuntijoiden, automaatioasentajien sekä muun projektitiimin kanssa.

Sinusta

Sinulla on Insinööri/DI-tason koulutus automaatio-, sähkö- tai muulta soveltuvalta tekniseltä alalta sekä käytännön kokemusta rakennusautomaation projekteista. Arvostamme erityisesti kentällä kertynyttä kokemusta rakennusautomaation käyttöönotoista ja projektien toteutuksesta.

Osaat lukea ja tulkita teknisiä suunnitelmia ja pystyt arvioimaan, toimiiko suunniteltu ratkaisu käytännössä. Tunnistat mahdollisia ongelmia toteutuksessa tai käyttöönotossa, ja ratkot niitä oma-aloitteisesti.

Kommunikoit päivittäin muiden projektin jäsenten kanssa, joten toivomme sinulta erinomaisia kirjallisia ja suullisia viestintä- ja kommunikaatiotaitoja. Uskallat tuoda oman teknisen näkemyksesi esiin ja pystyt viestimään asioista selkeästi myös haastavissa tilanteissa.

Projektien työkieli on usein englanti, joten tarvitset tehtävässä sujuvaa englannin kielen taitoa. JISsin sisäinen työskentelykieli on suomi.

Tarjoamme

JISillä pääset mukaan merkittäviin rakennusautomaatioprojekteihin ja näet läheltä, miten kokonaisuudet viedään suunnitelmista aina onnistuneeseen käyttöönottoon asti.

Rooli tarjoaa erinomaisen mahdollisuuden syventää osaamista rakennusautomaation käyttöönotoissa ja kasvattaa ymmärrystä suurten projektien teknisestä kokonaisuudesta. Pääset näkemään järjestelmiä yksittäistä osa-aluetta laajemmin ja vaikuttamaan konkreettisesti siihen, että lopputulos todella toimii.

Tehtävä voidaan sijoittaa Helsingin tai Pirkkalan toimipisteellemme.

Meistä

JISsin tarina alkoi vuonna 2001 miehen ja pakun voimin. Kun firman perustajat 25 vuotta sitten kiersivät ympäri Suomea asennuskeikoilla, heille oli jo silloin tärkeää, että vaikka töitä tehdään tosissaan, töissä pitää olla myös kivaa. Näitä arvoja on vaalittu tähän päivään asti, ja yritys on kasvanut yhdeksi Suomen suurimmista rakennusautomaatiotaloista. Nykyään meillä työskentelee jo yli 300 sähkö- ja automaatioalan huippuammattilaista, ja taistelu älyttömyyttä vastaan jatkuu!

Meidät erottaa muista JIS-henkisyys, mistä pidämme tiukasti kiinni. Meille on tärkeää, että jaat arvomaailmamme: "peräämme ei tarvitse soitella", "tehdään porukalla ja jeesataan kaveria" sekä "toimii ja järjestyy". Teemme sen, mitä lupaamme, ja aina ammattiylpeydellä. Meillä yhteishenki on huippuluokkaa ja asiantuntemus talossa käsittämättömän korkealla tasolla. Kollegat ovat auttavaisia ja helposti lähestyttäviä – meillä ketään ei jätetä yksin.

Lisätiedot ja hakuohjeet

Kuulostaako tämä sinulta? Jos tunnistat itsessäsi JIS-henkeä ja haluat mukaan huippujengiin, hae tehtävää mahdollisimman pian lähettämällä hakemuksesi alla olevan linkin kautta. Käsittelemme hakemuksia jatkuvasti, ja täytämme tehtävän heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä ja JISsistä työpaikkana antaa mielellään käyttöönottoasiantuntija Ari Harjumäki, puh. 050 366 1413.

title: Senior Backend Engineer, Search
description:

You will work at the intersection of backend engineering, information retrieval, and AI to help users find exactly what they need in real time.

You will improve relevance, accuracy, latency, and scalability while developing measurement frameworks that continuously raise search quality.
You will also contribute to vector and semantic search capabilities that enable next-generation, AI-powered experiences.
Working closely with backend, AI, and product teams, you will help integrate search capabilities into increasingly sophisticated product experiences.

  • Develop measurement frameworks, quality metrics, and evaluation processes to assess and continuously improve search performance.
  • Build and enhance vector search and semantic search capabilities using modern embedding-based technologies.
  • Optimize query parsing, indexing strategies, relevance tuning, and search-serving infrastructure.
  • Collaborate with AI, backend engineering, and product teams to integrate search capabilities into new and existing product experiences.

    • Demonstrated experience building and operating high-scale, real-time data ingestion and search-serving systems in backend environments.
    • Proven ability to optimize query parsing, indexing, relevance tuning, and search performance.
    • Experience developing methods and metrics for measuring and improving search quality.
    • Strong understanding of search ranking, relevance algorithms, and information retrieval principles.
    • Experience with vector embeddings and semantic search implementations is highly valued.

title: AniCura Odense Dyrehospital søger autoriseret veterinærsygeplejerske
description:
AniCura Odense Dyrehospital søger autoriseret veterinærsygeplejerske og daglig koordinator

Vil du bygge videre på din erfaring som veterinærsygeplejerske og udvikle dine kompetencer i et specialiseret dyrehospital med mange forskellige fagområder og patientforløb?

Vi søger en autoriseret veterinærsygeplejerske med erfaring fra klinisk smådyrspraksis, som har lyst til at blive en del af vores hospital og vores faglige fællesskab.

Om stillingen

Stillingen er for dig, der allerede har opbygget et klinisk fundament som veterinærsygeplejerske og nu ønsker at bygge videre på dine kompetencer. Samtidig er det en fordel hvis du har et godt overblik og har mod på at administrere vores daglige planlægning, da stillingen vil indebære at være del af vores koordinator team.

Vi søger en kollega med lyst til fortsat at udvikle sig fagligt. Det kan være inden for anæstesi og analgesi, men det kan også være inden for andre af hospitalets fagområder. Det vigtigste er, at du er nysgerrig, motiveret og har lyst til at bygge videre på dit kliniske fundament.

Vi har dygtige og erfarne veterinærsygeplejersker med forskellige faglige kompetencer. Du bliver derfor en del af et miljø, hvor der er gode muligheder for faglig sparring, sidemandsoplæring og udvikling, uanset hvilken faglig retning du ønsker at bygge videre på.

Vi er et avanceret dyrehospital, hvor arbejdet med komplekse operative og medicinske patienter er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Mange af vores patienter kræver særlig opmærksomhed i forhold til anæstesi, analgesi og medicinsk behandling og pleje, og du vil få mulighed for at arbejde med patienter og procedurer med varierende kompleksitet i takt med, at dine kompetencer udvikler sig.

Stillingen inkluderer samtidig mange af de klassiske opgaver for en veterinærsygeplejerske på et dyrehospital – opgaver, der er med til at sikre vores daglige drift og omstillingsparathed, så vi står klar til at hjælpe den næste patient, klient eller henvisende kollega.

Vagt er en del af stillingen

Deltagelse i vores vagtordning er en fast del af ansættelsen.

Det er derfor vigtigt, at du allerede har klinisk erfaring og et godt fundament at arbejde videre fra. Du behøver ikke nødvendigvis tidligere at have arbejdet i vagt. Hvis vagtdelen er ny for dig, sørger vi for introduktion og oplæring, så du bliver godt klædt på til opgaven.

Vagtarbejdet giver samtidig mulighed for at bygge videre på dine kompetencer inden for akutbehandling, anæstesi og håndtering af akut og kritisk syge patienter.

På sigt arbejder vi mod en model, hvor hospitalet kan være bemandet med en veterinærsygeplejerske 24/7. Du skal derfor være opmærksom på, at arbejdstiden fremadrettet kan udvikle sig til også at omfatte planlagt arbejde om aftenen og natten. Denne arbejdstid vil i så fald indgå som en del af din almindelige normtid og til overenskomstmæssige vilkår.

Faglighed og udvikling

Som ansat på AniCura Odense Dyrehospital bliver du en del af et bredt fagligt miljø og får mulighed for at arbejde sammen med dyrlæger og veterinærsygeplejersker med særlige kompetencer inden for blandt andet intern medicin, onkologi, oftalmologi, dermatologi, akutmedicin, rehabilitering, anæstesi samt bløddels-, ryg- og ortopædkirurgi.

Vores mange fagområder og in-house diagnostiske muligheder skaber et læringsmiljø drevet af faglig viden, evidens, erfaring og samarbejde.

Vi forventer ikke, at alle kan det samme. Til gengæld tror vi på værdien af at have forskellige kompetencer i huset og på, at vi bliver bedre, når vi bruger og deler dem på tværs.

Vi forestiller os, at du

  • er autoriseret veterinærsygeplejerske og har erfaring fra klinisk smådyrspraksis

  • har et godt klinisk fundament og lyst til at bygge videre på det

  • har lyst til at udvikle dine faglige kompetencer og gerne har interesse for et eller flere af hospitalets fagområder

  • trives med både almindelige hospitalsopgaver og mere komplekse patientforløb

  • har forståelse for ressource planlægning, tænker systematisk og kommunikere tydeligt og diplomatisk

  • er nysgerrig, fagligt engageret og opsøgende, når du møder noget, du endnu ikke kan

  • ønsker at indgå aktivt i et fagligt fællesskab, hvor vi bruger hinandens forskellige kompetencer

  • er indstillet på, at vagtdeltagelse er en del af ansættelsen

Om AniCura Odense Dyrehospital

Vi er et avanceret dyrehospital med et bredt patientgrundlag og specialiserede teams inden for en række fagområder. Vores diagnostiske og kirurgiske setup gør, at vi kan varetage langt de fleste patienter, der præsenteres for os.

Vi arbejder i et miljø med skiftende arbejdsopgaver, hvor samarbejde og omstilling er en naturlig del af hverdagen. Vi er et stærkt team, der arbejder tæt sammen og respekterer hinandens forskelligheder. Vi har en uformel omgangstone med plads til smil og grin og vægter både faglighed, fællesskab og en positiv arbejdskultur højt.

Vil du være med?

Send din ansøgning og CV hurtigst muligt. Vi holder løbende samtaler og venter gerne på den rette kandidat.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller hospitalet, er du velkommen til at kontakte hospitalschef Mette Nielsen på mette.nielsen@anicura.dk.

title: Projectcoördinator
description:
De energietransitie is onmogelijk zonder jou als projectcoördinator

Je bent een belangrijke schakel in projecten. Je gaat je bezighouden met inhoudelijke vraagstukken die gerelateerd zijn aan geld, risico’s, organisatie, tijd, informatie en kwaliteit. Gezamenlijk met het projectteam zorg je ervoor dat de doelstellingen worden behaald. Je bent samen bezig met het monitoren, structureren en verbeteren van het procesmatig verloop van de projecten. Door je proactieve houding lever je een belangrijke bijdrage in het projectenteam. Je weet mensen te verbinden en mee te nemen in het belang van projectbeheersing. Het energienet van de toekomst maken we voor iedereen, mét iedereen. Zo ben jij bezig met het:

  • Draagt bij aan het behalen van projectdoelen met oog voor kwaliteit, tijd en budget.
  • Verzorgen van de financiële projectenadministratie en verricht je mutaties binnen het projectinformatiesysteem.
  • Verbinden van alle betrokken in- en externe partijen op het gebied van projectbeheersing.
  • Opstellen, bijhouden en analyseren van projectplanningen.
  • Aanleveren van stuurinformatie door het leveren van actuele en betrouwbare rapportages en overzichten.
  • Levert een bijdrage in het borgen/vastleggen van benodigde documenten in een documentmanagementsysteem.
  • Coördineren en faciliteren van het risico- financieel- en kwaliteitsmanagement.
  • Bijdragen aan het opstellen van projectbegrotingen in lijn met scope en planning.

Jij maakt het net completer bij Alliander

Wist je dat we bij Alliander uit verschillende bedrijven bestaan? Samen met Liander, Qirion, Qterra, Dep, Firan en Entrnce ontwikkelen én beheren we het energienet voor miljoenen inwoners van Nederland. En met de huidige energietransitie is dat hard werken. Dat doen we met de hulp van een grote club vakmensen. Dankzij deze talenten hebben wij het volste vertrouwen in de energietoekomst van Nederland. Samen met jou maken wij dat mogelijk.

En jij gaat dat doen bij ons bedrijfsonderdeel Qirion. Hier houd jij je bezig met de energie-infrastructuur en slimme energieoplossingen. Zo ontwerp, bouw en onderhoud je het hoogspanningsnet van vandaag en de toekomst.

Slimme oplossingen bedenken kan alleen als jij genoeg energie hebt. En de juiste werkomgeving geeft jouw dat. De afdeling Hoogspanningskabels bestaat uit gezellige en behulpzame collega’s. In dit multidisciplinaire team is er ruimte voor lol en werken we aan veilige, betrouwbare en technisch haalbare ontwerpen en projecten. Je komt terecht in een snelgroeiende organisatie met volop kansen voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling.

Jij maakt het net energieker

Werken aan een organisatie die toekomstproof is. Dat doe je vanuit je eigen kracht en talent. En dat doe je bij ons. Draag jij daaraan bij met jouw kritische kijk op zaken? Klinkt goed! Zeker als je dit aanvult met:

  • Hbo werk- en denkniveau met minimaal 2 jaar werkervaring in een relevante functie en werkomgeving.
  • Ervaring met SAP en andere applicaties in een projectenomgeving en je bent bekend met alle Microsoft tools.
  • Projectmatige werkervaring (IPMA, Prince2)
  • Inzicht en ervaring met begrotingen en planningen
  • Klantgerichtheid: je begrijpt dat alles wat we doen uiteindelijk impact heeft op onze klanten, en je handelt daar ook naar.

Voor jou net beter geregeld

Daarvoor krijg jij op basis van een 38-urige werkweek:

  • een salaris van € 3.729,68 tot € 5.328,12 bruto per maand (schaal 7).
  • elke maand bovenop je salaris, een individueel keuze budget (IKB) van 18% (fulltime) of 12,8% (parttime) van je bruto jaarsalaris. Dit is inclusief 8% vakantietoeslag. Je kunt dit bedrag uit laten betalen, maar je kunt er bijvoorbeeld ook extra vrije dagen voor kopen. Jij kiest wat bij jou past.

  • elk jaar een DI-budget van € 700,00 voor jouw duurzame inzetbaarheid. Kies bijvoorbeeld voor een vergoeding van jouw sport of hobby, verduurzaming en vergroening van je huis, of het verlichten van je studieschuld bij DUO. Jij bepaalt waar jouw budget naartoe gaat
  • vergoedingen voor studies en trainingen. Alliander vergoedt in de meeste gevallen jouw gehele opleiding.
  • werken waar dit voor jou het beste werkt, als je functie dit toelaat. Vanaf kantoor of vanuit eigen huis. Werk je vanuit huis, dan ontvang je hiervoor een thuiswerktegemoetkoming.

title: Team Lead (Java)
description:
We are a product company – we build and continuously develop our own Master Data Management platform. This gives us a stable working environment and provides our people with a genuine opportunity to influence the shape and direction of the solutions we build. Instead of working on short-term projects for different clients, you will have the opportunity to contribute to a product over the long term and see the impact of your work.

We are looking for an experienced Team Lead (Java) who combines strong people leadership skills with deep technical expertise. As a Team Lead, you will support and develop your team members while taking responsibility for the technical quality of the systems your team builds and operates.

This is a broad and comprehensive role, made possible by the way our teams are structured: our Team Leads work with small, 3–5-person teams and have a very limited number of meetings. Apart from the daily, you mainly participate in meetings directly related to your team’s work and needs – typically around 2–3 hours per week in total. This lets you spend most of your time working with your team, making technical decisions, and supporting people’s development.

We expect you to have a very good understanding of your team’s technology stack, the ability to organize and coordinate the team’s work, and confidence in making technical decisions. Your impact will extend beyond your own team, including collaborating with other teams to ensure everyone stays focused on delivering value.

The ideal candidate has a strong background in backend development using modern Java technologies, several years of professional experience, and experience mentoring, leading or coordinating engineers. We are looking for a team-oriented person who values collaboration, knowledge sharing, and collective problem-solving. A genuine interest in data and databases will be a strong advantage.

Product Area You Will Be Responsible For:

  • Data Quality Guard – continuous validation and monitoring of business partner data (identifiers, addresses, and bank accounts), 1,500+ community rules as well as customer - specific custom rules, a unified data validation API, and dashboards, reports, and tools providing data quality insights. The product is powered by a rules engine built on a knowledge graph (RDF/SPARQL) and curated global reference data.
  • Duplicate Guard – detection, analysis, and consolidation of duplicate business partner records within and across datasets. It includes a matching engine with data-cleansing mechanisms and phonetic, geospatial, and exact comparators, continuous duplicate monitoring, and consolidation rules that lead to the creation of so-called golden records.
  • Tax Guard – verification and validation of direct and indirect tax identifiers (including EU VAT), as well as verification of names and addresses against official registers, both in transactional and monitoring modes through a headless API

Required Skills & Technologies

  • Java 21
  • MongoDB
  • Spring Boot
  • RabbitMQ
  • Kafka
  • OpenAPI
  • SQL

Experience & Leadership

  • Several years of hands-on backend development experience using modern Java technologies
  • Experience leading, mentoring, or coordinating a team of engineers
  • Ability to define and enforce architectural and procedural standards

Nice to Have

  • Semantic Web technologies – RDF and RDF-based data modeling, ontologies/vocabularies (RDFS, OWL, SHACL), SPARQL querying, triplestores and knowledge graph design. These technologies are used in the Data Quality Guard rules engine, where records are translated into RDF triples and validated using SPARQL-based rules against curated global reference data.
  • Spring Expression Language (SpEL), used as the interface between our rules engine and external data sources
  • Redis
  • MariaDB

Languages:

  • Polish – C1 (required)
  • English – C1/B2+ (required)

Go Strong avopalveluiden palveluvalikkoon kuuluu sisällöltään ja intensiteetiltään erilaisia palvelumuotoja. Palveluitamme ovat perhetyö, ammatillinen tukihenkilötoiminta, tuetun asumisen palvelu, lapsen ja nuoren lähiympäristöön vietävä tuki, tukijaksot, sekä tuki- ja sijaisperhetoiminta.

Tehtävänäsi on tukea asiakkaita heidän omissa toimintaympäristöissään. Lähtökohtaisesti meiltä onnistuu kaikki ja #jotainmuuta -ajatus kulkee mukanamme arjen haasteita ratkoessa ja työtä kehittäessä.

Työ on itsenäistä, mutta ei yksinäistä. Yhteydenpito ja yhteistyö esihenkilön ja kollegoiden kanssa on aktiivista ja säännöllistä! Toimistomme sijaitsee hyvien kulkuyhteyksien varrella, aivan Jumbon kauppakeskuksen kupeessa.

Sinulla tulee olla sosiaali- ja terveysalan ammattikorkeakoulututkinto ja vähintään kahden vuoden kokemus sosiaalialan töistä. Arvostamme kaikkea aikaisempaa työkokemusta; erityisesti aikuissosiaalityöstä ja kotoutumisen tuesta, sekä lasten, nuorten ja perheiden kanssa tehdystä työstä. Työ on liikkuvaa, joten ajokortti ja oman auton käytön mahdollisuus ovat työn organisoinnin kannalta oleellisia. Kiitettävän, puhutun ja kirjallisen suomen kielen lisäksi, laskemme eduksi muun kielitaidon ja muun sosiaalialan erityisosaamisen ja -koulutukset.

Huom! Tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä. Haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana, joten jätäthän hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian.

title: Senior Technical Officer
description:
• 4 – Year full time, fixed term opportunity

  • Opportunity to support world-leading single-cell proteomics research infrastructure

  • Base Salary $117,133 - $127,610 + 17% superannuation

About the opportunity

Sydney Mass Spectrometry (SydneyMS) is a core research facility within the DVC Research Portfolio, providing a suite of over 20 state-of-the-art mass spectrometers. SydneyMS supports research with global impact in the areas of metabolomics, lipidomics, proteomics, and mass spectrometry imaging. The facility provides best in class services to internal and external clients to the University, including industry, and across a wide range of disciplines in medical and life sciences.

As the Senior Technical Officer, you will play a key role in supporting the ACRF Single-Cell Cancer Proteomics Laboratory. The laboratory has been equipped with a comprehensive set of equipment for single cell analysis including a LMD7 microscope, a cellenONE single cell sorter, and an Orbitrap Astral Zoom mass spectrometer. You will be providing specialist technical expertise, operational oversight and advanced scientific support across these cutting-edge single-cell proteomics platforms.

Working within a collaborative research environment, you will oversee laboratory operations, undertake experimental work, support research projects, train users and researchers, and maintain sophisticated instrumentation. You will contribute to the delivery of high-quality research outcomes while ensuring laboratory activities are conducted safely, efficiently and in accordance with University requirements.

Your key responsibilities will be to:

  • provide expert technical advice and undertake experiments in collaboration with researchers and technical staff

  • oversee the operation, optimisation and maintenance of laboratory instrumentation and equipment

  • support single-cell proteomics and related research workflows across a multi-user facility

  • train researchers, students, staff and visitors in the safe and effective use of laboratory equipment and techniques

  • perform risk assessments and develop safe work and maintenance procedures for laboratory operations

  • manage technical information requests, quotations and support for fee-for-service and contract research activities

  • analyse and interpret experimental data and contribute to scientific reporting and technical documentation

  • coach and mentor users while contributing to a collaborative and high-performing laboratory environment

  • ensure compliance with work health and safety requirements and maintain a clean, safe laboratory environment

About you

Required:

  • demonstrated experience supporting or undertaking LCMS research within proteomics, metabolomics, lipidomics

  • proven experience operating, troubleshooting, optimising and maintaining mass spectrometry and/or liquid chromatography instrumentation, particularly nanoflow LCs and orbitrap mass spectrometers within life or medical sciences research settings

  • experience working within a multi-user laboratory environment, including vendor liaison and equipment coordination

  • demonstrated ability to deliver specialised technical training and support to other researchers, users and staff

  • strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills, with the ability to manage competing priorities

  • excellent written and verbal communication skills and the ability to build effective stakeholder relationships

  • a bachelor's degree in a relevant scientific discipline, or an equivalent combination of training and experience

Desired:

  • demonstrated experience supporting or undertaking LCMS research within proteomics, metabolomics, lipidomics, for single-cell and/or spatial omics analysis

  • knowledge and practical experience in optical light microscopy, especially in the area of laser capture microdissection

  • knowledge and practical experience in cell sorting and flow cytometry

  • knowledge and practical experience in data analysis and data visualisation, especially in the use of R

  • a PhD in biomedical research that was heavily based on mass spectrometry-based Omics analysis

Sponsorship / work rights for Australia

You must have unrestricted work rights in Australia for the duration of this employment to be eligible to apply. Visa sponsorship is not available for this appointment.

Pre-employment checks and declarations

Your employment is conditional upon the successful completion of all pre-employment or background checks required for the role in terms satisfactory to the University. Also, to meet the University’s obligations under the National Higher Education Code to Prevent and Eliminate Gender-Based Violence you will be asked to declare if you have been investigated for, or found to engaged in, sexual harm or gender-based violence in the course of previous employment or in a legal process. title: Senior Software Engineer, Test (Org Modeling)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Software Engineer, Test (Org Modeling) based in the United States.

This role offers the opportunity to engineer quality systems that enable development teams to ship reliable software with confidence.
You’ll work across the technology stack to design layered testing strategies spanning unit, integration, end-to-end, performance, security, and resilience testing.
Rather than focusing solely on test creation, you’ll build the frameworks, tooling, automation, and guardrails that make quality scalable.
You’ll partner closely with backend and frontend engineers, product managers, and designers to bring quality thinking into the entire development lifecycle.
The role also provides an opportunity to shape performance testing, CI/CD feedback loops, observability, and modern AI-assisted engineering practices.
You’ll operate in a fast-moving environment where reliability, developer velocity, and continuous improvement are equally important.
This is an ideal position for a technically strong engineer who enjoys solving complex quality challenges and influencing engineering practices at scale.

Accountabilities:

  • Design and build end-to-end quality systems, including scalable test frameworks, tooling, automation, and processes that enable confident software delivery.
  • Establish and evolve a layered quality strategy covering unit, integration, end-to-end, load and performance, security, contract, and chaos testing.
  • Act as a hands-on quality partner within engineering squads by participating in planning, standups, code reviews, technical discussions, and cross-team initiatives.
  • Drive performance and load testing by designing meaningful test scenarios, executing tests, building monitoring dashboards, and establishing ongoing performance measurement practices.
  • Integrate automated testing into CI/CD pipelines to create rapid and reliable feedback loops from code commit through production deployment.
  • Monitor test results and failures, investigate root causes, track defects, and partner with engineering teams to resolve complex quality issues.
  • Promote contract and chaos testing practices to uncover integration risks, systemic weaknesses, and resilience gaps before they affect users.
  • Apply AI-powered tools to improve engineering workflows, automate repetitive quality activities, and increase effectiveness across the broader team.
  • Continuously evaluate and improve testing tools, methodologies, reporting practices, and quality processes as the product and engineering organization scale.
  • Collaborate with engineers, product managers, and designers on test planning to improve coverage and ensure testing reflects realistic user scenarios.

    • Requirements:

    • Strong systems-thinking approach to software quality, with experience engineering maintainable and reliable testing systems rather than creating isolated test scripts.
    • Broad understanding of testing methodologies across functional, integration, contract, performance/load, chaos/resilience, and security layers.
    • Strong programming ability and the confidence to read and write production-quality code across different languages and frameworks; experience with C#, Java, Python, or similar object-oriented languages is a plus.
    • Demonstrated experience designing and executing performance or load tests, analyzing results, building dashboards, and monitoring performance trends.
    • Practical experience using AI-assisted engineering or testing tools to improve personal productivity and automate team workflows.
    • Strong troubleshooting skills, including the ability to investigate unfamiliar systems, interpret logs, use observability tools, and identify root causes of complex failures.
    • Experience integrating automated tests into CI/CD environments such as GitHub Actions, TeamCity, Jenkins, or similar platforms.

title: Gerente de restaurante
description:
About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

On Colombia’s Caribbean coast, in the historic city of Cartagena, Four Seasons is revitalizing a collection of landmark buildings dating as far back as the 16th century. Experience the authentic charm of the Getsemaní neighbourhood, where timeless style infuses the 131 accommodations, including 27 suites. Connect to the lively social scene in four restaurants and lounges. Entertain in two ballrooms. Then unwind at the Spa, Fitness Centre and two rooftop pools. With timeless style and legendary service, Four Seasons is shaping Cartagena’s new cultural focal point.

Acerca del rol:

El/la Gerente de restaurante se encarga de garantizar la satisfacción completa de las expectativas de nuestros huéspedes y clientes, creando experiencias épicas, innovadoras y de temporada. Así mismo, se encarga de cumplir los objetivos de calidad, financieros, higiene, formación y de fomentar un ambiente laboral basado en la filosofía de Four Seasons

Lo que vas a hacer:

  • Garantizar la secuencia de servicio establecida según los estándares de FS durante el servicio.

  • Controlar los tiempo del pase de comida garantizando la comunicación entre servicio y cocina, así como tiempos de entregas.

  • Actuar como punto de contacto para los huéspedes, gestión de quejas y resolución de problemas

  • Elaboración de horarios y asignación de turnos.

  • Controlar los inventarios y comandas.

  • Asegurar los briefings y formaciones diarias.

  • Implementar estrategias de marketing, ventas y visibilidad online.

  • Elaboración de presupuestos y forecast

  • Diseño de cartas de cócteles, vinos y maridajes premium.

  • Garantizar las capacitaciones y sesiones de entrenamiento realizadas por FS

  • Conocer y ejecutar las directrices de seguridad e higiene dentro del servicio y del turno de trabajo, motivando a otros a hacer lo mismo.

Requisitos

  • Profesional en hotelería y Turismo o áreas afines o 10 años de experiencia equivalente.

  • Certificación en algunas de la siguientes: Mixología o Enología. (Deseable).

  • Inglés avanzado

  • Mínimo 5 años de experiencia en servicio de restaurantes de alta calidad como gerente o 2 años como gerente general en entornos de alta demanda.

  • Experiencia mínima de 3 años gestionando objetivos de ventas y rentabilidad, manejando presupuestos, forecast y costes operativos en restaurantes.

  • Experiencia en la implementación de estándares de servicio como Forbes o LQA.

  • Experiencia gestionando inventario de carnes premium y vinos de alta gama. (Deseable)

Ofrecemos

  • Salario competitivo

  • Excelente formación y oportunidades de desarrollo

  • Alojamiento gratuito en otros hoteles y resorts de Four Seasons

  • Servicio de lavandería gratuito para los uniformes de los empleados

  • Comidas gratuitas para los empleados

title: Senior/Staff Frontend Engineer (React) - Remote friendly
description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,600+ Qontoers serving over 600,000+ customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


🌏 Location: You can choose to work in Qonto as long as you're living in (or willing to relocate to) either Germany, France, Italy, Serbia, or Spain.
Mission: Join us as a Frontend Engineer to craft the web apps that 600,000+ European SMEs rely on every day, from the customer-facing features that make finance simpler to the design system powering every pixel of our product.

➡️ As a Frontend Engineer at Qonto, you will

  • Craft new features for our customers within a squad Team, owning quality from design to production.
  • Grow in technical leadership: lead design discussions, contribute to guild-wide improvement, and raise the bar for developer experience across your peers
  • Be a key player in teamwork with Product, Design, and other Tech stacks
  • Work AI-first: use AI as a default part of how you explore the codebase, draft technical designs, prototype solutions, and accelerate delivery, while keeping strong human judgment and quality standards

➡️ What you can expect: our methodology, the Qonto Way

  • At Qonto, we value diversity and are proud to have 33% non-male in our Frontend guild.
  • You will contribute to and use our own design system and UI library, which we built from scratch.
  • You will be part of a team that is driven by quality. Our org assigns one team lead per project across stacks, giving your team a clear mission and full autonomy on how it operates
  • You will have access to best-in-class AI tools (e.g., Claude / Claude Code and internal workflows) and the autonomy to experiment, share learnings, and help scale what works across the guild
  • You will bring your energy and skills to improve the team’s tools and processes at many levels, contributing to a better developer experience for all your peers.
You can watch this interview of Imen, who joined the team as a Lead in January 2023.

➡️ Your future team

As a Frontend Engineer, you'll join one of Qonto's squad teams, each with a clear project mission, one team lead, and full product ownership.
You'll be part of a 100+ strong Frontend community within a 500+ Product Engineering department, working in teams of 5 to 10 people alongside Product, Design, and peers from Backend and Mobile.
We hold ourselves to high standards, and we've shipped several open-source JS libraries along the way. We almost completed a migration to React. Now is an exciting time to join, especially if you want to hone your expertise in React over the coming years!

➡️ About You

To succeed as a Frontend Engineer at Qonto, you will need to demonstrate:
  1. Proficiency in frontend engineering: you have at least three years of professional experience using React.js, as well as HTML and CSS. We don’t use CSS libraries such as Tailwind, so you will need to know how to write pure CSS.
  2. Attention to detail: you strive for excellence in every aspect of your job. You don’t gloss over minor issues and you understand that great work is the accumulation of many small things done right.
  3. Communication skills: you explain your thoughts in a clear, organized, concise and accurate manner.
  4. AI fluency & good judgment: you can leverage AI to move faster (research, writing, coding, testing) while staying critical, validating outputs, and protecting the product’s reliability and user trust
At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.
By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

🔒 Your security matters to us

Recruitment scams are on the rise. Keep in mind, we will never work with third-party platforms or agencies that request payment from candidates.

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Qonto, please report it right away (support@qonto.com)

title: Knowledge Management Team Director
description:
Focused on employment and labor law since 1958, Jackson Lewis P.C.’s 1,000+ attorneys located in major cities nationwide consistently identify and respond to new ways workplace law intersects business. We help employers develop proactive strategies, strong policies and business-oriented solutions to cultivate high-functioning workforces that are engaged and stable, and share our clients’ goals to emphasize belonging and respect for the contributions of every employee.

The Firm is ranked in the First Tier nationally in the category of Labor and Employment Litigation, as well as in both Employment Law and Labor Law on behalf of Management, in the U.S. News - Best Lawyers® “Best Law Firms”.

Director of Knowledge Management

Job Summary

The firm is seeking a Director of Knowledge Management to lead a team of Knowledge Management Attorneys (“KMAs”) who support the needs of the firm’s practice and industry groups by capturing attorney expertise, developing high-value knowledge resources, enabling consistent legal service delivery, and helping attorneys leverage firm knowledge more effectively.

The Director will be responsible for advancing a firmwide knowledge strategy that transforms legal expertise, practice insights, model documents, matter experience, and emerging legal developments into practical, reusable assets. The role will partner closely with practice, industry, innovation, technology, marketing, talent, and practice operations colleagues to improve attorney productivity, strengthen practice group execution, and support client value.

This position reports to the Chief Legal Operations and Practice Innovation Officer and works in close collaboration with National Practice and Industry Heads and Practice and Industry Group Leaders.

Essential Functions

Knowledge Strategy and Practice Enablement

  • Lead the Knowledge Management Team in developing and executing a firmwide knowledge strategy aligned with practice, industry, client service, and business priorities.
  • Partner with National Practice and Industry Heads, Practice Group Leaders, Industry Group Leaders, administrative leaders, and firm leadership to align KMA efforts with firmwide goals.
  • Collaborate with practice and industry groups to identify opportunities to standardize work product, create practice playbooks, improve matter execution, and reduce duplicative effort.
  • Provide strategic insights and direction to practice and industry group initiatives and other special projects.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of trends in legal practice support, content development, knowledge strategy, practice innovation, and AI-enabled legal service delivery.

Content, Precedent, and Knowledge Asset Development

  • Lead the KM team in content creation and development across practice and industry groups, including legislative updates, case law updates, industry/practice trends, and legal analysis.
  • Ensure practice and industry group intranet content is current, accurate, well organized, and useful to attorneys and allied professionals.
  • Build, maintain, and continuously improve knowledge libraries across practice and industry groups, including model documents, forms, precedents, checklists, practice guides, surveys, playbooks, matter tools, and related resources.
  • Accountable for review, editing, and contributions to content generated by other firm resources, including marketing and business development, attorney training and development, and other firm functions, as it relates to specific industries and practices.
  • Responsible for ensuring practice and industry group leadership are continually informed of strategic shifts and evolutions in practice approach, strategy, and execution.

AI, Legal Technology, and Knowledge Intelligence

  • Partner with the Innovation Team, IT, Practice Support Operations, and firm leaders to help attorneys adopt new technologies through practice and industry group use cases and workflows.
  • Support the development of AI-ready knowledge assets by promoting quality, consistency, source reliability, and appropriate governance of reusable legal content.
  • Identify opportunities to leverage enterprise technology investments, automation, search, and knowledge tools at the practice and industry group level.
  • Help translate attorney needs into practical technology, workflow, training, and content solutions that improve speed, consistency, and quality in legal service delivery.
  • Partner with central firm resources and colleagues to ensure effective use and leverage of firm-wide and practice-specific tools, processes, and technologies.

Knowledge Governance, Quality, and Risk Alignment

  • Establish and reinforce standards for the creation, classification, review, maintenance, retirement, and appropriate use of knowledge assets.
  • Help ensure knowledge resources are accurate, current, well sourced, and aligned with applicable confidentiality, ethical, information governance, and firm risk expectations.
  • Coordinate with relevant firm functions, including IT, Innovation, Marketing, Communications, Talent, Practice Support Operations, and General Counsel stakeholders, to support broader firm initiatives and promote consistent knowledge practices.
  • Develop practical quality-control processes so content owners, KMAs, and practice leaders can maintain high-value resources over time.

Team Leadership and Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Effectively manage and lead the KMA Team, providing direction, mentorship, coaching, and oversight.
  • Ensure the development of strategic goals, performance expectations, and alignment of the team with practice, industry, and firmwide priorities.
  • Create and maintain a collaborative, service-oriented, and high-performance culture within the team and among the practice and industry groups.
  • Serve as a liaison between the team and other departments.
  • Ensure strong working relationships between the team and the Practice Support Operations team and other stakeholders that support attorney effectiveness.

Metrics, Impact, and Continuous Improvement

  • Develop key performance indicators for the team and monitor and report on the impact of KMA work for the firm and its clients to firm leadership.
  • Measure adoption, utilization, quality, and business impact of knowledge resources, practice tools, technology initiatives, and KMA-supported programs.
  • Use data and feedback to recommend improvements to knowledge resources, attorney-facing tools, workflows, content strategy, training, and practice group support models.
  • Identify repeatable opportunities to increase attorney productivity, improve knowledge reuse, support onboarding and lateral integration, and enhance consistency in service delivery.

#LI-LM1

Other Duties

  • Perform other duties as assigned.

Qualifications/Skills Required

  • J.D. degree required.
  • Minimum of 6+ years’ experience as an employment litigator and/or knowledge management attorney, preferably with a balance of experience as a practicing litigator.
  • Minimum of 3+ years’ experience leading a team of attorneys with strong leadership and people-management skills or leading large, cross-departmental project implementations.
  • Demonstrated ability to lead knowledge management, practice enablement, legal operations, innovation, technology adoption, or related attorney-facing initiatives.
  • Experience developing or overseeing legal content, model documents, practice resources, playbooks, training materials, or workflow tools for practicing attorneys.
  • Familiarity with legal technology, enterprise search, document automation, generative AI, or other tools that support attorney productivity and legal service delivery.
  • Strong change-management skills, including the ability to influence attorneys and business professionals, drive adoption, and communicate the practical value of new ways of working.
  • Excellent writing, editing, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Passion for knowledge-sharing, strong organizational skills, proficiency with technology, and an aptitude for innovation, efficiency, and excellence in legal work.

We are an equal employment opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, national origin, gender, age, religion, disability, sexual orientation, veteran status, marital status or any other characteristics protected by law.

title: Member of the Technical Staff, IP Engineering
description:
About GF

GlobalFoundries (GF) is a leading manufacturer of essential semiconductors, enabling AI at scale from the cloud to the physical world. Through deep partnerships with customers, GF delivers differentiated, power efficient and high-performance solutions for high growth markets. With global manufacturing operations across the U.S., Europe and Asia, GF is a trusted and holistic technology partner for customers around the world. GF’s talented, global team remains focused every day on security, longevity, and sustainability. For more information, visit .

Introduction

GlobalFoundries is seeking a talented IP Design Engineer to join our IP Engineering team in Hsinchu. As an individual contributor, you will help develop high-performance computing processor IP products, collaborating with global teams across architecture, design, verification, and implementation. This role offers the opportunity to work on cutting-edge semiconductor technologies while driving technical innovation, product quality, and engineering excellence.

Your Role

  • Develop and deliver high-performance computing processor IP products as a member of the GF's IP Engineering team in Hsinchu.

  • Drive technical planning, execution, and delivery across product development, customer engagements, and engineering initiatives.

  • Work independently and collaborate effectively with global cross-functional teams to ensure high-quality and timely project execution.

  • Author and review technical specifications, work plans, design documentation, and project deliverables.

  • Contribute technical expertise in areas such as architecture analysis, microarchitecture, logic design, implementation, verification, signoff, and product delivery.

  • Support the development and enhancement of engineering methodologies, design flows, and quality improvement initiatives.

  • Participate in technology roadmap planning, project definition, and technical customer engagements.

  • Collaborate across sites and functions to resolve technical challenges and drive successful product outcomes.

  • Promote engineering excellence through knowledge sharing, execution discipline, and continuous process improvement.

  • Contribute to team capability development and mentor early-career engineers as needed.

  • Support system development initiatives, platform bring-up, and business-critical engineering programs.

  • Drive innovation and operational efficiency while ensuring alignment with project, quality, and business objectives.

Required Qualifications

  • Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.

  • 5+ years of experience in digital design, implementation, verification, or validation of processor/IP products.

  • Strong understanding of microprocessor, memory, and system architectures.

  • Hands-on experience in RTL design, microarchitecture, verification methodologies (UVM/OVM, formal verification, functional coverage), and technical specification development.

  • Proficiency in SystemVerilog, Verilog, C/C++, Python, Perl, and scripting languages.

  • Experience with industry-standard EDA tools for simulation, synthesis, linting, formal verification, and flow automation.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and technical communication skills.

  • Ability to drive technical execution, collaborate across global teams, and deliver high-quality results in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience leading projects or mentoring engineers.

  • Experience working with geographically distributed teams.

  • Familiarity with product signoff, silicon bring-up, and product delivery processes.

  • Experience in methodology development, process improvement, or engineering excellence initiatives.
