title: Salgskonsulent hos Strømlinet
description:
Salgskonsulent hos Strømlinet

Har du salg i blodet og trives du i telefonen? Og vil du gerne være en del af en virksomhed, hvor der er plads til forskelligheder, og hvor vi hjælper hinanden med at nå vores fælles mål? Så er det måske dig, vi mangler til vores salgs- og kundeservice team.

Vi søger en proaktiv og engageret medarbejder, der brænder for den gode kundedialog og som har lyst til at være en del af et fællesskab, hvor ordentlighed er i fokus – både i mødet med vores kunder og hinanden.

Stillingen kan enten være en fuldtidsstilling eller en studentermedhjælperstilling på 15 timer om ugen. Opstart er hurtigst muligt.

Hos os er en positiv indstilling og lysten til at lære vigtigere end erfaring med elbranchen. Vi sørger for en grundig oplæring i både produkter og systemer.

Dine arbejdsopgaver:

Som salgsmedarbejder får du en central rolle i at sikre, at vores kunder både får den bedst mulige oplevelse med vores løsninger og bliver godt oplyst om de produkter, der passer til deres behov. Du vil bruge størstedelen af din arbejdstid på telefonen, hvor du mere konkret vil:

  • følge op på kunder, der overvejer ændringer i deres aftale, og sikre, at de kender de muligheder, der er tilgængelige hos os.

  • rådgive kunder om vores løsninger med fokus på mersalg og relevante tilvalg, der matcher deres situation.

  • ringe til nuværende kunder for at afdække deres behov og introducere vores energiprodukter.

  • sikre en god opstart for nye kunder og introducere dem til relevante produkter.

  • sikre en god og positiv kundeoplevelse ved altid at møde kunden med ordentlighed og forståelse.

Vi forestiller os, at du…

er en udadvendt og serviceminded person med en naturlig evne til at forstå kunders behov. Du motiveres af at skabe resultater, tage ansvar og finde løsninger. Vi ser gerne, at du:

  • har erfaring med salg (telemarketing er et plus, men ikke et krav) – og trives med udgående kundekontakt

  • er proaktiv og har lyst til at sælge vores energiprodukter.

  • er positiv og imødekommende i telefonen og på skrift.

  • ser dig selv som en del af en virksomhed, hvor gode relationer til både kunder og kolleger er i fokus.

  • er flydende i dansk og begår dig godt på engelsk – både skrift og tale.

  • har lyst til et job, hvor du bruger størstedelen af din tid på telefonen

Vi tilbyder dig:

  • en grundig oplæring og introduktion til vores branche, produkter og systemer

  • en spændende stilling i en virksomhed i vækst

  • et ungt og socialt team med god energi

  • en arbejdsplads med fokus på trivsel, udvikling og ordentlighed

  • pensionsordning med sundhedsforsikring, personaleforening og kantineordning

  • en fast månedsløn

Derfor vil du gerne arbejde hos Strømlinet

Strømlinet er en 100 % danskejet energivirksomhed, der siden stiftelsen i 2017 har haft en klar ambition om at gøre det enkelt og gennemskueligt at være el- og gaskunde. Vi arbejder målrettet for den grønne omstilling og tilbyder el-produkter, der understøtter en mere bæredygtig hverdag. Vores seneste produktudvidelser omfatter komplette ladeløsninger til både private og erhverv samt 5G-internet.

Hos Strømlinet tilbyder vi en spændende og alsidig hverdag med fokus på høj kvalitet i opgaveløsningen og et stærkt kollegialt fællesskab.

Er du mere nysgerrig på, hvem vi er som arbejdsplads? Du kan få et indblik i vores fællesskab og hverdag her:

Lyder det som noget for dig?

Så send os din ansøgning og CV hurtigst muligt. Ansøgningsfristen er d. 11. september 2026. Vi behandler ansøgninger og afholder samtaler løbende. Du hører fra os uanset udfaldet.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen eller virksomheden, er du velkommen til at kontakte følgende:

  • Teamleder for Kundeservice, Frederik Kjær-Madsen på fkm@stromlinet.dk

  • HR-praktikant, Anne Veel, på mail: ak@stromlinet.dk

  • HR-Chef, Marco Thomsen, på tlf. 61 47 31 71

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

title: Pracownik / Pracowniczka w biurze obsługi klienta
company: Transcom Worldwide Poland Sp. z o.o.
description:
To oferujemy

  • Wynagrodzenie - 31,40 zł brutto/h (umowa zlecenie) + premie bez górnego limitu w sprzedaży, z możliwością przejścia na umowę o pracę.
  • Program Poleceń Pracowniczych - zgarnij do 3000 zł brutto za zatrudnienie pracownika z Twojego polecenia
  • Szkolenie wdrażające – pełne wiedzy i praktyki (za które oczywiście Ci zapłacimy!) a po nim ciągłe wsparcie w codziennej pracy.
  • Rozwój - w pierwszych 3 miesiącach nauczysz się prowadzić rozmowy, które rozwiązują problemy i budują pozytywne relacje z klientami (obsługa klienta), Rozwiniesz umiejętności badania potrzeb klienta, sprzedaży oraz prowadzenia rozmów (sprzedaż).
  • Jasna ścieżka rozwoju – z nami masz realne możliwości awansu! Ponad 90% naszych liderów awansowało wewnątrz firmy, bo wierzymy w rozwój naszych pracowników.
  • Konkursy z nagrodami pieniężnymi, wartościowe gadżety i wiele więcej!

Transcom Worldwide Poland Sp. z o.o.

W Transcom jesteśmy nieustannie zaangażowani w relacje między sobą i naszymi klientami. Każdego dnia ktoś nowy zaczyna z nami przygodę i wykorzystuje swój potencjał, przekształcając go w umiejętności przyszłości. Doceniamy ciężką pracę, grę zespołową i wzajemną pomoc, wspieramy pozytywne i trwałe zmiany. Tacy właśnie jesteśmy, dbamy o siebie i od samego początku sobie kibicujemy, a przy odpowiednim nastawieniu nie ma przed nami ograniczeń i możemy zajść naprawdę daleko.

  • Nastawienie na sprzedaż, aktywne słuchanie i wielozadaniowość (sprzedaż).
  • Umiejętność słuchania i jasnego komunikowania się – szanujemy drugą osobę i dbamy o to, by rozmowy były zrozumiałe i pełne empatii.
  • Pamiętaj – często zaniżamy ocenę swoich umiejętności, więc nie bój się aplikować, nawet jeśli nie jesteś pewny, czy spełniasz wszystkie wymagania. Daj sobie szansę!

title: Product Owner
description:
Are you up for a career with real life impact?

Do you want to work for a company where you help healthcare professionals, firefighters, and paramedics help people? Are you ready to work in an environment of change where we challenge status quo and are in the process of replacing legacy platforms and building new digital solutions that will take our company to the next level?

For more than 100 years, it has been Falck’s mission to prevent accidents, disease, and emergency situations, to rescue and assist people in emergencies quickly and competently and to rehabilitate people after illness and injury. Our company has more than 25.000 employees in 26 countries on six continents.

Falck is on a journey to digitalize, optimize, and improve what we do. Heavy investments are made in upgrading our core IT infrastructure and building new global digital capabilities that will enable Falck to deliver better in the future.

We are looking for a skilled and passionate Technical Product Owner to strengthen this journey.

As the Product Owner of the Subscription Management Team, you will be responsible for defining and prioritizing the product backlog, ensuring the successful implementation and continuous improvement of our subscription management processes. You will work closely with cross-functional teams, including IT, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Support, to deliver high-quality solutions that meet business objectives and enhance customer satisfaction.

Technology & Digital Transformation in Falck Scandinavia is where the majority of strategic initiatives in Falck are born and delivered. We work with both operating existing tech stacks, implementing new technology and driving product teams in close collaboration with Business Units.

In this function we are 120+ IT specialists working primarily in Copenhagen and Warsaw.
  • Bachelor’s degree in business, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Proven experience as a Product Owner or similar role, preferably in a subscription-based business, and demonstrated successful collaboration between business and IT.
  • Ideally experience with leading an innovative team delivering commercial value in a large organization.
  • Knowledge from subscription management-based systems, i.e., Dynamics 365, Oracle, Aria or Salesforce.
  • Experience with Agile methodologies and tools (e.g. Azure DevOps, Scrum, Kanban, JIRA).
  • Experience with software development.
  • Certification in Product Ownership (e.g. CSPO, PSPO) is a plus.
  • Ability and interest in understanding both complex business problems, identify and interpret business needs as well as understanding technical solutions and challenges.
  • Ability to prioritize and manage multiple tasks in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent problem-solving, conflict resolution, team building, critical thinking, and proactive planning skills.
  • Strong ability to motivate and inspire project teams and stakeholders.
  • Proficient in negotiation, vendor/supplier management, risk and issues management, and time management.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on data-driven decision making.

title: Sr. Engineer – Security Engineering (Zscaler)
description:
Role Overview

We are seeking a Zscaler & Network Security Engineer responsible for administering, monitoring, troubleshooting, and continuously improving secure internet access, endpoint connectivity, remote access, and security controls. The role will work closely with security operations, network teams, and senior security stakeholders to maintain a strong security posture while ensuring reliable user connectivity.

Key Responsibilities

  • Administer and maintain Zscaler Internet Access (ZIA) policies, including:
    • SSL inspection
    • Application control
    • Sandbox policies
    • URL filtering
    • CASB controls
    • Malware exceptions, blocks, and security policies
  • Manage and troubleshoot Zscaler Client Connector (ZCC) deployments, including installation, connectivity, authentication, policy enforcement, and endpoint-related issues.
  • Manage PAC file changes through a controlled, tested, peer-reviewed, and approved deployment process.
  • Monitor security alerts and operational dashboards, investigate issues, and resolve day-to-day security incidents within defined SLAs.
  • Raise, document, implement, and drive changes through formal Change Control processes, particularly where changes deviate from the approved security baseline.
  • Manage and troubleshoot VPN/remote-access solutions, such as Palo Alto GlobalProtect, addressing connectivity, authentication, performance, and user-access issues.
  • Use asset inventory and vulnerability-management tools, such as Qualys or similar platforms, to support troubleshooting, asset identification, security investigations, and vulnerability-management activities.
  • Review and assess policy, URL, application, and whitelisting requests, escalating higher-risk requests to senior security stakeholders for appropriate risk assessment and approval.
  • Apply least-privilege access principles across different user populations, including employees, contractors, privileged users, and executives.
  • Support security audits and compliance reviews by collecting, validating, and providing appropriate control evidence and supporting documentation.
  • Develop and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), troubleshooting guides, and knowledge base articles to improve operational consistency and knowledge sharing.

Required Skills & Experience

  • Hands-on experience administering Zscaler ZIA and Zscaler Client Connector.
  • Strong understanding of web security concepts, including SSL inspection, URL filtering, application control, CASB, sandboxing, and malware protection.
  • Experience troubleshooting ZCC, PAC files, proxy connectivity, and endpoint access issues.
  • Experience with VPN technologies, preferably Palo Alto GlobalProtect.
  • Familiarity with security incident management, alert monitoring, and SLA-driven operations.
  • Understanding of Change Management and Change Control processes.
  • Experience using Qualys or similar vulnerability/asset-management platforms.
  • Strong understanding of least privilege, secure baselines, access control, and security governance.
  • Ability to assess security risks and appropriately escalate exceptions or higher-risk requests.
  • Strong documentation skills, including writing SOPs, runbooks, and knowledge articles.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience working in an enterprise Security Operations or Network Security environment.
  • Palo Alto Networks security technology experience.
  • Familiarity with vulnerability-management and security-compliance frameworks.
  • Experience supporting internal and external security audits.
  • Relevant certifications such as Zscaler, Palo Alto Networks, Security+, or equivalent.

Key Competencies

  • Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills
  • Security-focused mindset
  • Attention to detail and risk awareness
  • Effective incident and change management
  • Clear written and verbal communication
  • Ability to work within defined SLAs and operational processes

About Four Seasons:

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. You will manage multiple priorities, keep projects moving, and ensure deadlines are consistently met.
You will work directly with clients, adapting your communication and approach to their individual priorities, processes, and business values.
The ideal candidate is proactive and comfortable taking an open-ended challenge and turning it into a clear, actionable plan.

  • Manage projects on behalf of clients, establishing priorities, coordinating tasks, and ensuring deadlines and deliverables are met.

title: Infrastructure Security Engineer
description:
Team description:

The Cybersecurity team is a strategic function within TME’s IT & Digital division, supporting the transformation of Toyota’s European IT operations. Joining this team means contributing to resilient security frameworks, helping manage cyber risks in a modern enterprise environment, and playing a visible role in building a proactive security culture across digital assets and operations. The team’s mission is to protect Toyota’s information assets, support regulatory compliance, and enable secure innovation across the organization.

Role Summary:

We are looking for an Infrastructure Security Engineer who is motivated to help strengthen secure infrastructure across a complex enterprise environment.

The Infrastructure Security Engineer is responsible for securing Toyota’s core IT infrastructure: servers, data centers, hypervisors, networks, storage systems, and endpoints. This role handles architecture reviews, vulnerability remediation, segmentation, privileged‑access governance, and incident response across critical environments. You will work across endpoint engineering, modern device management, and security operations, collaborating with infrastructure, identity, network, and support teams. This role offers the opportunity to combine technical depth with practical delivery while contributing to continuous improvement, secure operations at scale, and a collaborative team environment.

Formal Role Details:

  • Job Type: Permanent contract
  • Start date: From October 2026
  • Location: Wrocław, Silver Tower Office Center
  • Working Pattern: Hybrid – typically 2 to 3 days per week in the office, offering flexibility alongside collaboration with the team
  • Reporting line: Manager Infrastructure Security
  • Education level: Master’s degree or equivalent relevant experience

What we can offer you:

  • Health insurance
  • Sport card
  • Lunch subsidy
  • Car leasing
  • Languages lessons
  • Bonuses


Qualifications

  • Relevant experience in infrastructure security, network security or a related field.
  • Experience in hardening of various operating systems (Windows/Linux/MacOS), mobile, or cloud-connected endpoints within a structured IT or security function.
  • Experience working in enterprise or complex environments with a range of stakeholders and technologies.

We welcome candidates from different backgrounds, experiences, and career paths, including those with transferable skills or equivalent practical experience. If you meet many of the requirements but not every single one, we still encourage you to apply. We value curiosity, collaboration, and a willingness to learn alongside technical experience.

Core Technical Skills

  • Experience with Network segmentation, firewalling and remote connectivity.
  • Experience in analyzing security baselines, detecting and remediating deviations.
  • Good understanding of secure OS configuration, compliance baselines, and endpoint lifecycle management, including servers and mobile devices.
  • Experience with endpoint protection technologies such as anti-malware, EDR, device control, and related security controls.
  • Experience with vulnerability management processes, including risk-based prioritisation, remediation tracking, and coordination with infrastructure teams.
  • Understanding of security controls for server, virtualization, storage, and data-centre infrastructure environments.
  • Practical scripting or automation experience using PowerShell, and ideally Python or Bash.
  • Experience with AI use cases in infrastructure security, such as security monitoring, vulnerability prioritization, incident triage, anomaly detection, and automation of repetitive operational tasks, with an understanding of responsible and secure AI usage.

Communication & Collaboration Skills

  • Ability to explain technical concepts clearly to a range of audiences.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to build effective working relationships across teams.
  • A proactive mindset with an interest in continuous improvement, operational excellence, and knowledge sharing.

Desirable Skills

  • Familiarity with hybrid-cloud security concepts, cloud-connected infrastructure, and cloud-native security controls.
  • Familiarity with security hardening frameworks and benchmarks such as CIS, ISO 27001, NIST, or equivalent internal standards.

Certifications (Optional)

  • CompTIA Security+, EC-Council Certified Network Defender (CND), GIAC Security Essentials (GSEC), Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP), or equivalent certifications

You have a TOYOTA DNA, this means:

  • Courage: you are ready to let go of the easy path to reach challenging targets.
  • Collaboration: you are a team player, respectful and inclusive in your style, and you take a customer-oriented approach.
  • Creativity: your passion drives you to explore innovative ideas and challenge the impossible.
  • Curiosity: you combine imagination and fact-based observation.
  • Coaching: you share knowledge and feedback with your colleagues and celebrate each other’s success.

title: Algemeen verpleegkundige
description:
Wat vragen wij van jou?

Jij bent BIG-geregistreerd verpleegkundige met minimaal één jaar relevante werkervaring binnen een ziekenhuis of een zelfstandig behandelcentrum. Je bent patiëntgericht, empathisch en werkt prettig samen met collega’s. Daarnaast ben jij:

  • een gastvrije professional. Gastvrijheid is namelijk één van de belangrijkste uitgangspunten die DC Klinieken nastreeft binnen de zorgverlening;
  • iemand die zich verbonden voelt met onze kernwaarden die terugkomen in ons dagelijks handelen: daadkracht, aandacht, snelheid en eenvoud;
  • initiatiefrijk: je komt met oplossingen en denkt mee over de verpleegkundige zorgverlening;
  • op de hoogte van actuele ontwikkelingen binnen jouw vakgebied doordat je bijvoorbeeld vakliteratuur leest en interne trainingen volgt;
  • inzetbaar voor 24 -32 uur per week.

Bij DC Klinieken werken we aan zorg op het hoogste niveau. Om dit te blijven waarborgen voeren we bij nieuwe medewerkers die in dienst komen een referentiecheck uit bij voorgaande werkgevers en vragen we een recente positieve Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG).

Wat krijg je van ons?

Werken bij DC Klinieken betekent werken in een organisatie die bouwt aan een gezond zorglandschap, met aandacht voor zowel patiënten als collega’s. Je kunt rekenen op:

  • een werksetting bij een kliniek waar kwaliteit, gastvrijheid en tijd voor de patiënt centraal staat;
  • regelmatige diensten: je werkt overdag, met vaste werktijden. Geen nachten, geen bereikbaarheidsdiensten. Dat geeft rust én focus;
  • je ontvangt een bruto maandsalaris van minimaal € 3.252,- en maximaal € 4.770,- bruto op basis van een 40-urige werkweek (schaal 45 cao ZKN). Inschaling is afhankelijk van werkervaring;
  • een jaarcontract voor 24 uur per week met uitzicht op een vast dienstverband;
  • een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33% en 8,33% vakantiegeld;
  • 160 vakantie-uren en 72 PLB-uren bij een fulltime dienstverband (40 uur) werk je parttime dan naar rato;
  • een goede pensioenregeling via Cappital pensioen a.s.r.;
  • zorgzame arbeidsvoorwaarden zoals stoelmassages, rouwbegeleiding, loopbaanbegeleiding en de mogelijkheid om extra verlof te kopen;
  • reiskostenvergoeding: € 0,25 per kilometer of volledige OV-vergoeding;
  • we stimuleren vitaliteit en ontwikkeling. Zo is er dagelijks vers fruit, bieden we volop gelegenheid tot extra (bij)scholing, verdieping en verbreding van jouw kennis en interesses.
  • gratis en onbeperkt toegang tot DC Academy, een online bibliotheek vol met interessante trainingen.

description:
Wellways is committed to reconciliation, lived experience and inclusivity. We strongly encourage and warmly welcome people from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities, people with lived experience of mental health and disability and people who identify at LGBTIQA+ to apply. Even if you only meet some of the criteria, we’d love to hear from you.

  • Full time ongoing role based in Townsville
  • SCAHDS Level 6B $115,000 - $120,400 + Super + Leave Loading + Salary packaging benefits
  • Lead community-driven suicide prevention initiatives and create lasting change

Wellways is seeking an experienced and passionate Suicide Prevention Community Development Lead to bring communities together and lead meaningful action to prevent suicide across Townsville.

This is an opportunity to work at a community and systems level, building strong partnerships and bringing together people with lived experience, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities, local services, organisations and community members to create locally driven approaches to suicide prevention.

About the Role

Using a community-led approach, you will help develop and lead Suicide Prevention Community Action Plans (SPCAPs). You will support communities to identify their priorities and turn shared ideas into practical action.

Drawing on contemporary suicide prevention frameworks, including the Black Dog Institute LifeSpan Framework, you will facilitate engagement, co-design and community development activities that strengthen suicide prevention capability and connections across the region.

You will work across diverse communities, including rural and remote areas, while supporting a strong focus on lived experience, cultural safety, collaboration and sustainable community-led change.

This role will include travel and overnight stays in rural locations around the Townsville region.

In this role you will:

  • Build strong partnerships across Townsville and surrounding communities to support a coordinated approach to suicide prevention
  • Lead co-design and community engagement with diverse stakeholders
  • Co-develop, implement and review Suicide Prevention Community Action Plans
  • Facilitate community-led initiatives that increase suicide prevention awareness and strengthen local connections
  • Develop and support local networks to build community capability and support people experiencing distress
  • Provide guidance on collective impact and systems-based approaches to suicide prevention
  • Engage rural and remote communities and support locally relevant suicide prevention initiatives
  • Lead program coordination, including reporting, data collection, evaluation, quality and continuous improvement
  • Foster a collaborative team culture based on shared accountability, learning and mutual support

What do you need?

  • Extensive experience in Community Development and/or Suicide Prevention
  • Relevant qualifications or commensurate experience in working in the mental health or community services sector, generally a minimum of Diploma qualification
  • Experience with program planning, development coordination and delivery
  • Current valid Driver’s Licence and the ability to undertake significant travel for the role including overnight stays in rural locations
  • Blue Card and NDIS Workers Screening Check (must have prior to commencement)
  • Right to Work within Australia and 100 Point ID
  • Satisfactory Police Records Check
  • International Police Check (if applicable)
  • NDIS Worker Orientation Module Certificate – Quality Safety and You

If you’re passionate about bringing communities together, building local capability and creating meaningful change in suicide prevention, we’d love to hear from you.

For a confidential discussion about the role, please contact Zenta Martin-Szpyt, Community Development Coordinator via email at smartinszpyt@wellways.org

Please submit your resume and cover letter, to view the full Position Description click APPLY!

Wellways is committed to the safeguarding of children and vulnerable people. Successful applicants must undergo a comprehensive screening process prior to their commencement.

Job Description Summary

Lead community-driven suicide prevention across Townsville, building partnerships, shaping local action and creating lasting change across the region.

Culture

We’re passionate about our work, which is enjoyable, challenging and rewarding. All of our teams work to ensure everyone can imagine and achieve their hopes and potential. We know that people are unique and the experts on their life and are not defined by impairments, diagnosis or labels. We aim to specifically promote safety and inclusivity for LGBTIQ+ and First Nations communities.

How to Apply

This is your opportunity to join a values based, growing, innovative and nationally recognised organisation with over 2,000 staff members across 93 sites.

Please select "Apply" below to complete your application.

Applications Close

title: Cloud engineer - Cloud Operations
description:
Cloud Engineer

Er du en ingeniør eller lignende med passion for teknologi og et stærkt ønske om at arbejde med levering af livsvigtige IT-systemer inden for sundhedssektoren? Vil du være en del af et team, der konstant udfordrer sig selv og driver innovation fremad?

Vi søger nu en engageret og teknisk dygtig cloud engineer til vores team i Cloud Operations. Her arbejder vi med avancerede cloud-baserede løsninger, der gør en forskel for patienter og sundhedspersonale verden over. Vi leder efter dig, der ønsker at vokse i et miljø, hvor din erfaring værdsættes, og hvor du får mulighed for at bidrage både strategisk og operationelt.

Hos Sectra udvikler vi IT-løsninger, der forbedrer diagnostik, behandling og patientoverlevelse, især inden for kræftbehandling. Som en del af vores team vil du arbejde tæt sammen med vores kunder – sundhedspersonale, hvis arbejde handler om at redde liv – for at sikre, at vores systemer holder den højest mulige kvalitet og ydeevne.

Jobbeskrivelse

Som cloud engineer hos os vil du:

  • Have ansvar for levering af vores SaaS-tjenester på en standardiseret og struktureret måde til kunder globalt.
  • Sikre driftssikkerhed og ydeevne i vores virtuelle systemer samt arbejde med løbende forbedring af vores løsninger gennem automatisering og optimering.
  • Arbejde i komplekse IT-miljøer, hvor viden om virtualisering, netværk, scripting og integrationer mellem sundhedssystemer er afgørende.

    Hos os får du mulighed for at arbejde med en blanding af daglig drift, langsigtet udvikling og spændende tekniske udfordringer. Du bliver en del af et erfarent og kompetent team, hvor videndeling, holdånd og samarbejde er i fokus.


    Lokation

    Denne rolle er baseret på vores kontor i Odense. Mulighed for internationale opgaver er tilgængelig for dig, der er interesseret i at arbejde i udlandet på både korte og længere opgaver.


    Dine primære arbejdsopgaver

    • Drift og optimering af virtuelle systemer med fokus på stabilitet og ydeevne.
    • Installation, vedligeholdelse og opgraderinger af Sectras medicinske IT-produkter.
    • Automatisering for at effektivisere processer og minimere manuelle fejl.
    • Fejlfinding og problemløsning for løbende at forbedre vores tjenester.

      Vi søger dig, der har

      • En Bachelor- eller kandidatgrad inden for Datateknik, Informations Teknologi, Medicoteknik eller tilsvarende.
      • Erfaring med at arbejde med cloud-baserede IT-løsninger og/eller komplekse IT-miljøer.
      • God viden om virtualisering, netværk, scripting og databasehåndtering.
      • En ægte interesse for teknologi og innovation samt en analytisk og løsningsorienteret tilgang.
      • Meget gode færdigheder i dansk og engelsk, både mundtligt og skriftligt.


        Erfaringer, der er en fordel

        • Kompetencer inden for IT-sikkerhed, virtuelle Windows- eller Linux-miljøer, MS SQL Server AlwaysOn, Active Directory, lagringsløsninger og MS Azure.
        • Erfaring med arbejde med automatisering og scripting.
        • Tidligere erfaring med at lede eller deltage i projekter i internationale miljøer.
        • Interesse eller engagement uden for arbejdet, f.eks. sport, musik eller frivilligt arbejde.


          Hvad vi tilbyder dig

          • Mulighed for at arbejde med avanceret teknologi, der gør en reel forskel for patienter og sundhedspersonale.
          • Et dynamisk og udviklende arbejdsmiljø med stor variation i arbejdsopgaver.
          • Muligheden for at påvirke din egen karriereudvikling og specialisere dig inden for områder, der interesserer dig.
          • Et team af engagerede og erfarne kolleger, der støtter og udfordrer dig.


            Ansøgning

            Vi behandler ansøgninger løbende. Venligst vedhæft dit CV og relevante karakterer fra universitetsstudier til din ansøgning.

            For visse roller gennemfører vi baggrundskontrol som en del af rekrutteringsprocessen. Kontakt den ansvarlige rekrutterer, hvis du har spørgsmål om dette.

            Gør en forskel sammen med os hos Sectra – vi ser frem til din ansøgning!

title: Virtual Assistant - Detroit
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Virtual Assistant - Detroit based in United States.

This fully remote opportunity is ideal for a proactive and highly organized professional who enjoys helping business owners and founders stay focused on their priorities.
You will support multiple clients across a diverse range of administrative, operational, and project-based activities.
From scheduling and email management to research, data entry, and lead conversion support, no two days are likely to look exactly the same.
You will take ownership of deadlines, coordinate projects, and adapt quickly as client priorities and business needs evolve.
Strong judgment and independent problem-solving will be essential, particularly when tasks are open-ended or require you to recommend the best path forward.
You will work in a collaborative, fast-growing environment where initiative, reliability, and clear communication are highly valued.
The position starts at approximately 20 hours per week, with the potential to grow toward full-time hours as the organization expands.

Accountabilities:

  • Manage projects and assignments on behalf of clients, taking ownership of timelines, deliverables, priorities, and deadlines.
  • Provide a broad range of virtual assistance, including scheduling, calendar coordination, email management, research, data entry, lead conversion management, and other administrative or project-based tasks.
  • Communicate professionally and proactively with clients, adapting communication style and approach to different personalities, priorities, business needs, and processes.
  • Monitor project progress and ensure assignments are completed accurately and within agreed turnaround times, typically one to two business days.
  • Organize multiple concurrent priorities while maintaining attention to detail and consistent follow-through.
  • Approach open-ended requests with initiative by assessing the situation, identifying potential solutions, and proposing a practical plan of action.
  • Use critical thinking to identify potential issues, recommend alternative priorities, and raise concerns when a project or client need may require a different approach.
  • Support efficient processes and contribute to the successful delivery of client work in a rapidly growing, service-oriented environment.

    • Requirements:

    • Previous experience in operations, administration, virtual assistance, project coordination, or a related role.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to tailor messaging and interactions to different clients and communication styles.
    • Self-starter mindset with the confidence to take ownership of ambiguous or open-ended assignments without requiring extensive direction.
    • Demonstrated ability to manage projects, processes, deadlines, and multiple competing priorities.
    • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, with a consistent focus on accuracy and timely execution.
    • Analytical and critical-thinking abilities, including the judgment to identify problems and suggest better approaches.
    • Ability to work independently while maintaining strong client relationships and effective communication.
    • Adaptability and professionalism when priorities, requirements, or deadlines change.
    • Comfortable working remotely and managing a flexible weekday-based schedule.
    • Reliable, responsive, and motivated to grow within a fast-paced and expanding organization.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote position available within the United States.
      • Flexible schedule that is largely weekday-based.
      • Starting workload of approximately 20 hours per week, with potential to increase to 40 hours per week as business needs grow.
      • Starting pay of $22 per hour.
      • Bonus opportunities of up to $10,000 annually.
      • Opportunities for career growth and increased responsibility as the organization expands.
      • Performance-based opportunities to increase earnings.
      • Work-life balance supported by flexible hours and remote working arrangements.
      • Inclusive environment committed to respect, diversity, and equal treatment for people from varied backgrounds and identities.

title: Kalder alle supersælgere! Circle K Klampenborg søger sælgere på ca. 20 timer om ugen
description:
Job Description

Kære fremtidige kollega.

Først og fremmest, lad os starte med at sige, at et job som Sælger hos Circle K ikke er for alle. Men det er et job der passer til mange, og måske også dig?

At arbejde som sælger på Circle K er ikke som ethvert sælgerjob. Os der arbejder her er vilde med det, og spørger du en af vores uundværlige sælgere om hvorfor, vil de bl.a. nævne: Selvstændighed, fleksibilitet og ansvar.

Vi leder efter en positiv teamplayer som:

  • Har en sælger gemt I sig, motiveres af salg og kan levere en service lidt ud over det sædvanlige
  • Kan bevare overblikket og humøret, når der kommer uforudsete udfordringer ind af døren, og formår at løse dem med sund fornuft. Også selvom der er lang kø
  • Har en interesse for at tilberede mad. For vi elsker det! Og vi ser derfor gerne, at du har lyst til, at lave de lækreste sandwich og de bedste burgere.
  • Forstår vigtigheden af, at vores kunder får den bedste oplevelse når de besøger os. Dette indebærer også at butikken, kundetoilet og forplads er ren og pæn.
  • Du forstår betydningen af, at arbejde i et team, hvor alle er afhængige af- og stoler på, at hver løfter sit. Og til tider er villig til at give lidt ekstra.

Hvad kan I tilbyde mig?

Vi er en dynamisk, handlingsorienteret organisation, hvor vi arbejder sammen som ét team. Vi tager ikke os selv alt for højtideligt og engagerer os ikke i politik eller bureaukrati. Vi værdsætter diversitet og forskellige måder at tænke og arbejde på.

Det er altafgørende at du har lysten og motivationen til at lære nye ting, udvikle dig og bidrage til vores ”one-team” kultur. Hvis du har ambitionen om at bygge en karriere, får du unikke muligheder i Circle K, så længe du har den motivation der skal til.

Udover helt unikke udviklingsmuligheder, tilbyder vi et job med yderst attraktive fordele og personalegoder. Som en del af vores Circle K familie vil du bl.a. få medarbejderrabat på brændstof, bilvask samt på mad og drikkevarer i vores butikker.

Derudover tilbyder vi:

  • En attraktiv pensionsordning og sundhedsforsikring
  • Fordelagtige lønninger og forskudttidstillæg
  • Og ikke mindst, Danmarks bedste kollegaer

Så hvis du vil have et job, hvor du kan være med til at give vores kunder den bedste oplevelse, udvikle dig og blive en del af et fantastisk team på Circle K i Klampenborg, så er det nu du skal sende din ansøgning afsted.

Hvis du har spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Store Manager Julie Molving på tlf. nr.: +45 39 64 25 84

Antal timer:

Ca.20 timer ugentligt

Arbejdstiden er placeret på tidspunkter, der betyder, at stillingen er forbeholdt ansøgere over 18 år og ikke egner sig som studiejob.

Vagtfordeling:
Fast vagtplan med dag/aften og weekendvagter.

Ansøgningsfrist og tiltrædelse:

Løbende

Som en del af rekrutteringsprocessen, indhenter vi referencer fra tidligere arbejdsgivere.

Hos os behøver du, hverken CV eller ansøgning for at søge job. Når du trykker på ”ansøg nu” kommer du til en portal, hvor du skal svare på nogle spørgsmål om forskellige arbejdssituationer, som samtidig giver dig et indblik i, hvordan det er at arbejde i Circle K.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Hos Circle K er der plads til alle og vi arbejder altid sammen som One team! Vi værdsætter diversitet og forskellige måder at tænke og arbejde på. Vi opfordrer derfor alle til at søge stillingen – uanset alder, køn, religion, handicap, etnisk baggrund etc.

LANDSCAPE EQUIPMENT MAINTENANCE SPECIALIST

The Four Seasons Resort Lāna’i is looking for a Landscape Equipment Maintenance Specialist who shares a passion for excellence and who infuses enthusiasm into everything they do. Our teams have the opportunity to shape our guest experience by providing exceptional knowledge of the Resort and exemplifying the Golden Rule in each interaction. Work authorization required.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

The Landscape Equipment Maintenance Specialist is responsible for maintaining, repairing, and optimizing landscape and grounds maintenance equipment to ensure safe, reliable, and efficient operation across the resort. This role manages preventative maintenance programs, equipment diagnostics, repairs, inventory control, and operator support while promoting workplace safety, operational excellence, and the longevity of company assets. Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:

  • Develop and manage a comprehensive preventive maintenance program for golf course and landscape equipment, including inspections, diagnostics, repairs, blade grinding and sharpening, adjustments, and performance optimization to ensure reliability and operational efficiency

  • Oversee the maintenance shop, tools, equipment, parts inventory, and repair records, ensuring proper organization, safe operation, and accurate tracking of maintenance activities and materials

  • Perform troubleshooting, repairs, and testing of powered equipment, collaborating with vendors and manufacturers as needed to minimize downtime and support uninterrupted operations

  • Train and mentor equipment operators on the proper use, care, and routine maintenance of equipment to promote safe, efficient, and effective operations

  • Support golf course and grounds maintenance operations as needed while ensuring all work is performed in accordance with safety standards and proper care of company assets

  • Maintain compliance with workplace safety policies and procedures, promoting a safe environment for team members and equipment operations

  • And More!

WHAT TO BRING

  • Successful candidate must possess legal work authorization in United States

  • The hospitality business functions seven (7) days a week, twenty-four (24) hours a day and scheduled days and times may vary based on need. Holidays and weekends availability is required.

  • Ability to stand for extended periods, lift up to 80 lbs, and push/pull as needed during shifts

  • Hawaii Driver’s License/Drivers Abstract is required for this role

  • Ability to work in a wide range of environmental and physical conditions

JOIN OUR ‘OHANA & ENJOY OUR AMAZING BENEFITS:

  • 100% Employer contributed Medical, Dental, and Vision benefits

  • Competitive wages and other benefits (Retirement Plan, Wellness Credit, etc) as well as Paid Time Off & Holiday Pay

  • Inclusive and diverse employee engagement & recognition events all year-round

  • Complimentary stays and exclusive discounts at Four Seasons Worldwide

  • Complimentary Employee Meals & Dry Cleaning for Employee Uniforms

  • Owner subsidized on-island housing, inter-island airfare to Oahu and other resources

  • Comprehensive learning and development programs to help you master your craft

  • Energizing Employee Culture where you are encouraged to be your true self!

  • And so much more!

We look forward to receiving your application!

title: Senior DevOps Engineer
description:
At U.S. Bank, we’re on a journey to do our best. Helping the customers and businesses we serve to make better and smarter financial decisions, enabling the communities we support to grow and succeed in the right ways, all more confidently and more often—that’s what we call the courage to thrive. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. A career with U.S. Bank gives you a wide, ever-growing range of opportunities to discover what makes you thrive. Try new things, learn new skills and discover what you excel at—all from Day One.

As a wholly owned subsidiary of U.S. Bank, Elavon is committed to building the platforms and ecosystems that help over 1.5 million customers around the world to achieve their financial goals—no matter what they need. From transaction processing to customer service, to driving innovation and launching new products, we’re building a range of tailored payment solutions powered by the latest technology. As part of our team, you can explore what motivates and energizes your career goals: partnering with our customers, our communities, and each other.

We actively uphold transparent and fair hiring practices that support individual opportunity, inclusive culture, and career mobility across all levels of our organisation.

We offer meaningful opportunities for growth, a culture of inclusion, and a strong commitment to transparency and integrity in everything we do.

Job Description

The Dev Ops Team is about ensuring all the Opayo Web Applications are delivered through Development, Test and Productions environments in an automated Continuous Delivery manner. Opayo is a high transactional environment and applications are available 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. The team ensures that the Opayo core applications are maintained, monitored and issues are responded to and resolved in line with departmental SLAs.

Key accountabilities and decision ownership:

  • Maintaining and supporting Opayo Payments Applications, using monitoring tools to detect failures and investigating/resolving issues and writing custom monitoring scripts

  • Working with the development teams to help design new products and architecting new solutions

  • Monitor Live environment to detect failures and investigate/resolve issues

  • Work closely with the Development & Test Teams to deploy software releases

  • Support production systems as required inside and outside of standard working hours.

  • Reducing the overhead of BAU and manual tasks and replacing them with automated solutions

  • Actively contributing to the process of continual improvement, with regard to self, team and the systems you support

  • Actively participating in departmental projects as per the technology roadmap

  • Working with 3rd parties and partners to ensure product compliance and stability


Skills, know-how and experience:

Must have:

  • Extensive experience of AWS

  • Extensive experience of scripting languages

  • Extensive experience of monitoring tools (SumoLogic, New Relic)

  • Extensive experience of automation tools (Puppet, Ansible, Terraform)

  • Extensive experience of working in a DevOps support model

  • Experience of working in a highly available, high transaction, production environment

  • Demonstrable experience communicating in a fast-paced, results-oriented, team-based environment

  • Preferred: Proven experience of payment gateways

Key performance indicators:

  • System uptime and downtime is in accordance with Operational SLAs

  • Ensure all releases follow defined processes and procedures

  • Participation in Oncall rota (additional on-call allowance)

  • Objectives achieved through scripts maintained in source control

  • Key stakeholders:

  • Operations, Database, Infrastructure and Network Teams

  • Agile scrum Teams.

  • Security Team.

Location:

The role offers a hybrid / flexible schedule, which means there's an in-office expectation of 3 or more days per week and the flexibility to work outside the office location for the other days.

Accessibility

We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruitment experience. If you need adjustments at any stage of the application or hiring process, please contact your recruiter for guidance and support.

Total Rewards

U.S. Bank is committed to fair, equitable, and transparent compensation practices in line with local regulatory and legal requirements. Our total rewards approach is designed to attract, retain, and support top talent while ensuring equal pay for work of equal value.

We offer a market-competitive compensation package that includes:

  • Clearly defined salary ranges aligned with industry benchmarks and internal equity standards.

  • Performance-based incentives for eligible employees (as defined by relevant plan rules), awarded through transparent, objective criteria that recognize both individual and company performance.

  • Inclusive equitable benefits that are accessible to all employees and focused around our 3 main pillars of financial wellbeing, health & wellness).

  • Continuous development opportunities including training, education support, and career progression pathways based on inclusive and transparent criteria.

  • Employee recognition programs that celebrate achievements and milestones for all.

We regularly review our compensation and benefits to ensure they remain competitive, inclusive, and responsive to employee needs and market trends. Further details of the compensation package will be provided upon application.

We encourage candidates to explore the full value of our offer, including monetary and non-monetary benefits, at Employee benefits and development | U.S. Bank | Elavon.

title: Junior Data Engineer
description:
Junior Data Engineer

Location: Amsterdam
Work model: On-site
Team: Data Quality & Finance Innovation

The opportunity

Are you excited about turning raw data into reliable, useful information? Do you have foundational experience with SQL, data pipelines, or business-intelligence environments and want to develop those skills in a commercial setting?

Creative Clicks is looking for a Junior Data Engineer to join our five-person Data Quality & Finance Innovation team. You will help maintain and improve the data infrastructure supporting our reporting, financial processes, and business decision-making.

Working alongside Data Engineers, Software Developers, Finance Automation Specialists, and Data Analysts, you will learn how data supports performance marketing and e-commerce businesses operating at scale.

This is an opportunity to develop your technical skills, gain commercial domain knowledge, and gradually take ownership of data pipelines and integrations.

What your day will look like

Your work will combine technical focus time with collaboration across different business teams. You will help translate business requirements into technical tasks, maintain existing data structures, and contribute to new data solutions.

You will receive guidance from experienced colleagues while taking increasing ownership of your work.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • Building, maintaining, and optimizing ETL and data pipelines.

  • Supporting the development and maintenance of our data warehouse.

  • Mapping and integrating data from multiple internal and external sources.

  • Writing and improving SQL queries and stored procedures.

  • Helping design data structures for reporting and analytics.

  • Building automated controls to monitor data quality and integrity.

  • Investigating performance issues and supporting troubleshooting.

  • Contributing to AI-enabled solutions within our data warehouse and reporting environment.

  • Preparing and maintaining clear technical documentation.

  • Supporting reliable data delivery to analytical models, dashboards, and reports.

  • Sharing ideas and learning from colleagues through technical discussions and project reviews.

What you bring

  • A bachelor’s or master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

  • Foundational knowledge of SQL, relational databases, and data modelling.

  • An understanding of ETL processes and data pipelines.

  • Some practical experience gained through employment, an internship, academic projects, or personal projects.

  • An interest in cloud-based data environments and modern data engineering.

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Attention to detail and an appreciation for accurate, reliable data.

  • The ability to communicate with both technical and non-technical colleagues.

  • A proactive attitude and willingness to ask questions, learn, and improve.

  • The ability to work independently while contributing to a collaborative team.

Nice to have

You do not need to meet every point, but experience with any of the following would be valuable:

  • Microsoft Azure or another cloud platform such as AWS or Google Cloud.

  • Microsoft SQL Server and the wider Microsoft data stack.

  • Python or another programming language used for data processing.

  • Power BI or another business-intelligence platform.

  • Database performance concepts such as indexing, backups, monitoring, and quality checks.

  • AI or machine-learning capabilities within cloud or data environments.

  • Performance marketing, e-commerce, or financial reporting data.

What we offer

  • A fast-growing, international environment with 25+ nationalities

  • Competitive salary

  • NS Business Card (commuting costs fully covered)

  • 25 vacation days, plus the option to buy 10 more

  • Hybrid work setup and a healthy work-life balance

  • Fresh lunch daily at the office

  • Dutch lessons covered by us

  • Learning opportunities to expand your finance and cross-departmental knowledge

  • A young, ambitious team and a beautifully renovated office just 2 minutes from Leidseplein

  • A culture that values ownership, speed, collaboration, and continuous improvement

Eligibility

Applicants must currently live in the Netherlands and already have authorization to work in the Netherlands.

Creative Clicks is unable to provide visa sponsorship or relocation support for this position.

title: Principal Systems Engineer
description:
Leidos is seeking a Principal Systems Engineer (LEAD) to join the Air Traffic Business Area within the Homeland Sector, supporting the development of the Leidos Common Automation Platform (L-CAP). L-CAP is a mission-critical, future-ready automation platform built on a hybrid cloud data mesh architecture, enabling next-generation air traffic management capabilities. You will lead systems engineering across a four-ART engineering organization, providing technical governance for requirements, interfaces, integration, verification, and safety analysis. We are building with an AI-first engineering mindset, embracing emerging AI capabilities and modern development practices to accelerate delivery, improve software quality, and continuously evolve how we design and build mission-critical systems. This position supports government programs and requires the ability to obtain and maintain a favorable Public Trust investigation.

This role is part of a growing program, and hiring will depend on available funding. We review applications on a rolling basis, but the timeline for interviews and offers may vary. In some cases, we may extend contingent offers that become active once funding is confirmed.

This position is located in Gaithersburg, MD; Egg Harbor Township, NJ; or Eagan, MN. This is an opportunity to contribute to projects that impact millions of air travelers.

This is a hybrid position requiring 3 days onsite and 2 days remote work. Candidates should reside a commutable distance to one of the above locations.

What You'll Do

  • Lead cross-program systems engineering activities across four ARTs

  • Establish and govern requirements management processes and standards

  • Define and manage interface control documents and integration specifications

  • Develop verification and validation (V&V) strategy and execution plans

  • Maintain requirements traceability from stakeholder needs through implementation

  • Lead system integration planning and execution across the platform

  • Conduct safety analysis including hazard identification and mitigation

  • Support certification activities and regulatory compliance evidence

  • Define and enforce SE process standards and best practices

  • Lead technical reviews including SRR, PDR, CDR, and TRR

  • Ensure cross-ART architectural consistency by establishing shared systems engineering standards and interface governance

  • Lead modernization planning from a systems engineering perspective including decomposition strategies and transition sequencing

  • Govern interfaces between legacy and modernized services maintaining technical coherence across the program

  • Champion an AI-first engineering culture by identifying and applying AI-assisted development capabilities, automation, and emerging software engineering practices that improve developer productivity, code quality, testing, and delivery.

Core Technical Qualifications:

  • Bachelor's degree with 12+ years of relevant experience or Master's degree and 10+ years of experience or equivalent experience.

  • Systems engineering leadership for large-scale, complex programs

  • Requirements management expertise including decomposition and allocation

  • Verification and validation planning and execution at the enterprise level

  • Interface management across multiple subsystems and teams

  • MBSE and SysML modeling experience for complex system architectures

  • System integration planning and execution for distributed platforms

  • Safety-critical systems engineering including hazard and risk analysis

  • Aviation or defense domain systems engineering experience

  • Proficiency with DOORS, Jama, or equivalent requirements management tools

  • Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance; US citizenship required; subject to government background investigation

  • Experience ensuring architectural consistency across multiple development teams or release trains

  • Demonstrated leadership in systems engineering for large-scale modernization programs

  • ​Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust

  • U.S. citizenship required

  • Successful completion of background investigations as required by the government customer

Preferred / Desired Qualifications

  • FAA certification experience (DO-178C, DO-254, DO-278A)

  • DO-178 and DO-254 compliance and evidence development

  • INCOSE Certified Systems Engineering Professional (CSEP)

  • Large program SE leadership across 100+ engineers

  • Model-based systems engineering approaches

  • Formal verification and validation methods

  • Experience governing interfaces between legacy and modernized services in complex system-of-systems environments

Why Leidos?

You’ll work on systems where performance, precision, and reliability matter — every second. This is not experimental AI for prototypes. This is disciplined, responsible AI applied to mission-critical software that supports national infrastructure.

If you’re excited by solving complex problems in regulated, real-world environments — and using AI as a force multiplier rather than a shortcut — we’d like to talk.

ATMC

If you're looking for comfort, keep scrolling. At Leidos, we outthink, outbuild, and outpace the status quo — because the mission demands it. We're not hiring followers. We're recruiting the ones who disrupt, provoke, and refuse to fail. Step 10 is ancient history. We're already at step 30 — and moving faster than anyone else dares.

We are growing - Join our Defence division at Service Stream supporting the PAS contract

We are proud to become a new Australian Department of Defence partner, offering career opportunities to support the delivery of Property and Asset Services across South Australia and the Northern Territory.

We are hiring an Estate Upkeep (EU) Supervisor to support us in this contract. This will be offered as a permanent full-time position based at Larrakeyah Defence Precinct and report to the PAS Manager.

About us

Service Stream is an equal opportunity ASX-listed business that develops and operates Australia's essential services networks across telecommunications, utilities, transport, defence, and social infrastructure industries - we keep communities connected.

Your next role comes with these perks:

  • Career development – we offer growth opportunities and support internal mobility. You will have access to skill enhancement through our online learning system and onsite training. Mentoring and leadership development programs may also be available.

  • Access - discounts for hundreds of businesses such as Woolworths, Air BNB, The Iconic, JB HI-FI, Dan Murphys, Bupa Health Care, and Specsavers. We also offer access to novated leasing and a share matching program.

About the role

You will lead and manage the EU function across the Defence Base. This role involves the oversight of both in-house teams and external contractors to ensure the upkeep and maintenance of the estate are conducted to the highest standards. You will also ensure that service level agreement (SLA) requirements are understood and met, ensuring a safe and efficient working environment.

Your key responsibilities will include:

  • Leading the Estate Upkeep function across the designated Base Security Areas.

  • Managing and coordinating teams of in-house staff and external contractors.

  • Issuing permits-to-work as required, ensuring compliance with safety and operational regulations.

  • Ensuring SLA requirements are both understood and met across the areas of responsibility.

  • Maintaining accurate records and reports related to estate upkeep activities.

  • Collaborating with the PAS Base Manager to develop and implement maintenance schedules and plans.

  • Identifying and addressing any maintenance issues promptly and efficiently.

  • Ensuring compliance with all relevant health, safety, and environmental regulations.

  • Identifying areas for process improvement and work collaboratively with teams to implement best practices.

About you

Our ideal candidate will have:

  • Proven experience in a supervisory role within estate upkeep or similar facilities management environment.

  • Strong knowledge of safety regulations and experience in issuing permits-to-work.

  • Experience in managing both in-house teams and external contractors.

  • Excellent communication and organisational skills.

  • Proficiency in using maintenance management systems and software.

  • Relevant qualifications in facilities management, property maintenance, or a trade related field are highly desirable.

You must be an Australian Citizen and able to obtain and maintain a Defence Security Clearance.

Job Description:

NETWORK ENGINEER

Position Overview

Transform technology into opportunity as a Network Engineer with GDIT. A career in enterprise IT means connecting, securing, and elevating the systems that matter most. At GDIT, you’ll be at the forefront of innovation and play a meaningful part in how federal agencies operate. In this role, you will support the Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) Information Operations Enterprise Enclave (IOEE) and Information Operations Secure Enterprise Enclave (IOSEE) Engineering Support Services program in Springfield, VA. This is a hybrid position with onsite requirements once per week at minimum, plus onsite support at the DLA facility for SIPR-related tasks.

How You Will Make an Impact

  • Planning, executing, and documenting comprehensive laboratory assessments of hardware, software, and configuration changes that could affect the DLA network or interconnectivity across cloud, core, and remote sites. This includes conducting evaluations of emerging security solutions and traffic‑management technologies.
  • Coordinating with government customers to develop Technology Assessment Plans, Change Implementation Plans (CIP), Enterprise Change Requests (ECR) including objectives, technical approach, procedures, schedules, roles and responsibilities.
  • Preparing detailed After Action Reports documenting approach, results, and recommendations.
  • Identifying emerging network capabilities and developing evaluation and selection criteria.
  • Developing system evaluation methods, testing approaches, and technical documentation while leveraging DLA’s network monitoring systems.
  • Producing formal engineering documentation for executive-level briefings.
  • Ensuring interoperability between DLA WAN and DISN network systems.
  • Planning and tracking implementation tasks, creating network maps, detailed designs, test plans, ORT reports, device configurations, and procedures.
  • Defining network requirements, analyzing telecommunications needs, and collaborating with IT professionals to implement network services.
  • Developing alternative solutions and backup plans with functional users.
  • Providing constructive feedback and identifying configuration and/or routing improvements to lead and senior engineers for consideration and implementation.

What You’ll Need to Succeed

  • Active Secret clearance with SSBI (Tier 5) or Top-Secret clearance.
  • Minimum of three (3) years of relevant network engineering experience.
  • Required Certifications: CCNA and IAT Level II compliant certification (Security+, CySA+, SSCP, GSEC, CCNA Security, CND, or GICSP).
  • Preferred Certifications: CCNP Enterprise, Check Point CCSA.
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in lieu of degree.
  • Strong knowledge of LAN/WAN protocols, including but not limited to OSPF, BGP, MPLS, LDP, STIG compliance, routing/switching, and multi-vendor network devices.
  • Experience with wired, wireless, voice, and video technologies.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects, provide updates, and meet onsite requirements.
  • Hybrid schedule: onsite once weekly at minimum in Vienna, VA and DLA HQ as needed.
  • Possession of a U.S. passport or ability to obtain one within 60 days.

title: Vil du være med til at opbygge og udvikle Coors pricing-område?
description:
Coor søger en erfaren Pricing Controller til en nyoprettet rolle, hvor du får ansvaret for at etablere og udvikle vores tilgang til pricing og indeksering.

Du bliver drivkraften bag udviklingen af et mere struktureret og datadrevet pricing-setup og får en central rolle i at sikre, at prisjusteringer, mark-up, fees & charges samt øvrige kommercielle muligheder håndteres ensartet og værdiskabende på tværs af organisationen.

Rollen er for dig, der motiveres af at bygge noget op, skabe overblik i komplekse sammenhænge og omsætte analyser til konkrete resultater.

Om rollen

Som Pricing Controller får du ansvaret for at etablere processer, governance og samarbejdsstrukturer inden for pricing og årlige prisjusteringer. Du skal sikre, at kontraktuelle muligheder for prisregulering identificeres og udnyttes, samtidig med at du skal udvikle en mere strategisk tilgang til prissætning.

Du driver den periodiske indeksering på tværs af organisationen, følger op på resultaterne og analyserer effekten. Derudover får du en central rolle i at etablere og facilitere Pricing Councils med deltagere fra drift, Commercial og Finance for at sikre fælles beslutninger og en ensartet implementering af aftalte prisstrategier.

Dine primære ansvarsområder

  • Udvikle og implementere prissætningsstrategier på tværs af Coor
  • Etablere og drive en fælles pricing- og indekseringsproces
  • Drive periodisk indeksering og systematisk opfølgning
  • Analysere effekten af indeksering og understøtte forretningsmæssige beslutninger
  • Fastsætte rammer for priser, mark-up, og fees & charges
  • Sikre effektive processer for opdatering af priser i relevante systemer
  • Skabe fælles forståelse for cost-strukturer på tværs af Commercial, Finance og drift
  • Udvikle retningslinjer for indekseringsmekanismer til forskellige kundetyper
  • Drive Pricing Councils og styrke samarbejdet mellem drift, Commercial og Finance

Din profil

Vi søger en selvstændig profil med solid erfaring inden for pricing eller beslægtede områder. Du har lyst til at tage ejerskab for et område med stort potentiale og trives med at skabe struktur, retning og resultater.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Har erfaring fra en rolle inden for pricing, commercial excellence, revenue management eller lignende
  • Kan drive udvikling og forankring af processer i en kompleks organisation
  • Har stærke stakeholder management-kompetencer
  • Forstår sammenhængen mellem kontraktvilkår, økonomi, og kommercielle muligheder
  • Er pragmatisk og handlekraftig
  • Har gennemslagskraft og evner at udfordre forretningen konstruktivt

Det bliver du en del af

Du får en nøglerolle i udviklingen af pricing-området og bliver en vigtig del af arbejdet med at styrke vores prisbeslutninger, indekseringsprocesser og kommercielle muligheder. Rollen refererer til Head of Business Finance under CFO.

Vi tilbyder

I denne nyoprettede stilling får du mulighed for at sætte dit præg på et strategisk vigtigt område med stor betydning for forretningen. Du får stor selvstændighed og mulighed for at skabe resultater i tæt samarbejde med Commercial, Finance og drift. Samtidig får du en alsidig rolle, hvor du arbejder med pricing og indeksering på både strategisk, taktisk og operationelt niveau.

Er du vores nye Pricing Controller?

Hvis du motiveres af at bygge noget op, skabe struktur og omsætte analyser til forretningsværdi, vil vi meget gerne høre fra dig.

title: Begeleider - Ambulant Specialistisch Team | Gehandicaptenzorg
description:
24-32 uur | Amsterdam | Salaris tot €3.635,-

Fiets door Amsterdam en maak dagelijks impact als Ambulant Begeleider. Werk zelfstandig, bouw echte relaties op en help cliënten grip te houden op hun leven. Elke dag anders, altijd betekenisvol.

Jouw rol als Amstadammer

Als Begeleider in het Ambulant Specialistisch Team (AST) ondersteun je Amsterdammers met een licht verstandelijke beperking en bijkomende problematiek bij zelfstandig wonen. Jij bent een vast gezicht in hun dagelijks leven en helpt hen om grip te houden op situaties die soms ingewikkeld zijn. Met jouw rustige en duidelijke aanpak bouw je vertrouwen op, ook bij cliënten die zorg soms vermijden. Je weet wanneer je meebeweegt en wanneer je grenzen aangeeft. Geen dag is hetzelfde: je werkt op verschillende plekken in de stad en sluit aan bij wat iemand nodig heeft. Dit doe jij door:

  • Mee te gaan naar afspraken, zoals bij artsen, instanties of dagbesteding.

  • Cliënten te ondersteunen bij contact met bijvoorbeeld woningbouw, gemeente of schulddienstverlening.

  • Signalen op te vangen in de thuissituatie en hier passend op te reageren.

  • Bij te dragen aan een veilige en stabiele leefomgeving, ook als situaties chaotisch zijn.

  • Actief af te stemmen met het netwerk van de cliënt, zoals familie en andere betrokkenen, zodat begeleiding goed op elkaar aansluit.

Hier gebeurt het

Je werkt binnen het Ambulant Specialistisch Team (AST) van Amsta en begeleidt cliënten verspreid door Amsterdam en omgeving. Contactmomenten vinden plaats bij cliënten thuis of op onze locatie Polderweg in Amsterdam-Oost. Je komt terecht in een open en betrokken team van 10 collega’s. Iedereen werkt zelfstandig, maar collega’s weten elkaar makkelijk te vinden. Tijdens de tweewekelijkse multidisciplinaire overleggen (MDO’s) worden complexe situaties gezamenlijk besproken en wordt kennis gedeeld. Je werkt vooral tijdens kantoortijden. Avond- en weekenddiensten horen niet bij deze functie. Daarnaast krijg je veel vrijheid om zelf je agenda in te delen en je werkweek in te vullen.

Daarom pas jij bij Amsta

Je staat stevig in je schoenen en blijft rustig in onvoorspelbare situaties. Tegelijk ben je benaderbaar en weet je makkelijk contact te maken met cliënten. Daarnaast heb je:

  • Een mbo-3 of mbo-4 diploma in zorg of welzijn, zoals (Persoonlijk) Begeleider Maatschappelijke Zorg of Sociaal Werk.

  • Ervaring met het begeleiden van cliënten met een licht verstandelijke beperking en bijkomend problematiek zoals psychiatrie, verslaving of schulden.

  • Het vermogen om zelfstandig te werken en je eigen werk goed te plannen.

  • Ervaring in het opbouwen van vertrouwen en het stimuleren van zelfstandigheid.

  • Een praktische instelling en het vermogen om snel te schakelen als situaties veranderen.

Zo zorgen wij voor jou

Bij Amsta zorgen we dat jij je werk goed kunt doen én gezond blijft. Jij zorgt met aandacht voor anderen en wij zorgen met aandacht voor jou. Dat merk je in alles wat we je bieden:

  • Je start met een jaarcontract; zijn we allebei enthousiast, dan zetten we samen de stap naar een vast contract.

  • Salaris tot €3.635,- bruto per maand op basis van 36 uur (FWG 35, cao Gehandicaptenzorg).

  • 8% vakantiegeld en 8,33% eindejaarsuitkering, plus reiskostenvergoeding en pensioenopbouw via PFZW.

  • Ruimte om door te groeien en jezelf verder te ontwikkelen met opleidingen en trainingen die bij jouw ambities passen.

  • Vitaliteit: boost je energie en welzijn via ons Zorg voor jou-platform, met online groepssessies zoals mindfulness, meditatie en ademhaling, en masterclasses over voeding, emoties en financieel welzijn.

  • Voor jou als Amstadammer: een werkplek waar werk en privé goed in balans zijn, met plezier en ruimte voor persoonlijke ontwikkeling.

  • Gezond werken, gezond leven! Profiteer van een fietsplan, korting op je zorgverzekering én een Preventief Medisch Onderzoek voor een volledige check-up.

  • Een warme, liefdevolle organisatie waar je jezelf kunt zijn en waarin iedereen telt.

Amsta: zorgen op zijn Amsterdams

Amsta is een Amsterdamse zorginstelling, met locaties door de hele stad. We ondersteunen Amsterdammers die hulp nodig hebben, vooral ouderen en mensen met complexe zorgvragen. Dat doen we liefdevol en met oprechte aandacht voor wat elke bewoner of cliënt nodig heeft. Werken nauw samen met familie, naasten en vrijwilligers.

Als Amstadammer kun je rekenen op uitdagend en afwisselend werk, waarin je blijft leren en groeien. Want bij Amsta is veel kennis en expertise. Bijvoorbeeld over mensen met dementie, een verstandelijke beperking of ouderen met lichamelijke en/of psychische problemen. Zo is er altijd een baan die echt bij jou past.

Bij Amsta kan iedereen zichzelf zijn. Cliënten en bewoners, maar ook jíj als Amstadammer. Je achtergrond, karakter, lef en creativiteit doen ertoe. We geloven in jouw warme, persoonlijke en professionele aanpak

Enthousiast?

Leuk! Solliciteer dan nu en word ook Amstadammer. Wij ontvangen graag je CV en een motivatiebrief. En daarna?
⇾ Je hoort binnen 3 werkdagen iets van ons.

⇾ De eerste kennismaking is telefonisch met onze Recruiter Darmine Marcera-Wallé.

⇾ Het eerste gesprek op locatie is met de medewerkers van het Ambulant Specialistisch Team.

⇾ Het tweede gesprek op locatie is met onze Clustermanager Ymkje van der Meer.

⇾ Er volgt een arbeidsvoorwaardengesprek.

⇾ Je gaat starten. Welkom bij Amsta!

Twijfel je of heb je nog vragen?

Laat het ons weten! Mail dan gerust naar d.walle@amsta.nl.

Het aanleveren van een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) en het opvragen van een referentie zijn onderdeel van de selectieprocedure.

Met deze vacature willen wij zelf onze nieuwe collega werven. Acquisitie door werving- en selectie-, detachering- of uitzendbureaus wordt daarom niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Dokumentointi-insinööri
description:
Haluatko yhdistää teknisen osaamisesi ja selkeän viestinnän? Etsimme Kokkolaan dokumentointi-insinööriä vahvistamaan teknisen dokumentoinnin asiantuntijatiimiämme. Työskentelet osana asiantuntijaorganisaatiota, joka tuottaa dokumentaatiota maailman johtaville kone- ja laitevalmistajille.

Työskentely tapahtuu joustavasti sekä etänä että paikan päällä tarpeidemme mukaan. Työtehtävät edellyttävät ajoittaista läsnäoloa asiakkaan tai Etteplanin tiloissa Kokkolassa.

Dokumentointi-insinöörinä vastaat asiakkaidemme tuotteisiin ja järjestelmiin liittyvän teknisen dokumentaation tuottamisesta, ylläpidosta ja kehittämisestä. Varmistat, että dokumentaatio on laadukasta, ajantasaista ja käyttäjien tarpeita vastaavaa. Tuotat käyttö- ja huolto-ohjeita, varaosakirjoja sekä muuta laitteiden ja järjestelmien elinkaarta tukevaa sisältöä eri kohderyhmille, kuten loppukäyttäjille ja huolto-organisaatioille.

Työssäsi perehdyt asiakkaidemme tuotteisiin, teknisiin ratkaisuihin ja toimintaympäristöihin. Keräät tietoa suunnittelijoilta ja muilta asiantuntijoilta sekä jalostat sen selkeiksi, helposti hyödynnettäviksi dokumenteiksi. Osallistut myös dokumentointikäytäntöjen kehittämiseen, dokumentointiprojektien työmäärien ja aikataulujen arviointiin sekä dokumentaation laadun ja yhdenmukaisuuden varmistamiseen. Hyödynnät työssäsi moderneja dokumentointimenetelmiä ja mahdollisuuksien mukaan myös tekoälyratkaisuja.

Työskentelet itsenäisesti, mutta tiiviissä yhteistyössä asiakkaidemme, suunnittelijoidemme ja kansainvälisen dokumentointiverkostomme kanssa. Tehtävässä menestyminen edellyttää kykyä ymmärtää teknisiä kokonaisuuksia ja muokata niistä selkeää, käyttäjälähtöistä sisältöä.

Odotamme sinulta

·Soveltuvaa teknistä koulutusta, esimerkiksi insinöörin tai diplomi-insinöörin tutkintoa

·Vähintään kahden vuoden kokemusta vastaavista tehtävistä

·Kokemusta teknisestä dokumentoinnista tai ohjedokumentaation tuottamisesta

·Erinomaista suomen ja englannin kielen kirjallista ja suullista taitoa

·Hyviä yhteistyö- ja vuorovaikutustaitoja sekä oma-aloitteista ja ratkaisukeskeistä työotetta

·Kykyä arvioida työmäärä-, aikataulu- ja kustannusvaikutuksia sekä toimia eri suunnittelualojen asiantuntijoiden kanssa

·Järjestelmällistä ja huolellista työskentelytapaa

·Sujuvaa tietojärjestelmien käyttöä sekä kykyä omaksua uusia ohjelmistoja nopeasti

Eduksi katsomme

·Käytännön kokemuksen kone-, ajoneuvo- tai automaatiotekniikasta

·Kokemuksen rakenteisesta dokumentaatiosta ja siihen liittyvistä työkaluista

·XML-kielen osaamisen ja DITA-standardin tuntemuksen

·Kokemuksen tekoälyn hyödyntämisestä teknisen sisällön tuottamisessa

·Kokemuksen sisällönhallintajärjestelmistä, Adobe FrameMakerista tai vastaavista työkaluista

·Kuvankäsittelyosaamisen

Tarjoamme sinulle

Etteplanilla pääset työskentelemään monipuolisissa ja mielenkiintoisissa asiakasprojekteissa eri teollisuuden toimialoilla. Tarjoamme kansainvälisen työympäristön, osaavan asiantuntijaverkoston tuen sekä mahdollisuuden kehittää osaamistasi teknisen dokumentoinnin, rakenteisen sisällöntuotannon ja uusien teknologioiden parissa.

Työnkierto on meillä arkipäivää, joten pääset osallistumaan erilaisiin projekteihin kiinnostuksesi ja osaamisesi mukaan. Tarjoamme vakituisen työsuhteen, joustavat työajat sekä kattavat henkilöstöedut. Panostamme henkilöstömme hyvinvointiin, osaamisen kehittämiseen ja työn sekä vapaa-ajan tasapainoon.

Palkkasi määräytyy osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella. Tässä tehtävässä tyypillinen kuukausipalkka on 3 200-4 100 euroa.

Tule osaksi menestystarinaamme ja hae mukaan jo tänään. Käymme hakemuksia läpi hakuaikana ja täytämme tehtävän heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Team Manager Antti Ojala, antti.ojala@etteplan.com.

title: Advisor, Digital Investing, BMO SmartFolio
