title: winkelmedewerker
description:
dit ga je doen


Als winkelmedewerker bij HEMA is geen dag hetzelfde. Je helpt klanten met een glimlach, zorgt dat de winkel er aantrekkelijk uitziet en staat klaar bij de (zelfscan)kassa. Van het presenteren van nieuwe collecties tot een gezellig praatje over de actie van de week – jij maakt HEMA echt. Je werkt samen met een energiek team, denkt mee over verbeteringen en draagt bij aan een fijne sfeer. Van de eerste tot de laatste klant: jij zorgt dat iedereen zich welkom voelt in jouw HEMA.

dit bieden wij


Bij HEMA krijg je meer dan alleen een salaris dat past bij je leeftijd en het aantal uren dat je werkt. Je wordt onderdeel van een bekend en geliefd merk, waar je samenwerkt met gedreven collega’s in een fijne werkomgeving. Je werkt in een team dat samen wil groeien – met ruimte voor jouw ideeën. En of je nu parttime werkt of bijna fulltime aan de slag gaat: we stemmen je uren af in overleg. Daarnaast krijg je bij HEMA:
  • 💸 Een goed salaris passend bij jouw kennis en ervaring.
  • 🛍️ 15% personeelskorting op al je HEMA-favorieten – van tompoucen tot Takkie-knuffels.
  • 🌴 Vakantie en verlof: 8% vakantiegeld en voldoende vakantie per jaar om lekker op te laden.
  • 🚀 Leren & ontwikkelen: volop kansen om jezelf te ontwikkelen, met trainingen en hulp van je collega’s.
  • 💚 Gezondheid & energie: we zorgen dat jij lekker in je vel zit, ook op drukkere dagen.

dit breng je mee


Je houdt van mensen en wilt klanten echt helpen. Je bent nieuwsgierig, durft initiatief te nemen en krijgt energie van samenwerken. Je hebt gevoel voor service én voor verkopen. Ook als het druk is, blijf je vriendelijk en betrokken. Je ziet kansen en pakt ze, durft te leren van feedback en draagt actief bij aan een goede werksfeer. Kortom: je kijkt verder dan je takenlijstje en bent graag van waarde – voor de klant én je team.

jij maakt HEMA echt


Bij HEMA werken we met ruim 17.000 collega’s aan een beter alledaags leven in een mooiere wereld. Met producten die praktischer, mooier, beter zijn en ook nog eens langer meegaan. Én met kleurrijke winkels in dorpen, steden en online. We zijn trots op hoe ver we zijn gekomen, maar we zijn nog niet tevreden. HEMA is weer écht HEMA en klaar voor de volgende stap. Onze ambitie? Koploper worden in een uitdagende markt. Dat doen we samen, als één team, met trotse collega’s, ondernemers en partners. Door te spelen om te winnen. Dat betekent dat je nieuwsgierig bent, kansen grijpt, met plezier samenwerkt en altijd gaat voor het beste resultaat. Je durft jezelf uit te spreken en anderen uit te dagen om samen beter te worden. Jij kunt met jouw unieke bijdrage meebouwen aan het HEMA van morgen. Jij maakt HEMA echt. Doe je mee?

title: Quant Data Engineer
description:
About BestEx Research:

BestEx Research is a U.S.-based financial technology and research firm headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut, with offices in the United Kingdom, India and Armenia. The firm specializes in building sophisticated execution algorithms and transaction cost modeling tools servicing multiple asset classes. The firm provides its services to performance-demanding hedge funds, CTAs, asset managers, and banks through a traditional electronic broker and in a broker-neutral Software as a Service (SaaS) model.

BestEx Research’s mission is to become the leader in automation and measurement of execution across asset classes globally and significantly reduce transaction costs for our clients.

Its cloud-based platform, Algo Management System (AMS), is the first end-to-end algorithmic trading solution for equities, futures, and foreign exchange that delivers an entire ecosystem around execution algorithms, including transaction cost analysis (TCA), an algo customization tool called Strategy Studio, a trading dashboard, and pre-trade analytics in a single platform. The platform is currently live for US equity and global futures trading.

BestEx Research is disrupting a $100 billion industry by challenging the status quo of stale, black-box solutions from banks and offering next-generation execution algorithms that combine performance improvement with transparency and customization. BestEx Research uses leading-edge technology to support its low-latency, highly scalable research and trading systems with its back end in C++, research libraries in C++/Python and R, and web-based technologies for delivering its front-end platforms.

Visit for more information about our mission, products, research, and services.

Why Join Us?

BestEx Research’s Bangalore office is not an “offshore center.” It’s a core engineering and research hub - working on the exact same problems and projects as our U.S. team. You’ll be part of the global brain trust, solving some of the hardest problems in trading, systems, and data science.

What You’ll Love:

  • Zero bureaucracy, zero silos—engineers directly collaborate with traders, researchers, and the CEO.
  • Direct ownership and end-to-end visibility on production systems.
  • Daily opportunity to learn from pioneers in HFT, low-latency systems, and algo trading.
  • A high-trust environment where performance speaks louder than hierarchy.
  • Competitive compensation in India, including equity and cash bonuses

Location: Bengaluru, India

Our beautiful Bengaluru office is conveniently located in Prestige Tech Park, Outer Ring Road, Marathahalli Road, Bangalore. Amenities include modern work spaces, free parking, recreational games, and free meals.

Your Role: Build What Most Engineers Never Get to Touch

As a Quantitative Data Engineer, you will be a key contributor to the team responsible for our core data ecosystem. You will work alongside experienced practitioners to build robust data pipelines, design efficient database schemas, and maintain the mission-critical infrastructure that handles tick-by-tick market data and execution logs. This is an opportunity to contribute to scalable, performance-optimized systems within the high-stakes environment of algorithmic trading.

At BestEx Research, our data engineers are deeply integrated into the research lifecycle. You will have the chance to develop a specialized understanding of global market microstructure, algorithmic execution, and performance measurement. At BestEx Research, data engineers are nested within a talented team of experts and practitioners in the field and may participate in writing research papers and interface closely with client research teams to improve trading costs. Your day to day responsibilities in this role can include, but are not limited to:

What You’ll Work On

  • Design, build, and optimize high-throughput data pipelines using Python, R, and PostgreSQL to handle market and execution data.
  • Build and manage robust, scheduled data workflows using tools like Airflow/Dagster to ensure 24/7 data availability for global markets.
  • Monitor pipeline health, debug data discrepancies in logs, and implement automated data-quality checks.
  • Build and maintain REST API-based applications to serve analytics and performance metrics to both internal trading systems and external client interfaces.
  • Partner with Senior Quants and Product Managers to translate complex TCA research into production-grade features and custom client analyses.

Requirements

  • Experience: 1 - 4 Years
  • A highly motivated self-starter mindset with the ability to take end-to-end ownership of data products.
  • BTech/MTech in Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics or a related quantitative field.
  • Expert in Python (Numpy, Pandas, Polars, Multiprocessing etc) and advanced PostgreSQL (complex joins, window functions, and query optimization).
  • Hands-on experience building and orchestrating pipelines (e.g., Airflow, Dagster, Prefect).
  • Strong foundation in applied statistics. Ability to form hypotheses, analyze idiosyncratic order flow, and validate results with statistical significance.
  • Ability to translate complex technical or statistical findings into clear insights for Senior Quants and clients.
  • Strong analytical problem-solving skills.
  • Good Communication Skills.

Bonus Points For:

  • Experience building REST APIs (FastAPI, Django) to serve data at scale.
  • Exposure to C++ or low-latency environment concepts.
  • Familiarity with R for research and visualization.
  • Prior experience in fintech, electronic trading, or a data-heavy research environment is highly valued.
  • Exposure to ML
  • Exposure to AI is a big plus

Benefits

Why This Role Is Rare

  • Exposure to real-time trading systems live in global markets
  • Direct mentorship from senior algorithmic trading and software engineering veterans
  • Blend of research, systems design, and algorithm development
  • Zero red tape, no outsourcing mentality

title: Facility Specialist
description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Some degree of PPE (Personal Protective Equipment) required (safety glasses, gowning, gloves, lab coat, ear plugs etc.)

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

DESCRIPTION:
Join our organization as a Facilities Specialist I and contribute to maintaining and optimizing our facilities. You'll ensure the smooth operation of critical infrastructure while supporting our mission to enable customers to make the world healthier, cleaner, and safer. In this position, you'll manage building systems, coordinate with vendors, oversee maintenance activities, and implement continuous improvement initiatives.

In this dynamic role, you will:

  • Be integral to the facility management in our state-of-the- art manufacturing facility

  • Support and operate the maintenance planning for the field devices and utility equipment used for the manufacturing of biological products

Our Capture Select ligands are single- chain antibody fragments, produced through a sophisticated process involving:

  • Upstream fermentation in yeast

  • Primary recovery using micro-filtration (MF) and ultra- filtration (UF)

  • Purification via ion-exchange (IEX) chromatography

These ligands are essential for our customers in the research, development, and manufacturing of groundbreaking biopharmaceuticals. From novel antibody and gene therapies to recombinant proteins, our products contribute to the treatment of life-threatening diseases.

Job Description

Responsibilities

  • Execute minor electrical maintenance activities within the scope of NEN 3140 VOP authorization.

  • Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence culture through self-detecting and self-correcting processes, systems and instilling strong ownership & accountability

  • Perform routine inspections and preventive maintenance of utility systems, including HVAC, electrical distribution, compressed air, water treatment systems, steam, chilled water, lighting, fire safety systems, and other utilities.

  • Collaborate with cross functional teams to ensure seamless completion of tasks.

  • Respond to facility-related equipment failures and emergencies, and coordinate preventive and corrective maintenance activities with internal teams and external service providers, including support outside of standard working hours.

  • Monitor contractor activities to ensure compliance with safety, quality, and company procedures.

  • Specify and implement modifications to improve operational performance, efficiency and compliance.

  • Collaborate closely with the production team at the Naarden site to achieve or surpass the critical metrics.

  • Assist with facility improvement projects and energy-saving initiatives. Support installation, relocation, and commissioning of facility equipment.

  • Maintain accurate maintenance records, inspection reports, and work orders using the CMMS. Review maintenance records and identify recurring issues.

  • Ensure compliance with Health, Safety & Environment (HSE) policies and local regulations.

Qualifications

  • MBO Level 4 (or equivalent) in Facilities Management, Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

  • 3-5 years of hands-on experience in facilities maintenance or technical building operations.

  • Proven ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a team.

  • Basic understanding of working under ISO9001 or cGMP quality system.

  • Experience with SCADA or PLC would be a plus

  • Experience with CMMS or any maintenance management software would be a plus

  • Ease of working with Microsoft Windows, Excel, PowerPoint.

  • Knowledge of building automation systems (BMS).

  • Additional certifications such as VCA Basic, BHV, or NEN 3140 VOP are an advantage. Attention to detail and regulatory compliance.

  • Problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.

  • Ability to perform maintenance activities for extended periods.

  • Excellent communication skills in English, technical, organizational, and interpersonal skills are essential.

  • Ability to prioritize multiple tasks. Flexibility to accommodate to changing priorities and deadlines.

Working Conditions

  • Day shift with occasional after-hours or weekend support.

  • Monitor factory processes and control, both on- site and remotely, including outside standard working hours.

  • Use of appropriate Personal Protective Equipment (PPE).

title: Equity Research Multi-Industry Analyst
description:
Job Description

Purpose of the role

To produce and deliver Research with differentiated market insights and actionable ideas to Barclays Clients.

Accountabilities

  • Analysis of market, sector, corporate and/or economic data to help develop investment theses for your coverage universe to produce best in class Research.
  • Research may range from individual company or sector notes, through to long dated thematic reports.
  • Presentation of Research views to Barclays Clients; this can be through direct, face to face and virtual interactions, Research hosted events and written communications.
  • Engagement with Markets, Client Strategy and other stakeholders, to raise awareness of your Research both to Clients and internally. Prioritise interaction with the most relevant and valuable Clients for your Research.
  • Provision of insights and Research views to internal Clients to help them navigate financial markets and risks.
  • Collaboration with the Supervisory Analyst, Compliance and other stakeholders to ensure Research is produced and delivered to Clients and internal stakeholders in a compliant manner.

Analyst Expectations

  • To perform prescribed activities in a timely manner and to a high standard consistently driving continuous improvement.
  • Requires in-depth technical knowledge and experience in their assigned area of expertise
  • Thorough understanding of the underlying principles and concepts within the area of expertise
  • They lead and supervise a team, guiding and supporting professional development, allocating work requirements and coordinating team resources.
  • If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
  • OR for an individual contributor, they develop technical expertise in work area, acting as an advisor where appropriate.
  • Will have an impact on the work of related teams within the area.
  • Partner with other functions and business areas.
  • Takes responsibility for end results of a team’s operational processing and activities.
  • Escalate breaches of policies / procedure appropriately.
  • Take responsibility for embedding new policies/ procedures adopted due to risk mitigation.
  • Advise and influence decision making within own area of expertise.
  • Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work you own or contribute to. Deliver your work and areas of responsibility in line with relevant rules, regulation and codes of conduct.
  • Maintain and continually build an understanding of how own sub-function integrates with function, alongside knowledge of the organisations products, services and processes within the function.
  • Demonstrate understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
  • Make evaluative judgements based on the analysis of factual information, paying attention to detail.
  • Resolve problems by identifying and selecting solutions through the application of acquired technical experience and will be guided by precedents.
  • Guide and persuade team members and communicate complex / sensitive information.
  • Act as contact point for stakeholders outside of the immediate function, while building a network of contacts outside team and external to the organisation.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Join Barclays as an Equity Research Multi-Industry Analyst, where you’ll have the chance to collaborate with senior analysts to produce comprehensive research reports and presentations while monitoring market trends, economic indicators, and company news to update and refine investment solutions. You will also engage with institutional clients to communicate the research findings and provide strategic recommendations.

To be successful as an Equity Research Multi-Industry Analyst, you should have experience with:

  • Conducting detailed fundamental analysis and valuation of companies across multiple industries

  • Building and utilizing financial models and interpreting complex financial statements, with a focus on the Industrials sector

  • Developing clear, well-supported investment theses and research recommendations

  • Communicating complex financial analysis and investment views effectively to clients and internal stakeholders

  • Ample written and verbal communication skills with the ability to present research findings clearly and concisely

Some other highly valued skills may include:

  • Familiarity with financial software and databases such as Bloomberg, Alphasense and advanced Excel

  • Experience in building and maintaining relationships with institutional clients

  • Ability to support projects and mentor junior analysts

  • FINRA licensing: SIE, S63, S86, S87

  • CFA designation or in process

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in this role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking, digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is located in New York, NY.

This role is regulated by FINRA.

Minimum Salary: $110,000

Maximum Salary: $125,000

The minimum and maximum salary/rate information above include only base salary or base hourly rate. It does not include any other type of compensation or benefits that may be available.

title: Investment Analyst
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for an Investment Analyst based in the United States.

The Investment Analyst will play a key role in supporting investment research and portfolio construction within a wealth management environment.
You will conduct in-depth research and due diligence on external investment managers across a range of asset classes and investment vehicles.
The role combines quantitative analysis, investment judgment, and clear communication of recommendations to senior stakeholders.
You will help develop efficient portfolio models designed to meet different client objectives and risk profiles.
Your insights will directly support manager selection, portfolio decisions, and tactical investment changes.
You will also contribute to robust documentation, compliance processes, and ongoing monitoring of investment strategies.
This is a full-time, on-site opportunity suited to an experienced investment professional who thrives in both independent and collaborative settings.

Accountabilities:

  • Conduct thorough research and due diligence on external investment managers, strategies, funds, and investment vehicles.
  • Perform recurring manager searches across a variety of asset classes to identify suitable investment opportunities.
  • Maintain relationships with fund and investment management firms to obtain updates on strategy, performance, positioning, and other relevant developments.
  • Analyze investment managers and present research findings, recommendations, and supporting analysis to senior investment leadership and relevant councils.
  • Develop efficient portfolios and portfolio models designed to address different investment objectives and risk profiles.
  • Provide clear and timely information to Portfolio Managers regarding investment manager selections, portfolio construction decisions, and tactical changes.
  • Prepare and maintain detailed documentation supporting investment research, manager selection, portfolio decisions, compliance, and audit requirements.
  • Review non-approved assets transferred in-kind into new accounts and conduct annual reviews of such holdings.
  • Monitor investment and market developments to support informed recommendations and ongoing portfolio oversight.

    • Requirements:

    • Bachelor’s degree in finance, economics, business, or a related discipline is required; a graduate degree is preferred.
    • 6+ years of professional investment experience, with significant exposure to investment manager research and due diligence.
    • CFA designation or progress toward the CFA designation is preferred.
    • Strong analytical capabilities, with the ability to evaluate investment managers, strategies, performance, and portfolio construction considerations.
    • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to translate complex investment analysis into clear recommendations.
    • Ability to present research findings and investment recommendations effectively to senior stakeholders.
    • Strong organizational skills and attention to detail, particularly when preparing documentation for compliance and audit purposes.
    • Demonstrated ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a collaborative investment team.
    • Sound judgment, critical thinking, and a disciplined approach to investment research and decision-making.
    • Ability to successfully complete required criminal background and credit checks.
    • This is a full-time, non-remote position and requires the ability to work on-site.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive annual salary range of $72,892 to $87,329 USD.
      • Full-time employment in an investment-focused wealth management environment.
      • Opportunity to contribute directly to investment manager selection and portfolio construction decisions.
      • Exposure to a broad range of asset classes, investment strategies, and external investment managers.
      • Opportunities to present research and recommendations to senior investment leadership.
      • Professional growth through hands-on investment research, portfolio modeling, and manager due diligence experience.
      • Exempt position under applicable FLSA classification.
      • Equal opportunity workplace committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.

title: Head of Pricing
description:
Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

Job Description:

The Head of Pricing reports to the Chief Revenue and Transformation Officer and will lead Crowe’s firmwide pricing capability. This leader will help partners and business leaders price work based on value delivered, market dynamics, client needs, and delivery economics—not only bottom-up billable-hours buildups. The role will support Crowe’s Value Creation Plan (VCP) by building practical pricing processes, market insights, analytics, and tools that help business unit (BU), delivery unit (DU), partner, and seller teams price to win attractive work while protecting client trust and long-term relationships.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Build and scale Crowe’s pricing capability: Define the pricing function’s mandate, priorities, operating rhythm, decision support model, and ways of working in partnership with the Chief Revenue and Transformation Officer, partners, BU and DU leaders, Finance, Revenue Operations (RevOps), Marketing, Information Technology (IT), and client-facing teams.
  • Enable value-based pricing for new work: Develop practical tools, pricing ranges, decision aids, and training that help partners and client teams price to win new engagements based on value delivered, scope, risk, urgency, complexity, market alternatives, competitive dynamics, delivery model, and client lifetime value.
  • Support renewal and annuity pricing: Help partners prepare for renewal conversations with clear facts, value narratives, client history, market context, and options that balance price realization with retention, service quality, relationship strength, and long-term client profitability.
  • Create pricing analytics and key performance indicators: Develop dashboards and metrics that help leaders understand pricing performance, including true price realization, scope expansion, mix, discounting, win/loss, retention, renewal economics, and revenue and margin trends by client account. Where possible, separate volume growth, scope growth, mix, and price growth so leaders can see what is driving results.
  • Coordinate practical pricing guardrails and guidance: Create fast, partner-friendly guidance for discounts, exceptions, concessions, urgent work, strategic accounts, bundles, cross-sell opportunities, and one-off projects. Preserve appropriate partner judgment while making pricing decisions more consistent, transparent, and grounded in market and client value.
  • Develop offering, bundle, and pricing architecture: Partner with service-line and BU leaders to build a practical hierarchy of services, offerings, bundles, cross-sell packages, one-off work, and stock keeping units (SKUs), with clear pricing parameters that reflect value delivered, market dynamics, competitive benchmarks, cost-to-serve, delivery economics, and the cost and value of artificial intelligence (AI) tools where relevant.
  • Equip partners and sellers with pricing confidence: Provide simple value narratives, talking points, market intelligence, price-to-win guidance, negotiation support, and responses to common client or procurement questions. Help partners and sellers win attractive work by explaining pricing in relation to business outcomes, expertise, service quality, risk reduction, responsiveness, AI, offshore delivery, efficiency, and the broader value Crowe provides.
  • Embed pricing into commercial workflows and technology: Partner with RevOps, Finance, IT, Marketing, and business leaders to integrate pricing guidance into Customer Relationship Management (CRM) data, Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ) capabilities, account planning, forecasting, proposal processes, and dashboards in ways that are easy to use and do not slow response times to clients or prospects.
  • Support adoption through influence and enablement: Build trust with partners and client-facing teams by making pricing support practical, responsive, and useful. Use pilots, training, feedback loops, and best-practice sharing to improve the approach before broader rollout and to encourage adoption across the firm.
  • Measure impact and communicate trade-offs: Track progress against pricing goals, surface risks and opportunities, and prepare concise leadership updates that clarify trade-offs among realization, win rate, margin quality, retention, client relationships, and long-term firm value.

Ideal Experience and Qualifications:

  • Pricing leadership: 10+ years of experience in pricing, revenue management, commercial strategy, deal desk / commercial operations, management consulting, or a related discipline, with meaningful experience leading pricing work in a business-to-business services environment.
  • B2B services pricing expertise: Deep practical experience with value-based pricing in business-to-business services, ideally including professional services, consulting, advisory, financial services, software / technology-enabled services, or other complex relationship-led environments.
  • Pricing capability and governance experience: Track record building or materially improving pricing processes, governance, decision support, discount guidance, analytics, and tools that partner-led or relationship-led organizations actually use.
  • Analytical and modeling strength: Strong analytical capabilities, including price waterfalls, sensitivity analysis, margin analysis, win/loss analysis, renewal cohorts, client profitability, discount analytics, and executive-ready insights.
  • Commercial acumen and price-to-win judgment: Strong judgment on how to balance price realization, win rate, retention, client lifetime value, competitive dynamics, relationship strength, and long-term value.
  • Complex commercial environment exposure: Experience in a scaled, matrixed, multi-service or multi-product business-to-business environment; professional services, consulting, financial services, or private-equity-backed transformation experience is a plus.
  • Pricing technology and data fluency: Experience with CRM data, CPQ platforms, pricing analytics, workflow design, dashboards, data quality, governance, automation, and the practical use of AI, including how AI tool and token costs affect pricing where relevant.
  • Executive influence and cross-functional partnership: Demonstrated ability to influence senior partners, client-facing leaders, Finance, IT, Marketing, Legal, RevOps, and executive stakeholders through practical advice, credibility, and clear communication.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree is required; Master of Business Administration (MBA) or advanced degree in finance, economics, analytics, business, or a related field preferred but not required.

What you Bring:

  • Commercially pragmatic and partner-friendly, with the credibility to help senior client-facing leaders price to win without being overly academic or theoretical
  • Fact-based and highly analytical, with a bias toward using data to improve judgment rather than creating process for its own sake
  • Strong communicator who can turn complex pricing dynamics into simple guidance, talking points, and decisions that partners can use with clients
  • Client-centered and values-driven, balancing pricing ambition with trust, service quality, retention, and long-term relationships
  • Collaborative One Crowe leader who builds trust across business units, delivery units, and functions
  • Curious and current on market dynamics, competitive pricing trends, AI, automation, offshore delivery, and emerging pricing technologies
  • High-judgment prioritizer who knows when to create guardrails, when to preserve flexibility, and how to keep pricing processes fast and practical

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

You will work closely with Product, Design, and Engineering leadership to translate business priorities into scalable product outcomes.

title: Intern - DRAM Product Test Engineer
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Micron Technology is a world leader in innovating memory and storage solutions that accelerate the transformation of information into intelligence, inspiring the world to learn, communicate and advance faster than ever.

Do you love the interaction of cutting-edge hardware and innovative software solutions?

In today's data economy, Micron's memory and storage products are essential to advancing state of the art computing technology. Continued scaling of memory technology presents challenges that require complex and creative testing solutions.

As a Product Test Engineer, you will be responsible for the development, debug and maintenance of test programs that help deliver Micron's world-class DRAM portfolio to market. Minimum Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline
  • Basic R/L/C circuit knowledge
  • Digital systems and logic gate representation
  • Understanding of CMOS transistor operation
  • Basic statistics and data analytics

Preferred Qualifications

  • Intermediate to advanced programming capability [C++ or Python]

title: Webber - Road Technician - Infrastructure Management
description:
Join Ferrovial: Where Innovation Meets Opportunity

Are you ready to elevate your career with a global leader in infrastructure solving complex problems and generating a positive outcome on people’s lives? At Ferrovial, we are not just a company; we are a community of innovators and trailblazers. Listed on two major stock markets: Nasdaq - 100 Index (US) and IBEX 35 (Spain), we are also member of the Dow Jones Sustainability Index and FTSE4Good. We operate in more than 15 countries and have a workforce of over 22,000 professionals worldwide. Ferrovial’s activity is carried out through our business units, including Highways, Airports, Construction, and Energy.


Founded in 1963, Webber, part of Ferrovial Construction, is a leading construction company that specializes in heavy civil, waterworks, energy and infrastructure management and is dedicated to safely providing intelligent solutions to its clients and community. Webber is headquartered in Houston, Texas, with offices and projects in the United States and Canada. Webber supports a wide range of project models to meet client needs, including traditional design bid build, design build, alternative delivery models and public private partnership (P3) solutions. Webber also has an in-house engineering services department to help optimize building efficiency and quality while solving complex project challenges using field experience, innovative construction methods and BIM technology. As a subsidiary of Ferrovial, Webber has access to a global network of skilled engineers, best-in-class technology and vast resources.


Why Ferrovial?

  • Global presence, local impact: Be part of a company that is shaping the future of infrastructure worldwide, with challenging roles and projects that make a real difference.
  • Collaborative excellence: Work alongside talented professionals in a collaborative environment where your ideas and contributions are valued.
  • Inclusive Culture: Thrive in an innovative and respectful workplace that values every voice, celebrates what makes us unique and turns differences into innovation.
  • Career growth: Benefit from global and cross-business unit mobility, with development processes designed to ensure your professional growth.
  • Compelling benefits and employee wellbeing: Enjoy a comprehensive benefits package that rewards your hard work and dedication and take advantage of initiatives designed to support your physical and psychological health.
  • Productivity tools: Utilize cutting-edge tools like Microsoft Copilot to enhance your productivity and efficiency.

Job Description:

Position Summary

Responsible for maintenance, servicing and repairs of roads and other infrastructure assets. This individual will be responsible for maintaining contracted assets (such as roadways, medians, signs, guardrails, fences, bridges, tunnels, vegetation, etc.) per standards in the contract and as directed by supervisor.

*Please note - in order to support our road maintenance services, this role may be assigned to operations of equipment for winter (if applicable) or summer operations as required.

The pay range for this position is $25–$27 per hour, depending on experience and qualifications.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities

  • Creates safe Maintenance of Traffic, control by setup and removal of traffic control devices including cones, message/arrow boards, temporary signage, etc.
  • Must be comfortable working from heights in bucket trucks, scaffolding, ladders and aerial platforms lifts.
  • Basic maintenance and repair of bridge structures and equipment rooms including portals, railings, expansion joints, doors, and painting as required.
  • Repairs/maintains functionality of roadway catch basins, sumps and pumps, fire hydrants and other mechanical assets through use of shovels and other hand or power tools and equipment.
  • Repairs/maintains functionality of equipment room ventilation systems
  • Repairs/maintains basic electrical systems including emergency telephones, CCTV systems, electronic traffic signs, call boxes, lane signals, lighting,
  • Transports crew and equipment to work sites operating vehicle large trucks and specialized motor vehicles and trailers.
  • Required to be available for emergency response rotations as need for overtime, evenings, weekends, and holidays
  • Positively contribute to a diverse, inclusive and fair work environment, free from discrimination, bullying and harassment.
  • Carry out all duties in line with Company policies and procedures as amended from time to time.
  • Maintain and repair highway and other surfaces including potholes, striping, adding or replacing reflectors, working with concrete and asphalt.
  • Creates safe traffic control by setup and removal of traffic control devices including cones, message/arrow boards, temporary signage, etc.
  • Maintains clean appearance of highways and medians through litter and debris removal and disposal (may use litter claw or other device)
  • Repairs/maintains functionality of slopes, berms, culverts, drains, etc. through use of shovels and other hand or power tools and equipment
  • Controls vegetation appearance and growth through use of lawn mowing equipment, hand or power trimmers, and chemical sprayers and other methods
  • Maintains the appearance and functionality of signs, guardrails, fence, and lighting through repair and/or replacement using hand or power tools.
  • Keep roadways free of debris including ice and snow by using snow removal and/or sanding equipment
  • Transports crew and equipment to work sites operating vehicle pickup trucks and specialized motor vehicles
  • Required to be available and accessible for emergency response rotations as need for overtime, evenings, weekends, and holidays
  • All other duties as assigned.
  • Avoids legal challenges by complying with federal, state, and local legal requirements.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

  • Demonstrated knowledge of underground infrastructure maintenance.
  • Must practice safe work methods to remain accident and injury free.
  • Ability to recognize hazards inherent in routine and non-routine tasks and make adjustments to avoid loss, injury or accident.
  • Will be required to wear Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) appropriate to your job.
  • Ability to cooperate and communicate written or verbally with co-workers and supervisor.
  • Ability to perform basic math functions (add, subtract, multiply divide, calculate proportions, percentages, measurements).
  • Ability to understand instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form.
  • Ability to read, write and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals to comply with contractual requirements
  • Ability to work flexibly and willingness to work extensively to meet business needs
  • High level of attention to detail.
  • Takes ownership of responsibilities
  • Basic knowledge of the standard methods, materials, tools and equipment used in concrete, asphalt repair, construction and maintenance.
  • Skill in the use and care of small hand power tools associated with the work.
  • Ability to interface with the public in a professional manner.

Education and Experience

  • HS Diploma or GED (Required)
  • One (1) year work experience in infrastructure, maintenance, and repair. (Preferred)
  • A valid AZ/DZ driver license and a good driving record are required to drive a company vehicle.
  • CDL, DOT/MTO certifications, Electrical and Welding Certifications (Highly Desirable)

Work Conditions / Physical Demands

Work Environment

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is routinely exposed to traffic and outside weather conditions including extreme heat and cold. The employee is occasionally exposed to wet and/or humid conditions; high precarious places; fume or airborne particles. Frequent exposure to toxic or caustic chemicals, frequent exposure to insects and infrequent exposure to reptiles/rodents. The noise level in the work environment usually moderate but on occasion can be more than moderate.

Physical Demands

The employee is regularly required to stand; sit; walk on a wide range of surfaces; use hands and fingers, handle, or feel; reach with hands and arms; climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl, and talk or hear. Ability to lift up to 50 pounds unassisted. Use manual and powered pneumatic, hydraulic, gas, and electric powered tools and equipment. Vision abilities include both close and distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and ability to adjust focus. Ability to pass fit test for respirator as required. Ability to work at heights. Ability to work in confined spaces.

title: Software Engineer - Application development
description:
Meet the Team

Cisco's Webex Engineering Group is redefining the future of collaboration. We’re building a world where people connect effortlessly to enjoy modern, uncompromised collaboration across every room, desk, pocket, and application.

Our technology powers industry-leading products such as Webex Meetings, Webex Calling, and Webex Contact Center. As a member of our team, your work will ensure every user gets a truly immersive experience across desktop and mobile devices, empowering the hybrid working patterns of the future.

Our engineering teams know the right things to do and are empowered to do them. This is a friendly, energetic environment with a fast pace of delivery, working closely with UX design and product management teams.

Your Impact

  • Design, build, and technically lead end-user features used by millions of people worldwide across desktop and mobile applications.
  • Develop high-quality, performant application software using modern C++, including shared components and capabilities integrated into native iOS and Android experiences.
  • Own the breakdown of product requirements into clear technical designs and executable tasks, delivering high-quality, maintainable solutions within an existing framework.
  • Make pragmatic design decisions across shared, cross-platform code and platform-specific implementations, taking account of performance, reliability, security, accessibility, battery life, and device constraints.
  • Act as a technical point of reference for the team—reviewing designs and code, guiding implementation decisions, and raising the bar for engineering quality.
  • Listen to the customer and elevate their experience. CSAT, NPS, app feedback, crash data, telemetry, and quality metrics are their voice—investigate issues, identify root causes, and drive meaningful improvements.
  • Partner closely with engineers, product managers, and designers to deliver consistent, intuitive experiences across platforms, balancing speed, quality, and long-term sustainability.
  • Improve engineering efficiency through automation, including development tooling, test automation, CI/CD workflows, diagnostics, and mobile build and release processes.
  • Enable the team to focus on complex problems by using AI tools effectively and responsibly across the development lifecycle.
  • Mentor and support other engineers, fostering a culture of learning, ownership, and continuous improvement.
  • Bring your fun, curiosity, and personality to the team.

Minimum Qualification

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in an analytical subject such as Computer Science, Electronic Engineering, or Software Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.
  • Experience: 5+ years of professional software development experience or equivalent, with a strong track record of delivering production-quality software at scale.
  • Programming: Strong proficiency in modern C++ or another relevant language, such as Swift, Kotlin, Java, C#, Rust, or Objective-C, along with the ability and willingness to work in and develop proficiency with modern C++.
  • Application development: Experience developing customer-facing applications for at least one major platform, such as iOS, Android, Windows, macOS, Linux, or Web, and the ability to apply that expertise in a cross-platform environment.
  • Technical depth: Strong software design and programming expertise, with the ability to make sound technical decisions and quickly learn new technologies and platforms.
  • Problem solving: Proven ability to apply and lead a structured, scientific, and creative approach to solving complex engineering problems.
  • Leadership and collaboration: Experience working in cross-functional teams, influencing technical direction, and communicating clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Quality focus: Deep commitment to software quality, including test strategy definition, code reviews, automation, observability, and continuous improvement practices.

Preferred Qualification

  • Professional experience with modern C++, particularly in a large, long-lived, cross-platform, or performance-sensitive application codebase.
  • Experience developing native mobile applications for iOS or Android using Swift, Objective-C, Kotlin, or Java.
  • Experience integrating shared C++ libraries or SDKs with native mobile code, including language interoperability, APIs, build systems, debugging, and lifecycle or memory-management considerations.
  • Understanding of mobile application architecture and platform conventions, including background execution, concurrency, networking, offline behaviour, permissions, accessibility, security, battery efficiency, and varying device capabilities.
  • End-to-end development experience in one or more of the following areas:
    • Languages: Modern C++, Swift, Objective-C, Kotlin, Java, Python, or TypeScript/JavaScript
    • Application and UI frameworks: SwiftUI, UIKit, Jetpack Compose, Android SDK, Qt, Cocoa, React Native, React, Angular, or similar
    • Back end and integration: Java/Spring, RESTful APIs, WebSockets, distributed systems, push notifications, or API design
  • Experience using mobile diagnostics and product data—such as crash reports, performance traces, logs, telemetry, or app-quality metrics—to identify root causes and guide improvements.
  • Experience with mobile build, signing, packaging, automated testing, staged rollout, and release processes, including App Store or Google Play delivery.
  • Experience leading or significantly contributing to system design, architecture discussions, and technical decision-making.
  • Strong experience with unit, integration, UI, and end-to-end testing, including contract testing and automation in CI pipelines across desktop or mobile platforms.
  • Experience creating automation using Python or a similar scripting language for tooling, testing, builds, diagnostics, data analysis, or operational workflows.
  • Practical experience or strong interest in AI-assisted development, including the use of LLM-based tools for scaffolding, refactoring, test generation, debugging, and improving developer productivity—with clear ownership of validated, production-ready code.
  • Familiarity with Git, DevOps practices, continuous integration, and continuous delivery.
  • Experience developing or optimising applications across iOS, Android, Windows, macOS, Linux, or Web platforms.

title: Head of Commercial and Insights
description:
As Head of Commercial and Insights, you own the commercial engine behind Crytek's portfolio, reporting to the Chief Publishing Officer. You are accountable for how our games are priced, sold, forecasted and understood, across every storefront and every region.

You lead two connected disciplines. On the commercial side, you own storefront and platform strategy, pricing, promotions and revenue performance. On the insights side, you build the analytics capability that tells us what is actually happening, and what to do about it. Together they give publishing leadership a single, trustworthy view of the business.

This is a role for someone equally comfortable negotiating platform deals and challenging forecast models, and who wants to build an insights function from the ground up.

What You'll Do

  • Own commercial strategy across the portfolio: pricing, promotions, storefront positioning and revenue performance

  • Lead relationships with digital storefronts, platform holders and distribution partners

  • Own portfolio forecasting and the commercial planning cycle, and report performance to the Chief Publishing Officer

  • Build and lead the insights function, including analytics, dashboards, forecasting models and post-launch reporting

  • Set the KPI framework that governs go-to-market planning, campaign delivery and live operations

  • Partner with the Economy Designer on monetization design and in-game economy performance

  • Ensure commercial and player data is reliable, accessible and used in decision-making

  • Grow a small, senior team across sales, economy design and insights

What You Bring

  • 10+ years in commercial, sales or business operations roles in games or digital entertainment, including team leadership

  • Deep knowledge of digital storefront ecosystems and platform commercial models

  • Strong forecasting, pricing and revenue planning capability, with the rigour to defend a number

  • Experience building or materially improving an analytics or insights capability

  • Commercial contract literacy and partner negotiation experience

  • Comfort working with economy design and live-service monetization

  • Excellent communication skills in English and the ability to make data legible to non-analysts

  • Willingness to relocate to Frankfurt am Main, Germany

What you can expect from us

Career Path
Your professional development is important to us, so we have laid out a career plan to help you progress towards your goals and objectives.
Relocation Support
We offer a relocation budget and full coverage of flights to Frankfurt for you and your family.
You can expect extensive assistance with visa, work permits, and communication with authorities during the relocation process, as well as help settling into Germany (e.g. setting up appointments with banks, government agencies, schools, landlords, finding apartments etc.).
Company Apartment
To help you get settled, we provide you with a fully furnished company apartment during your first three months in Frankfurt.
Public Transport Pass
Discover Frankfurt by bus, tram and metro – free of charge.
Gym Card
A healthy body is a healthy mind. We offer a membership at the premium gym chain Fitness First in Germany. Work out, join group fitness classes, or relax in the wellness facilities.
State-of-the-art Office
We’ve recently moved into a brand-new, modern office located in the heart of Frankfurt. Our new workspace is designed to inspire creativity and collaboration, with open areas, quiet zones, and top-tier facilities — all just steps away from public transport, restaurants, bars and cultural hotspots.
Hybrid Working
We believe in the value of in-person collaboration while also supporting flexibility. Our hybrid working model includes three days per week in the office and the option to work remotely up to two days per week, unless role-specific requirements or business needs require you to be on site.
Equal Opportunity & Inclusion
We’re building a workplace where everyone belongs. We welcome people of all backgrounds and identities and are proud to be a truly global team, with employees from over 42 countries contributing their ideas, cultures, and perspectives every day.
German Classes
Understanding the local culture will make your stay abroad more enjoyable, and Crytek supports that by offering German language courses for you and your family.
Events
Join us on our exciting company events, including new starter breakfasts, summer and winter parties, our annual trip to Gamescom in Cologne, and many more!
Vacation Days
At our Frankfurt office you can enjoy 24 days of vacation per year, and every 2 years you get 1 more (up to a maximum of 28 days). You will also have on average 10 public holidays on top of the days you take off.

title: Senior / Staff Frontend Engineer (React) - Remote friendly
description:
Our mission and customers: We are creating the freedom for SMEs to succeed by delivering Europe's leading finance workspace with banking at its core, augmented by financial tools. We are proud to be rated 4.8 on Trustpilot, based on 55,000+ reviews. Our culture puts customer satisfaction at the core of what we do, as proven by our Net Promoter Score of 75 (more about our culture here).

Our journey: Founded in 2017 by Alexandre and Steve, Qonto has grown to 1,600+ Qontoers serving over 600,000+ customers across 8 European countries. We have been profitable since 2023, and we are just getting started.

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

AI at Qonto: AI is deeply embedded in how we work (here) - Every Qontoer gets unlimited access to the best AI tools. We want people who experiment without waiting for permission, push AI beyond the obvious, know when to trust it, and when to question it.

------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


🌏 Location: You can choose to work in Qonto as long as you're living in (or willing to relocate to) either Germany, France, Italy, Serbia, or Spain.
Mission: Join us as a Frontend Engineer to craft the web apps that 600,000+ European SMEs rely on every day, from the customer-facing features that make finance simpler to the design system powering every pixel of our product.

➡️ As a Frontend Engineer at Qonto, you will

  • Craft new features for our customers within a squad Team, owning quality from design to production.
  • Grow in technical leadership: lead design discussions, contribute to guild-wide improvement, and raise the bar for developer experience across your peers
  • Be a key player in teamwork with Product, Design, and other Tech stacks
  • Work AI-first: use AI as a default part of how you explore the codebase, draft technical designs, prototype solutions, and accelerate delivery, while keeping strong human judgment and quality standards

➡️ What you can expect: our methodology, the Qonto Way

  • At Qonto, we value diversity and are proud to have 33% non-male in our Frontend guild.
  • You will contribute to and use our own design system and UI library, which we built from scratch.
  • You will be part of a team that is driven by quality. Our org assigns one team lead per project across stacks, giving your team a clear mission and full autonomy on how it operates
  • You will have access to best-in-class AI tools (e.g., Claude / Claude Code and internal workflows) and the autonomy to experiment, share learnings, and help scale what works across the guild
  • You will bring your energy and skills to improve the team’s tools and processes at many levels, contributing to a better developer experience for all your peers.
You can watch this interview of Imen, who joined the team as a Lead in January 2023.

As a Frontend Engineer, you'll join one of Qonto's squad teams, each with a clear project mission, one team lead, and full product ownership.
You'll be part of a 100+ strong Frontend community within a 500+ Product Engineering department, working in teams of 5 to 10 people alongside Product, Design, and peers from Backend and Mobile.
We hold ourselves to high standards, and we've shipped several open-source JS libraries along the way. We almost completed a migration to React. Now is an exciting time to join, especially if you want to hone your expertise in React over the coming years!

➡️ About You

To succeed as a Frontend Engineer at Qonto, you will need to demonstrate:
  1. Proficiency in frontend engineering: you have at least three years of professional experience using React.js, as well as HTML and CSS. We don’t use CSS libraries such as Tailwind, so you will need to know how to write pure CSS.
  2. Attention to detail: you strive for excellence in every aspect of your job. You don’t gloss over minor issues and you understand that great work is the accumulation of many small things done right.
  3. Communication skills: you explain your thoughts in a clear, organized, concise and accurate manner.
  4. AI fluency & good judgment: you can leverage AI to move faster (research, writing, coding, testing) while staying critical, validating outputs, and protecting the product’s reliability and user trust
At Qonto, we understand that true diversity isn’t just about ticking boxes on a hiring checklist. Apply regardless of the boxes you tick — who knows? You may have the missing piece of the puzzle we’ve been searching for all along.
By applying, you agree that Qonto processes your personal data to assess your application. Your data is kept for up to 2 years in our candidate pool. Read our Privacy Notice for full details.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
On average, our hiring process lasts 20 working days. More information on our candidate journey here
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

title: Kassa-myyjiä, Helsinki, Kaari (määräaikainen 10-30 h/vko)
description:
Hei!

Nyt on maailman paras ostaja hankkinut hyllyt täyteen laatutuotteita ja meillä on tarjolla työpaikkoja kolmelle asiakaspalveluhenkisille ja vauhdikkaasta työstä nauttiville työkavereille! Haluatko sinä mukaan ystävälliseen porukkaamme?

Kassa-myyjänä pääset yhdessä työkavereidesi kanssa varmistamaan asiakkaillemme mukavan ja mutkattoman asiointikokemuksen Tokmannin myymälässä.

Monipuolinen työpäiväsi sisältää asiakaspalvelua kassalla ja myymälässä, tuotteiden hyllytystä, tuotteiden esillelaiton suunnittelua ja toteutusta sekä myymälän viihtyisyydestä huolehtimista. Tärkeä osa työtäsi on myymälässämme asioivien asiakkaidemme auttaminen erilaisissa kysymyksissä, ja aina autamme myös toisiamme, kun tiimissä tarvitaan apua.

Kattavan valikoimamme ansiosta pääset laittamaan esille esimerkiksi pukeutumiseen, vapaa-aikaan sekä kodin arkeen ja kunnostamiseen liittyviä tuotteita ja opastamaan asiakkaitamme monenlaisissa kysymyksissä.

Tehtävät ovat 3 kuukauden mittaisia määräaikaisuuksia. Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan ja työaika on 10-30 h/vko. Sinulla on meillä työskennellessäsi myös mahdollisuus tehdä osa sopimuksesi tunneista tai lisätunteja työskentelemällä lähimyymälöissäsi. Täytämme tehtävän heti, kun löydämme sopivan työkaverin joukkoomme, joten toimithan pian!

Voit olla etsimämme työkaveri, jos olet täysi-ikäinen ja sinulla on:

  • Iloinen asiakaspalveluasenne
  • Hyvät vuorovaikutustaidot ja yhteistyökyvyt sekä sosiaalista pelisilmää
  • Halu toimia liikkuvassa ja vauhdikkaassa työssä
  • Oma-aloitteinen ja asioita tehokkaasti loppuun saattava työskentelytyyli
  • Mahdollisuus työskennellä vaihtelevissa työvuoroissa arkisin ja viikonloppuisin
  • Halu tehdä työsi hyvin, ylpeyttä omasta ammattitaidostasi sekä kiinnostusta oman ammattitaidon kehittämiseen
  • Kyky palvella asiakkaitamme suomenkielellä; hyvä englannin kielen taito lasketaan eduksi

Kassa-myyjän työssä vastaanotetaan ja siirrellään painaviakin tuotteita kumarrellen ja kurkottaen, joten työssä tarvitaan hyvää fyysistä kuntoa ja liikkuvuutta.

Kaupallinen koulutus ja kokemus kaupan alalta katsotaan eduksesi, mutta tärkeintä meille on positiivinen asenteesi sekä aito kiinnostus kaupan alaa ja myymälätyöskentelyä kohtaan.

Tarkkailethan sähköpostiasi hakemuksen jättämisen jälkeen ja muista kurkata myös roskapostikansio, joskus rekrytointiviestimme saattavat vahingossa päätyä sinne.

title: Production Planning Coordinator
description:
Haemme Broman Logistics Oy:lle Keravan Logistiikkakeskukseen

PRODUCTION PLANNING COORDINATOR

Etsimme osaavaa tuotannonsuunnittelun koordinaattoria työskentelemään tuotannon suunnittelun ja ohjauksen tehtävissä logistiikkakeskuksessamme Keravalla. Teet tiivistä yhteistyötä tuotannon esihenkilöiden ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa varmistaen, että järjestelmät, ohjeistukset ja prosessikuvaukset tukevat sujuvaa ja tehokasta päivittäistä tuotantoa.

🤝 Työsuhde on vakituinen ja kokoaikainen 37,5h/vko

💰 Palkkaus sopimuksen mukaan

Sovit joukkoomme, mikäli:

  • Sinulla on soveltuva alan koulutus tai useamman vuoden työkokemus vastaavista tehtävistä

  • Olet työskennellyt aiemmin logistiikkakeskuksessa ja ymmärrät logistiikka-sekä tuotantoprosessit

  • Hallitset SQL perusteet

  • Olet analyyttinen ja osaat tehdä päätöksiä numeroiden ja datan pohjalta

  • Hallitset kustannusseurannan ja osaat tehostaa prosesseja optimoimalla toimintaa

  • Tunnet logistiikan automaatiojärjestelmiä

  • Olet järjestelmällinen ja sinulla on hyvä ongelmanratkaisukyky

  • Olet joustava, yhteistyökykyinen ja osaat priorisoida tehtäviä tehokkaasti

  • Hallitset hyvin Microsoft Office -ohjelmistot

  • Kommunikoit sujuvasti myös englanniksi

  • Pystyt tuottamaan ymmärrettäviä ja selkeitä ohje- ja toiminnankuvausdokumentteja

🔥 TOP 5 🔥
syytä valita meidät työnantajaksi:

Menestyvä työpaikka - Meillä menee hyvin! Työskennellessäsi meillä pysyt alan kehityksen kärjessä ja saat itsellesi vakavaraisen sekä luotettavan työnantajan.
Jatkuvasti kehittyvä työympäristö - Eteenpäin meneminen on meille tärkeää ja siksi kehitysaskeleita otetaan sitä mukaan, kun kehitettävää löydetään. Uudistuminen on toimintamme pohja ja se on viety arvoihimme saakka.
Mahdollisuus kehittää itseäsi - Työssä kehittyminen on meillä ehdoton kunnia-asia! Jokainen meillä saa edellytykset kehittyä omassa työssään niin sisäisten kuin ulkoistenkin koulutusten parissa. Erityisesti panostamme lähijohtamiseen, johon koulutamme ja opastamme henkilöstöä mm. omien esihenkilö- ja päällikkövalmennusten kautta.
Avulias ja ammattitaitoinen työtiimi - Ketään ei jätetä yksin, vaan yhdessä tekemällä päästään parhaaseen mahdolliseen lopputulemaan. Meillä on kasassa huipputiimi, vaikka mekin kaikki olemme vain ihmisiä.
Työn ja vapaan tasapaino - Kotiin saa ja pitääkin lähteä!

Hae mukaan!

Rekrytointiprosessissa edetään jo hakuaikana, joten hakemuksen kanssa ei kannata turhaan aikailla. Haastattelut aloitetaan sopivien kandidaattien myötä ja valinta tehdään oikean henkilön löydyttyä.

📅 Hae kuitenkin viimeistään 13.09.2026.

Heräsikö kysymyksiä? Tai haluat muuten vain vaihtaa ajatuksia? Sehän passaa!
Tuotantopäällikkö Juha Larimo auttaa sinua mielellään. Juhan tavoitat sähköpostitse osoitteesta juha.larimo@bromangroup.fi ja puhelimitse numerosta +358444190217 keskiviikkona 26.8.2026 klo. 12-14, keskiviikkona 2.9.2026 klo. 12-14 sekä keskiviikkona 9.9.2026 klo. 12-14.

Jäämme innolla odottamaan hakemustasi! Jos työ ei ole sinua itseäsi varten, niin vinkkaa siitä henkilölle, kenet ilmoitukselta tunnistit ja hae itse johonkin muuhun tehtävään! Täältä kaikkiin avoimiin työpaikkoihimme.

title: First Nations Recovery Worker - Windsor
description:
Wellways is committed to reconciliation, lived experience and inclusivity. We strongly encourage and warmly welcome people from Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander communities, people with a lived experience of mental health and disability and people who identify as LGBTIQA+ to apply. Even if you only meet some of the criteria, we’d love to hear from you.

  • Support Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people through culturally safe, recovery-focused practice.
  • Build meaningful connections with families, communities and local services.
  • SCHADS Level 3 ($38.65 - $43.42 per hour) + Salary Packaging + Leave loading

First Nations Recovery Worker | Community Living Support (CLS)

Windsor/Richmond

Walk alongside people on their recovery journey while strengthening connection to culture, community and wellbeing.

At Wellways, we believe that recovery is possible for everyone. As a First Nations Recovery Worker, you will play a vital role in supporting Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people experiencing mental health challenges, psychological distress and/or substance use concerns to achieve their goals and live meaningful lives.

Community Living Support (CLS) is a NSW Government-funded program providing person-led, community-based psychosocial support for people aged 16 years and over living with severe mental health challenges. Working within a multidisciplinary team, you will provide culturally safe, recovery-oriented support that empowers participants to build independence, strengthen natural supports and reconnect with culture, family and community.

What you'll be doing

  • Provide practical, culturally safe and recovery-focused support to participants in the community.
  • Support people to identify their strengths, aspirations and goals and develop plans that support their recovery journey.
  • Build and strengthen connections with families, communities, services and cultural supports to promote wellbeing and belonging.

What you'll bring
You are passionate about supporting Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander peoples and understand the importance of culture, connection and self-determination in recovery.

You bring strong communication and relationship-building skills, a collaborative approach to working within multidisciplinary teams, and the ability to provide practical support that promotes hope, healing and independence. You are confident maintaining accurate records and documentation and are comfortable travelling across the region.

Main responsibilities of the role include:

  • Support first nations participants to develop and work towards their recovery goals and aspirations.
  • Provide practical, strengths-based support that promotes independence and wellbeing.
  • Foster connections with Country, families, communities and natural support networks.
  • Complete recovery plans, assessments, file notes and program documentation.
  • Travel across the region to meet participant needs

You will also need:

  • Is acknowledged by First Nations community and leadership
  • Demonstrated strong connection with First Nations communities and demonstrated strong understanding of the lived experiences of First Nations communities on Country
  • Certificate IV/Diploma in Mental Health, AOD or tertiary qualification in social science or 1+ year relevant work experience in the Mental Health Sector or Intentional Peer Support Training
  • 100 points of identification and Birth Certificate/Passport
  • Drivers Licence
  • National Police Check
  • Working with Children Check and NDIS Workers Screening Check
  • NDIS Workers Orientation Modules – free online course

What we will offer you…

  • A purpose driven culture where people can thrive, everyone is respected, and differences are valued
  • An equitable, diverse, and socially inclusive work environment
  • Salary packaging up to $15,899 enables you to spend a portion of your salary before it is taxed to pay for things like rent, mortgage repayments, car leasing
  • Meal and Entertainment allowance via salary packaging up to $2,650 per annum
  • Receive 17.5% leave loading every time you take annual leave
  • Paid parental leave after 12 months of ongoing employment
  • Access for you and your family to our Employee Assistance Program

For a confidential discussion about the role, please contact Sadia Tariq, Team Leader via email at stariq@wellways.org

Please ensure you submit your updated Resume along with a Cover Letter outlining your relevant experience.

To view the full Position Description and submit your application, click APPLY.

We encourage early applications as interviews may begin prior to advertising closing date.

Wellways is committed to the safeguarding of children and vulnerable people. Successful applicants must undergo a comprehensive screening process prior to their commencement.

Job Description Summary

Support recovery, culture and community as a First Nations Recovery Worker. Make a real difference through culturally safe, person-led support.

Culture

We’re passionate about our work, which is enjoyable, challenging and rewarding. All of our teams work to ensure everyone can imagine and achieve their hopes and potential. We know that people are unique and the experts on their life and are not defined by impairments, diagnosis or labels. We aim to specifically promote safety and inclusivity for LGBTIQ+ and First Nations communities.

How to Apply

This is your opportunity to join a values based, growing, innovative and nationally recognised organisation with over 2,000 staff members across 93 sites.

title: Strategic Projects Lead - Australia
description:
The role

Gridsight has a strong position in Australia and significant opportunity to deepen key accounts, expand through partners and make the regional commercial engine more scalable. We are looking for a Strategic Projects Lead to turn those regional opportunities and constraints into measurable outcomes.

This is a hands-on regional operating role designed to create leverage for the ANZ GM and regional leadership by turning the ANZ plan into executed outcomes. You will report to the ANZ GM and be based in Sydney. Your portfolio will be set against the ANZ plan, with a primary focus on Australia: deepen priority accounts, strengthen the partner ecosystem and improve how opportunities move from sales through delivery and expansion.

Your mandate

Own the highest-leverage strategic projects

  • Own a small portfolio of the ANZ region’s most important commercial and customer initiatives, from clearly framed problem to measurable result.
  • Turn regional leadership priorities into clear workstreams, owners, milestones, risks and decision points, then maintain momentum through delivery.
  • Structure ambiguous regional problems from first principles, form hypotheses, find the evidence and implement the answer.
  • Incubate new regional motions, prove them in Australia and transition them cleanly to the right Sales, Partnerships or Delivery owner.

Advance Australian commercial and customer outcomes

  • Build account and market plans that connect customer needs, the commercial path and delivery realities.
  • Help Sales advance priority opportunities and expansions by resolving cross-functional blockers, strengthening commercial cases and driving clear next steps.
  • Turn partnerships into measurable revenue, market reach, credibility or delivery capacity across the region.
  • Help priority Australian customers move from commercial commitment to realized value quickly and reliably, protecting trust and creating room for expansion.
  • Turn customer, win-loss and delivery patterns into concrete choices about where the Australian team should focus, experiment or stop.

Connect Sales, Partnerships and Delivery

  • Create one shared view of regional priorities, commitments, owners and dependencies across Sales, Partnerships and Delivery.
  • Connect the teams before commitments are made so scope, responsibilities and customer outcomes are clear.
  • Diagnose friction across the regional sales-to-delivery lifecycle and stay accountable until the path is stable.
  • Use implementation and account evidence to protect retention, surface expansion opportunities and improve commercial choices.
  • Turn successful delivery improvements into repeatable handoffs and playbooks that functional teams can own.

Build the operating system for repeatable execution

  • Create a focused regional cadence around account health, expansion, pipeline, partner contribution and delivery performance.
  • Build the dashboards and analysis that give the ANZ GM and regional leadership one trusted view of performance and the decisions required.
  • Run cross-functional reviews that end with a decision, owner and next action—not another status update.
  • Use automation and AI to remove recurring regional work and give Sales, Partnerships and Delivery more time with customers.

What success looks like

  • Priority Australian accounts expand and regional net revenue retention strengthens.
  • Priority opportunities move more predictably from pipeline through delivery and realized customer value.
  • Partner relationships produce measurable revenue, market reach or delivery leverage.
  • Delivery becomes faster, more repeatable and more efficient without compromising quality.
  • The ANZ GM and regional leadership have more leverage because priority projects are fully owned, decisions move faster and successful improvements become routines operated by the right team.

What will make you phenomenal

  • You start with the regional constraint, not the org chart, and keep going until the outcome is visible.
  • You think from first principles, use data well and are willing to challenge an inherited answer.
  • You are a hands-on builder: equally comfortable with an executive customer and the model, CRM cleanup or playbook needed to move the work.
  • You bring high agency and low ego, and you measure your contribution in regional results rather than activity.
  • You stay close to customers, partners and frontline teams because the best regional decisions start with ground truth.
  • You have strong commercial judgment and can connect enterprise sales, partnerships, delivery economics and customer value.
  • You can lead complex work across functions without formal authority and make trade-offs clear when leaders disagree.
  • Experience in a high-growth startup, strategy and operations, consulting, enterprise go-to-market, partnerships or customer delivery is useful; evidence of ownership and regional execution matters more than a conventional pedigree.
