Job Description:

Why GDIT

Are you ready to be a part of an elite team at GDIT, working on a large-scale, pioneering National Intelligence program? This is an incredible opportunity to immerse yourself into an environment that fuses innovation, speed, and security to safeguard our Nation.

At GDIT, you'll thrive in a dynamic and collaborative setting, where your technical skills will be both challenged and expanded. This program offers the chance to engage with cutting-edge technologies and contemporary development practices in support of a vital mission. You'll play a critical role in addressing some of the most intricate security and operational challenges facing Intelligence and Homeland Security today.

Come join us and contribute to a mission that truly matters, while advancing your career alongside some of the brightest minds in the industry.

What You’ll Achieve

The Mission Assurance/Quality Manager plays a strategic, high-impact role at the IDIQ level, embedded within the PMO. This person will start off in Task Order 2 setting process, oversees risk reduction, process compliance, and product reliability to guarantee the MVIs are successfully met. They enforce quality standards, oversee verification testing, and process governess. In this role, you will:

  • Quality Management Framework for the IDIQ

    • Design, maintain, and continuously improve the program’s quality management approach across all task orders (e.g., quality plan, standards, templates).

    • Ensure the program’s software‑development lifecycle (SDLC), Agile/SAFe practices, and DevSecOps processes have clearly defined quality criteria at each stage.

    • Align quality practices with contract requirements, customer standards, and GDIT policies.

    • Serve as the ultimate technical authority for QA tooling and architecture.

  • Process Definition, Compliance, and Continuous Improvement

    • Define and document key processes for requirements, design, coding, testing, release, defect management, and configuration management.

    • Perform periodic process compliance checks (e.g., audits, walkthroughs, spot checks) across task orders to verify teams are following agreed practices.

    • Collect and analyze findings, drive corrective actions, and track closure of non‑conformances or observations.

    • Facilitate continual improvement cycles by capturing lessons learned and updating processes, checklists, and templates.

  • Metrics, Monitoring, and Reporting

    • Define and maintain a consistent set of quality and mission assurance metrics for the program, such as:

      • Defect density and leakage (e.g., defects escaping to higher environments/production).

      • Test coverage, automation rates, and rework.

      • Release quality (e.g., incidents post‑deployment, rollback rates).

    • Consolidate and analyze quality data across task orders; identify trends, hotspots, and systemic issues.

    • Provide regular quality dashboards and narratives to PMO, program leadership, and customer stakeholders.

  • Risk Management, Issues, and Root Cause Analysis

    • Partner with program management to identify and track quality‑related risks and issues in the program risk/issue register.

    • Lead or support root cause analysis (RCA) for significant defects, outages, or delivery failures and ensure corrective/preventive actions (CAPAs) are defined and implemented.

    • Monitor the effectiveness of CAPAs and adjust as needed to prevent recurrence.

  • Integration of Quality into Agile/SAFe and DevSecOps

    • Collaborate with the Lead Agilist, Solution Architect, and tech leads to embed quality practices into:

      • Backlog refinement, Definitions of Ready/Done.

      • Testing strategies (unit, integration, system, performance, security).

      • CI/CD pipelines (e.g., automated quality gates, static code analysis, security scans).

    • Promote and support test automation and “shift‑left” quality practices to reduce defects and rework.

    • Ensure quality checkpoints are integrated into program ceremonies (e.g., PI planning, system demos, retros).

  • Deliverable and Release Quality Assurance

    • Define acceptance criteria and review standards for key program deliverables (documents, designs, plans, test evidence, release packages).

    • Perform independent quality reviews of high‑risk or high‑visibility deliverables prior to submission to the customer.

    • Participate in release readiness reviews, confirming that quality thresholds and exit criteria are met before deployment.

  • Customer Interface on Quality and Mission Assurance

    • Support program management as the primary voice on quality‑related topics in customer reviews, audits, and status meetings.

    • Prepare and present quality performance summaries, trends, and improvement plans to customer stakeholders.

    • Coordinate responses to customer quality concerns, audits, or findings; track and report closure.

  • Alignment Across Task Orders

    • Ensure teams adhere to program quality standards and reporting expectations.

    • Perform or coordinate quality reviews of team deliverables and contributions.

    • Support harmonization of quality approaches across task orders so the program operates with a common baseline and shared best practices.

  • Training, Coaching, and Quality Culture

    • Provide training or orientation to new team members, Scrum teams, and task leads on program quality expectations, processes, and tools.

    • Coach teams on best practices in software quality, test design, defect prevention, and documentation.

    • Promote a culture where team members proactively raise quality issues and participate in improvement efforts

Required Qualifications

  • BS/BA or equivalent experience

  • TS/SCI with Polygraph

  • 10+ years of progressive software engineering and quality assurance experience, with a proven track record of moving from hands-on technical contributor to senior leadership

  • 5+ years of experience leading teams with demonstrated ability to plan, organize, and implement significant strategic initiatives.

  • Demonstrable experience architecting and executing a large-scale manual-to-automation transformation. Must be able to speak deeply to the technical framework design, ROI analysis, and change management strategies used.

  • Deep, hands-on expertise with modern automation tooling, CI/CD pipeline integration, and testing large-scale, multi-tier, service-oriented architectures.

Desired Skills and Experience

  • Experience evaluating and implementing GenAI tooling to accelerate test script generation, optimize test data management (including synthetic data for PHI/PII), and improve overall QA efficiency.

  • Familiarity with modern automation frameworks (e.g., Playwright, Cypress) and shift-left API testing strategies.

  • Experience with traditional enterprise stacks, including Java, Jira, GitHub, and DB2 (or similar) on large-scale applications.

  • Deep knowledge of DORA metrics (Deployment Frequency, Lead Time for Changes, Change Failure Rate) and establishing engineering benchmarks.

title: Specialist, Strategy and Operations
description:
The World Economic Forum is an independent, not-for-profit organization, headquartered in Geneva, with offices in New York, San Francisco, Beijing, and Tokyo.

We are the trusted platform for public-private cooperation where leaders come together to understand global challenges and drive action across sectors and regions. We create spaces where different stakeholders engage openly, build trust, and collaborate to help solve shared global challenges.

Context and why we are recruiting?

The Centre for Health and Healthcare brings together leaders from business, government, academia and civil society to improve health systems and health outcomes. Strong and sustained relationships with business partners are central to the Centre’s ability to grow its work, deliver meaningful programmes and maintain long-term impact.

The role brings together two core areas: Programming and Operations, and Partner Development (sales) and Engagement (account management). It will support major Forum meetings and Centre-led convenings while serving as the Centre-side liaison with Forum teams responsible for partner development and industry engagement. The role will maintain visibility on priority prospects, coordinate Centre inputs and follow-up, support the engagement of key business partners, and identify opportunities to deepen relationships over time.

Reporting line and how is this role embedded in the wider team?

Reporting to the Lead, Operations and Strategy, the role sits within the Centre for Health and Healthcare and will be based in Geneva. It will work closely with the Centre Head, Partner Development, Industry and account management colleagues, initiative and project leads, and Forum teams responsible for programming and major meetings.

What will you be responsible for?

Programming and Operations

  • Support major Centre programming across the year, including priority Forum meetings and Centre-led convenings such as the Annual Meeting and the Annual Health Roundtable, from planning through delivery and follow-up.
  • Maintain clear visibility across assigned programming activity, including key dates, session concepts, review points, speaker and participant needs, decisions and delivery risks.
  • Support the development of session objectives, formats, agendas, speaker and participant planning, briefing materials and other programme documents.
  • Work with Forum programming, events, participant engagement, communications and relevant project teams on assigned programming deliverables and help resolve issues that could affect readiness or delivery.
  • Maintain the practical tools, Salesforce information and materials needed to support assigned programming and partner-facing activity.

Centre Partner and Engagement

  • Serve as the Centre-side liaison with Partner Development Team, maintaining visibility on priority prospects and partnership opportunities and ensuring relevant Centre stakeholders understand acquisition status, next steps and required follow-up.
  • Work closely with Industry and account management colleagues as the Centre-side point of connection for key business partners, helping ensure newly assigned partners receive a clear introduction to the Centre and are connected to relevant initiatives and programming.
  • Monitor partner engagement across Centre initiatives and programming, using available engagement information to identify limited, declining or one-off participation and provide regular visibility to Centre leadership on engagement gaps, retention risks and actions requiring attention.
  • Support retention and engagement planning by identifying opportunities to deepen partner involvement and coordinating Centre follow-up in close collaboration with the teams that own the partner relationship.

What core knowledge, skills and experience are we looking to add to our team?

Domain Knowledge and Experience

  • Relevant experience in programme development, event programming, partner engagement, business development, account management or a related role.
  • Experience working across partner development, account management or industry-facing teams, with an understanding of how acquisition, engagement and retention responsibilities connect across functions.
  • Experience supporting senior-level meetings, sessions or convenings and preparing clear materials for senior leaders and external stakeholders.
  • Experience using pipeline, engagement or relationship information to identify risks, opportunities and next actions is helpful.
  • Strong working knowledge of PowerPoint and Excel; experience with Salesforce or another customer relationship management system is helpful.
  • An interest in global health and healthcare. Direct experience in the field is welcome but not required.

Core Skills

  • Able to build trusted working relationships with business partners and internal teams across different levels of seniority.
  • Able to connect information across teams, maintain clear follow-up and identify meaningful opportunities for partner engagement within the Centre’s work.
  • Strong written communication and the ability to turn complex information into clear partner, programme and leadership materials.
  • Able to organize complex work, maintain accurate reporting and manage several deadlines and contributors at the same time.
  • Strong attention to detail, reliable follow-through and a practical approach to solving problems.
  • Good judgment, discretion and the confidence to raise concerns early when engagement is weakening, priorities change or information is incomplete.

Why join us?


Join an independent and impartial organization with over 55 years of connecting leaders to make sense of global challenges and move the world forward together.

description:
About Leidos Australia

At Leidos Australia, our work goes beyond a job title. We design, build, operate and support the systems, services and capabilities that help protect and advance the Australian way of life.

Backed by a global organisation of more than 40,000 people, our Australian team of around 2,000 has partnered with government, defence and national security customers for more than 30 years. We deliver mission-critical solutions where reliability, trust and purpose matter.

Leidos is a destination for people who want their work to have purpose, their contribution to be recognised, and their career to grow without needing to fit a single mould. Meaningful work is supported by benefits, flexibility and career pathways that help you grow while balancing life outside work. This includes:

  • Flex Your Way – Tailor work to your life with options including Life Days (up to 12 extra days off per year), part-time arrangements, job sharing, and compressed hours.

  • Wellbeing That Matters – Free access to Headspace and MeQuilibrium, plus dedicated wellness spaces to support your mental, physical, and emotional wellbeing.

  • Learn Without Limits – Access over 120,000 on-demand courses, alongside technical, project management, leadership, and professional development opportunities.

  • Work That Makes an Impact – Contribute to nationally significant projects that matter, solve complex challenges, and accelerate your career through unique growth opportunities.

  • Build Your Future – Whether you're deepening technical expertise or preparing for leadership, we'll invest in your development every step of the way.
    · And Much More – These are just a few of the ways we invest in our people and help them thrive.

About the Team

You’ll join a team where people work with integrity, inclusion, innovation, agility, collaboration and commitment. In practice, that means sharing ownership, solving complex problems together and staying connected to the customer context, the purpose behind the work and how each role contributes to meaningful outcomes.

We deliver secure, resilient and innovative technology services that enable Defence enterprise and warfighting capabilities across multiple classified domains and networks. We provide world-class ICT operations and agile digital modernisation using advanced analytics, automation, hybrid cloud, DevSecOps, Infrastructure as Code, cybersecurity and AI to optimise highly complex, mission-critical environments.

The Opportunity

The Service Desk Analyst provides Level 1 and Level 2 ICT support within a mission-critical network monitoring and operational support environment. Acting as a first point of contact for users, this role ensures timely incident resolution, service restoration, and escalation of technical issues impacting network availability, performance, and operational capability. Working within an ITIL-aligned service management framework, the role supports 24x7 operational environments through proactive monitoring, incident management, customer engagement, and collaboration with technical support teams.

The position will only be open to Aboriginal or Torres Strait Islander applicants. The filling of this position is intended to constitute an equal opportunity measure under section 8(1) of the Racial Discrimination Act 1975 (Cth).*

Key responsibilities include:

  • Manage incidents and service requests, including logging, categorisation, prioritisation, resolution, and customer communication within agreed service levels.

  • Monitor ICT infrastructure, network services, applications, and operational dashboards to identify service degradation, outages, and performance issues.

  • Perform incident triage and diagnosis, coordinate escalations to specialist teams, and support service restoration, recovery, and major incident activities.

  • Deliver responsive customer support, including troubleshooting assistance, onboarding support, account administration, and access management.

  • Contribute to continuous improvement through operational documentation, knowledge management, service improvement initiatives, and compliance activities.

About You

We are looking for someone who brings judgement, curiosity and a collaborative approach to work that matters.

  • Demonstrated troubleshooting and diagnostic skills across ICT environments.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to engage effectively with stakeholders and customers.

  • Proven ability to manage competing priorities in a fast-paced operational environment.

  • Customer-focused mindset with a commitment to delivering positive service outcomes.

  • Strong attention to detail, accountability, teamwork, and the ability to remain calm under pressure.

This role requires the successful applicant to be an Australian citizen and hold, or be eligible to obtain a TSPV security clearance.

If this role interests you, we encourage you to apply. We value different experiences and are interested in the capability and potential you could bring.

What to Expect When You Apply

Our hiring process is designed to be straightforward, respectful and easy to navigate. If your skills, experience and qualifications look aligned with the role, our Talent Acquisition team will contact you to discuss the next stage. You can expect:

  • An initial conversation with our Talent Acquisition team

  • An interview with the hiring manager or interview panel

We’ll let you know what to expect before each stage, including who you’ll meet and how to prepare. If you need any adjustments or support during the process, please let us know.

Ready to explore what’s possible?

If this sounds like a role where you can make an impact and continue to grow, we’d like to hear from you. Please apply via the “Apply Now” button with your resume. If you have any questions about the role or recruitment process, please contact careers.au@au.leidos.com.

title: Sales Engineer - RSA Governance & Lifecycle (G&L) Specialist

This is a deeply technical, specialist Sales Engineering role focused primarily on RSA Governance & Lifecycle (G&L). This person will serve as the internal G&L Subject Matter Expert (SME), looking after complex, high-stakes technical SE engagements across the international pre-sales organization.

The role will focus (but not limited to) on Identity Governance and Administration (IGA) activities: delivering complicated Proofs-of-Concept (POCs), leading technical workshops, building advanced demonstrations and environments, engineering advanced and non-standard use cases. The role includes a degree of international travel across the EMEA and APJ regions to support key engagements, workshops, and enablement.

The Sales Engineer assists in driving new business from prospective and existing customer accounts within their respective assigned territories, and meeting and/or exceeding the sales quotas to achieve revenue goals.

  • Act as the internal G&L SME and go-to technical authority for the pre-sales and wider field organization on Identity Governance & Administration (IGA).
  • Design, build, and deliver complex, multi-phase Proofs-of-Concept (POCs) that address advanced customer requirements and edge-case scenarios. Whether remote or onsite.
  • Plan and lead technical deep-dive workshops for customers, prospects, and partners, translating business governance requirements into working technical solutions.
  • Leverage AI tools to build and maintain advanced, reusable demonstrations that showcase the full breadth of G&L capabilities, including sophisticated and non-standard use cases.
  • Design, build, and maintain SE demo environments and reference architectures used by the broader Sales Engineering community.
  • Engineer advanced use cases, custom integrations, workflows, connectors, and rules to prove complex governance, provisioning, and access certification scenarios.
  • Serve as go-to person within the SE community on the most technically challenging G&L opportunities and evaluations.
  • Partner with Product Management and Engineering to surface field requirements, validate roadmap capabilities, and pilot new features.
  • Create and deliver technical enablement, knowledge transfer, and best-practice guidance to upskill partners on G&L.
  • Travel across the EMEA and APJ regions as required to support strategic POCs, workshops, and enablement engagements.
  • Work in close collaboration with the entire International pre-sales function across RSA.
  • Skills and Experience Required
  • 6+ years of professional experience in the IT industry.
  • 4+ years of experience in Cybersecurity, ideally within Identity Security.
  • Solid background in Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), ideally hands-on experience with RSA Governance & Lifecycle (G&L).
  • Proven ability to design and deliver complex POCs, technical workshops, and advanced demonstrations.
  • Strong technical background in Linux, SQL, networking, and Oracle databases.
  • Working knowledge of JavaScript and VMware is a plus.
  • Proven ability to successfully navigate and relate to varying levels of functional and technical personnel at customer sites.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills; fluent English is essential.
  • Willingness and ability to travel internationally across the EMEA and APJ regions.

title: Senior/Principal verification Engineer
description:

Debug & Root Cause Analysis

  • Analyze simulation failures and identify RTL, testbench, or architectural issues.
  • Work closely with design and architecture teams to resolve functional and performance-related bugs.
  • Lead complex debug activities across multiple IPs and subsystems.

Coverage & Sign-Off

  • Define and track functional coverage models.
  • Drive functional, code, assertion, and cross-coverage closure.
  • Review verification metrics and provide sign-off recommendations.

    • Interconnect and fabric verification

    • Memory subsystem verification
    • Boot and reset validation

Leadership & Mentoring

  • Strong attention to detail and ability to handle confidential information with discretion and professionalism.

  • Excellent research, analytical and problem-solving skills.

  • Ability to organize workload, prioritize tasks and meet strict deadlines, particularly in payroll or time-sensitive HR processes.

title: Senior Information Security Engineer
description:
About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Information Security Engineer to accelerate modernization and scale of our Security Baseline Configuration program. This role is responsible to independently drive complex work to closure in a high-volume environment, lead cross-functional delivery across teams, and raise the technical bar through automation, scripting, and practical AI-enabled efficiency. This role will be accountable to convert policies and legacy procedures into a secure-by-default, consumable catalog of baseline options that shortens deployment timelines and measurably improves security outcomes


In this role, you will:

  • Lead or participate in computer security incident response activities for moderately complex events
  • Conduct technical investigation of security related incidents and post incident digital forensics to identify causes and recommend future mitigation strategies
  • Provide security consulting on medium projects for internal clients to ensure conformity with corporate information, security policy, and standards
  • Design, document, test, maintain, and provide issue resolution recommendations for moderately complex security solutions related to networking, cryptography, cloud, authentication and directory services, email, internet, applications, and endpoint security
  • Review and correlate security logs
  • Utilize subject matter knowledge in industry leading security solutions and best practices to implement one or more components of information security such as availability, integrity, confidentiality, risk management, threat identification, modeling, monitoring, incident response, access management, and business continuity
  • Identify security vulnerabilities and issues, perform risk assessments, and evaluate remediation alternatives
  • Collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues and managers to resolve issues and achieve goals


Required Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of Information Security Engineering experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education


Desired Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s or master’s degree in relevant Technology /Security discipline
  • One or more professional certifications such as CISSP, CISA, CISM, CCSP, CCSK, CRISC or other industry security certifications
  • Strong Jira experience (workflow usage, ticket hygiene, dependency/aging discipline)
  • Experience implementing or tailoring hardening standards aligned to CIS Benchmarks
  • Expert depth in automation/scripting, baseline configuration engineering, or validation/attestation patterns
  • Experience building standardized “catalog” offerings or secure-by-default patterns consumed by multiple teams
  • Proven success in modernizing processes (reducing cycle time, improving consistency and quality)
  • Strong written communication: concise docs, decisions, and stakeholder updates


Job Expectations:

  • Demonstrated ability to manage a high-volume queue and independently drive complex work to closure
  • Hands-on experience in security engineering or infrastructure engineering with security responsibilities
  • Advanced knowledge in at least two relevant domains (e.g., baselines/hardening, scripting/automation, server OS, encryption, network concepts)
  • Demonstrated ability to create and maintain clear technical documentation and stakeholder updates
  • Demonstrated ability to lead technical reviews and validate outcomes (testing/evidence) for security configurations
  • Own and drive work items from intake → analysis → implementation → validation → closure with minimal supervision
  • Build, review, and publish baseline configurations and standards aligned to CIS Benchmarks where applicable
  • Translate policy/requirements into actionable, testable technical configuration guidance
  • Drive baseline validation (test plans, evidence, outcomes) and iterate based on feedback and telemetry
  • Maintain a secure-by-default baseline catalog with clear versioning, exceptions guidance, and consumption patterns
  • Proactively triages and prioritizes incoming requests; creates clarity from ambiguity and incomplete inputs
  • Own end-to-end delivery for complex work items; manages dependencies, aging, and stakeholder expectations
  • Communicate status/ETAs early and often; escalates with context and recommended options
  • Break large work into smaller deliverables; defines acceptance criteria and validation steps
  • Continuously improve intake, workflow hygiene, and cycle time through lightweight process and automation
  • Resolve friction with a collaborative, solutions-first approach; minimizes escalation by default
  • Translate security requirements into actionable steps; negotiates tradeoffs using risk and data
  • Build durable partnerships; can influence senior engineers and managers through credibility and outcomes
  • Lead working groups to resolve contested requirements, exception patterns, and implementation constraints
  • Contribute to program metrics (adoption, exceptions, cycle time) and continuous improvement initiatives
  • Partner with platform teams to integrate baselines into pipelines (e.g., build/deploy/CI checks) where feasible
  • Apply AI responsibly to accelerate research, analysis, and drafting—with human verification and secure data handling
  • Demonstrate Advanced knowledge in two or more relevant domains; expert in one domain is a strong plus.

Relevant domains include

  • Security baseline configurations / hardening (explicitly including CIS Benchmarks)
  • Scripting/automation/Programming (PowerShell, Python, Bash, C#, Java, etc.)
  • AI understanding (practical use cases, limitations, and secure usage)
  • Server OS fundamentals (Windows/Linux)
  • Network/Firewall concepts (as applicable to baseline requirements)
  • Encryption fundamentals (as applicable to baseline requirements)

Posting End Date:

20 Dec 2026

*Job posting may come down early due to volume of applicants.

We Value Equal Opportunity

Wells Fargo is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Employees support our focus on building strong customer relationships balanced with a strong risk mitigating and compliance-driven culture which firmly establishes those disciplines as critical to the success of our customers and company. They are accountable for execution of all applicable risk programs (Credit, Market, Financial Crimes, Operational, Regulatory Compliance), which includes effectively following and adhering to applicable Wells Fargo policies and procedures, appropriately fulfilling risk and compliance obligations, timely and effective escalation and remediation of issues, and making sound risk decisions. There is emphasis on proactive monitoring, governance, risk identification and escalation, as well as making sound risk decisions commensurate with the business unit’s risk appetite and all risk and compliance program requirements.

title: Safety Coordinator
description:
We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Safety Coordinator to support and promote our company's safety culture across multiple construction and utility job sites. This position is responsible for conducting field safety inspections, ensuring compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements, coordinating employee training, investigating incidents, and working closely with operations teams to maintain safe work environments.

The ideal candidate will have strong communication skills, a hands-on approach to problem solving, and a commitment to protecting employees, clients, and company assets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct regular safety inspections of active job sites, shops, offices, vehicles, and equipment.
  • Prepare and distribute detailed job site inspection reports with corrective action recommendations.
  • Review daily trenching and excavation inspection documentation.
  • Monitor work practices to ensure compliance with OSHA regulations, company policies, and industry best practices.

  • Administer drug and alcohol testing as required.
  • Determine training needs and coordinate employee certifications, safety training, and compliance programs.
  • Enforce permit requirements, including confined space entry procedures.
  • Inspect and test gas monitoring equipment and other safety devices.
  • Verify availability and condition of first aid kits and required safety supplies.
  • Support traffic control and Maintenance of Traffic (MOT) operations, including setup and inspections.
  • Participate in client safety meetings, project planning meetings, pre-construction meetings, and weekly scheduling meetings.
  • Review upcoming work activities and identify potential safety concerns before work begins.
  • Monitor excavation operations to ensure utility locating, potholing, and damage prevention requirements are followed.
  • Assist with development and delivery of safety manuals and safety-related documentation.
  • Prepare safety-related disciplinary documentation and corrective action records.
  • Support loss prevention initiatives through equipment and asset inspections.

title: Full-stack Engineer
description:
Company Description

TuoTempo, part of the Docplanner group since 2019, develops the market-leading CRM solution dedicated to hospitals, medical centers, and health insurance providers. The platform manages and automates the entire patient journey, from the first request to follow-up, centralizing contacts, communications, and processes in a single modular system integrated with the software already used by the organization.

Active in Italy, Spain, Mexico, Colombia, Brazil, and Chile, TuoTempo operates with a clear goal: to revolutionize interactions between healthcare organizations and patients, improve efficiency, reduce costs, and increase staff and patient satisfaction.

Discover how we’re reshaping healthcare delivery at tuotempo.com

Embrace flexibility with our remote-first culture: Work entirely remotely from Italy or Spain, or collaborate in-person at our vibrant hubs in Bologna or Barcelona—we believe in empowering you to work where you thrive!

Full Stack Engineer

We’re looking for a Full Stack Engineer to help build and evolve the products used every day by thousands of clinics and millions of patients. You’ll own product features end-to-end, from backend logic to the interface the user actually touches.

Our frontend is built in React and TypeScript; our backend runs in PHP today and is evolving toward a modern, microservices-based architecture, with AI at the core of how we build. You’ll start by delivering features on our existing product, get a deep understanding of it, and help shape where our stack goes next.

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain product features end-to-end, across frontend and backend.
  • Deliver features on our current PHP backend and contribute to its evolution toward a modern, microservices-based architecture.
  • Build user-facing interfaces in React and TypeScript.
  • Write clean, well-tested code (unit, integration, end-to-end) and take part in code reviews.
  • Make the most of modern AI tooling in your day-to-day development.
  • Work closely with product managers, designers, and QA to ship and monitor features in production.

Your First Month

What to Expect in Your Journey With Us

  • Set up your development environment and get access to our systems.
  • Participate in onboarding sessions.
  • Start exploring our product and getting to know the team.
  • Get comfortable with our workflows and development practices.

After The Second Month

  • Develop, test, and deploy your first feature to production.
  • Monitor how your feature performs and start building a feel for our product metrics.
  • Have a solid understanding of the product across the full stack.
  • Deliver a steady stream of features to production, owning them end-to-end.
  • Start spotting opportunities for improvement and bringing your own proposals to the table.

Qualifications

Must-have:

  • Degree in Computer Science or a related field (e.g., Computer Engineering, Software Engineering, or similar)
  • Fluency in Italian (spoken and written)
  • Good knowledge of English (spoken and written)
  • 3+ years building and shipping web applications.
  • Solid experience with modern frontend architecture (preferred React and TypeScript).
  • Solid backend skills. PHP or TypeScript experience is highly valued, but we also welcome candidates with solid backend experience in other languages (e.g. Java, C#, Go, Rust) who are eager and comfortable working with PHP.
  • Good command of SQL databases.
  • Experience with automated testing.
  • Comfortable working across the full stack.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.

Nice-to-have

  • Experience with microservice / distributed-system architectures.
  • Previous work migrating legacy systems to modern stacks.
  • Experience with Docker and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or Azure).
  • Experience in SaaS, multi-tenant, or healthcare/regulated domains.

✨ What We Offer

We value a healthy work-life balance and long-term growth. Benefits vary by location, but here’s what you can expect:

Shared Benefits

  • 100% remote work, with the option to join our offices in Bologna or Barcelona
  • One extra day off for your birthday
  • Access to iFeel – our mental wellbeing platform

Italy-specific

  • ️ €8/day meal vouchers – lunch is covered if you’re in the Bologna office
  • Private health coverage via Metasalute
  • Access to study in action platform

How does the recruitment process work?

  • Online test – online async exercise to get a first sense of your tech skills.
  • HR interview – a friendly chat to get to know you, your motivations, and tell you more about Tuotempo, our culture, and the team (1 hour).
  • Technical interview – with our Tech Managers, including practical exercises to evaluate your approach and problem-solving skills as a developer (1.5 hours).
  • Final interview — a broader conversation to align on expectations and future growth. If it’s a match, we’ll move forward with the offer!

description:

Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

Your day at NTT DATA
As a Cross Technology Managed Services Engineer (L2) at NTT DATA, you will play an essential role in maintaining our clients' IT infrastructure and systems. Your expertise will help keep everything running smoothly by proactively monitoring, identifying, investigating, and resolving technical incidents and problems. You'll be the go-to person to restore services and ensure our clients' satisfaction.

Your typical day involves managing work queues, addressing incidents and requests within agreed SLAs, and updating tickets with the actions taken. By identifying, analysing, and logging issues before they escalate, you'll be instrumental in maintaining service quality. You'll also collaborate closely with other teams and clients to provide second-level support, ensuring seamless communication and efficient problem resolution.

You will execute changes meticulously, understanding and mitigating risks, and contribute to the change management process with detailed documentation. Your role includes auditing incident and request tickets for quality, recommending improvements, and identifying tasks for automation to enhance efficiency. Additionally, you'll handle client escalations with professionalism and assist in disaster recovery functions and tests when necessary.

Working within our diverse and inclusive environment, you'll help drive the optimization of efforts by working with automation teams and supporting L1 Engineers. Your responsibility also extends to contributing to various projects, ensuring that all changes are approved, and maintaining a positive outlook even in high-pressure situations.

To thrive in this role, you need to have:

title: Technisch administratief medewerker
description:
Hey ondersteunende Baas,

Jij snapt hoe het werkt in de infra: projecten draaien alleen soepel als iemand overzicht houdt, vragen beantwoordt en alles strak in het systeem zet. Jij bent die onmisbare schakel. Jij zorgt dat buiten en binnen perfect op elkaar aansluiten. Geen gedoe. Geen chaos. Gewoon geregeld.

Administratief medewerker: jij houdt het overzicht
Jij bent de lijm tussen onze mensen in het veld, de opdrachtgever en de collega’s op kantoor. Als (technisch) administratief medewerker vorm jij samen met de werkvoorbereider, uitvoerder en projectleider het hart van het projectteam. Alles loopt via jou, van nieuwe projecten registreren, het regelen van materieel en het verwerken van allerlei informatie en documenten in onze systemen. Ook verwerk je de uren die op de projecten zijn gemaakt en verstuur je overzichten hiervan naar onze opdrachtgevers.

Geen dag is hetzelfde. Gelukkig maar, want jij houdt wel van een beetje pit. Je pakt dingen snel op, schakelt makkelijk tussen taken en weet precies wanneer je moet doorpakken. En het mooiste? Jij zorgt voor rust in de storm. Dat maakt jou een echte Baas.

Baas Verkley is een club van doeners

Experts in technische infrastructuur. Landelijk opererend. Van ondergrondse infra tot bovengrondse netwerken: we leggen de basis van Nederland. Onze ambitie? Energietransitie. Samen zetten we de schouders eronder. En over een aantal jaar denken wij en misschien ook jij: yes, ik was erbij!

We zijn bazen onder elkaar. Een groot deel van ons werkt buiten, met beide voeten in de aarde. Hard werken, hard lachen. Bij ons werken alleen maar bazen. Je herkent ons meteen:

  • Regen? Kunnen we tegen
  • Niet lullen maar poetsen
  • Onze handen? Steevast uit de mouwen
  • Aanpakken, doorzetten, always in a good mud
  • Trots op wat we samen voor elkaar krijgen

Geen Baas. Geen probleem. Kun je altijd ergens anders heen.

Wel een Baas? Hoor je erbij. Lees snel verder.

Jij bent een ondersteunende-Baas als je...

  • Administratieve ervaring meebrengt (infra? Helemaal top, maar geen must)
  • Energie krijgt van overzicht, structuur en scherpe administratie
  • Proactief meedenkt hoe het nóg beter en slimmer kan
  • Houdt van afwisseling en snel schakelen
  • 32 tot 40 uur per week kan werken

Wat je daarvoor terugkrijgt? Baas-waardige voorwaarden:

  • Een salaris tussen €3.122,- en €4.481,- bruto per maand (o.b.v 40 uur)
  • 38 (!) vrije dagen per jaar (we houden van doorwerken, maar ook van opladen)
  • Een goeie pensioenregeling, want ook later wil je nog Baas zijn
  • Tijdelijk? Daar doen we niet aan. Jij krijgt meteen een vast contract
  • Groeien in je vak
  • Voldoening

Klaar om jouw administratieve skills in te zetten waar het écht telt?
Klik op de knop en laat van je horen. Met je cv. Of op jouw manier. Zolang we maar snappen waarom jij een echte Baas bent. Voeg gerust toe: Ik … #omdatikeenbaasben

Meer weten?
Bel, app, mail of stuur een rooksignaal of postduif naar Danique via 06-51353255 of d.kouwenberg@baasbv.nl.

We houden van initiatief, maar acquisitie door bureaus slaan we vriendelijk over.

  • Subbing Application; support training and usage for teaching team

  • HRIS Application; support training and usage for teaching and SET team

  • Help Desk; Submit facilities tickets when on duty ​and communicate follow up needs to Studio Manager

Teaching Schedule

  • Support the studio class schedule by teaching a minimum of 6 classes per week of branded CorePower Yoga classes and support the studio through subbing additional classes as needed

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Must demonstrate CorePower Yoga Core Value

  • Excellent oral communication skills, professionalism and exceptional interpersonal skills are required

  • Experience in Customer Service required

  • Completion of a Yoga Alliance certified 200-hour program is preferred

  • Yoga Sculpt teacher training is preferred

  • Familiar and comfortable in studio systems such as the HRIS, intranet, point of sale systems, company scheduling and payroll systems, etc.

  • Ability to build relationships with individuals with diverse personalities and styles and at different levels of seniority

  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment and can prioritize while working under multiple deadlines

  • Proven self-starter with ability to take on new projects with enthusiasm

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office products: Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel

  • Excellent Time Management skills

THE FINE PRINT

COMPENSATION

THE PERKS

At CorePower Yoga, we live our power by showing the world the incredible life-changing things that happen when you root an intensely physical workout in the mindfulness of yoga. This is our promise. We are the nation’s largest yoga studio brand with over 200 locations across the country, digital livestream and on-demand classes, and thousands of passionate yoga teachers sharing the transformative power of our practice.

As a team, we love seeing the magic that happens in a CorePower Yoga class when physical meets mindful and strive to create a work environment that mirrors the balance, empowerment and community experienced in our yoga studios.

title: Verpleegkundige mbo/hbo | Acute Zorg | IHT Venlo | 24-36 uur
description:
Ben jij een verpleegkundige die energie krijgt van werken in de frontlinie van de geestelijke gezondheidszorg? In de acute zorg draait alles om één doel: crisis voorkomen of stabiliseren. Zie jij de uitdaging in complexe zorgsituaties en haal je voldoening uit het begeleiden van mensen in een kwetsbare periode van hun leven?

Als verpleegkundige bij Intensive Home Treatment (IHT) werk je met mensen met psychiatrische problemen die in crisis zijn of dreigen te raken. Samen met een multidisciplinair team biedt je acute zorg, met als doel de crisis te stabiliseren en psychiatrische opnames waar mogelijk te voorkomen of te verkorten. Je ondersteunt patiënten in hun eigen omgeving, vaak thuis, en begeleidt hen in hun herstelproces, samen met naasten en met behoud van zoveel mogelijk eigen regie.

Ons team heeft je hart nodig

Als verpleegkundige bij Intensive Home Treatment (IHT) ben je verantwoordelijk voor het verlenen van acute zorg aan zowel nieuwe patiënten als patiënten uit andere zorgprogramma’s binnen het Vincent van Gogh.

Jouw rol als verpleegkundige binnen het IHT is dat je ondersteuning biedt aan het herstelproces van de patiënt. Dit doe je door middel van huisbezoeken of afspraken binnen het RCG (poliklinisch en dagbehandeling). Je biedt emotionele steun, motiveert en begeleidt hen om zelfstandig te functioneren. Je helpt bij het ontwikkelen van effectieve coping strategieën om toekomstige crisissituaties te voorkomen. Daarnaast geef je voorlichting en advies aan patiënten en hun naasten over psychiatrische aandoeningen, medicatie, zelfzorg en andere relevante onderwerpen.

Je werkt intensief samen met een multidisciplinair team om crisis te stabiliseren waar er gewerkt wordt aan de hand van “shared caseload”. Je neemt deel aan teambesprekingen, intervisies en scholingsactiviteiten om je kennis en vaardigheden actueel te houden en te vergroten. Samen pakken we complexe situaties aan, met ruimte voor overleg, humor en collegialiteit. Dankzij onze inzet kunnen patiënten thuisblijven en wij doen ons werk met trots en plezier.

Als IHT-verpleegkundige kun je goed samenwerken en gebruik maken van de kwaliteiten van je collega’s. Daarnaast ben je in staat om zelfstandig te handelen en hierbij jouw eigen grenzen te bewaken. Je bent kritisch en alert en kunt jezelf zowel mondeling als schriftelijk goed uitdrukken. In jouw werk kun je goed individueel werken, maar heb je ook de eigenschap om op een prettige, flexibele en collegiale wijze jouw plek in te nemen in het team. Je werkt in onregelmatige diensten (dag-, avond- en weekenddiensten).

Verder heb je:

  • Een afgeronde mbo- of hbo-opleiding Verpleegkunde en je beschikt over een geldige BIG-registratie.

  • Kennis van en ervaring met diverse psychiatrische ziektebeelden.

  • Affiniteit met werken met mensen met acute en complexe psychiatrische problematiek.

Om in aanmerking te komen voor deze functie is een positieve Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) vereist.

Het natrekken van referenties en het controleren van diploma’s maken onderdeel uit van de sollicitatieprocedure.

Hoe we jou voorop zetten

  • Inschaling conform CAO GGZ FWG 45 of FWG 50. Bij een mbo-diploma bedraagt het salaris minimaal €3180 en maximaal €4273 bij een fulltime dienstverband. Bij een hbo-diploma bedraagt het salaris minimaal €3560 en maximaal €4716 bij een fulltime dienstverband.

  • Een vast contract voor 24-36 uur per week.

  • Een fijne werkplek in Venlo.

  • Klik hier voor onze primaire en secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden.

Even contacten?

Ben je nieuwsgierig geworden naar het werken op het IHT? Laten we dan kennismaken! Een kop koffie, een meeloopdag en een goed gesprek; we nemen graag de tijd voor jou. Stuur je cv en korte motivatie via de button onderaan de pagina en wie weet zien we je snel.

Heb je eerst nog vragen over de inhoud van deze functie? Neem dan contact op met Jurgen Blommaert. teamleider Acute Zorg, via

jurgenblommaert@vigogroep.nl of 06-34537901.

Mocht je vragen hebben over de sollicitatieprocedure, dan kun je terecht bij Saqi van Elsen, corpprate recruiter, via werken@vigogroep.nl.

Acquisitie op basis van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Senior Category Buyer II
description:
Location: Singapore, Singapore

Thales is a global technology leader trusted by governments, institutions, and enterprises to tackle their most demanding challenges. From quantum applications and artificial intelligence to cybersecurity and 6G innovation, our solutions empower critical decisions rooted in human intelligence. Operating at the forefront of aerospace and space, cybersecurity and digital identity, we’re driven by a mission to build a future we can all trust.

In Singapore, Thales has been a trusted partner since 1973, originally focused on aerospace activities in the Asia-Pacific region. With 2,000 employees across three local sites, we deliver cutting-edge solutions across aerospace (including air traffic management), defence and security, and digital identity and cybersecurity sectors. Together, we’re shaping the future by enabling customers to make pivotal decisions that safeguard communities and power progress.

The Category Buyer (CB) may support one or several procurement categories. He/She is accountable for end to end performance of the acquisition process, via the management of the RFI &/or RFP's until the Pvet 4 stage (up to PVet 5 based on some Regions).

The Category Buyer is expected to lead supplier selection exercises to support business needs. He/She ensures the deployment, implementation and monitoring of agreed category strategies.

Furthermore, the CB is :

Responsible for supplier relationship management and continuous improvement of suppliers within his/her category (with the support of Supplier Performance Management Team if needed) and the management of suppliers performance including, but not limited to, quality, cost, delivery, contractual performance and innovation.

An essential element of his role is to ensure that the suppliers provide the competitiveness required to support the business and to introduce optimal supply base changes to support business winning capability.

Job Responsibilities:
The Category Buyer (CB) supports one or several procurement categories. He/She in close relation with the relevant Global Category Managers (GCM), the Categories Team leader (CTL), the Category Manager(CM) and the Tactical Buyer (TB).
All actions have to be in line with the strategy defined by the Global Category Manager and the CM. The CB's prime role is the management of the RFI or/and RFP's until PVet 4 stage (up to PVet 5 based on some Regions) in order to provide the competiveness to the business.

In addition to this their main tasks are:

Operational Support :

  • Ensure the BA's (Business Admin/Users) receive all required information to raise the Procurement Orders.

Procurement Competitiveness Capture:

  • Monitor the markets for defined categories including key players, newcomers, economic evolutions, market or regulation constraints, innovations and technology in order to support the development of the most up to date category strategies to the businesses.
  • Based on the above provide insights as to how products / projects could be more competitive via the adoption of different suppliers / methodologies / technology etc.
  • Governance, Leadership and Performance Management:
  • Ensure appropriate governance is applied using KPI's and root cause corrective actions

Supplier / Acquisition Management:

  • Performance management of the supply base in line with the standards set out by the Global Category Manager .
  • Ensure that supplier competitions follow the governance process and are balanced and fair in order to improve business and customer performance.
  • Ensure that global contracts / framework agreements are adopted and utilized.
  • Ensure that Thales e-Acquisition and all THALES procurement tools are fully used.
  • Based on the performance management of the supply base identify the suppliers who require focused development actions and ensure that the Supplier Development Team have the required support / leverage in order for these actions to be successful.

Qualifications:

  • Recognized professional qualification (CIPS, EIPM, ISM, MAI...) are desirable
  • Business, Procurement, Supply Chain or Engineering degrees are desirable
  • Experience working in project/program, design / product development with cross functional teams.
  • IS/IT Category experience includes IS/IT hardware, software, network equipment, telco services and its equivalent.
  • Demonstrates experience in negotiation projects &/or categories is desirable
  • Ability to implement operational supply chain strategy
  • Contractual knowledge especially of framework agreements, Liability & insurance.
  • Ability to lead negotiation including import / export considerations
  • Understanding of the market for the categories under his/her control but also ability to understand the customer’s needs and program issues
  • Good knowledge of a best practice acquisition Process.
  • Capability to work within cross functional and international multi organisational teams (teamwork)
  • Open minded (listen, share ideas etc.) and able to bring added value and new ideas
  • Ability to take initiatives with a good capacity of analysis and of synthesis
  • Ability to prioritize tasks
  • Ability to represent Thales and to demonstrate Thales values
  • Good written and verbal communication skills

At Thales, we’re committed to fostering a workplace where respect, trust, collaboration, and passion drive everything we do. Here, you’ll feel empowered to bring your best self, thrive in a supportive culture, and love the work you do. Join us, and be part of a team reimagining technology to create solutions that truly make a difference – for a safer, greener, and more inclusive world.

title: Securitized Products Market Risk Senior Vice President
description:
Excited to grow your career?

BBVA is a global company with more than 160 years of history that operates in more than 25 countries where we serve more than 80 million customers. We are more than 121,000 professionals working in multidisciplinary teams with profiles as diverse as financiers, legal experts, data scientists, developers, engineers and designers.

About the job:

Role Overview

We are seeking an experienced Senior Manager within Market Risk with deep expertise in U.S. structured products, including ABS, MBS, CMBS and related securitized products.

The role requires a strong understanding of the U.S. securitized-products market and the ability to independently assess market risk, pricing and valuation dynamics across complex portfolios.

This is a senior technical and risk-management position requiring sound judgment, market expertise and the ability to challenge trading and valuation assumptions from an independent Market Risk perspective.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide independent Market Risk oversight of structured-product portfolios, with particular focus on ABS, MBS, CMBS and other securitized or mortgage-related instruments.

  • Monitor and assess market risk exposures across the portfolio, including key sensitivities, spread risk, interest-rate risk, volatility risk, basis risk and other relevant risk drivers.

  • Develop a deep understanding of portfolio positioning and risk concentrations, identifying emerging risks and potential vulnerabilities under changing market conditions.

  • Perform rigorous analysis of valuation and pricing, independently assessing whether market prices, model outputs and valuation assumptions appropriately reflect prevailing market conditions and underlying risk characteristics.

  • Challenge Front Office pricing and valuation methodologies where appropriate, using market data, comparable instruments, model analysis and professional judgment.

  • Understand and assess the impact of key structural characteristics of securitized products, including prepayment behavior, extension/contraction risk, credit enhancement, collateral performance, tranche structure and optionality.

  • Monitor developments in the U.S. ABS, MBS and CMBS markets, including changes in liquidity, spreads, issuance activity, investor positioning, collateral performance and macroeconomic drivers.

  • Evaluate portfolio risk under both normal and stressed market conditions and contribute to the development and interpretation of stress-testing and scenario-analysis frameworks.

  • Assess the adequacy of risk metrics and methodologies used to capture the specific characteristics and nonlinear behavior of structured products.

  • Perform independent analysis using industry-standard valuation and analytics platforms, including Numerix and/or Polypaths, as well as other relevant analytical tools.

  • Support the review and enhancement of market-risk frameworks, limits, controls and monitoring processes applicable to securitized-product portfolios.

  • Identify material changes in portfolio risk, valuation uncertainty or market liquidity and communicate them clearly to Market Risk management and relevant senior stakeholders.

  • Partner effectively with Trading, Finance, Model Risk and other control functions while maintaining an independent Market Risk perspective.

  • Provide senior-level technical expertise and guidance on structured-product risk without requiring the broader organizational or strategic scope expected of a Principal or Director-level role.

Required Experience

  • 10+ years of relevant professional experience in Market Risk, Trading Risk, Valuation, Product Control or a closely related function within fixed income or structured products;

  • At least 5–7 years of direct experience covering U.S. securitized products, including ABS, MBS and CMBS.

  • Demonstrated experience in market risk measurement, valuation and pricing assessment of complex fixed-income and structured-product portfolios.

  • Strong track record analyzing sensitivities, stress scenarios, spread risk, interest-rate risk, optionality, prepayment risk and extension risk.

  • Significant exposure to the U.S. structured-products market, ideally within a major bank, broker-dealer, asset manager or other institution with meaningful securitized-products activity.

  • Hands-on experience using Numerix and/or Polypaths for valuation, cash-flow analysis and risk measurement.

  • Experience independently challenging Front Office assumptions, pricing and risk assessments from an independent Market Risk perspective.

  • Prior experience interacting with senior stakeholders across Trading, Risk, Finance, Valuation and Model Risk.

Required Qualifications and Expertise

  • Deep expertise in ABS, MBS and CMBS, with strong understanding of product structures, cash-flow behavior, embedded optionality and key valuation and risk drivers.

  • Strong and demonstrable knowledge of the U.S. securitized-products market.

  • Significant experience analyzing market risk through sensitivities, scenario analysis, stress testing and other quantitative and qualitative risk measures.

  • Strong valuation and pricing expertise, including the ability to independently assess market levels and critically evaluate model-based valuations.

  • Strong understanding of fixed-income markets, yield curves, credit spreads, volatility, liquidity and relative-value dynamics.

  • Excellent analytical and quantitative capabilities, combined with strong commercial and market judgment.

  • Ability to interpret complex portfolios and translate technical risk analysis into clear conclusions and actionable risk assessments.

  • Strong communication skills and the ability to engage credibly with senior stakeholders, traders, quantitative teams and other control functions.

  • Demonstrated ability to work independently and exercise sound judgment in complex or fast-moving market environments.

Preferred Background

  • Prior experience within a major U.S. or international bank, broker-dealer, asset manager or other institution with significant structured-products activity.

  • Experience covering trading desks active in U.S. securitized products from a Market Risk or independent risk-management perspective.

  • Strong familiarity with mortgage analytics, prepayment models, cash-flow modeling and structured-product valuation methodologies.

  • Knowledge of relevant market data sources, valuation platforms and risk infrastructure used within securitized-products businesses.

title: Product Owner
description:
Ga jij verder als Product Owner?

Als Product Owner word je onderdeel van de afdeling change en regiemanagement. Deze afdeling is verantwoordelijk voor het vertalen van strategische en tactische (business) doelstellingen naar een concrete roadmap met initiatieven die bijdragen aan deze doelstellingen. Daarnaast is de Product Owner ook verantwoordelijk voor de realisatie van deze roadmap binnen de gehele organisatie.

Deze vacature voor Product Owner richt zich op onze passieve kabelinfrastructuur (Laag 1). Onze kabelinfrastructuur betreft zowel Fiber to the Home (FTTH) als Coax, naar in totaal 1.6 miljoen adressen. Om deze netwerken zo optimaal mogelijk te bouwen, onderhouden, monitoren en beheren, gebruiken we diverse applicaties voor administratieve registratie en gerelateerde processen zoals levering, service en voorraadbeheer. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan applicaties die vastleggen waar kabels geografisch in de grond liggen, of applicaties waarmee storingen op het netwerk worden afgehandeld. Samen vormt dit Laag 1-landschap het fundament van onze dienstverlening, zodat de partijen die hierop hun diensten leveren het netwerk optimaal kunnen benutten.

Als Product Owner ben jij verantwoordelijk voor meerdere applicaties die bij verschillende leveranciers worden gebouwd en onderhouden. Dat betekent dat geen dag hetzelfde is: het ene moment stem je de backlog af met een externe partij, het volgende moment schakel je met interne stakeholders over prioriteiten. Jij houdt het overzicht en weet moeiteloos te schakelen tussen belangen, werkwijzen per leverancier en stakeholders, hierop weet jij jouw communicatiestijl aan te passen. Je bent het eerste aanspreekpunt voor functionaliteit, het afstemmen van prioriteiten en het bewaken van de backlog.

Tot jouw takenpakket behoren o.a.:

  • Ontwikkelen en beheren van een heldere productvisie en roadmap voor de lange termijn;

  • Coördineren van de ontwikkeling en implementatie van Laag 1 applicaties, hiervoor voer jij de regie naar de verschillende leveranciers;

  • Implementeren van verbeteringen en nieuwe functionaliteiten op basis van operationele behoeften en feedback van gebruikers, maar ook security;

  • Begeleiden en ondersteunen van ontwikkelteams bij technische uitdagingen;

  • Onderhouden van relaties met interne en externe stakeholders, waaronder: verschillende afdelingen binnen DELTA Fiber, aannemers, Internet Service Providers en leveranciers.

  • Het opstellen en bijhouden van een backlog per applicatie in Azure DevOps

Wordt dit jouw nieuwe uitdaging?

Je bent een proactieve en resultaatgerichte professional met een passie voor product- en procesbeheer en ontwikkeling van applicaties. Met jouw hands-on mentaliteit coördineer je de ontwikkeling en implementatie van applicaties, waarbij je nauw samenwerkt met diverse interne en externe ontwikkelteams om ervoor te zorgen dat technische en functionele eisen worden opgeleverd. Door jouw strategisch inzicht ontwikkel je een heldere product visie en identificeer je kansen voor innovatie. Je ondersteunt dagelijks de operationele activiteiten, monitort prestaties en zorgt voor continue verbeteringen. Je voelt je prettig in een omgeving met meerdere lopende trajecten tegelijk, en raakt niet in de war van wisselende prioriteiten of onverwachte issues. Je bent niet degene die alles zelf bouwt, maar wél degene die zorgt dat alle neuzen dezelfde kant op staan — ook als de partijen verschillende belangen of processen hebben. Je bent analytisch, besluitvaardig, en past moeiteloos je communicatiestijl aan op je gesprekspartner en de situatie.

De standplaats voor deze functie is in Schiedam, perfect gelegen tussen de snelweg en het station in.

Waarom DELTA?

Bij DELTA Fiber bouwen we aan de digitale infrastructuur van Nederland - en daar horen arbeidsvoorwaarden bij die net zo sterk en toekomstgericht zijn als ons netwerk. Zo is alles goed geregeld voor nu én later. Daarom kun je bij ons o.a. rekenen op:

  • Een salaris tussen € 4.206 en € 6.008 bruto per maand (o.b.v. 40 uur), passend bij jouw ervaring en impact;

  • Een Benefit Budget van 15,17% boven op je salaris, inclusief 8% vakantiegeld en de waarde van 7 extra bovenwettelijke vakantiedagen - vrij te besteden aan extra inkomen, verlof of andere arbeidsvoorwaarden die bij jou passen. Denk bijvoorbeeld aan het fiscaal voordelig aflossen van je studieschuld, investeren in de verduurzaming van je woning of werken aan je vitaliteit;

  • Een jaarlijkse bonus tot 3% van je jaarsalaris, gekoppeld aan jouw individuele prestaties;

  • 20 vakantiedagen per jaar, met de flexibiliteit om via je benefit budget extra dagen aan te schaffen;

  • Een goede pensioenpot voor later. Samen investeren we in jouw toekomst én die van je naasten: DELTA Fiber neemt het grootste deel van de premie voor haar rekening (18,97% vs. 8,13%), zodat jij met een kleine eigen bijdrage zorgeloos bouwt aan later, inclusief partnerpensioen en bescherming bij arbeidsongeschiktheid;

  • Mogelijkheden tot thuiswerken met ruimte om je werkweek flexibel in te richten (in overleg met je leidinggevende);

  • Onbeperkt toegang tot trainingen en opleidingen via onze eigen DELTA Fiber Academy;

  • Ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen en door te groeien binnen de organisatie.

Dit neem je mee:

  • Een afgeronde HBO opleiding, bij voorkeur in de richting van IT;

  • Aantoonbare ervaring in een soortgelijke rol binnen de Telecom- of IT sector;

  • Kennis van FTTH-netwerken en bijbehorende IT-applicaties is een pre;

  • Ervaring met Agile/Scrum-methodologieën, backlogmanagement en bij voorkeur in het bezit van PSPO 1 certificaat;

  • Uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk;

title: Myyjiä Keskisuomalaisen myyntitiimiin Uudellemaalle!
description:
Haetaan reippaita myyjiä Mediakonserni Keskisuomalaisen myyntitiimiin!

Oletko reipas ja vuorovaikutuksellinen asennetyyppi, joka haluaa oppia uutta myynnin parissa? Hyvä, meillä on sinulle töitä! Etsinnässä avoin ja reipas persoona, joka ei pelkää ihmiskohtaamisia ja nauttii vuorovaikutuksellisesta juttelusta. Myynnissä myös asenne ratkaisee - muut opit saat meiltä!

Mistä on kyse?

Keskisuomalaisen myyntikonsepti kasvaa ja tästä syystä tarvitsemme reippaita myyjiä Uudenmaan alueelle. Tässä työssä pääset reissaamaan jopa 19 eri alueelle ja myymään kunkin alueen omaa paikallismediaa, eli työ on liikkuvaa ja myyntialueet vaihtuvat päivittäin. Yhteiskäyttöauto löytyy Vantaan Martinlaaksosta, aivan Vantaankosken juna-aseman läheisyydestä.

Keskisuomalaisen myyntipisteillä työ koostuu myynnin kuninkuuslajista, eli tarjontamyynnistä. Työtä tehdään kauppakeskuksissa, messuilla sekä erilaisissa tapahtumissa kuten Espoon Viinijuhlat, Tikkurila Festivaalit, Kivistön Kivijuhlat jne. Tapahtumasta riippuen pääset tekemään, joko promootiotyötä tai myyntiä. Yhteinen missiomme on ottaa Uudenmaan alue haltuun ja tehdä loistavaa tulosta!

Tässä työssä pääset myös tienaamaan! Palkkasi koostuu kiinteästä pohjapalkasta 11€/h sekä kannustavasta provisiosta. Rainmakerilla työtehtäviin annetaan työsuhteen alussa kattava koulutus, joka on yhden kuukauden mittainen. Rainmakerin koulutusjakso on palkallinen. Koulutusjakson palkkaus on 85 % sovitusta pohjapalkasta. Tarjoamme mahdollisuuden kehittyä ja kasvaa ammatillisesti. Motivoivan provikkamallin avulla saat nostettua palkkapussisi uudelle levelille. Maksamme siis pohjapalkan päälle extraa jokaisesta tehdystä tilauksesta. Keskituntiansio nykyisillä myyjillämme on 18 e/h ja aktiivisimmat myyjämme pääsevät jopa 30-50€/h ansioihin!

Pähkinänkuoressa, tarjoamme sinulle:

  • Joustavan, opettavaisen ja hauskan työn myynnin ja promootiotyön parissa

  • Vahvan ja ammattitaitoisen tuen kehittymiselle

  • Erityisen mahtavan työporukan ympärille

  • Merkityksellisen työtehtävän loistavien tuotteiden parissa

  • Hyvän palkan ja vakituisen työsuhteen

Mitä odotamme sinulta:

Odotamme sinulta ennen kaikkea tavoitteellista, myynnillistä sekä positiivista asennetta, ja halua saavuttaa yhdessä tiimisi kanssa huipputuloksia! Tämä voi olla ensikosketuksesi myynnin maailmaan, eli sinulla ei tarvitse olla aiempaa kokemusta myyntityöstä.

Tehtävä edellyttää täysi-ikäisyyttä sekä sujuvaa suomen kielen taitoa. Työ edellyttää voimassa olevaa B-ajokorttia.

Rainmaker = mahdollisuus menestyä

Rainmaker on Suomen suurin myynnin ja asiakastyön palveluyritys. Palveluksessamme työskentelee noin 1500 sateentekijöiksikin kutsuttua palvelualan ammattilaista ympäri Suomen sijaitsevissa toimipisteissämme, asiakkaidemme toimitiloissa sekä toimipisteessämme Espanjan Torreviejassa. Haluamme tarjota sekä työntekijöillemme, että asiakkaillemme mahdollisuuksia menestyä!

Meitä sateentekijöitä yhdistää positiivinen asenne ja halu kehittää itseämme. Teemme työtä sen eteen, että sinä saat työstäsi sen, mitä elämässäsi juuri nyt tarvitset. Meillä on tilaa yksilöllisille urapoluille asiakaskohtaamisten maailmassa ja edustamme sekä kotimaisia että kansainvälisiä huippubrändejä eri toimialoilta. Laadukkaat myynnilliset asiakaskohtaamiset ovat meille sydämen asia. Panostamme työhyvinvointiin, hyvään työilmapiiriin ja innostuneeseen työyhteisöön, sillä mielestämme työssä pitää olla myös hauskaa. Työkulttuuriimme kuuluvat myös erilaiset hauskat kilpailut pelillistämisen keinoin.

💙 Edut ja työntekijöiden hyvinvointi

✅ Maksamme myös aluekohtaista toimintarahaa kuukausitasolla, joka voidaan käyttää yhdessäoloon paikallisesti.

✅ Kattava Terveystalon työterveyshuolto

Kannattaa hakea heti!

Mikäli kysyttävää heräsi, tavoitat rekrytoijamme soittamalla +35840 714 7999 / Maria. Jos minua ei saa heti kiinni, olen yhteydessä mahdollisimman pian.

Haastattelen hakijoita jo hakuaikana. Voit jättää hakemuksesi kohdasta ''Hae työpaikkaa''.

Tehtävän perustiedot:

Paikkakunta: Uusimaa
Aloitus: Sopimuksen mukaan mahdollisimman pian
Työaika: 15-40h/vko, pääsääntöisesti klo 10 – 19 välillä, arkisin ja lauantaisin
Työn kesto: Toistaiseksi voimassa oleva
Palkka: pohja 11 €/h + provisiot ja bonukset

title: Senior Business Process Analyst
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Business Process Analyst based in the United States.

The Senior Business Process Analyst will play a key role in driving efficient project delivery and operational excellence across complex, cross-functional initiatives.
This position combines business analysis, project management, process optimization, and Agile delivery leadership.
You’ll help teams translate business needs into clear requirements, user stories, and actionable delivery plans.
Working across Scrum and Kanban teams, you’ll monitor progress, manage dependencies, identify risks, and keep initiatives aligned with commitments.
You’ll also use Jira, Confluence, and AI-enabled tools to improve project visibility, documentation, workflow automation, and collaboration.
The role offers an opportunity to influence processes and delivery practices while working with diverse technical, operational, and business stakeholders.
This is a fully remote position designed for an organized, analytical professional who thrives in a fast-paced, collaborative environment.

Accountabilities:

  • Lead day-to-day project management activities, including schedule development, milestone tracking, dependency management, risk identification, and issue mitigation.
  • Maintain project plans, dashboards, status reports, delivery roadmaps, and other reporting tools to provide stakeholders with clear visibility into progress and commitments.
  • Track work across multiple Scrum and Kanban teams using Jira, ensuring planned, active, and completed work remain aligned with delivery objectives.
  • Follow up consistently on action items, deliverables, blockers, dependencies, and stakeholder requests to maintain delivery momentum.
  • Establish repeatable project workflows, documentation standards, and governance practices that improve consistency and operational efficiency.
  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily standups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives.
  • Support teams in removing impediments, improving communication, and maintaining alignment with sprint goals and delivery priorities.
  • Monitor Agile delivery metrics such as velocity, burndown, capacity, and workflow health, proactively addressing risks that could affect timelines or outcomes.
  • Manage Jira boards, workflows, tasks, queries, and reporting structures to improve project transparency and team efficiency.
  • Gather, document, and validate business and functional requirements with stakeholders, translating them into well-defined user stories and acceptance criteria.
  • Map and analyze end-to-end business processes to identify opportunities for optimization, automation, reengineering, and improved operational performance.
  • Collaborate with subject matter experts, technical teams, analysts, and operations professionals to ensure requirements are understood and delivered accurately.
  • Maintain structured and traceable project documentation in Confluence, linking requirements, development activities, reporting, and delivery artifacts.
  • Leverage AI-enabled tools to support project tracking, workflow automation, documentation maintenance, reporting, and coordination across multiple initiatives.
  • Provide clear project updates, identify emerging risks and dependencies, and support stakeholders in making informed delivery decisions.

    • Requirements

    • Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.
    • At least 3 years of experience in project management, business analysis, Agile delivery, or a closely related field; the broader role profile calls for 5+ years of related experience.
    • Demonstrated experience managing project schedules, tracking delivery milestones, coordinating dependencies, and monitoring risks and issues.
    • Strong experience gathering and documenting business requirements and translating them into user stories, acceptance criteria, and actionable deliverables.
    • Hands-on experience working with Agile methodologies, including Scrum and/or Kanban, and facilitating core Agile ceremonies.
    • Proficiency with Jira and Confluence for project tracking, workflow management, requirements traceability, reporting, and documentation.
    • Strong analytical and process-improvement skills, with the ability to evaluate existing workflows and identify opportunities for greater efficiency and automation.
    • Familiarity with project management and delivery concepts, including roadmaps, sprint metrics, capacity, dependencies, risks, and stakeholder reporting.
    • Ability to use AI tools effectively to enhance project coordination, documentation, tracking, and operational workflows.
    • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex project information clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
    • Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent initiatives and competing priorities.
    • Strong collaboration and facilitation skills, with the ability to work effectively across cross-functional teams.
    • U.S. citizenship is required.
    • The position requires the ability to satisfy a BI Full 6C (T4) Public Trust requirement; no security clearance is currently required or obtainable for this role.
    • Familiarity with refugee and immigrant populations, social programs, ITIL, or other process improvement frameworks is preferred.
    • Experience integrating business and operational data into Jira and Confluence for traceability, reporting, and workflow automation is an advantage.

      • Salary: Estimated range of $102,000–$138,000 annually, with actual compensation determined by experience, geographic location, and applicable contractual requirements.
