  • Exciting opportunity for a Clinical Trial Assistant to join the Sydney Clinical Trials Centre (CTC) at the University of Sydney

  • Base Salary $89,755 - $100,495 + 17% superannuation

About the opportunity

This is a Targeted Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander Position. While we welcome applications from all candidates, this is a targeted role for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander people. As part of our commitment to diversity and inclusion, Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander candidates will be assessed as a priority. This Exemption is claimed under Section 21 of the Anti-Discrimination Act 1977.

The Sydney CTC is a flagship centre of excellence in clinical trials and related research at the University of Sydney. We design and deliver trials and related research, including coordination, monitoring, data acquisition and management, and statistical analysis. Our health economics, biostatistics, systematic reviews, and biomarker teams work with trial data to inform healthcare providers about best practices.

In this role, you will be supporting the delivery of high-quality clinical trial activities across multiple concurrent projects. Working under the general direction of the Trial Operations Coordinator and Project Manager, you will play a key part in maintaining essential trial documentation, coordinating daily administrative functions and ensuring operational activities run smoothly. You will support staff, study sites and collaborative groups through accurate information management, proactive problem-solving and timely coordination of trial-related tasks. This is a hands-on, fast-paced and detail-oriented role where your organisational strengths and initiative will support the effective delivery of impactful clinical research.

Why work with us

We are committed to creating a culturally safe, supportive and inclusive workplace for Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander staff.

Key benefits include:

  • generous cultural leave and flexible working arrangements

  • access to Indigenous professional and career development programs, including mentoring, leadership programs, and development funding

  • participation in an internal Indigenous staff network, providing cultural connection, peer support and professional development opportunities

  • YURA network

  • tax-efficient salary packaging options for cars, laptops, and additional contributions to your superannuation fund

Your key responsibilities will be to:

  • Provide high-level administrative and operational support by delivering efficient daily services, coordinating correspondence, and maintaining accurate records and filing systems.

  • Coordinate administrative tasks for meetings including preparing materials, organising venues and catering, arranging teleconferences, and taking minutes.

  • Develop, maintain and track trial documentation, study materials, online content and relevant databases in accordance with SOPs and project requirements.

title: Scientist II, Protein Engineering
description:
Work Schedule

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Environmental Conditions

Laboratory Setting

Job Description

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you’ll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.


DESCRIPTION:

We are seeking a Scientist II with a strong background in protein engineering and relevant experience in an R&D environment. As part of the Ligand Discovery department, you will join a multidisciplinary team developing next-generation antibody-based affinity ligands for the purification of biologics.

In this role, you will apply your expertise in protein engineering, molecular biology and biochemistry to develop and characterize antibody fragments with defined binding properties. Working closely with colleagues across R&D, you will design, execute and interpret experiments that contribute to the development of innovative affinity ligands.

In addition, you will take ownership of defined scientific workstreams, identify technical challenges, propose practical solutions, and contribute to project discussions and scientific decision-making. You will contribute to the development of new products from early discovery through development while working in a collaborative and innovative environment.

What you will do:

  • Design, plan and execute protein-engineering experiments to improve the performance of affinity ligands.
  • Apply computational protein engineering, structural modeling, bioinformatics, and AI-enabled software tools to support ligand design and optimization.
  • Screen and characterize antibody fragments using protein-display technologies such as phage display or yeast display.
  • Analyze and integrate large experimental, sequence, and screening datasets to identify trends, generate actionable insights, and guide iterative engineering cycles
  • Contribute to project planning, coordinate experimental activities, and track progress within assigned workstreams.
  • Collaborate closely with multidisciplinary teams across R&D.
  • Share knowledge and support colleagues and junior team members where appropriate.
  • Stay informed about scientific and technological developments and evaluate new approaches that can strengthen our antibody-engineering platform.


REQUIREMENTS:

Minimum Requirements / Qualifications:

  • MSc or PhD in Molecular Biology, Biochemistry or a related life-sciences discipline. BSc candidates with extensive experience in antibody engineering may also be considered.
  • Relevant experience in protein engineering, preferably within the biotechnology industry or applied academic research.
  • Experience independently planning, executing and interpreting scientific experiments.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to laboratory safety protocols
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a proactive, hands-on approach.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Working knowledge of Dutch is considered an advantage.

Required Technical Experience:

  • Protein engineering, preferably in combination with display technologies.
  • Molecular cloning and protein expression in microbial expression systems.
  • Proficiency with data analysis software and statistical tools
  • Immunological assays, such as ELISA.

Preferred Technical Experience:

  • Experience with antibodies or antibody fragments.
  • Experience with SPR or BLI for the analysis of protein-protein interactions.
  • Experience with with automated liquid handling systems and high-throughput workflows.
  • Experience with protein purification using FPLC.

title: Network Engineer
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

Do you want to be at the forefront of designing and implementing cutting-edge network solutions? Within our Network Services team at Kyndryl, you will be the go-to expert for providing top-of-the-line technical solutions throughout the entire solution lifecycle. You will be responsible for creating local and wide-area network solutions that utilize multiple platforms and protocols, ensuring that our customers have the best possible network infrastructure to support their business needs.

Your skills in routers, networking controllers, bridges, and networking software will be essential as you troubleshoot network issues and coordinate with vendors to install the latest hardware and software, such as routers and switches. Not only will you help keep our customer’s networks running smoothly, but you will also work on project implementation, conduct project planning and cost analysis, and build proof-of-concept solutions with networking system technology.

In this role, you will have the opportunity to review project requirements, communicate them accurately to the team, and ensure they are appropriately fulfilled. You will use your expertise to design and implement local and wide-area network solutions, including IP and VOIP, that address customer requirements. You will also provide high-quality technical solutions to our customers to prepare them for implementation, go-live, and maintenance.

If you are excited about using your technical expertise to create innovative network solutions and provide outstanding customer service, then this is the role for you!

Your Future at Kyndryl
At Kyndryl, we understand the importance of investing in our employees' professional growth and development. In Network Services, you can expect to receive a lot of support for training programs to keep your skills and knowledge up to date with the latest industry trends and technologies. By joining our team, you will have the opportunity to work on cutting-edge projects and contribute to the development of innovative solutions for our customers – including new wireless and 5G technologies – not yet adopted by most companies.


Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise

•6+ years of experience focused on network support, configuration, and implementation
•6+ years of experience in core switching, routing, MPLS, and firewalls
•Networking and security architecture and engineering support experience across local, regional, and global domains
•Ability to effectively execute multiple IT projects and deadlines with limited supervision

Preferred Technical and Professional Experience

•Application Centric Infrastructure (ACI) deployment and data center experience
•Experience with design and implementing Software Defined Network (SDN) and large complex networks
•Experience with protocols and technologies such as, BDP, OSPF, MP-FBP EVPN, VXLAN, or VPC


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

description:

Sviluppatore Java / Angular con almeno 2 anni di esperienza

Nello specifico si occuperà di:


  • Contribuire attivamente allo sviluppo e all'implementazione di applicazioni software e soluzioni IT sia lato backend che frontend;
  • Partecipare alla progettazione dell'architettura software seguendo le specifiche tecniche e i requisiti di business;
  • Sviluppare ed esporre servizi e API secondo standard moderni;
  • Collaborare alla manutenzione, all'ottimizzazione e al refactoring del codice esistente per garantirne la scalabilità;
  • Lavorare in sinergia con i team di sviluppo, i designer e il management aziendale secondo logiche collaborative;
  • Supportare le attività di testing, debugging e messa in opera (deployment) degli applicativi;
  • Redigere la documentazione tecnica relativa al codice e alle soluzioni implementate.


Competenze ricercate:


Titolo di studio:

Laurea triennale o magistrale in informatica, ingegneria informatica, o discipline scientifico-tecnologiche equivalenti (saranno valutati anche profili con diploma tecnico ed equivalente esperienza sul campo).


Esperienza:

Esperienza di almeno 2 anni in ruoli di sviluppo software in contesti aziendali o consulenziali strutturati.


Competenze Tecniche:

Conoscenza lavorativa e pratica di almeno una delle seguenti tecnologie:


  • SpringBoot
  • Servizi REST
  • Angular o React


Attitudine e Passione:

Valutiamo la passione per l'informatica come il primo vero requisito per iniziare a lavorare con noi; siamo convinti che, con la giusta motivazione e flessibilità al cambiamento, tutto il resto si possa facilmente imparare all'interno del nostro team.


Soft Skills:

Ottime capacità relazionali e comunicative, forte propensione al lavoro di squadra (\"filosofia collaborativa\") e orientamento alla soddisfazione del cliente.


Nice to have:

  • Conoscenza o esperienza pregressa nell'utilizzo di architetture a microservizi, database relazionali e non relazionali, o strumenti di versionamento del codice (es. Git);
  • Conoscenza dei principali tool di vibe coding e metodologie relative.


Sedi di inserimento aziendale:

Napoli, Roma, Padova, Milano, Como, Verona (con possibilità di valutare modalità di lavoro ibrida in base alla sede).

title: Teamleider Vergunningen
description:
Werk jij straks hier?

Werken voor Veiligheid, Vergunningen, Toezicht en Handhaving (VTH) is iedere dag werken aan het veiligheidsgevoel en de leefbaarheid van onze inwoners. Hier verlenen de vergunningverleners vergunningen, houden de BOA’s toezicht op de openbare ruimte en controleren de toezichthouders nieuwe en bestaande bouwwerken. We handhaven wetten, maken integraal veiligheidsbeleid en pakken als één team crisisbeheersing op. Alles voor een veilig en leefbaar Leidschendam-Voorburg!

Hoe doe jij ertoe:

Het team Vergunningen is volop in ontwikkeling. Als teamleider bouw je verder aan een professionele en toekomstbestendige organisatie waarin eigenaarschap, samenwerking en dienstverlening centraal staan. Je geeft richting aan verandering, creëert rust en duidelijkheid en zorgt ervoor dat medewerkers het beste uit zichzelf kunnen halen.

In deze functie:

  • Geef je leiding aan het team Vergunningen (Bouw, APV/Bijzondere Wetten, Juristen en Ondersteuning);
  • Coach en ontwikkel je medewerkers en stimuleer je eigenaarschap, vakmanschap en samenwerking;
  • Zorg je voor een stabiele, professionele en resultaatgerichte werkomgeving;
  • Stuur je op kwaliteit, prestaties en een optimale dienstverlening aan inwoners en ondernemers;
  • Ben je een stevige gesprekspartner voor bestuurders, management en samenwerkingspartners;
  • Verbind je bestuurlijke opgaven met een zorgvuldige en efficiënte uitvoering;
  • Draag je bij aan de verdere ontwikkeling en professionalisering van het vergunningendomein;
  • Stuur je op een doelmatige inrichting van processen en continu verbeteren van de dienstverlening;
  • Heb je oog voor innovatie, digitalisering en datagedreven werken.

Hoe ziet je dag er uit?

Je start de dag met het doornemen van je agenda, e-mails en eventuele bijzonderheden binnen het team. Op kantoor sluit je aan bij verschillende teamoverleggen met de administratie, bouwvergunningverleners en juristen. Vervolgens bespreek je een politiek gevoelige zaak waarbij een hoger beroep wordt voorbereid. Samen met de juristen en vergunningverlener zorg je ervoor dat de wethouder en het afdelingshoofd goed zijn geïnformeerd.

Later op de ochtend voer je een ontwikkelgesprek met een medewerker. Je bespreekt haar ambities, denkt mee over opleidingen en ondersteunt haar bij uitdagingen binnen het team.

Tijdens de lunch neem je de tijd om collega's te spreken en feeling te houden met wat er speelt binnen de organisatie. Daarna werk je op een centrale plek binnen het team, zodat collega's je gemakkelijk kunnen vinden voor advies of ondersteuning bij complexe dossiers.

's Middags bespreek je de mogelijkheden van AI binnen toekomstige werkprocessen en denk je mee over innovaties die de dienstverlening kunnen verbeteren. Daarna staat een overleg met de wethouder gepland over een groot project. Dankzij een goede voorbereiding kun je samen met de casemanager de benodigde toelichting geven.

Aan het einde van de dag loop je nog een ronde langs het team, beantwoord je vragen en ondersteun je collega’s bij lastige vraagstukken. Later op de avond volg je nog een deel van de raadsvergadering waarin een belangrijk plan wordt behandeld. Zo blijf je betrokken bij de bestuurlijke besluitvorming en wat er leeft binnen de gemeente.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Je beschikt over hbo+/academisch werk- en denkniveau, bijvoorbeeld in de richting van bestuurskunde of een vergelijkbare opleiding.
  • Je hebt in de afgelopen vijf jaar meerdere jaren leidinggevende ervaring opgedaan binnen een politiek-bestuurlijke omgeving.
  • Je hebt aantoonbare ervaring met het succesvol begeleiden en implementeren van organisatieveranderingen.
  • Je denkt strategisch en toekomstgericht en weet ontwikkelingen te vertalen naar concrete verbeteringen.
  • Je bent innovatief, ziet kansen voor vernieuwing en komt met creatieve oplossingen voor complexe vraagstukken.
  • Je hebt oog voor de ontwikkeling van medewerkers en stimuleert eigenaarschap, samenwerking en groei.
  • Je beschikt over politieke en bestuurlijke sensitiviteit en weet effectief om te gaan met uiteenlopende belangen.
  • Je communiceert helder en overtuigend, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.

Wat doen we voor jou?

  • Salaris van minimaal € 5.369,- euro en maximaal € 7.253,- euro per maand op basis van een 36-urige werkweek (schaal 12)
  • In deze vaste baan start je met een tijdelijke arbeidsovereenkomst van 12 maanden
  • Individueel keuzebudget (IKB) ter waarde van 17,05% van het salaris (incl. vakantiegeld en eindejaarsuitkering)
  • Persoonlijke ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden en studiefaciliteiten
  • Thuiswerkmogelijkheden, een iPhone en laptop

Goed om te weten

  • Voor meer informatie kun je contact opnemen met Thomas Both, afdelingshoofd Veiligheid, Vergunningen, Toezicht & Handhaving via tboth@leidschendam-voorburg.nl of via 06-48876863.
  • Reageren kan tot en met 10 september 2026.

Voor de invulling van deze vacature werken wij niet samen met externe partijen. Acquisitie is daarom niet nodig.

title: Associate, Securities Lending
description:
About this role

Role Summary

Join BlackRock's Securities Lending Operations team and play a critical role in supporting one of the firm's global revenue-generating investment services. This role offers the opportunity to develop expertise across securities lending products, collateral management, operational risk, and trade lifecycle management while partnering with colleagues across Investments, Trading, Product, Technology, and external market participants. You will help ensure lending activity is executed accurately, efficiently, and within a strong control framework that protects client assets and supports operational excellence.

About BlackRock

At BlackRock, our mission is to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Business Operations Services (BOS) is BlackRock's operational engine, providing the scale, control, and infrastructure that enable investment ideas to move efficiently from concept to client outcome. By leveraging technology, data, automation, and operational expertise, BOS supports every stage of the investment lifecycle and helps deliver operational excellence across global markets.

Team Overview

Securities Lending Operations supports the end-to-end lifecycle of BlackRock's global securities lending business. The team is responsible for transaction management, collateral management, inventory optimization, sufficiency monitoring, accounting and billing, reconciliations, counterparty support, and operational risk oversight. The function partners closely with Trading, Portfolio Management, Product, Technology, custodians, lending agents, brokers, and third-party service providers to facilitate lending activity while maintaining strong operational controls and regulatory compliance.

Role Overview

As an Associate within Securities Lending Operations, you will oversee daily operational activities supporting BlackRock's securities lending platform. You will take ownership of complex processes, manage operational exceptions, partner with stakeholders across the organization, and contribute to risk mitigation and continuous improvement initiatives. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, attention to detail, operational risk awareness, and the ability to drive solutions in a fast-paced environment. The position provides significant exposure to securities lending products, collateral processes, market infrastructure, and operational controls.

Key Responsibilities

You will:

  • Oversee daily securities lending operational processes, ensuring transactions are processed accurately and within established control standards.
  • Monitor lending activity, collateral movements, inventory balances, and operational exceptions across global markets.
  • Investigate and resolve complex breaks, discrepancies, counterparty issues, and reconciliation exceptions.
  • Partner with Trading, Portfolio Management, Product, Technology, custodians, lending agents, brokers, and service providers to support business objectives.
  • Identify operational risks, escalate issues appropriately, and support remediation efforts to strengthen controls.
  • Produce and analyze operational reporting, risk metrics, service-level measures, and management information.
  • Contribute to automation, process improvement, and operating model enhancement initiatives that improve efficiency and scalability.
  • Support new business initiatives, client opportunities, market expansion efforts, and platform enhancements.
  • Maintain accurate documentation, procedures, and governance controls in accordance with regulatory and internal requirements.
  • Provide guidance and support to Analysts while contributing to a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

Required Qualifications

You have:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related discipline.
  • 2-5 years of experience in securities lending, investment operations, asset servicing, custody, capital markets, or a related financial services environment.
  • Strong understanding of securities, market infrastructure, trade lifecycle processes, or collateral management concepts.
  • Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail.
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and operate effectively in a fast-paced, risk-controlled environment.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to collaborate across teams and regions.
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.

Preferred Qualifications

It would be helpful if you also have:

  • Experience supporting securities lending, collateral operations, investment operations, or post-trade processes.
  • Knowledge of operational risk frameworks, reconciliations, exception management, and control environments.
  • Experience with data analysis, automation tools, workflow platforms, or process improvement initiatives.
  • Familiarity with investment management, asset servicing, or custody operating models.
  • Professional certifications such as CFA, CAIA, FRM, or equivalent.

Equal Opportunity, Inclusion & Reasonable Accommodations

BlackRock is proud to be an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, national origin, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, veteran status, age, religion, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. BlackRock is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations or adjustments to qualified individuals with disabilities or other special needs throughout the recruitment process and employment. If you need support to apply for a position, participate in the application or interview process, perform essential job functions, or access the benefits and privileges of employment, please let us know how we can assist.

Our benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of employee benefits including: retirement investment and tools designed to help you in building a sound financial future; access to education reimbursement; comprehensive resources to support your physical health and emotional well-being; family support programs; and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.


Guidance on AI use for candidates


At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.


About BlackRock


At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.


This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.


To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.


BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected characteristics at law.

The security team at Salesforce works on some of the most challenging problems in information security. We are seeking a Product Vulnerability Engineer to join one of the world's leading vulnerability response teams. The pace and variety of our work create a unique learning environment, whether you are starting out or have deep security experience. You will be given unique challenges, the tools to solve them, surrounded by exceptional colleagues, and supported by incredibly helpful partner teams.

Product Vulnerability Engineers are responsible for:

  • Leading the response to lower/moderate severity vulnerabilities.

  • Participating in the response to high-severity vulnerabilities.

  • Managing and triaging security vulnerabilities, differentiating urgent issues from important ones.

  • Assessing complex problems, formulating action plans, and driving resolution under pressure.

  • Investigating and analyzing vulnerabilities to determine potential impact.

Successful vulnerability engineers thrive on challenges, remain calm under pressure, and can think on their feet.

Required Skills

  • Experience managing common types of security vulnerabilities, such as OWASP Top 10.

  • Application forensics skills, including collecting and analyzing code artifacts to assess potential impact if vulnerabilities are exploited.

  • Prior experience utilizing AI tools for automation and analysis.

  • Experience working in a large and complex organization operating across multiple locations with a high degree of change.

  • Experience reproducing proof-of-concept exploitation steps.

  • Experience assessing vulnerability priority based on risk and impact.

  • Experience securing applications and infrastructure in Amazon Web Services and similar IaaS/PaaS platforms.

  • Deep application security knowledge, with the ability to map application vulnerabilities to exploitation indicators and relevant investigation techniques.

  • Relevant incident response or information security certifications, such as:

    • GIAC GXPN

Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Arts-onderzoeker 'Eiwitopname bij obesitasbehandeling'
description:
Functie

De groep Humane Fysiologie van het Radboudumc zoekt, in samenwerking met de Nederlandse Obesitas Kliniek (NOK) en FrieslandCampina, een enthousiaste arts-onderzoeker ter versterking van ons multidisciplinaire team. Wil jij klinisch werk combineren met wetenschappelijk onderzoek én promoveren binnen een innovatief en maatschappelijk relevant onderzoeksproject? Dan zijn wij op zoek naar jou!

Het promotieonderzoek
Behandelingen voor overgewicht en obesitas met zowel medicatie als chirurgie leiden tot substantieel gewichtsverlies, maar dit gaat ook gepaard met spiermassa verlies. Het behoud van spiermassa is essentieel voor gezondheid, functioneren en herstel. Een optimale eiwitinname speelt hierbij een belangrijke rol, maar het is nog onvoldoende bekend welk type eiwit de beste opname en ondersteuning biedt.

Dat is de centrale vraag van dit promotietraject binnen een gezamenlijk onderzoek van de groep Humane Fysiologie van het Radboudumc, de Nederlandse Obesitas Kliniek (NOK) en FrieslandCampina. We zoeken een BIG-geregistreerd arts die klinisch werk wil combineren met een promotietraject van 3,5 jaar.

Wat ga je doen?

Onderzoek (24 uur per week)

Als onderzoeker bestudeer je de opname van verschillende eiwitten. Daarbij richt je je onder andere op:

  • De verschillen tussen mensen die met medicatie en mensen die met chirurgie behandeld worden.
  • De verschillen voor en na start van medicatie.
  • Mate van spiermassaverlies en effecten op spierfunctie.

Klinisch werk (16 uur per week)

Als arts bij NOK begeleid je patiënten die worden behandeld met bariatrische chirurgie of medicatie. Je werkt daarbij nauw samen met een coaches en andere leden van het multidisciplinaire behandelteam. Je bent onder andere verantwoordelijk voor medische controles, beoordeling van de behandeling en medische begeleiding gedurende het behandeltraject. Je klinische werkzaamheden vinden plaats op onze locatie in Nieuwegein.

Jouw werkplek

De afdeling Fysiologie van het Radboudumc en de Nederlandse Obesitas Kliniek (NOK) werken al meerdere jaren samen op het terrein van obesitas en leefstijl.

Het Radboudumc
Binnen het Radboudumc werk je in een multidisciplinair team en maak je onderdeel uit van een grote groep enthousiaste promovendi van de sectie Fysiologie van de afdeling Medical Bioscience. De afdeling Fysiologie is een bruisende afdeling waar onderzoek en onderwijs centraal staan.

Onze missie is: to have a significant impact on health and healthcare. We willen vooroplopen bij de ontwikkeling van duurzame zorg: zorg die mens en milieu zo gezond mogelijk houdt, zinnig en betaalbaar is, en liever voorkomt dan geneest. Zorg die er ook nog is voor de kinderen van onze kinderen. Dat doen we in alle drie onze kerntaken: zorg, onderwijs en onderzoek. We werken innovatief, persoonsgericht en samen met anderen in netwerken.

De Nederlandse Obesitas Kliniek (NOK)
De NOK is de grootste en meest gespecialiseerde zelfstandige kliniek in Nederland voor de behandeling van mensen met overgewicht en obesitas. Al meer dan 30 jaar behandelen wij patiënten op inmiddels 11 locaties. We bieden zowel metabole bariatrische chirurgie als medicamenteuze behandeling in combinatie met leefstijlbegeleiding en binnen multidisciplinaire teams.

Profiel

title: Uutistoimittaja, Yle Oulun deskialue, Kajaani
description:
Oletko sinä journalisti, joka haistaa uutisen ennen muita? Haluatko tehdä uutisia, jotka herättävät tunteita ja saavat aikaan keskustelua?

Haemme rohkeaa ja idearikasta uutistoimittajaa Kajaaniin.

Mitä on luvassa?

Tehtävänäsi on hankkia valtakunnallisesti ja paikallisesti mielenkiintoisia uutisia Kainuusta. Reagoit päivän aiheisiin, ideoit juttuja, etsit niihin tuoreita näkökulmia ja tartut toimeen. Työskentelet vahvalla verkkopainotuksella ja käytät itsenäisesti kevyttä kuvauskalustoa. Juttuja teet monikanavaisesti: samasta aiheesta syntyy uutinen verkkoon, radioon ja televisioon.

Työskentelet osana innostunutta ja kunnianhimoista tiimiä, joka tukee ja haastaa sinua kehittymään.

Työskentelypaikkasi on Kajaani. Tehtävä on vakituinen. Aloitus tehtävässä sopimuksen mukaan.

Mitä odotamme sinulta?

Olet osaava ja kokenut uutisjournalisti, joka pystyy hyppäämään hommiin heti. Olet kartalla siitä, mitä alueellasi tapahtuu ja mistä juuri nyt puhutaan. Haluat pysyä alan kehityksessä mukana ja olet valmis oppimaan jatkuvasti uutta. Sinulla on ideoita, intoa ja rohkeutta tarttua aiheisiin. Löydät mielenkiintoisia aiheita läheltä ja osaat uutisoida ne kiinnostavasti.

Osaat toimittaa erilaisia kokonaisuuksia niin verkkoon, radioon kuin televisioon.Osaat esiintyä suorissa lähetyksissä. Tarjoilet aiheet yleisölle oman persoonasi kautta ja uskallat heittäytyä!

Miksi meille?

Pääset tekemään paikallisesti ja valtakunnallisesti merkittäviä uutissisältöjä. Seuraamme kaupunkien, kuntien ja hyvinvointialueiden päätöksentekoa sekä elinkeinoelämää. Aiheita nousee myös kainuulaisten arjesta ja elämästä. Olemme lähellä ihmistä.

Meillä saat työskennellä mukavien ja rautaisten uutis- ja paikallisjournalismin ammattilaisten kanssa. Saat työhösi tukea kollegoilta, tuottajilta ja alueen päälliköltä. Oulun deskialueella on tiimit Oulussa ja Kajaanissa. Olemme läsnä myös Kuusamossa.

Kiinnostuitko?

Mikäli kiinnostuit tehtävästä, hae nyt! Täytä oheinen hakemus ja liitä mukaan CV:si ja hakemuskirjeesi viimeistään 20.9.2026. Lisää mukaan myös muutama tekemäsi juttunäyte.

Haastattelut aloitetaan jo hakuaikana.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa Paikallisuutisten Pohjoisen päällikkö Riikka Heikkilä, p. 044-4216545, riikka.heikkila@yle.fi. Soittoajat: 7.9. klo 15-16 ja 17.9. klo 16-17.

title: MBO Verpleegkundige GGZ
description:
Wil jij werken als mbo verpleegkundige GGZ bij Arkin? In de geestelijke gezondheidszorg (GGZ) maak je dagelijks het verschil voor mensen die tijdelijk de grip op hun leven zijn kwijtgeraakt. Als mbo-verpleegkundige in de psychiatrie werk je binnen de klinieken van Arkin en combineer je vakkennis met oprechte aandacht voor de mens achter de diagnose.

Je werkt samen met een multidisciplinair team van psychiaters, psychologen, therapeuten, agogen, maatschappelijk werkers en verpleegkundigen. Binnen de kliniek is geen dag hetzelfde: je observeert, redeneert klinisch, voert gesprekken met cliënten en handelt snel wanneer situaties daarom vragen.


Wat ga je doen?
Je begeleidt en ondersteunt cliënten tijdens hun behandeling en herstel. Je bewaakt de veiligheid op de afdeling en bent een belangrijk aanspreekpunt.

Werkzaamheden:

  • Observeren van gedrag en klinisch redeneren
  • Motiverende gesprekken voeren met cliënten
  • Begeleiden van dagelijkse activiteiten op de afdeling
  • Professioneel handelen bij spanningen of crisissituaties
  • Samenwerken binnen de psychiatrische zorg

Binnen Arkin starten mbo-verpleegkundigen in de kliniek en kunnen later doorgroeien naar bijvoorbeeld FACT-teams binnen de GGZ. Heb je nog weinig ervaring in de psychiatrie of geestelijke gezondheidszorg? Dan kun je starten via een GGZ traineeship, deze duurt 15 maanden en leer je binnen twee verschillende specialismes de GGZ kennen.

Wij bieden jou

  • Vanuit de CAO GGZ de standaard arbeidsvoorwaarden en een salaris in FWG 45 (min. €3180,- en max. €4273,- bruto op basis van 36 uur);
  • Een jaarcontract voor 24-36 uur en de mogelijkheid tot vast contract bij 6 maanden
  • Een eindejaarsuitkering en vakantiegeld van 8,33%;
  • Je bouwt een goed pensioen op bij Pensioenfonds Zorg en Welzijn.

Daarnaast een aantal aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden van Arkin:

  • Korting op verschillende verzekeringen;
  • Voor woon-werkverkeer en dienstreizen een 2e klasse mobiliteitskaart, ook te gebruiken voor OV-fiets of een km-vergoeding;
  • Arkin biedt met 11 specialismen op verschillende locaties ook veel mogelijkheden op langer termijn voor jouw professionele ontwikkeling met keuze uit het werken met verschillende doelgroepen en methodieken;
  • Via ons eigen trainingsaanbod en opleiding hbo-v doorgroeien naar verpleegkundige II of het ambulante team;
  • Een meerkeuzesysteem waarbij je brutoloon kunt gebruiken voor extra vakantie-uren, fietsaanschaf, een aanvullende reiskostenvergoeding of een tegemoetkoming in het lidmaatschap van een vakbond en/of een beroepsorganisatie;
  • Voor jouw welzijn een jaarlijks vitaliteitsbudget van maximaal €100,- netto (bij een vast dienstverband van minimaal 18 uren per week), €1000,- balansbudget en toegang tot het platform Nrgize voor deelname aan activiteiten zoals bootcamp, yoga en padel;
  • Parkeermogelijkheden;
  • Collega aandragen? Ontvang in totaal een aanbrengbonus van €1000,- bruto.

Wat breng je mee?

  • Diploma mbo-verpleegkunde
  • BIG-registratie

Werken bij ons
Arkin is dé Randstedelijke GGZ aanbieder met 11 specialismen. Samen zijn we de expert op het gebied van de psychiatrie en verslavingszorg. Met elkaar maken we ons sterk voor de mentale veerkracht van onze cliënten

Meer weten over deze vacature?
Neem contact op met recruiter Ranoe Baidjoe – 06 25 08 38 57 of mail ranoe.baidjoe@arkin.nl en ontdek hoeveel voldoening werken in de GGZ als verpleegkundige geeft.

Reageren kan zolang de vacature online staat. Hebben wij een nieuwe collega mogen verwelkomen dan wordt de vacature gesloten.

Bij Arkin omarmen we diversiteit en streven we naar een inclusieve cultuur waarin we het beste in elkaar naar boven halen. Meer over onze visie op D&I lees je bij 'over ons'.

The automotive industry is in disruption. As a company, CARIAD is playing a part in multiple large trends at the same time: electrification, automation, and digitalization. The new name builds on changing customer needs. Automotive customers are demanding more comfort, more safety, more sustainability, and more connectivity. With its software platforms and digital features, CARIAD is developing solutions and products that will turn the car into a smart companion to accompany customers into the future with continuous updates and new digital features, even years later. The new software and technology platform is built from scratch and will be used first at the end of 2024 in Artemis, the lighthouse project of Audi. title: Butikssäljare 75%, Stadium Outlet Västerås

Vad innebär det att vara butikssäljare?
Våra kunder ska känna sig välkomna hos oss, de ska bli inbjudna till en kundupplevelse i hela butiken. En upplevelse som kännetecknas av service i världsklass. Som butikssäljare skapar du förutsättningar för våra kunder att hitta de produkter de söker. Detta innebära att du fyller på varor och ser till att butiken är inspirerande och attraktiv, välfylld med våra produkter. Du ser till att ge våra kunder bästa möjliga personliga service genom att hjälpa dem vid behov och ta emot dem i kassan.

Vem är du?
Vi tror att du delar vår inställning och övertygelse när det gäller att se varje utmaning som en möjlighet. Du trivs med att ha mycket ansvar och vill växa och utvecklas i rollen som butikssäljare. För att jobba på Stadium måste du ha fyllt 18 år. Butikserfarenhet är ett plus.

Vad erbjuder vi dig?
Läs mer om vårt lag på vår Karriärsida, på Instagram WorkatStadium eller på Linkedin.

Klicka på länken här för att komma till våra poddavsnitt och på 15 min få en inblick i hur det är att jobba på Stadium.
__ Varaktighet/arbetstid: Tjänsten är tillsvidare på 75% med tillträde enligt överenskommelse. Provanställning tillämpas.

Ansökan Som en del i rekryteringsprocessen kommer du att få en inbjudan till din e-mail till att besvara ett personlighetstest. Det tar ca 15 minuter att besvara testet. Vi kommunicerar mestadels genom mail så se till att hålla koll på din inkorg, håll även koll på skräpposten för säkerhets skull.

Eftersom vi alltid vill göra saker så enkelt som möjligt är det inte säkert att vi väntar till sista ansökningsdag innan vi går vidare i rekryteringsprocessen. Så vänta inte, sök redan nu.

Välkommen med din ansökan. Come join the movement!

title: Ramp Agent - ALB
description:
Department:

Ground Operations

Our Company Promise


We are committed to provide our Employees a stable work environment with equal opportunity for learning and personal growth. Above all, Employees will be provided the same concern, respect, and caring attitude within the organization that they are expected to share externally with every Southwest Customer.

Job Description:

*** For external applicants only:
(1.) Southwest Airlines will consider your interest for this position if you are currently a resident of the State of New York.

Pay of $20.63 per hour*, with the opportunity for future increase per applicable collective bargaining agreement wage scale based on time in position. Opportunities for overtime and shift premiums.

Looking for a role where you’ll be at the heart of every successful departure? Ramp Agents at Southwest work outside to guide planes, move bags and cargo, help with de-icing planes during cold weather, and help keep our operation running smoothly. It’s a busy, hands-on job where working together helps flights leave on time. Whether you're an aviation pro or just starting to learn about the industry, you’ll gain valuable experience and learn new things in this role — all while helping Southwest run safely and on schedule. See what a day on the ramp looks like:

Additional details

  • This role is part of a Collective Bargaining Agreement (CBA), which means pay, schedules, and other job details are set through an agreement with the labor union.

We’re committed to fair hiring practices and to making employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other legally protected characteristics.

Duties and Responsibilities
  • Provide friendly service to and maintains positive relationships with all internal and external Customers
  • Work in a cooperative spirit to ensure the success of our Company
  • Responsible for providing legendary Customer service to people desiring to travel, use cargo or baggage service by servicing aircraft at ramps and terminals
  • Load, unload, service, guide, and direct Company Aircraft
  • Receive and record Customer baggage, air freight, mail and company materials as required
  • Handle all aspects of loading, stowing and unloading baggage, cargo airmail, air freight, ballast and company materials according to a predetermined plan received either electronically or manually from an Operations Agent. Submits, either electronically or manually, a Cargo Bin Loading Slip (CBLS) to an Operations Agent
  • Pick up, deliver, and transport cargo and baggage to and from aircraft and prepares records in connection with these responsibilities
  • Warehouses, weighs, stacks, picks up and delivers air cargo, checks air cargo handled against accompanying forms to identify any mishandling or discrepancies and corrects routine errors
  • Safeguards Customers' baggage, air cargo, air mail, and COMAT from weather, loss, theft, damage and/or destruction
  • Use jetway stairs frequently to carry items checked at the gate to the aircraft bin
  • Review cargo forms for accuracy and corrects forms as necessary
  • Perform interior aircraft cabin cleaning by hand, including sweeping upholstery, cleans windows, galleys and disposal containers in accordance with applicable paperwork
  • Clean and service lavatories, operate lavatory carts and dispose of contents in accordance with established procedures
  • May perform duties of a Provisioning Agent, including stocking aircraft cabin interiors for flights with equipment and supplies such as literature, disposal, and refuse containers and commissary items in accordance with applicable paperwork. Maintains an inventory of such items and supplies
  • Transport cabin and cleaning equipment between aircraft storage area
  • Operate and/or drive motorized equipment, such as belt loaders, air start units, lift trucks, push back tugs, bag cart, lavatory cart and de-icers
  • Manually pushes and pulls push carts and containers
  • Work in the vicinity of and between passenger terminals, hangars and airfreight facilities, both indoors and outdoors
  • May be exposed to a wide variety of weather condition, jet and machinery noises, fumes, dirt and dust for extended periods of time
  • Completes forms and paperwork connected with work assignments according to established procedures, and enters such information in to the Company’s information system as required
  • Duties vary by size and organization of station.

Knowledge, Skills and Responsibilities
  • Ability to work well with others as part of a team, and work under stressful situations

  • Ability to read documents, follow instructions, learn and understand ramp operations procedures, rules and regulations
  • Must be aware of hazardous situations and be able to handle emergencies as needed
  • Must work under tight time constraints to accomplish quick turns of aircraft
  • Must meet all grooming standards as outlined in the Ground Operations Employee Handbook and the Labor Agreement
  • Must be able to be alert to moving vehicles or aircraft and use radio equipment. Must be able to communicate information and instructions verbally and/or via radio equipment
Education
  • No education requirement
Experience
  • No experience requirement
Licensing/Certification
  • Must possess a valid state motor vehicle operator's license
  • Must be able to obtain a SIDA badge and meet all local airport requirements
  • May be required by Station Leadership to obtain a Customs Seal and meet all requirements to work international flights
Physical Abilities
  • Must be able to lift and move items of 70 pounds and/or more on a regular basis and repetitively lift weights of 40 to 50 pounds on raised surfaces
  • Must be able to climb, bend, kneel, crawl, and stoop on a frequent basis and for extended periods
  • Must be able to work in cramped or high places
  • Must be able to carry heavy items up and down jetway stairs
  • Must maintain the ability to wear prescribed uniforms

  • Must maintain a well-groomed appearance per Company appearance standards as described in established guidelines

title: Intern - CDM
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing.

Project Title:

AI-Enabled Quality Engineering Transformation for Semiconductor Manufacturing

Project Description
Develop quality engineering expertise in semiconductor manufacturing through analytical problem-solving, statistical analysis, quality systems, process characterization, and risk management.

The intern will undertake a structured AI-Enabled transformation project to improve productivity, workflow efficiency, data visibility, and engineering decision-making for contamination control, incoming quality control, and/or chemical laboratory analysis. The project will provide practical exposure to industrial data analytics, Artificial Intelligence, automation, visualization, and cross-functional engineering collaboration.

Objective of the Project

  • Analyze a defined quality engineering workflow and identify opportunities to improve productivity, efficiency, and decision-making.

  • Develop an AI-Enabled, automation, or digital solution addressing a real engineering challenge.

  • Evaluate the solution using appropriate technical, quality, usability, and business-impact criteria.

  • Build practical knowledge of quality systems, statistical methods, process characterization, and risk management in semiconductor manufacturing.

Opportunities for Full Time Employment
The internship provides exposure to quality engineering career opportunities within semiconductor manufacturing. Interns may be considered for future internships or full-time employment based on business requirements, role availability, project outcomes, and the applicable recruitment process.

Project Scope

  • Analyze engineering workflows within contamination control, incoming quality control, and/or chemical laboratory analysis.

  • Develop digital solutions that enhance data visibility, reporting efficiency, and engineering decision-making.

  • Apply Generative AI, Large Language Models, AI Agents, machine learning, and statistical techniques to enhance inspection strategies, automate quality-data analysis, or improve anomaly detection.

  • Develop and evaluate a prototype, dashboard, analytical model, Agentic Solution, or automated workflow for the selected use case.

Learning Opportunities

  • Gain exposure to quality engineering systems and practices within a semiconductor manufacturing environment.

  • Learn statistical analysis, structured problem-solving, process characterization, and risk-assessment methodologies.

  • Explore AI-Enabled workflows, Generative AI, AI Agents, data visualization, and software-based or physical automation technologies.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams and subject matter experts.

  • The internal quality-project example similarly emphasizes semiconductor manufacturing analytics, machine learning, predictive modelling, visualization, and cross-functional collaboration.

Deliverables

  • An AI-Enabled, automation, or digital transformation solution addressing a defined quality engineering challenge.

  • Evaluation results demonstrating solution effectiveness, identified limitations, and potential business impact.

  • Technical documentation covering the methodology, solution design, data requirements, risks, and recommendations.

  • A final project report and leadership presentation covering the problem statement, methodology, results, business impact, and future scaling opportunities.

  • The internal internship programme requires interns to present project deliverables to department leaders and includes final reports and presentations within the completion documentation.

Impact of the Project

  • Improve the visibility, consistency, and accessibility of relevant quality engineering information.

  • Reduce inefficient or repetitive steps in the selected engineering workflow.

  • Strengthen anomaly identification, engineering reporting, and data-informed decision-making.

  • Demonstrate a scalable digital or AI-Enabled approach for future quality engineering transformation.

Skillsets Required

  • Strong analytical, statistical, and structured problem-solving skills.

  • Familiarity with Python, R, Structured Query Language, data visualization, or equivalent analytical tools.

  • Familiarity with machine learning, Generative AI, Large Language Models, AI Assistants, AI Agents, or other AI-Enabled workflows.

  • Effective collaboration, technical documentation, and presentation skills.


Course of Interest
The ideal candidate should be pursuing a \ degree in Chemical Engineering, Materials Engineering, Electrical and Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, Industrial and Systems Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Chemistry, Applied Chemistry, or a related field.

Duration of Period
The ideal candidate should be able to commit to a full-time internship period of at least five months.

title: CTO Communications Expert
description:
The CTO Communications team is looking for an experienced Communications Expert to help shape, strengthen and deliver strategic communications across ING’s global Technology organisation. This is a role for someone who can think strategically, write with clarity and confidence, and translate complex technology topics into messages that are easy to understand, relevant and engaging for global audiences. From internal leadership communications to external speaking opportunities, the role will help bring ING’s technology strategy to life in a way that connects with engineers, leaders, business stakeholders and external audiences. You will play an important role in supporting Technology leaders, by preparing high-quality messaging, presentations, speeches, talking points and communications plans. You will also help ensure that global and strategic messages reach the right audiences across Tech, in the right format, through the right channels. You will bring clarity, structure and energy to communications that help people understand where Technology is heading, why it matters and how they connect to it.

This is a cross-border, cross-functional role that requires strong judgement, cultural awareness and the ability to work confidently in a fast-moving, international environment.

The team
As CTO Communications Expert, you will join the CTO Communications team, which is part of ING’s Global Communications, Brand & MarCom department. The team supports communications across the global organisation, helping to build awareness, understanding and engagement around ING’s technology strategy, priorities and leadership agenda.

The team works closely with senior Technology leaders, global communications colleagues, business partners and stakeholders across functions and geographies. Together, we help make complex topics accessible, connect global teams to strategic priorities, and strengthen the voice of Technology across ING.

Role and responsibilities

In this role, you will be responsible for helping shape and deliver clear, strategic and engaging communications for the CTO domain. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Strategic communications planning - Develop and implement communications plans that support the CTO agenda, global Technology priorities and key strategic initiatives. Ensure communications are audience-led, business-relevant and measurable.
  • External communications and speaker preparation - Support external speaking engagements by preparing compelling narratives, speeches, presentation storylines, briefing materials and key messages. Ensure external communications reflect ING’s strategic positioning and are suitable for senior audiences, industry platforms and technology-focused events.
  • Technology storytelling - Take complex IT, engineering, cyber, infrastructure, data, AI and digital transformation topics and turn them into clear, accessible and engaging content for global audiences. Bring structure, simplicity and relevance to topics that can otherwise feel technical or abstract.
  • Audience engagement across Technology - Understand the needs, interests and expectations of technology audiences, including engineers, experts, leaders and global teams. Ensure strategic messages land effectively across Technology and are translated into content that feels meaningful, practical and relevant.
  • Content development and channel activation - Create and coordinate high-quality content across a range of internal and external channels, including presentations, speeches, intranet stories, newsletters, leadership updates, event materials, video scripts and social content where relevant.
  • Stakeholder management - Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders across Technology, Communications, Brand, MarCom and other global functions. Work confidently with C-suite leaders and their teams, providing constructive challenge and trusted communications advice.
  • Cross-border collaboration - Work effectively across countries, cultures and time zones, ensuring communications reflect ING’s global context and resonate across different markets and audiences.
  • Measurement and continuous improvement - Use insights, feedback and performance data to improve communications impact, refine messages and strengthen how the CTO agenda is understood across the organisation.
  • Personal development - Pursue development reflected in individual development plans and leverage departmental training opportunities

Required skills and capabilities

We are looking for someone who brings a strong mix of strategic thinking, excellent writing skills, technology understanding and senior stakeholder management experience.

You should have:

  • A degree-level qualification, preferably in Communications, Journalism, Marketing, Reputation Management or a related field.

  • Fluent in English, both spoken and writing

  • 7+ years of experience in a comparable communications role, ideally in an international organisation with a large and diverse stakeholder environment.

  • Strong strategic thinking skills, with the ability to connect communications activity to business priorities, leadership agendas and organisational outcomes.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create clear, engaging and audience-focused content for global audiences.

  • Proven experience translating complex technology or IT topics into simple, human and compelling messages for non-specialist audiences.

  • A strong understanding of technology audiences, including engineers, IT experts, digital teams and senior technology leaders.

  • Experience supporting external communications, including preparing speeches, presentations, talking points and briefing materials for our speakers.

  • Strong C-suite stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to advise, challenge and partner with senior leaders.

  • Experience working across cultures, countries and functions, with the sensitivity and judgement needed in a global organisation.

  • Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines and stakeholders at the same time.

  • A proactive and collaborative mindset, with the ability to work independently while staying closely connected to team priorities.

  • Strong editorial judgement, with the ability to shape messages that are clear, credible, strategic and appropriate for the audience.

  • Experience using internal and external communications channels and tools, such as SharePoint, Viva Engage, Stream, Spotler, LinkedIn or similar platforms.

  • Curiosity about technology, innovation and the role of communications in helping people understand and engage with change.

Rewards and benefits

We want to make sure that it’s possible for you to strike the right balance between your career and your private life. Find out more about our employment conditions.

The benefits of working with us at ING include:

  • 25-28 vacation days depending on contract
  • Pension scheme
  • 13th month salary
  • 8% Holiday payment
  • Hybrid working
  • Personal growth and challenging work with endless possibilities
  • An informal working environment with innovative colleagues

About us

Curious about how ING empowers people and businesses to move forward?

Discover what we do and what we can offer you.

Questions?

Please visit our Frequently Asked Questions section to find some answers on questions you might have.

Contact the recruiter attached to the advertisement. Want to apply directly? Please upload your CV and motivation letter by clicking the ‘Apply’ button.

Ikke alle helter har kappe. Noen har caps med logo på. Og nå jakter vi den rette medarbeider som kan jobbe kveld og helg. Du skal ikke bare temme sult og slukke tørst, men også spre hverdagsglede. 💥

Med Big Bite får du sjanse til å være med på en lærerik reise i et helnorsk fastfood-konsept som tilbyr rask og rimelig mat i farta, med nysmurte subs som hovedprodukt. 🌯

Veteran eller ungt heltetalent?
Rett mentale innstilling veier vel så tungt som en CV med erfaring. Du vil fort se at Big Bite-systemet ikke holder kunnskapen innelåst. Tvert om, vi deler. Her bygger veteraner opp ferskinger.

I tillegg kan du skilte med andre superkrefter, som at du:

  • Er serviceinnstilt og fremoverlent

  • Trives med et høyt arbeidstempo

  • Har et øye for salg

Våre verdier oppsummeres i ordet ELSK og står sterkt hos oss. Vi ser derfor etter kandidater som gjenspeiler disse:

  • EIERSKAP - Vi er stolte ambassadører som tar ansvar for hele virksomheten - økonomisk og sosialt. Aldri halvveis, aldri litt.

  • LIDENSKAP - Vi brenner for jobben vår, trives i et sultent prestasjonsmiljø og har et varmt hjerte for mat og mennesker.

  • SAMSPILL - Vi spiller hverandre gode, unner andre suksess og vet at vi alltid presterer sterkest sammen.

  • KREMMERÅND - Vi er offensive og griper muligheter for utvikling og vekst. Vi vet at gode resultater kommer av å skape og gjenskape fine gjesteopplevelser - bedre for hver dag.

Hvorfor skal du velge oss?
Vi tilbyr grundig opplæring og en sosial og trivelig arbeidsplass med hyggelige kolleger. I fellesskap jobber vi for gode kundeopplevelser, likeså viktig er det at vi tar vare på hverandre i Big Bite-familien. 🥳

Blir du trigget av dette håper vi å høre fra deg!

Sjekk ut vår karriereside og alle våre ledige stillinger ved å trykke her - da vil du få et enda større innblikk i hvordan det er å jobbe i Big Bite.

title: Store Cleaning Associate

All benefits are provided in accordance with and subject to the terms of the applicable plan or program and may change from time to time. Contact your TJX representative for more information.

In addition to our open door policy and supportive work environment, we also strive to provide a competitive salary and benefits package. TJX considers all applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, gender identity and expression, marital or military status, or based on any individual's status in any group or class protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. title: Timmerman - Breda
description:
Klapkot zoekt een Timmerman, Meubelmaker of Houtbewerker!

Ben jij een timmerman, meubelmaker of houtbewerker die liever een compleet product bouwt dan iedere dag hetzelfde onderdeel maakt? Bij Klapkot werk je aan bijzondere tiny houses op wielen, die we van frame tot interieur volledig in onze eigen productiehal in Breda bouwen. En hier telt afwerking écht. Vrijwel alles wat je maakt blijft zichtbaar, dus nauwkeurigheid en vakmanschap zijn belangrijk. Je werkt met hout en aluminium, maakt meubels en interieuronderdelen en ziet stap voor stap een compleet Klapkot onder je handen ontstaan.

Wie is Klapkot?

Klapkot ontwikkelt en bouwt uitklapbare tiny houses op wielen voor onder andere recreatie, wonen, tijdelijk verblijf en mantelzorg. Dankzij ons eigen klapsysteem ontstaat na het uitklappen een verrassend ruime leefplek, compleet met keuken, badkamer en slaapruimte.

In onze goed uitgeruste productiehal in Breda bouwen we met een klein team complete Klapkotten. Daarbij beschikken we onder andere over een CNC-machine en professioneel gereedschap. Geen lopendebandwerk of standaardproductie, maar vakwerk waarbij je van frame en gevel tot interieur en afwerking betrokken bent. Onze Klapkotten worden vooral gebouwd voor recreatiebedrijven en particuliere klanten in Nederland en daarbuiten.

Wat ga je doen?

In deze functie werk je mee aan de volledige bouw van een Klapkot. Het grootste deel van je werk doe je in onze productiehal in Breda. Daar bouw je samen met je collega’s stap voor stap een compleet Klapkot. Incidenteel werk je op een andere locatie, bijvoorbeeld voor montage, plaatsing of service.

Je werkt met onder andere hout, plaatmateriaal en gevelbekleding en bent betrokken bij zowel de constructie als de afwerking. Ook meubels en interieuronderdelen maken we zelf. Omdat veel van wat je maakt uiteindelijk zichtbaar blijft, werken we met veel aandacht voor kwaliteit en detail. Je krijgt de ruimte om zelfstandig te werken, maar ook om mee te denken over praktische oplossingen en verbeteringen.

Jouw werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit:

  • bouwen en afwerken van complete Klapkotten;

  • uitvoeren van uiteenlopende timmer- en montagewerkzaamheden;

  • maken en monteren van meubels en interieuronderdelen;

  • zorgen voor een nauwkeurige en hoogwaardige afwerking;

  • meedenken over praktische oplossingen en verbeteringen tijdens de bouw;

  • samenwerken met collega’s gedurende het volledige productieproces;

  • incidenteel werkzaamheden uitvoeren buiten onze productiehal.

Wat bieden wij?

Bij Klapkot krijg je een veelzijdige functie waarin je aan het einde van de dag daadwerkelijk ziet wat je hebt gemaakt. Je werkt voornamelijk binnen, in onze eigen goed uitgeruste productiehal in Breda, en krijgt de vrijheid en verantwoordelijkheid om jouw vakmanschap te laten zien.

Je kunt rekenen op:

  • Een dienstverband van 37,5 uur per week;

  • Arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens de CAO Timmerindustrie;

  • Werktijden van maandag t/m donderdag van 07.30 tot 16.00 uur en op vrijdag van 07.30 tot 13.00 uur;

  • Gereedschap en werkkleding van de zaak;

  • Een vaste en goed uitgeruste werkplek in Breda;

  • Een klein en betrokken team met korte lijnen;

  • Twee keer per jaar een teamuitje;

  • Ruimte om jezelf verder te ontwikkelen;

  • Veel afwisseling in je werkzaamheden;

  • Werken aan complete Klapkotten in plaats van seriewerk;

  • Werken bij een groeiend Nederlands bedrijf met een bijzonder eigen product.

Je hebt bij ons dus een vaste werkplek, duidelijke werktijden én op vrijdag lekker vroeg weekend.

Wie zoeken wij?

Jij bent een vakman of vakvrouw die graag iets moois maakt en trots wil zijn op het eindresultaat. Je werkt nauwkeurig, hebt oog voor detail en vindt het leuk om aan verschillende onderdelen van één compleet product te werken.

Je hoeft niet jarenlang als traditionele timmerman op een bouwplaats te hebben gewerkt. Ook ervaring als meubelmaker, interieurbouwer, houtbewerker of in de houtskeletbouw kan uitstekend aansluiten. Belangrijk is dat je relevante praktijkervaring hebt en gewend bent om netjes en nauwkeurig te werken.

Daarnaast beschik je over:

  • mbo-werk- en -denkniveau;

  • minimaal 2 jaar relevante praktijkervaring in bijvoorbeeld timmerwerk, meubel-/interieurbouw, houtbewerking of houtskeletbouw;

  • goede beheersing van de Nederlandse taal;

  • technisch inzicht;

  • een nauwkeurige werkwijze en oog voor afwerking;

  • de motivatie om verschillende werkzaamheden op te pakken;

  • kennis van eenvoudige water- en elektrotechniek is een pré;

  • ervaring met een CNC-machine is mooi meegenomen.

title: Food & Beverage Cost Controller
description:
Southern Sun welcomes job applications from passionate and hard-working team players who want to be part of our ever growing Southern Sun family. We value our employees and provide them with the means to grow within the company, opening many doors in the process. If this is an offer that excites you, send in your application and you could be the newest addition to our family.

We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Cost Controller to join our finance team. The successful candidate will support cost management and financial reporting across hotel operations, ensuring accurate recording of costs, timely reporting, and effective collaboration with operational teams to drive efficiency and profitability.

Key Responsibilities

  • Our successful F&B Cost Controller …

    · Controls and records the flow of goods between Food and Beverage outlets as well as issues from stores to user departments.

    · Checks the receiving voucher against the supplier’s invoice and purchase order for accuracy.

    · Ensures supplier’s tax invoices are compliant with the FTA guidelines.

    · Production of daily food flash cost of sales reports

    · Ensures that the 10, 20 days and monthly food & beverage stock counts are performed as per company policy and procedures.

    · Costing of all recipes before implementing a new dish on a menu to ensure right pricing.

    · Analysis of the monthly sales statistics and highlighting slow moving items to the responsible head of department.

    · Analyse outlet activity on a monthly basis. The analysis should include revenue, cost of sales and productivity.

    · Prepares the month end closing reports for the following: food, beverage, and tobacco, general stock and operating supplies.

    · Oversee the management of hotel stores and ensure the stockholding is in line with business levels.

    · adhoc analysis and restaurant spot checks

Person Specification - Skills and Experience

  • Previous experience in F&B cost control, financial reporting or accounting roles within hospitality or a related sector preferred.

  • Strong numerical and analytical skills with attention to detail and accuracy.

  • Good knowledge of budgeting, variance analysis and inventory valuation methods.

  • Proficient in Excel and comfortable using accounting or hotel property management systems; experience with Sun Systems and/or finance systems advantageous.

  • Effective communication skills; able to present financial information clearly to non-financial colleagues.

  • Organised, able to prioritise workload and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

  • Problem-solving mindset and ability to work both independently and as part of a team.

Qualifications and Training

  • basic knowledge of financial management, budgets and cost controls, sound MS Office skills (Word, Excel, and Outlook)Relevant accounting or finance qualification

  • strong communication skills.

  • Experience of or training in inventory control, stocktaking procedures and cost accounting is advantageous.

  • Full on-the-job training will be provided on company systems, internal procedures and reporting standards.

  • A finance related tertiary qualification will be advantageous

How to Apply

Please submit a CV and a brief cover letter outlining your relevant experience and availability. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted for interview. We are an equal opportunities employer and welcome applications from all suitably qualified individuals.

title: Airport Safety Officer I
description:
Purpose of Classification:

An employee in the classification serves as a safety and information ambassador. They are responsible for assisting airport passengers and visitors with traffic flow, pedestrian safety, information, directions, and directs vehicle traffic to the proper areas of the airport. This employee will look after parking facilities and may write parking violations as needed. They will also assist the Department of Public Safety during emergency situations and observe and report safety issues or situations at the terminal, parking facilities, or other airport property as needed.

Essential Functions:

The following duties are normal for this position. The omission of specific statements of the duties does not exclude them from the classification if the work is similar, related, or a logical assignment for this classification. Other duties may be required and assigned.

Provides assistance and customer service to the traveling public and other users of the Columbia Metropolitan Airport; directs and provides travelers directions to various locations throughout the airport and surrounding areas and points of interest within the region.

Patrols airport roadways, parking lots and passenger loading/unloading zones, enforcing relevant codes and regulations; issues citations for violations of terminal curbside parking regulations.

Enforces relevant federal, state and local codes and regulations governing the operations of for-hire and other commercial vehicles at the Columbia Metropolitan Airport.

Observes and reports unattended baggage and other suspicious situations to law enforcement.

Participates in announced and unannounced vehicle safety inspections of taxis, shuttles, for-hire limousines, and courtesy vehicles.

Assists with the emergency evacuation of airport terminal for fire alarms, bomb threats and other emergency situations.

Operates a two-way radio and cell phone to communicate with other airport personnel and to assist travelers.

Direct vehicular and pedestrian traffic at the main terminal of the Columbia Metropolitan Airport to ensure the curbside is free of unattended vehicles.

Acts as a liaison between the airport, the traveling public, tenants, vendors, and ground transportation companies to ensure the airport’s rules and regulations are followed.

Additional Functions: Performs other related duties as required.
