title: Activiteitenbegeleider OBA Helpt digitaal (m/v/x)
description:
Help je graag mensen? Kun je op een begrijpelijke manier ingewikkelde vragen uitleggen? Weet jij de weg in de wereld van de digitale overheid? Ben je actief bezig met digitale ontwikkelingen en maak je nieuwe toepassingen snel eigen? En vind je het leuk om mensen die minder digitaal vaardig zijn verder te helpen? Lees dan snel verder.

Om mee te kunnen doen in de steeds verder digitaliserende wereld zijn goede digitale basisvaardigheden van groot belang. Maar lang niet iedereen beschikt in voldoende mate over deze vaardigheden. Bij OBA Helpt digitaal willen wij bijdragen aan de digitale inclusie van groot Amsterdam. Met de uitvoering van de Informatiepunten Digitale Overheid (IDO) helpen wij Amsterdammers wegwijs in de wereld van de digitale overheidsdiensten. We stimuleren bezoekers in hun zelfredzaamheid en in het ontwikkelen van hun digitale vaardigheden. OBA Helpt organiseert hiervoor in 21 OBA vestigingen spreekuren en een divers aanbod van cursussen en workshops.

Voor het programma OBA Helpt digitaal zoeken wij een Activiteitenbegeleider OBA Helpt digitaal (m/v/x) voor 32 uur per week.

Als activiteitenbegeleider OBA Helpt digitaal ben je samen met 16 andere activiteitenbegeleiders verantwoordelijk voor het op een prettige en professionele wijze uitvoeren van ons aanbod. Je biedt de Amsterdammer (of inwoner van Diemen of Ouder-Amstel) praktische hulp aan bij hun (digitale) vragen tijdens een open inloopspreekuur. Bij dit spreekuur staat de bezoeker informeren en stimuleren van zelfredzaamheid centraal; het gaat niet alleen om het probleem ‘oplossen’.
Daarnaast organiseer en geef je wekelijks cursussen of workshops over digitale vaardigheden en voer je alle promotie en administratie daaromheen uit.
Je begeleidt vrijwilligers die ondersteunen in de werkzaamheden.
Je onderhoudt contact met andere organisaties: om hen te informeren over het aanbod van OBA Helpt, of om hen te faciliteren wanneer zij voor OBA Helpt activiteiten uitvoeren. Je bent daarbij in staat een netwerk op te bouwen en te onderhouden met organisaties en sleutelfiguren in de buurt van je vestiging.

Je voert je werkzaamheden uit op minstens 2 of 3 vaste OBA Helpt vestigingen in gemeente Amsterdam en Weesp, gemeente Ouder-Amstel en gemeente Diemen. Je wordt ingedeeld op vaste werkdagen, waarbij maandagochtend verplicht is voor iedereen. Voor iedereen geldt dat je waar nodig invalt op andere vestigingen. Voor deze vacature zal het vaste stadsdeel waarschijnlijk Noord zijn.

Wie ben jij?

  • Je hebt aantoonbare kennis over, en affiniteit met, digitale basisvaardigheden.

  • Je vindt het belangrijk om mensen te helpen en hebt sociale voelsprieten die verdergaan dan gastvrijheid. Je kunt je goed verplaatsen in mensen die minder digitaal vaardig zijn en vindt het leuk om digitale informatie rustig en begrijpelijk uit te leggen.

  • Je bent nieuwsgierig naar nieuwe digitale ontwikkelingen en maakt nieuwe toepassingen en kennis snel eigen. Je staat open voor verandering en krijgt er energie van om jezelf nieuwe dingen aan te leren. Je hoeft niet alles al te weten, maar je bent wel bereid om dingen uit te zoeken en je kennis verder te ontwikkelen.

  • Je hebt een uitstekende beheersing van het Nederlandse in woord en geschrift.

  • Dit is een functie op mbo-niveau. Belangrijker dan een diploma vinden we echter dat je je volledig herkent in onderstaande competenties.

We willen het onderstaande graag teruglezen in jouw brief of c.v.

  • Je bent oplossingsgericht: als activiteitenbegeleider kan en hoef je niet alles te weten of te kunnen. Belangrijker is dat je samen met bezoeker op zoek gaat naar een oplossing, of dat je weet waar je de juiste informatie kan vinden. Zo help je de bezoeker in ieder geval één stap verder.

  • Je bent analytisch: je kunt de hulpvraag van de bezoeker snel helder krijgen maar houdt altijd oog voor de mens achter de hulpvraag.

  • Je beschikt over didactische vaardigheden: je brengt met gemak informatie over aan groepen en je kunt mensen coachend iets leren.

  • Je kunt goed grenzen stellen: je bent duidelijk zijn naar bezoekers toe, kunt waar nodig nee zeggen en omgaan met onverwachte situaties en moeilijke bezoekers.

  • Je bent zelfstandig en zelfredzaam: je doet je activiteiten alleen, dit moet je leuk vinden. Als het nodig is, vraag je om hulp van collega’s.

Wij bieden

  • Een uitdagende en veelzijdige rol in een unieke Amsterdamse organisatie in transitie, actief op het gebied van cultuur, ontwikkeling, informatie en maatschappij.

  • Goede ontwikkelings- en opleidingsmogelijkheden.

  • OBA Helpt digitaal is een vanuit de overheid gesubsidieerd project. Dit betekent dat we je een tijdelijk contract aanbieden voor in eerste instantie 1 jaar, met zicht op verlenging. Heb je al een vaste aanstelling bij de Oba, dan behoud je deze.

  • Een goed arbeidsvoorwaardenpakket (schaal 6 cao openbare bibliotheken, bruto maandsalaris min. €2.607 tot max. €3.503 op basis van 36 uur per week). De cao openbare bibliotheken is van toepassing.

Informatie

Wil je meer weten over deze vacature, neem dan contact op met Charlotte Buitenkamp, manager OBA Helpt, via c.buitenkamp@oba.nl of 06-12292346.
Wil je meer weten over de procedure, neem dan contact op met de HR-adviseur, Marit de Looijer, via m.delooijer@oba.nl.


De eerste gespreksronde staat gepland op 29 september 2026.

De tweede gespreksronde vindt plaats op 6 oktober 2026.

Omdat je als activiteitenbegeleider OBA Helpt digitaal met vertrouwelijke informatie van bezoekers in aanraking komt, is een Verklaring Omtrent Gedrag (VOG) verplicht.

Reageren

Iedereen is welkom bij de OBA en krijgt een gelijke kans. In een stad met meer dan 900.000 unieke Amsterdammers, zien we deze kleurrijke variatie graag terug onder onze medewerkers, vrijwilligers en stagiaires. Voel je vrij om op deze vacature te reageren.

Kun je wat tips gebruiken? Bekijk deze op de website.

Stuur ons jouw motivatie en cv (zie ook ‘Wie ben jij?’) uiterlijk 20 september 2026 via de sollicitatieknop.

title: Heritage & Environmental Advisor
description:

Job Description Summary

The Heritage & Environmental Advisor is responsible for assessing proposed telecommunications infrastructure sites and works to identify environmental and heritage constraints and determine applicable approval requirements. The role coordinates the preparation and management of permits, approvals, assessments and compliance activities, provides technical advice to project teams, and supports the delivery of projects in accordance with legislative and regulatory requirements

About the Role

Primary purpose of position

The Heritage & Environmental Advisor is responsible for assessing proposed telecommunications infrastructure sites and works to identify environmental and heritage constraints and determine applicable approval requirements. The role coordinates the preparation and management of permits, approvals, assessments and compliance activities, provides technical advice to project teams, and supports the delivery of projects in accordance with legislative and regulatory requirements

Key responsibilities

  • Assess telecommunications projects for environmental and heritage constraints and identify potential risks, permit requirements and approval pathways.
  • Provide advice and guidance to Operations, Project Managers and delivery teams on environmental and heritage matters.
  • Prepare, coordinate and submit environmental, heritage and statutory permits, approvals and supporting documentation.
  • Coordinate environmental and heritage assessments to support project delivery and compliance requirements.
  • Engage and manage external consultants to obtain required assessments, reports, permits and approvals.
  • Review consultant deliverables to ensure quality, compliance and alignment with project requirements.
  • Liaise with councils, government agencies, regulators, utility providers and other stakeholders as required.
  • Monitor project compliance with environmental and heritage obligations and identify potential risks.
  • Identify and escalate complex, high-risk or precedent setting matters to the Heritage & Environmental Lead.
  • Maintain accurate project records, approvals registers and supporting documentation.

Experience required

  • Minimum 3 years' experience in the telecommunications, infrastructure, environmental or heritage sectors.
  • Demonstrated experience supporting environmental and heritage assessments, permits, approvals and compliance activities.
  • Experience interpreting and applying local, state and Commonwealth legislation, regulations and approval requirements relating to environmental, heritage and infrastructure projects.
  • Experience coordinating consultants, regulatory approvals and technical assessments.
  • Experience engaging with councils, regulators, consultants and internal stakeholders.
  • Experience preparing technical reports, permit applications and supporting documentation.
  • Exposure to engaging with First Nations (Aboriginal and Torres Strait Islander) stakeholders or culturally appropriate consultation processes is desirable.

Qualifications required

  • Tertiary qualifications in Urban & Regional Planning, Environmental Planning or related discipline.

Competencies required

  • Strong statutory and regulatory interpretation skills.

  • Effective stakeholder engagement and relationship management skills.
  • Ability to coordinate multiple projects, approvals and competing priorities.
  • Risk assessment and mitigation capability.
  • Strong organisational and documentation management skills.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within project teams.

title: Senior Scientist, Analytical Testing
description:
At Bristol Myers Squibb, our employees often ask, “Who are you working for?”—a question that fuels collaboration, accountability, and urgency in our work. Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.



Our Analytical Strategy and Operations team creates transformative medicines of tomorrow based on the cutting-edge science of today. Working within Global Product Development and Supply this team uses state-of-the art technologies to develop, enable and execute analytical and CMC strategies that ensure safety, quality and efficacy of life-saving medicines administered to patients in clinical studies. Our team is involved at the earliest stages of Pharmaceutical and Biopharmaceutical product development through the successful commercial launch. As a member of our team, you will get the chance to play a pivotal role to positively impact patients’ lives while developing professionally to achieve your own career goals.

Position Summary:

The successful candidate will be part of the Analytical Regulated Testing GMP team at BMS New Jersey within Analytical Strategy & Operations. The scientist performs analytical method validation and cGMP activities and provides oversight and strategy to support clinical and commercial development for small molecule New Chemical entities and Investigational Medicinal Products.

Role & Responsibilities:

  • Follows GMP/GLP guidelines in the acquisition and/or review of data related to method validation and/or testing of release, stability and development materials. May be assigned to guide others in these activities.
  • Applies a phase appropriate approach to GMP in laboratory work and documentation.
  • May be responsible for coordination of method transfers, testing, management of and acceptance of data acquired by contract laboratories & service providers.
  • Operates within and maintains the laboratory in an ‘audit ready’ status.
  • Participates in audits and inspections.
  • May contribute to the establishment and implementation of proper corrective actions for findings.
  • Prepares, and may approve, reports for methods, validation, and technology transfer.
  • Prepares and/or reviews operational procedures, testing protocols/reports and training materials.
  • Practice and assist in implementation of best practices associated with laboratory Quality Systems including training, procedures, instrumentation management, and data and records
  • management.
  • May prepare and/or approves plans and tools for continuous improvement of quality and compliance.
  • Identify deviations to quality systems or limits/specifications, and ensures they are addressed in a timely manner.
  • Lead and participates in investigations, including the preparation and implementation of corrective actions (CAPAs).
  • May prepare responses to questions from regulatory agencies related to an analytical data and procedures.
  • Effective collaboration and communication with the CMC sub teams to ensure all API and drug product release testing, stability testing and filing requirements meet associated clinical timelines.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Bachelor's degree in analytical chemistry, organic chemistry, biochemistry, pharmacy or related field with 7+ years relevant industrial experience or equivalent, or Master's degree and 4-6 years of experience, or PhD and 2-4 years of experience
  • Demonstrated knowledge of the IND and NDA validation and troubleshooting of chromatographic separation methods used to analyze API and drug product.
  • Excellent interpersonal communication skills with capability of interfacing with and influencing multi-disciplinary teams.
  • Experience with regulatory submissions and interaction with regulatory agency inspectors.
  • Demonstrate a strong knowledge of cGMP compliance, regulatory agency requirements and ICH compliance.

Competencies:

  • Demonstrates ability to prioritize project responsibilities to meet competing requirements.
  • Ability to adapt to change, manage multiple projects effectively meeting timelines.
  • Able to influence teams and seek opportunities to develop new and different ways to resolve project challenges.
  • Able to identify opportunities and implement solutions to improve efficiency, productivity and quality/compliance.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively communicate with key partners both internally and externally.

title: Client Executive - Banking Group (Global)
description:
Make an impact with NTT DATA
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

Role Purpose

The Client Executive (CE) will have overall responsibility for developing and growing NTT DATA’s strategic relationship with Banking Group globally.

This is not primarily an infrastructure sales role. The CE is expected to engage Banking ’s senior business and technology leadership, understand the bank’s strategic priorities, and translate those priorities into high-value transformation opportunities for NTT DATA.

The role will place particular emphasis on:

  • Strategic and technology advisory

  • Data, Analytics & Artificial Intelligence

  • Generative AI and Agentic AI

  • Cloud and cloud-native transformation

  • Application and digital modernization

  • Automation and intelligent operations

  • Cybersecurity and resilience where relevant to transformation

  • Business and technology transformation

A separate Client Manager will support the account for core infrastructure solutions and services, allowing the CE to concentrate on executive engagement, strategic opportunities and higher-value solutions.

The CE should ultimately position NTT DATA not simply as an IT service provider to Banking , but as a strategic transformation partner.

Key Responsibilities

1. Own the Banking Group Relationship Globally

  • Act as the senior commercial leader for the Banking relationship across the Group and its major markets.

  • Develop trusted relationships with senior Banking executives across business and technology.

  • Build relationships beyond traditional IT procurement and infrastructure stakeholders.

  • Establish access to C-level and C-1 executives, including technology, digital, data, operations and relevant business leadership.

  • Understand Banking ’s strategic agenda, investment priorities and transformation roadmap.

  • Coordinate NTT DATA’s engagement with Banking across countries and business entities.

  • Maintain an integrated global account strategy and stakeholder map.

2. Create Strategic Demand

A critical measure of success is the CE’s ability to create opportunities before they become formal RFPs.

  • Identify business and technology challenges that NTT DATA can help solve.

  • Develop transformation propositions jointly with NTT DATA consulting and technology specialists.

  • Bring relevant global banking perspectives, benchmarks and innovation to Banking .

  • Facilitate executive workshops and strategic discussions.

  • Shape transformation programs at an early stage.

  • Build business cases and value propositions together with solution teams.

  • Convert strategic conversations into qualified opportunities and ultimately revenue.

  • The CE should actively move the relationship from responding to RFPs, to shaping opportunities, to co-creating transformation agendas.

3. Drive Data & AI Opportunities

Data and AI should be one of the CE’s principal growth areas. The CE should work with NTT DATA’s global Data & AI capabilities to identify opportunities such as:

  • Enterprise AI strategy and operating models

  • Generative AI and Agentic AI

  • Enterprise data platforms

  • Data modernization

  • AI-enabled customer experience

  • AI-enabled banking operations

  • Intelligent automation

  • Fraud and financial crime analytics

  • Risk and credit analytics

  • AI-enabled software engineering

  • AI governance, responsible AI and model governance

  • Enterprise knowledge and productivity solutions

  • The CE does not need to be the technical architect but must have sufficient understanding to engage credibly with senior banking executives and connect their business priorities to NTT DATA capabilities.

4. Develop Cloud & Modernization Opportunities

Identify and develop strategic opportunities around:

  • Cloud strategy and transformation

  • Hybrid and multi-cloud architecture

  • Cloud migration and modernization

  • Application modernization

  • Cloud-native development

  • Platform engineering

  • DevSecOps

  • FinOps

  • Cloud operating models

  • Resilience and regulatory requirements for financial services

  • The CE should be capable of positioning cloud as part of a broader business and technology transformation agenda, rather than simply infrastructure migration.

5. Lead Advisory-Led Engagement

Use NTT DATA’s consulting and advisory capabilities to open strategic conversations. Potential engagements may include:

  • Technology strategy

  • AI and Data strategy

  • Cloud strategy

  • Digital banking transformation

  • Enterprise architecture

  • Operating model transformation

  • Cost optimization

  • Technology modernization

  • Customer experience transformation

  • Banking operations transformation

The objective is to establish NTT DATA earlier in Banking ’s decision-making process and create downstream implementation and managed-service opportunities.

6. Orchestrate the Full NTT DATA Organization

The CE acts as the account orchestrator and should mobilize capabilities from across NTT DATA, including:

  • Consulting

  • Data & AI

  • Cloud

  • Applications

  • Digital

  • Cybersecurity

  • Infrastructure

  • Managed Services

  • Global Delivery

  • Industry and banking specialists

  • Strategic technology partners

The CE should know when to bring the right experts into the client conversation, rather than attempting to sell every solution personally.

7. Build a Multi-Year Account Growth Plan

Develop and execute a 3–5 year Banking account strategy covering:

  • Client strategic priorities

  • Executive stakeholder strategy

  • Competitive positioning

  • NTT DATA installed base

  • White-space opportunities

  • Data & AI opportunity roadmap

  • Cloud opportunity roadmap

  • Advisory-led opportunities

  • Major transformation pursuits

  • Infrastructure opportunities

  • Partner ecosystem strategy

  • Revenue and pipeline targets

  • Relationship development plan

  • The CE should establish a clear pathway for materially increasing NTT DATA’s share of wallet within Banking Group.

Candidate Profile

We are looking for an experienced enterprise technology sales leader who combines banking knowledge, executive presence and strong commercial instincts.

The ideal candidate will have:

  • Significant experience managing major banking or financial-services accounts.

  • A strong network within the banking industry, ideally including relationships within Banking or comparable regional/global banks.

  • Demonstrated success selling large, complex IT services and transformation programs.

  • Experience selling consulting or advisory-led engagements.

  • Strong understanding of Data & AI and emerging AI technologies.

  • Good understanding of enterprise Cloud transformation.

  • Experience navigating complex, multi-country organizations.

  • Strong executive communication and stakeholder-management skills.

  • Ability to orchestrate global solution, consulting and delivery teams.

  • Strong commercial and negotiation capabilities.

  • Track record of building significant pipeline and converting strategic opportunities into major deals.

What We Are Not Looking For

This distinction is important when selecting candidates. We are not looking primarily for a traditional infrastructure salesperson or an account manager who depends on RFPs and procurement relationships.

The successful CE should be comfortable discussing: Banking ’s business strategy -> Banking transformation -> Technology strategy -> AI/Data/Cloud -> NTT DATA capabilities -> Business outcomes.

Rather than simply: Product -> Price -> Proposal -> RFP.

Key Measures of Success

Commercial

  • Revenue growth

  • Gross profit growth

  • Qualified pipeline creation

  • Pipeline coverage

  • New bookings / TCV

  • Growth in Data & AI, Cloud, advisory and transformation revenue

  • Share-of-wallet expansion

  • Strategic

title: Senior Solution Architect - Banking
description:
We are looking for a highly experienced Senior Solution Architect / Technical Architect to join the Architecture team supporting Digital Products and Corporate Assisted Banking initiatives.

The Senior Architect will work closely with the Head of Architecture while partnering with Delivery Heads, business stakeholders, technology teams, and relevant internal departments and subsidiaries. The role requires deep technical expertise, strong solution-oriented thinking, and the ability to design secure, resilient, reliable, scalable, and high-performing solutions that balance functional requirements with customer/user experience.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in banking and financial services, with exposure to accounting, payments, lending, credit products, and preferably corporate banking, together with extensive experience in microservices, APIs, event-driven architecture, message brokers, cloud-native infrastructure, and modern application architecture.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead and contribute to the architecture and solution design of complex enterprise applications across Digital Products and Corporate Assisted Banking.
  • Translate business and functional requirements into scalable, secure, reliable, resilient, and high-performance technical solutions.
  • Develop end-to-end solution designs, high-level designs, architecture patterns, and technical solutions across backend, frontend, APIs, mobile applications, microservices, message brokers, and event-streaming platforms.
  • Participate in and/or lead architecture activities for multiple projects, ensuring solutions are aligned with enterprise architecture principles and standards.
  • Design solutions within microservices and API-based ecosystems.
  • Define and evaluate architectural design principles, patterns, and approaches, clearly articulating their benefits, limitations, trade-offs, and suitability for the given business requirement.
  • Develop and maintain architecture standards, guidelines, patterns, and best practices.
  • Work closely with internal technology teams, business stakeholders, delivery teams, departments, and subsidiaries to ensure effective solution design and implementation.
  • Ensure architecture decisions appropriately balance functional requirements, customer/user experience, performance, reliability, resiliency, scalability, and security.
  • Provide technical leadership and architectural guidance throughout the solution lifecycle, from requirements and design through implementation and delivery.
  • Support technical decision-making and provide architectural recommendations for complex business and technology challenges.
  • Ensure proposed solutions are aligned with relevant cyber security and information security requirements.
  • Collaborate with Agile delivery teams and contribute to architecture activities throughout the Agile delivery lifecycle.
  • Support architecture governance and ensure adherence to agreed architecture standards and best practices.
  • Demonstrate strong ownership, leadership, communication, and stakeholder management across complex technology initiatives.
  • Continuously learn and adapt to new technologies, business domains, and evolving banking requirements.

Functional / Domain Competencies

The successful candidate should demonstrate strong functional knowledge and experience in:

  • Banking
  • Accounting
  • Payments
  • Lending
  • Credit Products
  • Digital Banking
  • Corporate Banking – preferred
  • Corporate Assisted Banking

Candidates should demonstrate a strong ability and willingness to learn and adapt to new business and functional domains.

Architecture & Technical Competencies

Solution & Technical Architecture

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience building end-to-end:
    • Solution designs
    • High-Level Designs (HLD)
    • Technical architecture
    • Design patterns
    • Architecture solutions
  • Strong experience designing applications across:
    • Backend systems
    • Frontend applications
    • Mobile applications
    • APIs
    • Microservices
    • Message brokers
    • Event-streaming platforms
  • Strong experience working with container-based and cloud-native infrastructure and its associated ecosystem.
  • Strong understanding of modern enterprise application architecture and distributed systems.
  • Deep knowledge of architectural design principles and patterns.
  • Ability to evaluate alternative architecture approaches and clearly explain their advantages, disadvantages, trade-offs, and business/technical impact.

Microservices & API Architecture

  • Strong hands-on experience designing and architecting microservices-based applications.
  • Strong experience with API-based ecosystems and API architecture.
  • Experience designing secure, scalable, reliable, and resilient APIs and distributed services.
  • Understanding of service-to-service communication and integration patterns.

Event-Driven Architecture

  • Experience with message brokers and event-streaming technologies.
  • Strong understanding of event-driven architecture and asynchronous communication patterns.
  • Ability to design resilient and scalable event-based solutions.

Cloud-Native & Container Architecture

  • Strong experience with container-based / cloud-native application infrastructure.
  • Understanding of cloud-native architecture principles and associated technology ecosystems.
  • Experience designing solutions for scalability, availability, resiliency, and performance in distributed environments.

Security Architecture

  • Adequate knowledge and practical experience in incorporating cyber security and information security considerations into application and solution architecture.
  • Ability to ensure security requirements are considered throughout solution design.
  • Understanding of secure application architecture, APIs, microservices, and cloud-native environments.

Agile Delivery Experience

Strong experience working within Agile methodologies and Agile delivery teams is essential.

The candidate should have practical experience with:

Agile Team Concepts

  • Tribes
  • Squads
  • Cross-functional Agile teams

Agile Ceremonies

  • Quarterly Planning
  • Sprint Planning
  • Sprint Refinement
  • Sprint Retrospectives

Agile Deliverables

  • Features
  • Epics
  • User Stories
  • Acceptance Criteria

The candidate should be comfortable collaborating with product, business, engineering, delivery, and architecture teams throughout the Agile lifecycle.

Required Experience

  • Strong experience in Solution Architecture and/or Technical Architecture.
  • Minimum 5+ years of experience in end-to-end architecture, HLD, solution design, and architecture patterns.
  • Strong banking / financial services domain experience.
  • Experience participating in and/or leading at least 3 projects involving the design and architecture of resilient, reliable, and secure applications.
  • Strong experience with microservices and API-based ecosystems.
  • Experience across backend, frontend, APIs, mobile applications, message brokers, and event streams.
  • Experience with container-based / cloud-native infrastructure.
  • Strong understanding of architecture principles, patterns, trade-offs, and best practices.
  • Experience developing and maintaining architecture standards and guidelines.
  • Strong Agile delivery experience, including Tribes, Squads, Agile ceremonies, Features, Epics, Stories, and Acceptance Criteria.
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Ability to work across business, technology, architecture, delivery, and internal stakeholder groups.

Leadership & Behavioral Competencies

  • Strong technical leadership and architectural decision-making capability.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Ability to influence technical and business stakeholders.
  • Strong solution-oriented and analytical mindset.
  • Ability to balance business requirements with technical excellence.
  • Strong ownership and accountability.
  • Ability to work effectively within a matrix organization.
  • Comfortable working in complex, fast-paced enterprise environments.
  • Strong willingness to learn and adapt to new domains and technologies.

Preferred Experience

  • Corporate Banking experience.
  • Digital Banking / Digital Products experience.
  • Corporate Assisted Banking experience.
  • Experience within large banks or financial institutions.
  • Experience with enterprise-scale transformation programs.
  • Exposure to modern cloud-native and event-driven architecture.
  • Experience working across multiple business and technology teams.

title: Kapitalförvaltare
description:
Vi växer ytterligare, är du vår nya kapitalförvaltare?

Hos oss på Swedbank har du en möjlighet att:

  • Arbeta som kapitalförvaltare inom Swedbanks Rådgivande Förvaltning.

  • Ha ett eget affärsansvar för din kundbas och erbjuda dina kunder en kvalificerad och individuellt anpassad förvaltning.

  • Ha ett nära samarbete med bankens analysenheter.

  • Ansvara för intäkter och lönsamhet på din kundstock.

I denna roll behöver du:

  • Ett stort intresse och kunskap för finansiella marknader

  • Ha en stark drivkraft att utveckla och ansvara för en egen kundportfölj

  • Flera års erfarenhet av att arbeta som kapitalförvaltare

  • En civilekonomutbildning eller motsvarande utbildning inom ekonomi/finans

  • En förståelse för vikten av teamwork både inom vår enhet samt övriga enheter i banken

  • Swedseclicens

Hos oss kan du uppleva:

  • Personlig och professionell utveckling genom självledarskap och kontinuerlig utveckling.

  • Meningsfullt arbete som positivt påverkar vår arbetsplats, våra kunder och samhället.

  • En öppen och samarbetsinriktad kultur som uppmuntrar tvärfunktionellt teamarbete och erbjuder nätverksmöjligheter.

  • En stöttande och inkluderande miljö som främjar en balanserad och hållbar arbetslivssituation, med flexibla arbetsförhållanden när det passar rollen.

  • Förmåner såsom vårt erbjudande för bankprodukter för anställda, tjänstepensionsplan, aktiebaserade belöningsprogram Eken, och friskvårdsbidraget.

"Bli en del av vårt team och...

jag kommer kunna erbjuda dig en av bankens mest spännande, krävande och utvecklande tjänster. Du arbetar som en del av ett kompetent och professionellt team i en dynamisk och krävande miljö där varumärket Swedbank, kund, resultat och affärer alltid ligger i fokus.

Du har förmågan att skapa förtroende inte bara i kontakt med kunder utan även gentemot kollegor både inom teamet och i övriga banken. Att samtidigt dela med sig av sin kunskap och kompetens är centralt. En annan viktig egenskap som vi söker är förmågan att ta till sig nya arbetssätt och ha ett processtänk i ditt arbete där du skapar bra och effektiva kundmöten.


Jag kommer att ge dig möjligheten att arbeta självständigt med en öppen och ärlig attityd och en tydlig målsättning. Som team är vi positiva, drivna, välkomnande och professionella." Stefan Andersson, din framtida chef

Vi ser fram emot din ansökan senast den 2026-09-04.

Placeringsort: Göteborg

Rekryterande chef: Stefan Andersson

Vi kan komma att påbörja urvalet under ansökningstiden och välkomnar din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Swedbank är en inkluderande arbetsgivare och diskriminerar ingen utifrån kön, ålder, sexuell läggning eller sexuell identitet, etnicitet, religion eller funktionsnedsättning - alla är välkomna.

title: Full Time - Merchandising Service Associate - Day
description:
Your Impact at Lowe's

As a Lowe's Merchandising Services Associate, you are a key connection point between Merchandising and Store Operations, allowing us to deliver a great shopping experience in every Lowe's store. If you want to build eye-catching displays and implement strategies that showcase in-demand products, you'll enjoy working with our Merchandising Services Team.

How We Support You

Whether you need a part-time position or a place to plant yourself and grow, Lowe's is ready to support your goals. As a Lowe's associate, you'll gain access to many benefits beyond competitive pay and flexible schedules.
  • Keep your weekends free with a set weekday schedule. *
  • Make your well-being a priority with multiple top-tier health insurance options.
  • Explore educational opportunities with Lowe's tuition assistance program.
  • Take charge of your financial future with a company-matching 401(k) and optional Employee Stock Purchase Program.
  • Gain extra savings with a 10% Associate Discount.
  • Learn new trade skills with our Track to the Trades program.
For information about our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit .

*Live Nursery MST Associates may be required to work weekend shifts.

Your Day at Lowe's

As a Merchandising Services Associate, you ensure our store's signage, pricing information, and displays are accurate so merchandise is easy to locate. You create product displays that are safe, clean, visually appealing, and easy for customers to access.

While most of your time will be spent on activities that don't involve customer interaction, you may be expected to engage with customers when the opportunity arises. You'll be expected to listen to customers and answer questions, communicate product or warranty information, and assist in locating or handling merchandise.

Key Responsibilities
  • Complete merchandising resets and service-related projects according to Lowe's specifications and provide proof of completion for assigned tasks
  • Verify buyback items and ensure they are pulled, prepped, and ready for shipping
  • Update/validate wayfinding and product location signage, as well as digital maintenance of this information throughout the store
  • Confirm product pricing information is clearly visible and replace any missing price labels
  • Help drive add-on sales by staging clearance products, sorting products in proper locations, and ensuring displays are placed appropriately throughout the store
  • Repair/replace damaged or missing items, including signage, merchandise and displays.
  • Communicate project priorities, schedule, and needs with Merchandising Services Team and Manager
  • Analyze metrics and provide feedback on project execution and in-store service to store, market, and corporate leaders
  • Complete other duties as assigned

Minimum Qualifications
  • Read, write, and perform basic arithmetic (addition and subtraction)
  • Ability to hear, listen, and to communicate verbally with others
  • Utilize web-based computer programs to accomplish assigned tasks
  • Ability to sit and stand for long periods of time
  • Minimally lift 25lbs unassisted or over 25lbs with or without accommodation

Preferred Qualifications
  • Lowe's sales floor experience
  • Experience performing product merchandising tasks, including reading planograms and setting up and tearing down displays.
  • Experience operating power equipment such as lifts, order pickers, and similar equipment
  • Working knowledge of essential tools (e.g., hand tools, drills, saws, etc.)

Lowe's commitment to growth and teamwork extends to the community as well. To better equip our stores and serve our communities, we strongly encourage bilingual, military, and veteran talent to apply and join our team.

Travel Requirements

This role does not require regular travel; however, this role may need to travel occasionally to meetings, training, or to support neighboring stores.

Working Conditions

Environmental factors vary by location. You may be working in both inside and outside weather conditions. Exposure to varying climates, including extreme heat or cold, wet, damp, humid, windy, or drafty conditions, is possible. You may be exposed to constant or intermittent noises in addition to moving or shaking objects and equipment.

Lifting methods vary based on role, weight, and volume. Associates must follow guidelines, limiting single lifts to 75 pounds. Team lifts are used minimally starting at 75 pounds or when needed. Powered equipment should be used as required, with proper training or assistance from a trained coworker.

Lowe's Companies, Inc. (NYSE: LOW) is a FORTUNE® 50 home improvement company serving approximately 16 million customer transactions a week in the United States. With total fiscal year 2023 sales of more than $86 billion, Lowe's operates over 1,700 home improvement stores and employs approximately 300,000 associates. Based in Mooresville, N.C., Lowe's supports the communities it serves through programs focused on creating safe, affordable housing and helping to develop the next generation of skilled trade experts. For more information, visit Pay Range: $18.42 - $19.45 per hour

Starting rate of pay may vary based on factors including, but not limited to, position offered, location, education, training, and/or experience. For information regarding our benefit programs and eligibility, please visit .

Associate Benefits ()

  • Working at one of the largest retail companies has its perks. We offer exceptional benefits and wellness programs for eligible full-time and part-time associates, tailored for many different lifestyles. Our benefits range from health, vision and dental insurance to paid vacation, tuition assistance and parental and family-building benefits. Plus, we offer learning and development opportunities to help our associates grow their skills and achieve their goals.

  • Health, Dental and Vision insurance

  • Life and Disability insurance

  • Paid time off based on role, tenure, and locality, including vacation, holidays, sick and volunteer time

  • Flexible spending and health savings accounts

  • 401(k) Retirement account with company match

  • Employee Assistance Program with concierge, work/life services and no-cost counseling for all kinds of needs

  • Education support programs, including tuition assistance and trade skills scholarships

  • Business Travel Accident insurance

  • Maternity and Parental leave

  • Adoption assistance

  • Lowe's Associate Discount and broad discount platform

  • Other discretionary benefits (based on eligibility) include annual bonuses, enrollment in Lowe's Employee Stock Purchase Plan and/or deferred compensation plan, and grant awards

Lowe’s employs approximately 300,000 associates and operates over 1,750 home improvement stores, 540 branches and 120 distribution centers. title: Customer relationship- Japanese
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

Japanese Language Specialist at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients – which means some of the biggest in the world.

One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.


Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development.   • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical information to non-technical individuals
  • Experience in working with Japanese clients or in a multicultural team is preferred.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple tasks and deadlines.

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

title: Expert Project Finance (all genders)
description:
Q ENERGY is Europe’s 360° green energy company. Together with our more than 500 employees we develop, build, and manage renewable energy assets across the entire value chain of large-scale renewable energy projects – from solar, to onshore wind and offshore wind, to energy storage and hybrid power plants. With a pipeline of more than 11 GW we are among the leading renewable energy companies in Europe. We are always on the lookout for people who want to work with us to empower a sustainable world with green energy.

We are looking for a motivated and experienced Expert Project Finance (all genders) to join our Berlin based team.

Your responsibilities will include:

  • You are guiding projects (Onshore Wind, BESS, Solar) through the investment cycle whilst maintain a position at the forefront of transactions on the buy- and sell-side from inception until closing.
  • You are utilizing your existing and further growing network to renewable energy developers in the German market and originate a constant deal flow.
  • You perform best-in-class investment valuations with established valuation methods (e.g. DCF, multiples, etc.) and make sure that you are always on top of the numbers with audit-proof quality ready for investment approval.
  • You assist in negotiations of relevant transaction contracts (NBO, SPA, PDA, EPC, TMA, Facility Agreements, PPA, etc.) in close collaboration with other internal teams and suite of top tier advisers.
  • You are drafting information materials, IC documentation and other internal presentations as relevant.
  • You manage packages of the due diligence process vis-à-vis internal cross-functional teams, sellers, investors and lenders whilst ensuring projects meet international bankability requirements and transaction timeframes.
  • You consistently perform market research in the energy sector and translate the contents into solid commercial decisions.

Requirements

  • You have a bachelor’s or master’s degree in Finance, Business, Economics, Mathematics or a related field.
  • You have at least 4 years of experience from a project finance lending institution, private equity, infra fund, developer or adviser preferably within the renewable energy or other alternative infrastructure sectors, Onshore Wind or BESS experience is preferred.
  • You are able to negotiate key project contracts and challenge your position towards the senior team throughout the deal execution.
  • You have advanced proficiency in financial modelling and analytical skills, with a strong commercial sense, able to mutate results into clear contract arrangements.
  • You possess strong communication skills, able to translate QENERGYs interests into clear transaction proposals and IC recommendations.
  • You are a high-ownership individual experienced at the front line and home in a fast-paced environment, striving to pitch, originate and execute deals.
  • You are fluent in German and English

Benefits

For this position, the fixed annual base salary starts at 74.000,00€ gross per year.

Separate from the starting base salary stated above, additional benefits may be available depending on the role, employee level and applicable company policies.

Additionally, we offer the following benefits:

  • Spendit Card: €50 monthly allowance on top of your monthly salary, which can be used for your daily lunch or can be saved up unlimitedly.
  • Public Transport Allowance: Enjoy a €15 monthly contribution to your BVG ticket—making your commute easier and more affordable!
  • Pension Plan: We contribute €13.29 each month to your pension.

On top we offer:

  • Our workplace: Located in a modern and sustainable office building just a few steps from Südkreuz station, making it easily accessible for all employees.
  • IT Equipment: We’ll set you up with a laptop, monitor, headphones, and, if needed, a company phone.
  • Work-Life Balance: we value your personal time. Enjoy the flexibility to choose your work hours, so you can prioritize what matters most—whether it’s attending a workout class, handling personal matters, or starting your weekend a little earlier. You’re in control.
  • Mobile Working: At Q ENERGY we offer a hybrid work model: three days in the office and two days of mobile working. This setup supports in-person teamwork while also allowing for more flexibility and reduced commuting.
  • Generous Vacation Policy: Enjoy a well-deserved break and take 31 vacation days a year.
  • Onboarding: We provide a detailed onboarding process to ensure you have a smooth and successful start with us, helping you feel supported and prepared from day one.
  • Pension Plan: We contribute €13.29 each month to your pension.
  • Insurance Coverage: With accident and life insurance included, we’ve got you covered, giving you peace of mind on and off the job.
  • Corporate Discounts: Employees get access to exclusive offers and discounts for various brands through our Corporate Benefits program.
  • Company Car: If eligible and your role requires it, you get access to a company car!
  • Corporate Health Management: Prioritize your well-being with our corporate health management program, including preventive check-ups to keep you at your best!
  • Mutual support: You’ll thrive in a supportive environment where open communication, teamwork, and knowledge sharing are highly valued. We’re committed to your growth, encouraging your professional and personal development through ongoing support and guidance.

Then we look forward to receiving your application. Please let us know your salary expectations and your earliest possible starting date.

Please note: We do not accept applications by email. Please use the "Apply for this Job" button for your application. Thank you very much!

If you have any questions, please contact our Recruiting team recruiting@qenergy.eu.

Q ENERGY is an internationally operating company - at our company, people from many nations, cultures, and locations work together in partnership and exchange their experiences and values with each other in an open and collegial manner.

title: Crypto Quality SW Process Internship
description:
Ready to join the future of innovation in Crypto & Security at NXP?

Become part of a highly talented team and dynamic team that develops and tests state-of-the art secure cryptographic libraries protected against physical and logical attacks which have applications across all different NXP domains and business lines (payment, identification, mobile, IoT, Automotive, Edge Processing, etc.).

Your Responsibilities:

  • Support the implementation and maintenance of software quality processes for NXP software products, ensuring compliance with applicable industry standards and customer requirements, including CMMI, ISO 26262, Automotive SPICE, ISO/SAE 21434, and IATF 16949.
  • Participate in work product reviews and support the collection of review evidence in accordance with defined quality and process requirements.
  • Assist in planning, tracking, and reporting quality-related activities, including Quality Plans, Lessons Learned, Problem Resolution Management, Process Compliance Status, and Continuous Improvement Initiatives.
  • Support process compliance assessments, internal audits, and external evaluations (e.g., ASPICE and CMMI), including the follow-up and tracking of identified actions.
  • Contribute to process definition, tailoring, deployment, and continuous improvement activities across software development projects.
  • Support the collection, analysis, and reporting of quality and process metrics, helping teams monitor project performance and compliance.

Here are some useful tips to help you prepare.

And more: Life at NXP is more than work alone. We like to start our day with a free coffee and chat with a colleague and on Thursdays we have fresh fruits for all employees. Join us at one of the many social activities that are organized by and for employees such as our Christmas parties, our employee children’s party and food fairs. Or help us give back to society by donating blood or collecting clothes and food for children in need.

title: Ambulant persoonlijk begeleider team Eigen Thuis Centrum/ Noord (32 uur)
description:
Vind je het leuk om mee te denken over vernieuwing van ons zorgaanbod en wil jij graag jongvolwassenen met diverse psychiatrische en psychosociale problemen begeleiden op hun weg naar een zelfstandige toekomst? Lees dan snel verder en solliciteer op deze uitdagende functie!

Jouw rol
Je gelooft in de kracht van de cliënt en hun vermogen om hun leven weer op de rit te krijgen en houden. Als ambulant persoonlijk begeleider werk je samen met jongvolwassenen om concrete stappen te zetten om hun doelen en dromen te bereiken. Jij bent hun eerste aanspreekpunt en bouwt een vertrouwensband op die de intrinsieke motivatie stimuleert. Je ziet de samenhang tussen de ontwrichtende levensloop en de doelen die zijn gesteld. Je bezoekt cliënten in hun woonomgeving en gaat indien nodig met hen mee naar afspraken.

Met een outreachende werkwijze signaleer jij vroegtijdig problemen om de kansen van jongvolwassenen op herstel en zelfredzaamheid te vergroten. Dankzij je uitstekende communicatieve vaardigheden, creëer je sterke verbindingen tussen cliënten onderling en met andere professionals. Met onze krachtmethodiek, stimuleer jij jouw cliënten om het beste uit zichzelf te halen. Dit doen ze door zich samen met jou te richten op wat mogelijk en haalbaar is.

Team
Team Eigen Thuis Noord/Centrum begeleidt jongvolwassenen van 17 tot en met 27 jaar met een huisvestings- en zorgvraag. Zij hebben veelal een achtergrond in de jeugdzorg en/of dak- en thuisloosheid. Door ontwrichtende ervaringen in hun jeugd is de zorgvraag heel verschillend. De jongvolwassenen kampen bijvoorbeeld met psychosociale of psychiatrische problematiek. Daarnaast zijn schulden, beperkte scholing, ontbreken van een steunend netwerk of forensische thematiek, uitdagingen waar jongvolwassenen voor staan.

Ons team geeft jongvolwassenen meer dan een plek om te wonen – we bieden een veilige basis om opnieuw richting te geven aan hun leven. In Amsterdam-Noord bieden we 41 beschermde woonplekken in het Overhoeks gebied en daarnaast 40 zelfstandige woningen verspreid over Amsterdam-Noord en Amsterdam-Centrum. Samen bouwen we aan vertrouwen, zelfstandigheid en een toekomst waarin jongvolwassenen weer volop kunnen meedoen in de samenleving. We werken vraaggericht, vanuit de krachtmethodiek en zo veel mogelijk in samenwerking met naasten. Je werktijden liggen tussen 8.30 en 22.00 uur door de weeks en in het weekend (ook op feestdagen).

Jouw profiel
Je bent proactief, toegankelijk, en houdt van innovatie en samenwerken. De afwisseling van ambulante begeleiding spreekt je aan, en je bent flexibel en ondernemend. Je communiceert positief en opbouwend, komt afspraken na en bent nauwkeurig in het bijhouden van rapportages en registraties. Methodisch en doelgericht werken zit in jouw natuur. Empathie, geduld, zelfstandigheid en om hulp kunnen vragen zijn herkenbare eigenschappen van jou. Herken je jezelf ook in onderstaande wensen, dan maken we graag kennis met jou!

  • Je beschikt over aantoonbaar hbo werk- en denkniveau en hebt minimaal een mbo-niveau 4 diploma op zak;
  • Je hebt affiniteit met de doelgroep of ervaringskennis die aansluit bij de doelgroep;
  • Je hebt minimaal 2 jaar werkervaring in een soortgelijke omgeving;
  • Je bent een verbinder en overziet complexere zorgvraagstukken;
  • Je bent een echte doorpakker, daadkrachtig en staat stevig in je schoenen;
  • De Housing First aanpak past goed bij jouw visie op zorg.

Arbeidsvoorwaarden en bijzonderheden

  • Een baan met veel vrijheid en ruimte voor initiatief;
  • Het betreft in eerste instantie een contract voor de duur van een jaar met uitzicht op verlenging;
  • Jouw salaris bedraagt minimaal € 3.461,- en maximaal € 5.157,- bruto per maand; (schaal 8, CAO Sociaal Werk) op basis van een 36-urige werkweek. Per 1 oktober 2026 worden de salarissen conform de CAO Sociaal Werk verhoogd met 2,1%. Dit is exclusief een arbeidsmarkttoeslag van 1,13%;
  • Een 2e klas mobiliteitskaart voor woon-werkverkeer en dienstreizen met OV of gebruik van OV-fiets;
  • Je ontvangt bij een 36-urige werkweek minimaal 24 verlofdagen per jaar. Door feestdagencompensatie en vitaliteitsverlof kan dit oplopen tot ongeveer 30 verlofdagen. Daarnaast kun je via je IKB extra verlofuren kopen;
  • Overige arbeidsvoorwaarden zijn conform CAO Sociaal Werk. Zo krijg je een individueel keuze budget van 17,07%. Hierin zitten onder andere vakantiegeld en een eindejaarsuitkering. Ook bouw je maandelijks een loopbaanbudget van 1,5% op. We vinden vitaliteit belangrijk en bieden jou daarom jaarlijks een sportvergoeding van €100,-;
  • Een referentiecheck en verklaring omtrent gedrag maken onderdeel uit van deze procedure. Tijdens de onboarding vragen we je om een online competentievragenlijst in te vullen;
  • Met een interactief onboardingprogramma bieden we jou een warm welkom en een goede start.

HVO-Querido heeft de ambitie om een inclusieve en gelijkwaardige organisatie te zijn waar alle cliënten en medewerkers zichzelf kunnen zijn en zich thuis voelen, met als doel om betere kwaliteit van zorg te leveren aan onze cliënten en een veilige en inspirerende werkplek te bieden voor onze medewerkers. Bij HVO-Querido werken we vanuit drie kennisbronnen: ervaringskennis, praktijkkennis en wetenschappelijke inzichten.

Meer informatie?
Voor meer informatie over de functie kun je contact opnemen met Hishaam Eldewieh, teammanager, via 06-11364248. of Hans Zuidema, zorgcoördinator via 06-25550370.

Direct solliciteren?
Graag ontvangen we je digitale reactie vóór 14 september a.s.

title: Apotektekniker
description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Vi søker nå etter apotektekniker til tilkalling hos oss på Boots apotek Nardo.

Er du apotektekniker og får energi av å hjelpe kunder med deres helsebehov?

Vi mener det er nettopp medarbeiderne som utgjør den viktigste forskjellen for kunden!

Bli med på vårt team og få muligheten til å veilede og gi rådgivning til kunder i et miljø som setter kvalitet i kundemøtet og utvikling av helsetjenester i fokus! Bli med på å forme fremtidens apotek!

Boots apotek Nardo finner du på Nardocenteret. Apoteket er åpent fra kl:09:00 - 20:00 i hverdager og kl: 10:00 - 18:00 på lørdager. Vi har topp fokus på de gode kundemøtene og å utvikle oss. Våre kunder skal alltid ønske å komme tilbake – uansett om det handler om helsetjenester, reseptsalg eller en kunde i selvvalget. På apoteket finner du 3 farmasøyter (inkludert apoteker) og 2 apotekteknikere, i tillegg til studenter og medarbeidere.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Som apotektekniker hos Boots apotek vil du ha en sentral rolle i å veilede og gi rådgivning til kundene våre. Dette innebærer å velge riktige produkter og forstå hvordan de skal brukes, samt gi informasjon om og utføre helsetjenester. På denne måten bidrar du med din kompetanse til bedre helse og økt livskvalitet for kundene!

Kvalifikasjoner

  • Vi søker etter en apotektekniker eller noen med annen relevant bakgrunn, ideelt sett med erfaring fra norske apotek.
  • Gode ferdigheter i norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig, tilsvarende minimum B2-nivå i henhold til Helsedirektoratets anbefalinger.

Personlige egenskaper

  • I denne rollen er det viktig at du liker å bruke din kompetanse i kundemøtene. Du bør være engasjert i å hjelpe kundene med deres individuelle behov og kunne kommunisere tydelig om medisiner, tjenester og helseprodukter.
  • Ditt engasjement driver deg til å stadig strekke deg etter det beste. Du ønsker alltid å levere den beste servicen til kundene dine ved å være kunnskapsrik, profesjonell og imøtekommende.
  • Gode mellommenneskelige ferdigheter er viktige i denne rollen da du vil jobbe tett sammen med kolleger og samhandle daglig med kunder. Evnen til å etablere gode relasjoner, være utadvendt og ha et positivt humør vil bidra til en trivelig arbeidsatmosfære.

Vi tilbyr

  • Stillingen som apotektekniker hos Boots apotek gir deg muligheten til å bli en del av en anerkjent apotekkjede.

About the Company
Embitel Technologies is a Volkswagen AG (VW) Group Company. VW is a German multinational automotive manufacturing corporation headquartered in Wolfsburg, Germany. VW is one of the world’s largest automaker by sales. VW sold 10.9 million vehicles in 2019. The group comprises of 12 brands from seven European Countries: Volkswagen, Audi, Lamborghini, Porsche, Bugatti, Bentley, Ducati (motorcycles), Skoda, SEAT, Scania, MAN and Volkswagen commercial vehicles.

About CARIAD (Car, I Am Digital)


The automotive industry is in disruption. As a company, CARIAD is playing a part in multiple large trends at the same time: electrification, automation, and digitalization. The new name builds on changing customer needs. Automotive customers are demanding more comfort, more safety, more sustainability, and more connectivity. With its software platforms and digital features, CARIAD is developing solutions and products that will turn the car into a smart companion to accompany customers into the future with continuous updates and new digital features, even years later. The new company name reflects this zeitgeist: ‘Car, I Am Digital’. The brand profile can be found on its new website .


Currently, around 4,000 employees are working at CARIAD on the digital transformation of the car. CARIAD is working intensively on the software and technology platform for Premium Platform Electric (PPE). The first vehicles based on PPE will be the electric Porsche Macan and Audi Q6 e-tron. At the core of CARIAD is the development of the unified and scalable software and technology platform E³ 2.0 for all Group brands. E³ stands for ‘end to end electronics architecture’. The new software and technology platform is built from scratch and will be used first at the end of 2024 in Artemis, the lighthouse project of Audi. As of 2026, E³ 2.0 is due to be scaled by the Volkswagen brand with Trinity in the volume segment.


About our Group


CARIAD COE (Centre of Excellence) is setup in Bangalore, India working exclusively with CARIAD and associated VW groups with the focus on development of ‘VW.OS”. The areas of work involve development of platform components such as firmware, boot loaders, AUTOSAR, Linux/QNX BSP, Service oriented architecture-based middleware components.

title: Graphics Artist, Journeyman
description:
Looking for an opportunity to make an impact?

At Leidos, we deliver innovative solutions through the efforts of our diverse and talented people who are dedicated to our customers’ success. We empower our teams, contribute to our communities, and operate sustainably. Everything we do is built on a commitment to do the right thing for our customers, our people, and our community. The Leidos Intelligence Sector combines technology-enabled services and mission software capabilities in the areas of cyber, logistics, security operations, and decision analytics to support our defense and intel customers’ mission to defend against evolving threats around the world.

Your greatest work is ahead!

The Intelligence Sector seeks highly qualified and trained Journeyman-level Graphics Artists to support United States Cyber Command (USCYBERCOM) operations through production of high-quality and high-visibility graphics underpinning critical visual communications to include briefings, documents, and web materials. As part of a collaborative team, candidates will conceptualize, design, and deliver visually compelling products that effectively communicate complex information in a professional, clear, and aesthetically pleasing manner.

This opportunity is in anticipation of a potential future contract award.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Provide timely, accurate, relevant support in manner that best supports USCYBERCOM as graphics artist supporting multiple customers across the USCYERCOM J3, Cyber National Mission Force (CNMF), and Joint Task Force-ARES (JTF-ARES).

  • Design and produce high-quality graphic content using Microsoft Office and Adobe Creative Suite products.

  • Develop visual concepts from start to finish with creativity and precision, while adhering to USCYBERCOM branding and presentation standards.

  • Collaborate with technical SMEs and leaders to transform complex information into clean, engaging visual content.

  • Provide expert recommendations and feedback on visual communication strategies to end users.

  • Format and revise subject matter for effective graphic presentation, including the selection of visual elements, layout design, and delivery formatting.

  • Design materials for internal and external communications, including documents, infographics, presentations, and web-based assets.

  • Contribute to the development of analytic standards and best practices, continuously improving methodologies and products.

  • Ensure compliance with DoD and USCYBERCOM policies, regulations, and frameworks, and interpret and apply laws, regulations, and any other applicable guidance relevant to daily activities.

  • Communicate complex information, concepts, or ideas in a confident and well-organized manner through verbal, written, and/or visual means.

What does Leidos need from me?

  • Top Secret/SCI (TS/SCI) security clearance with Polygraph, upon Application, to be consideration for this position.

  • Associate’s degree or higher in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, Multimedia Arts, or related field. Additional years of experience may be considered in lieu of degree.

  • Three to Five plus years’ experience in graphic design within a professional environment, with preference for previous experience supporting DoD or Intelligence Community (IC) organizations.

  • Ability to provide support timely, accurate, relevant graphics artist support to analytical production, to include documents, summaries, issue papers, talking points, and briefings.

  • Proficiency in Microsoft 365 and Adobe Creative Suite.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating a range of graphic design skills, especially in presentation graphics and executive-level content.

  • Knowledge of computer networking fundamentals as well as concepts, terminology, and operations of a wide range of communications media (computer and telephone networks, satellite, fiber, wireless).

  • Demonstrated understanding of formatting for classified and unclassified briefing environments.

  • Strong attention to detail, ability to follow branding guidelines, and commitment to high visual standards.

  • Display excellent interpersonal and communication skills; ability to receive and apply feedback effectively.

  • Demonstrated proficiency working in a fast-paced collaborative environment, ability to proactively multi-task and meet short deadlines.

Favorable if you have:

  • Bachelors’ degree or higher within field of Graphic Design, Visual Communications, Multimedia Arts, or a related field.

  • Familiarity with USCYBERCOM organizational structure and mission.

  • Experience designing for executive-level or military audiences.

  • Prior experience providing graphic design support to Joint operations across multiple warfighting domains.

  • Demonstrated understanding of DoD and IC collaboration and graphics design best practices.

  • Desired Certifications: DoD 8570 IAT Level II (CCNA Security, COMPTIA CySA+, COMPTIA Security + CE, GICSP, GSEC, SSCP).

Vi värdesätter praktisk förståelse, noggrannhet och samarbetsförmåga. Du behöver inte ha lång erfarenhet – det viktigaste är att du är nyfiken, ansvarstagande och vill bidra till ett tryggt och effektivt arbetsflöde.

Arla är inte bara ett företag, vi är ett bondekooperativ där passion och samhörighet blomstrar. Med rötterna djupt förankrade på bondgårdar runt om i världen. Som marknadsledare är det vårt gemensamma mål och strävan efter excellens som definierar oss. Hos Arla tror vi på kraften i mångfald och växande ambitioner. Tillsammans skapar vi innovation, hållbarhet och en äkta känsla av gemenskap som sträcker sig bortom affärstransaktioner. Är redo att vara en del av något större än bara ett företag? Är du redo att omsätta passion till verklighet och vara en del av en global familj som sätter kvalitet och hållbarhet främst? Då är Arla rätt plats för dig.

title: Process Technician I (2nd Shift)
description:
Use Your Power for Purpose

Our breakthroughs would not make it to the hands of patients without our dedicated and agile pharmaceutical manufacturing team. We rely on members who understand the importance and impact of their role in Pfizer’s mission. Patients need colleagues like you who take pride in their work and always strive to improve outcomes. You will help ensure that patients and physicians have the medicines they need when they need them.


What You Will Achieve

In this role, you will:

  • Take responsibility for individual contributions to achieve team deliverables, working effectively as a team member and coordinating with others.
  • Manage personal time and professional development, being accountable for results.
  • Follow standard procedures to complete tasks of varying scope, sequence, and complexity within the agreed timeframe.
  • Identify and solve moderately routine problems.
  • Complete assignments with moderate supervision using established procedures, referring deviations from standard procedures to the supervisor.
  • Ensure work is reviewed for accuracy, quality, and adherence to standards.
  • Prepare and operate various components, materials, equipment, and machines in your assigned area, ensuring adequate inventory of parts and materials before starting a production run.
  • Adhere strictly to all plant safety and current Good Manufacturing Practices (cGMP) regulations.
  • Perform in-process quality inspections, and seek to implement process and safety improvements.

Role Overview

The Biological Operations Tech role is responsible for processing raw materials (i.e. human and equine blood and plasma) into Stroma to be used in the formulation of ATGAM Purified Drug Substance by means of a large-scale biologic separation processes (i.e. centrifugation). Techs may also perform work on other processing steps related to other products run in that area. Work is performed in strict compliance with manufacturing standards (SOPs) and following all regulatory requirements (i.e., GMPs & OSHA). This job includes the following functions:


  • Performing unit operations in the biological processing area with a variety of different equipment types (tanks, pumps, centrifuges, scales, filters, freeze dryers, etc.)
  • Washing, sanitizing and cleaning facilities and equipment
  • Handling, Charging and packaging materials
  • Monitoring process parameters and batch end reports for quality or equipment concerns
  • Utilizing computer skills to interact with multiple complex PLC and SCADA systems
  • Collaborating with maintenance and engineers to troubleshoot equipment and perform TPM tasks
  • Supporting development and execution of capital projects, corrective actions, and continuous improvement ideas
  • Demonstrating growth mindset to share best practices & utilize downtime effectively
  • Working safely and compliantly following all applicable SOPs and standards including recording of GMP documentation
  • Completing and maintaining all required training on time
  • Demonstrating ownership and accountability of the production schedule and product quality
  • Executing in-process quality inspections
  • Other duties as assigned by the supervisor

Role Responsibilities

Overview: As the entry levelrole in this career path, the colleague is expected to show progression towards all the items below and competency on a growing number of them as the duration in the role progresses.

EHS

  • Safety Orientation &Safety OJT training
  • LOTO / Safe work permits / Confined space Awareness
  • Unit safety self-inspections

GMP

  • GMP record entries
  • Gowning access (Certification completed)
  • Meets daily GMP requirements - with assistance
  • Maintains training documentation (PLS & Curricula)
  • Alarm response & notification awareness

BIOLOGICAL OPERATIONS

  • Stroma process and Blood Room operations (with assistance)
  • Setting up and operating biological operations equipment (with assistance)
  • Monitoring process performance and making appropriate documentation entries
  • Weighing and charging operations with biological materials
  • Perform specific and accurate double checks
  • Can perform disposals
  • Weekend Rotation (participation)
  • Maintain area audit readiness
  • Display cGMP’s at all times
  • Identify issues, respond, and escalate appropriately
  • Complete andaccuratehandoffs
  • Operatorcare activities
  • Facility cleaning for routine and special cause events
  • Batchrecordreview

Other:

  • Practices leader behaviors in accordance with Pfizer Core Values including: Seizes Accountability, Grows Self, Adapt to Change, Self Awareness, Commits to One Pfizer, and Peer Relationships
  • Performs work in professional, self-directed, responsible, and timely manner


QUALIFICATIONS

Education and Experience:

High school diploma / general education degree (GED) plus

  • An associate degree, OR
  • Veteran/Military experience, OR
  • Six months of relevant work experience in a manufacturing or GMP facility (e.g. current or previous Pfizer colleague or contractor or similar)

In addition, the following skills are preferred:

  • Mechanical experience/aptitude
  • Experience handling biologic substances, APIs, or drug products



PHYSICAL/MENTAL REQUIREMENTS

Physical/Mental Requirements

Physical Demands:

  • lifting/lowering up to 55 pounds, working in high elevations (above 6 feet), and reaching/standing/walking/stooping/crawling.
  • Able to wear safety PPE (Hard hat, body harness, face shield)
  • Able to work under clean room (GRADE C/D) environments with appropriate gowning

NON-STANDARD WORK SCHEDULE, TRAVEL OR ENVIRONMENT REQUIREMENTS

Positions are staffed across all three shifts. Specific shift schedules may vary by specific operational area. Weekend, holiday, and overtime may be required to meet business or customer needs.

In addition, this position offers eligibility for overtime, weekend, holiday and other pay premiums depending on the work schedule and the Company’s policies.
