title: Stageplaats bij Intergas 2027
description:
Zoek je een stageplek waar je écht mag meedoen, veel leert én bijdraagt aan de energietransitie? Bij Intergas in Coevorden hebben we regelmatig ruimte voor stagiairs van alle studierichtingen: techniek, IT, logistiek, finance, HR, communicatie, bedrijfskunde, data, marketing – en alles daarbuiten. We kijken graag samen met jou welke afdeling en opdracht bij jouw studie, niveau en leerdoelen past.

Over Intergas en onze afdelingen

Intergas ontwikkelt en produceert betrouwbare en energiezuinige verwarmingsoplossingen. Vanuit Coevorden werken we met honderden collega’s aan cv-ketels, hybride systemen en andere oplossingen die een rol spelen in de energietransitie in Nederland en daarbuiten.

Je kunt bij ons stage lopen op verschillende afdelingen, bijvoorbeeld:

  • R&D en Engineering – ontwikkeling en verbetering van onze producten en systemen.

  • Productie & Logistiek – het maken, plannen en leveren van onze producten.

  • Kwaliteit, Veiligheid & Service – testen, verbeteren en ondersteunen van onze klanten.

  • IT & Data – ondersteunende systemen, data-analyse en digitalisering.

  • Finance & Control – cijfers, rapportages en bedrijfsvoering.

  • HR & Recruitment – instroom, doorstroom en ontwikkeling van collega’s.

  • Marketing, Communicatie & Sales support – onze klantcommunicatie en marktbenadering.

We horen graag wat jij zoekt, dan zoeken we daar de best passende afdeling bij.

Over de stage

Als stagiair bij Intergas maak je echt onderdeel uit van een team. Je draait mee in de dagelijkse praktijk én werkt aan je eigen (afstudeer)opdracht. We bieden persoonlijke begeleiding, zowel op de inhoud van je opdracht als op het proces van stage lopen: planning, samenwerking, reflectie en jouw volgende stap na je stage.

Afhankelijk van je opleiding en afdeling kun je denken aan werkzaamheden zoals:

  • Meewerken met het team aan de dagelijkse werkzaamheden binnen jouw vakgebied.

  • Uitvoeren van een eigen (onderzoeks)opdracht met duidelijke doelen en resultaten.

  • Gegevens of processen analyseren en verbeterpunten in kaart brengen.

  • Overleggen met collega’s van verschillende afdelingen over jouw bevindingen.

  • Uitwerken en presenteren van jouw advies, onderzoeksresultaten of plan van aanpak.

  • Meedenken over verbeteringen in onze producten, diensten of interne processen.

  • Bijdragen aan projecten rond energiebesparing, klanttevredenheid of procesoptimalisatie.

We hebben plekken voor meewerkstages en afstudeerstages op mbo-, hbo- en wo-niveau.

Wat bieden wij?

Je krijgt bij ons de kans om in een professionele organisatie te ontdekken waar jouw talent ligt. Je leert hoe het eraan toegaat in een moderne productie- en kantooromgeving en je bouwt een netwerk op waar je later in je loopbaan profijt van hebt. Je krijgt een vaste stagebegeleider en ruimte om te werken aan jouw leerdoelen.

Daarnaast ontvang je:

  • Een passende stagevergoeding, afgestemd op je opleidingsniveau en stageduur.

  • Persoonlijke begeleiding op zowel de inhoud van je opdracht als het stageproces.

  • Goede werkfaciliteiten (en indien nodig een laptop voor je stageopdracht).

  • Toegang tot interne kennis, overleggen, trainingen of bijeenkomsten.

  • De kans om, bij een goede match, door te groeien naar een (starters)functie of vervolgstage.

Wat zoeken wij?

We staan open voor verschillende studierichtingen. Belangrijker dan je exacte opleiding vinden we jouw motivatie om te leren en mee te denken. Je durft vragen te stellen, zoekt graag uit hoe dingen werken en vindt het leuk om samen met collega’s resultaten te halen.

We zijn op zoek naar iemand die:

  • Een mbo-, hbo- of wo-opleiding volgt en een meewerk- of afstudeerstage zoekt.

  • Beschikbaar is voor een stage van bij voorkeur minimaal 3 maanden.

  • Nieuwsgierig is, initiatief neemt en verantwoordelijkheid durft te pakken.

  • Zowel zelfstandig als in een team kan werken.

    Bij Intergas is iedere student welkom, ongeacht je achtergrond, studierichting of ervaringsniveau. We denken graag met je mee over een passende plek.

Zo solliciteer je

Enthousiast geworden over een stage bij Intergas?

Klik op de sollicitatieknop en stuur ons:

  • Je cv

  • Een korte motivatie waarin je aangeeft:

    • Welke opleiding je volgt en op welk niveau (mbo/hbo/wo)

    • Of je een meewerkstage of afstudeerstage zoekt

    • In welke periode je stage wilt lopen en voor hoeveel dagen per week

    • Welke richting/afdeling jou interessant lijkt

We nemen daarna contact met je op om te kijken welke mogelijkheden er zijn en hoe we jouw leerdoelen het beste kunnen invullen.

title: Business Analyst
description:
Role Purpose

Maximize the business value of Enterprise Applications by driving their continuous improvement and adoption.

Act as the bridge between business users, Enterprise Applications teams, and technical support organizations to improve adoption, identify structural improvement opportunities, reduce operational friction, and ensure enterprise applications continue to evolve alongside changing business processes.

Operate as part of the EnSite Experience & Adoption team, working closely with Enterprise Applications Support, Governance, Delivery & Modernization, and Business stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop a strong understanding of the supported business processes and the Enterprise Applications enabling them.

  • Build trusted relationships with business users and key stakeholders to understand how Enterprise Applications support their daily operations.

  • Identify operational friction, process inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities through user engagement, trend analysis, and operational metrics.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that increase business value, improve user experience, and promote effective adoption of Enterprise Applications.

  • Perform structured root cause analysis to distinguish between process, data, training, and technical opportunities for improvement.

  • Translate business improvement opportunities into clearly documented demand items and work closely with the Delivery & Modernization team to ensure successful implementation.

  • Partner with Enterprise Applications Support teams to validate that implemented improvements deliver sustainable business outcomes.

  • Support projects during testing, hypercare, and transition into steady-state operations to ensure successful business adoption and operational readiness.

  • Develop and maintain business process documentation, user guidance, training materials, and best practices where appropriate.

  • Monitor KPIs and trends related to user experience, business process effectiveness, application adoption, and continuous improvement.

  • Provide management with insights, recommendations, and measurable improvement opportunities across the supported application landscape.

  • Contribute to the development of a repeatable Experience & Adoption operating model that can be expanded globally.

Experience & Profile

  • Experience working with Enterprise Applications (SAP, Oracle, or similar ERP environments).

  • Strong understanding of end-to-end business processes within one or more functional domains (Finance, Supply Chain, Manufacturing, HR, Procurement, etc.).

  • Experience working closely with business users to improve business processes and Enterprise Application usage.

  • Experience participating in ERP implementation, stabilization, or continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Strong analytical mindset with structured problem-solving capabilities.

  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

  • Comfortable operating at the intersection of business and IT within a global matrix organization.

  • Experience documenting business requirements, process improvements, and functional solutions.

  • Customer-focused mindset with a passion for continuous improvement and long-term sustainability.

  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal.

What Success Looks Like

Success in this role is measured by:

  • Increased adoption of standard Enterprise Application processes.

  • Reduction of operational friction through structural improvements.

  • Improved user experience and business confidence in Enterprise Applications.

  • Well-defined and prioritized continuous improvement opportunities.

  • Successful transition of projects into sustainable day-to-day operations.

  • Strong collaboration between business stakeholders, Enterprise Applications Support, and Delivery & Modernization teams.

  • Contribution to a scalable Experience & Adoption operating model that can be expanded across regions.

title: Lead Product Designer — Home Lending Research & Design
description:
About this Role

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Product Designer to help shape the future of Home Lending for the customers and employees who experience it every day.

This role goes beyond designing individual screens or workflows. You will bring clarity to complex journeys, connect moments across the mortgage lifecycle, and create a cohesive story of where the experience is headed. Through thoughtful design and compelling visual and written storytelling, you will help teams envision the future, align around it, and turn that vision into experiences that are intuitive, accessible, and meaningful.

We are looking for a strategic, hands-on designer who can see the whole journey, translate complexity into possibility, and inspire others to build toward a shared vision.

In This Role, You Will

  • Lead the end-to-end design of complex customer and employee experiences across Home Lending, translating customer needs, business goals, operational requirements, and technical constraints into intuitive solutions.

  • Apply service design and systems thinking to improve experiences across products, channels, processes, and teams, including loan origination and servicing workflows.

  • Create user flows, information architecture, wireframes, high-fidelity designs, prototypes, reusable patterns, and other artifacts that move concepts from discovery through delivery.

  • Use research, usability testing, concept validation, design systems, and AI-enabled tools to accelerate learning, strengthen decisions, and improve experience quality.

  • Create compelling visual and written narratives that connect customer and employee needs, business strategy, and future-state concepts into a clear end-to-end story.

  • Facilitate workshops, journey mapping sessions, and stakeholder reviews; communicate design rationale and tradeoffs to align leaders and cross-functional partners.

  • Partner closely with Product, Technology, Content Strategy, and business teams throughout the product lifecycle while ensuring solutions meet accessibility, brand, compliance, and governance standards.

Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of Online and Digital Product Design, Information Sciences, Graphic and Visual Arts experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education.

Desired Qualifications

  • Advanced proficiency with Figma, FigJam, prototyping tools, enterprise design systems, component-based frameworks, and AI-assisted design tools such as Figma Make or Copilot.

  • Experience designing complex digital products, enterprise platforms, operational workflows, or customer-facing experiences, including translating complex business processes into intuitive, scalable solutions.

  • Strong portfolio demonstrating end-to-end UX/UI expertise across discovery, interaction design, information architecture, visual design, prototyping, validation, and delivery.

  • Exceptional facilitation, communication, stakeholder management, and influence skills, with the ability to navigate ambiguity and align partners in a large, matrixed organization.

  • Demonstrated ability to tell complete, memorable stories through visual and written forms, supported by professional or personal work such as digital products, video games, novels, financial services, theme parks, entertainment, or other experience-driven environments.

  • Experience partnering with Product, Technology, Content Strategy, and business stakeholders throughout the product development lifecycle.

  • Experience conducting or supporting usability testing, research synthesis, and concept validation while applying accessibility, brand, and enterprise governance standards.

  • Experience with Home Lending, mortgage servicing, loan origination, financial services, regulated industries, or AI-powered, conversational, agentic, and intelligent workflow experiences.

What Will Make You Successful

  • Strategic and hands-on: You connect long-term vision to practical execution and turn complex, ambiguous problems into clear, actionable design direction.

  • Compelling storyteller: You create cohesive visual and written narratives that bring end-to-end customer and employee journeys to life.

  • Customer-centered and outcomes-focused: You balance customer insights and data with usability, accessibility, compliance, innovation, and business objectives.

  • Collaborative and influential: You build trusted cross-functional relationships, facilitate alignment, and move teams toward shared decisions.

  • Curious and forward-looking: You create scalable experience patterns and thoughtfully explore emerging technologies, including AI-enabled experiences.

title: Farmasøyt
description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!

Job Details

Farmasøyt til tilkallingsstilling Boots apotek Nardo

Vi søker nå etter farmasøyt og/eller farmasistudent med ekspedisjonsrett, som ønsker å være en del av teamet vårt. Boots apotek Nardo ligger på Nardocenteret med andre diverse butikker som dagligvare, blomsterbutikk, solsenter m.m. Vi har fokus på god kundeservice og høy faglig kunnskap. Åpningstidene er hverdager kl: 09:00 - 20:00 og lørdager kl: 10:00 - 18:00.

Personalet består av 3 farmasøyter (inkl. apoteker) og 2 apotekteknikere.

Vi søker deg som har et genuint ønske om å jobbe i apotek, som trives i et travelt, men utviklende miljø og er opptatt av gode kundemøter og godt arbeidsmiljø.

Oppstart: Snarest, eller etter nærmere avtale


Arbeidsoppgaver:

• Levere profesjonell veiledning og rådgivning for å sikre trygg bruk av legemidler og andre helseprodukter

• Utføre aktuelle helsetjenester i apotek på en profesjonell og tillitsbyggende måte

• Bruke din kompetanse til å møte kundens behov på en serviceorientert måte.

Kvalifikasjoner:

• Utdanning som reseptarfarmasøyt/Bachelor of Pharmacy eller cand.pharm/Master of Pharmacy.

• Erfaring fra apotek er ønskelig, men ikke et krav – vi verdsetter også nysgjerrige nyutdannede!

• Sterk interesse for farmasi og evnen til å holde deg oppdatert på ny kunnskap innen feltet.

• Gode ferdigheter i norsk, både muntlig og skriftlig, tilsvarende minimum B2-nivå i henhold til Helsedirektoratets anbefalinger.

Personlige egenskaper:

• Du er utadvendt, oppsøkende, og har en naturlig evne til å skape kontakt med mennesker.

• Du er lyttende, empatisk, og i stand til å forstå kundens behov.

• Fleksibel tenkning som gjør at du kan håndtere ulike situasjoner effektivt.

• Har evnen til å samarbeide godt med kolleger og trives med teamarbeid.

Vi kan tilby:

• En dynamisk arbeidsplass hvor kvalitet i kundemøtet står sterkt i fokus.

• Konkurransedyktige betingelser som reflekterer din erfaring og kompetanse.

• Gode muligheter for faglig og personlig utvikling gjennom opplæringstilbud og karrieremuligheter internt i selskapet.

Hvis du ønsker å være en del av et inspirerende team som jobber kontinuerlig for å levere førsteklasses farmasøytisk service, så ser vi frem til å motta din søknad. Bli med oss på vår reise for å bidra til bedre helse – søk nå!


Ved spørsmål om stillingen, kontakt Julie på e-post: juliemarie.lesjo@boots.no eller telefon: 45459933


.

Alliance Healthcare Norge Apotekdrift AS eier og driver over 150 Boots apotek i Norge. Vi har kjedekontor på Økern i Oslo og grossisten Alliance Healthcare Norge AS, med administrasjon og lager på Langhus og lager i Tromsø.
Boots, som har mer enn 160 års erfaring fra internasjonal apotekdrift, åpnet sitt første apotek i Norge i 2008. Selskapet er i dag et av verdens best kjente merkenavn. I samarbeid med forskere og spesialister innen helse og hudpleie, utvikler og produserer Boots flere bestselgende merkevarer for eksempel No7, Soap & Glory og Soltan. Disse distribueres gjennom Boots Apotek i Norge. Boots Apotek/Alliance Healthcare Norge Apotekdrift AS og Alliance Healthcare Norge AS er en del av det internasjonale selskapet Cencora.
Cencora er et ledende, globalt selskap innen farmasøytiske tjenester. Vårt fokus er å forbedre livene til mennesker og dyr over hele verden. Vi samarbeider med farmasøytiske innovatører på tvers av verdikjeden for å lette og optimalisere markedstilgangen til legemiddelbehandling. Vi sørger for sikker og pålitelig leveranse av legemidler, helseprodukter og løsninger. Selskapet har 46 000+ ansatte globalt, som alle bidrar til selskapets formål: Vi står sammen om vårt ansvar for å skape en sunnere fremtid. Cencora er rangert som nr. 11 på Fortune 500 og nr. 24 på Global Fortune 500 med mer enn 200 milliarder USD i årlig omsetning. Les mer om selskapet på www.cencora.com
Vi jobber for å skape en sterk kultur i selskapet der mangfold og inkludering er sentralt i alt vi gjør. Ved å fremme samarbeid og innovasjon får vi inspirasjon til å hjelpe mennesker over hele verden til å få bedret helse og livskvalitet. I vårt selskap skal medarbeiderne ha like muligheter for utvikling og involvering, uansett bakgrunn. Hos oss skal alle føle seg respektert, verdsatt og inspirert til å drive selskapet vårt fremover.

title: Teamleider treinbeveiliging
description:
Jouw impact

Jij geeft richting aan een team van specialisten, laat professionals groeien en werkt samen aan treinbeveiligingsprojecten met maatschappelijke impact.

Dit ga je doen

  • Jij geeft samen met de afdelingsmanager richting aan de ontwikkeling van de afdeling en draagt bij aan de verdere groei van het team.

  • Jij begeleidt een team van professionals en helpt hen het beste uit zichzelf en hun projecten te halen.

  • Jij stuurt op resultaat, capaciteit, kwaliteit en financiën en zorgt voor een gezonde balans tussen projecten, medewerkers en afdelingsdoelstellingen.

Nederland heeft een van de drukste spoorwegnetten van Europa. Binnen de afdeling Treinbeveiligingsinstallaties werken jouw collega’s aan systemen die trein-, tram- en metroverkeer veilig laten rijden. Als teamleider ondersteun je de afdelingsmanager en geef je richting aan de inzet en ontwikkeling van het team. Je verbindt collega’s, stimuleert samenwerking en zorgt dat mensen en middelen goed aansluiten op wat de afdeling nodig heeft. Het teamleidersdeel vraagt gemiddeld 8 tot 12 uur per week; daarnaast werk je zelf mee aan projecten, bijvoorbeeld rond ERTMS, verificatie en validatie of de vernieuwing van bestaande beveiligingsinstallaties.

Dit ben jij

Jij bent verbindend en daadkrachtig en schakelt gemakkelijk tussen mensen, projecten en organisatiebelangen. Je brengt structuur, geeft richting en creëert een werkomgeving waarin onze professionals verantwoordelijkheid nemen en zich blijven ontwikkelen. Daarbij houd je oog voor zowel de resultaten van de afdeling als de ontwikkeling van onze collega's.

Dit breng je ook mee:

  • je hebt een afgeronde hbo- of wo-opleiding in een technische richting, bijvoorbeeld Elektrotechniek, Technische Informatica of vergelijkbaar;

  • je hebt ervaring binnen treinbeveiliging, spoorwegbeveiliging, ERTMS of vergelijkbare veiligheidskritische systemen;

  • je haalt energie uit het begeleiden en ontwikkelen van professionals in een technische omgeving.

Binnen Movares kijken we niet alleen naar ervaring, maar ook naar potentieel en ontwikkelmogelijkheden. Met trainingen, coaching en begeleiding helpen we je graag verder groeien. Zo kun jij een move maken die bij jou past.

Bij Movares

Bij Movares werk je aan mooie projecten met maatschappelijke impact. Dat geeft energie en voldoening, iets wat niet in geld is uit te drukken.

Je draagt bij aan het verschil dat we samen maken voor de openbare ruimte in Nederland door te blijven groeien in je vak én als professional. Daarom krijg je in elke fase van jouw loopbaan de ruimte om jouw ontwikkeling actief vorm te geven, ondersteund door learning on the job, masterclasses en een brede leeromgeving in onze eigen Academy.

Dat is niet alles. We bieden ook goede primaire en secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden. Die zetten we hieronder voor je op een rij:

  • een salaris tussen €5.500,- en €7.500,- op basis van een fulltime dienstverband van 40 uur;

  • de intentie om duurzaam met elkaar samen te werken, met perspectief op een vast dienstverband;

  • een aantrekkelijk pakket van secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden, inclusief fiscaal voordelige regelingen;

  • duurzaam reizen voor je werk met een goede mobiliteitsregeling;

  • goede faciliteiten om je werk te kunnen doen thuis of op kantoor;

  • een moderne pensioenregeling met aandacht voor jouw toekomst;

  • oog voor jouw persoonlijke situatie, met maatwerk in werkplek of begeleiding als dat nodig is.

​En er is méér. Want werken bij Movares betekent ook:

  • vertrouwen en flexibiliteit in hoe en waar je werkt, passend bij jouw team en werkzaamheden;

  • werk dat ertoe doet: je draagt bij aan een duurzamere en schonere leefomgeving, samen met collega’s die dit belangrijk vinden;

  • aandacht voor verbinding en plezier tijdens activiteiten met collega’s, inhoudelijk én informeel.

Jouw team

Je wordt onderdeel van de afdeling Treinbeveiligingsinstallaties binnen de marktunit Rail. Hier werken technische collega’s aan treinbeveiligingssystemen voor trein-, tram- en metroverkeer. De afdeling is betrokken bij de volledige levenscyclus van deze systemen: van verkennende studies en ontwerp tot realisatie, testen en onderhoud. Ook werk je mee aan de overgang naar digitale technieken zoals ERTMS.

Binnen jouw team draait het om vakmanschap, veiligheid en leren van elkaar. Je werkt met collega’s die technische diepgang combineren met nuchterheid en betrokkenheid. Als teamleider help jij hen om hun kennis verder te ontwikkelen, keuzes te maken in projecten en samen vooruit te kijken naar de toekomst van spoorwegbeveiliging.

.

title: Ocean Freight Douane Supervisor
description:
DHL Global Forwarding maakt deel uit van DHL Group en is de wereldwijde specialist in het vervoeren van goederen via lucht-, zee- en wegvervoer. Van dagelijkse producten zoals kleding en elektronica tot grotere zendingen zoals machines en medische benodigdheden, wij zorgen ervoor dat alles op tijd en veilig op de juiste plek aankomt, waar ook ter wereld.
Voor onze vestiging in Antwerpen zijn we op zoek naar een nieuwe collega die samen met ons het verschil wil maken in de wereld van logistiek. Ben jij klaar om deel uit te maken van ons enthousiaste team?

Jouw taken en verantwoordelijkheden

  • Je coördineert de orders, klanten en taken binnen het team, zodanig dat de douaneformaliteiten correct worden doorgevoerd;
  • Je handelt douaneformaliteiten correct en tijdig af en verricht administratieve werkzaamheden binnen de gestelde termijnen;
  • Je informeert op deskundige wijze klanten en medewerkers over douane aangelegenheden;
  • Je stuurt een team aan en beheert de verlofplanning ervan.

Jouw profiel

  • Je hebt reeds enkele jaren ervaring in een declaranten positie en hebt praktische kennis van zowel ocean freight import als export;
  • Je hebt oog voor detail en bent een pro-actieve, probleemoplossende en ondernemende teamplayer met een goeie dosis leergierigheid en enthousiasme;
  • Je hebt een gedreven zin voor organisatie van het werk. Inzicht in het optimaliseren van systemen, processen en procedures is een plus;
  • Je bent flexibel, stressbestendig en communicatief vaardig;
  • Je beschikt over een goede taalbeheersing (Nederlands, Engels).

Ons aanbod

  • Een contract van onbepaalde duur met een marktconform loon, een mooi pakket extra-legale voordelen en een aantrekkelijke verlofregeling
  • 39 uren week met de mogelijkheid tot telewerk na een inwerkperiode
  • Een ruim opleidingsaanbod
  • Interessante carrièremogelijkheden binnen een groot bedrijf met hechte familiale waarden en een professionele werkomgeving

Sollicitatieproces

  1. Na het invullen van het online sollicitatieformulier, contacteren we jou voor een eerste telefonische kennismaking.
  2. Als het telefonisch gesprek goed is verlopen nodigen we je uit voor een gesprek ter plaatse met de leidinggevende voor de functie.
  3. Als de klik er is langs beide kanten, doen we je een loonsvoorstel.
  4. Goed nieuws! Je wilt starten bij ons bedrijf. Je komt je contract tekenen en we bereiden je opstart en onboarding voor.

Voor verdere vragen kun je ons altijd contacteren via jobs.globalforwarding@dhl.com .

title: Commercial Escrow Officer
description:
FNF® is the leading provider of title insurance and settlement services to the real estate and mortgage industries. FNF®'s various mortgage and real estate services companies provide services that complement our title insurance business. From a full-service qualified intermediary, home warranties, UCC insurance, relocation services, and notary services, we provide essential services to fulfill the needs of a changing real estate industry. FNF® believes the power of technology can elevate the real estate transaction. From investments in title and escrow software to industry-leading real estate partner solutions, we take our commitment to provide real estate professionals and consumers with a truly reimagined, transparent, connected, and trusted real estate experience to heart.

Fidelity Title National Commercial Services seeks a Commercial Escrow Officer to join our team of real estate professionals in their Michigan NCS operation. This Escrow officer will oversee the closing and disbursement of high liability commercial real estate transactions. They work with multiple internal teams as well as our direct customers and consumers to get deals closed and funded. This position can be full-time or contract.

Responsibilities

  • Review documents and closing instructions submitted by attorneys and lenders for compliance and requirements to close

  • Communicate requirements and give status updates to all parties in the transaction whether those parties are in person or remotely attending the closing

  • Finalize settlement statements and distribute to appropriate parties

  • Create transaction documents as required based on the requirements, instructions and details of each transaction

  • Obtain signatures and notarize documents

  • Work with title and underwriting to clear title exceptions

  • Receive, disburse and obtaining funding approval for escrow closings

  • Timely submission of accurate documents for recording

Knowledge, Skills and Technology Used

  • Strong customer focus

  • Ability to work with others as part of a team

  • Excellent verbal and written communication

  • Attention to detail

  • Problem solving

  • Familiarity of the concepts, terms, procedures and practices of real estate closings in Illinois

  • SoftPro Select software

Typical Range of Experience

  • 4+ years’ experience in title insurance or a related field involving real estate closings

  • Escrow closing experience required

  • Commercial transaction experience preferred

  • SoftPro Select software experience preferred

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

FNF, its affiliates, and subsidiaries carefully considers multiple factors to determine compensation, including a candidate's education, training, specialty, experience, and work location. The base salary (exempt) or hourly rate (non-exempt) is just one component of the total rewards package offered to our employees, including potential bonus or commission eligibility, insurance (medical/dental/vision/life/disability), matching 401(k) plan and matching employee stock purchase plan.

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY POLICY


FNF, its affiliates and subsidiaries, is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, age, disability, protected veteran status, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression (including transgender status), genetic information or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

title: Project Engineer
description:
Discover your exciting role

Our people are our success. At Exyte, you will be part of a global community of challenge seekers who are ambitious and passionate about innovation. title: Network Operator
location: South West & M5 Corridor Sydney NSW
description:
12-month casual position, based in Sydney.

This role requires full availability, including weekends and public holidays, as the roads we manage operate 24/7.

About the role

We’re seeking for a casual Network Operator to work in our busy control rooms, redirect traffic flow, coordinate response teams, and relay critical info to keep our roads safe, all while remaining naturally composed and alert at all times.

You’ll join an innovative team, who tirelessly monitor the flow of the traffic with an eagle eye and respond with lightning speed in the event of incidents, both big and small.

Day-to-day, you will:

  • Work with different control systems to monitor and manage traffic on both open roads and in tunnels

  • Automated Height Detectors, Road Management systems, CCTV , Automatic Incident Detection Systems – these are just some of the things you will get to know like the back of your hand

  • Work collaboratively with field staff, Emergency Service and your team, you will act swiftly to respond to incidents to contain the event and keep everyone safe

  • Incident Management and Traffic Management plans will become second nature to you, you will create these with ease to ensure our roads run more efficiently and safely when things don’t go to plan

  • Collate real time info on road conditions for our stakeholders, the media and our customers, so there are no surprises when they use our roads

  • Understand the importance of rigorous knowledge of traffic management policies, practices and procedures, including operational systems.

This role will suit someone with a curious mind and transferrable skills and experiences, including:

  • Experience in a monitoring centre or operational environment

  • Computer smart and analytical, you’re fascinated with new technology and systems - you like to jump in the deep end

  • Organised, efficient and decisive in in prioritising the tasks that count, all while juggling multiple tasks

  • Experienced in writing reports and you know which important details to include so the operation runs smoothly

  • Shift work’s your thing, you’ve done it before and you like it – our roads are open 24/7.

If you meet some of these requirements, but not all, we encourage you to submit your application.

We offer a range of flexible working and leave options, so you can balance your work and life commitments and interests. Have a conversation with us about how this could work for you.

title: Senior Contract Analyst
description:
Our vision is to transform how the world uses information to enrich life for all.

Join an inclusive team passionate about one thing: using their expertise in the relentless pursuit of innovation for customers and partners. The solutions we build help make everything from virtual reality experiences to breakthroughs in neural networks possible. We do it all while committing to integrity, sustainability, and giving back to our communities. Because doing so can fuel the very innovation we are pursuing.

Job Description

RESPONSIBILITIES AND TASKS

  • Contract Management, including drafting, reviewing, and negotiating contracts with clients, subcontractors, and suppliers, and ensuring compliance with contractual terms and conditions.
  • Identify and mitigate contractual risks while safeguarding the firm’s interests.
  • Allocating resources effectively and ensuring high performance across contract administration and tendering functions.
  • Assuring construction projects meet agreed legal, regulatory and company standards
  • Manage record keeping for all contract-related correspondence and documentation
  • Manage claims, variations, and dispute resolution processes.
  • Establish and maintain supplier relationships by serving as a single point of contact for contractual matters
  • Attending site meetings to monitor progress, acting as the main point of contact for site and project managers
  • Working with third parties to ensure that everyone understands their roles and responsibilities
  • Liaising with technical and financial staff, sub-contractors, legal teams and the client’s own representatives
  • Managing construction schedules and dealing with any unexpected costs
  • Monitor and complete contract close-out, extension or renewal, as appropriate
  • Provide contract-related issue resolution, both internally and externally
  • Communicate contract-related information and provide advice to relevant stakeholders
  • Assist with tenders and commercial bids on behalf of Micron
  • Integrates AI-assisted tools and insights into daily work to improve efficiency, quality, or effectiveness, exercising sound judgment and complying with organizational standards and legal requirements.
  • Contributes to a culture of continuous improvement by identifying, testing, and sharing AI-enabled enhancements within one’s scope of work.

EDUCATION

  • Bachelor's Degree or higher
  • Engineering, Supply Chain, Business or Legal Related Degrees, preferred

EXPERIENCE

  • Ability to work with minimal supervision, strong project management skills
  • Demonstrated negotiation and problem-solving skills
  • Skilled in written communication
  • Proficient in drafting documents with clear articulation.
  • Strong contract modelling software skills with contract management, procurement or legal experience
  • Able to communicate clearly and effectively with stakeholders
  • Robust skills in Microsoft Office software, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access, Project and Visio
  • Ability to meet project objectives within designated constraints

WORKPLACE

  • Travel Required - Yes
  • You may be assigned to manage/support projects in Taiwan, Japan, China, Singapore or Malaysia
  • If assigned, you may be required to travel to those countries.

title: Senior Data Analyst
description:
Starship Technologies is revolutionizing deliveries with autonomous robots. These robots are designed to deliver food, groceries, and packages across neighborhoods in minutes. Starship has now completed millions of autonomous deliveries to date, traveled millions of miles, and is currently doing more than 140k road crossings each day. Our contribution to society includes reducing congestion and pollution, providing zero-emissions deliveries, increasing the quality of life for residents, empowering seniors and disabled people, and enabling affordable delivery for local businesses.

We are growing fast, and we are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join the team.

You will be a key strategic partner to our Commercial and Operational leaders, building the logic that proves the value of our technology and secures both our next level of commercial success and our ability to scale operations to match.

What the job is all about:

The boring part is done. Our data is accessible, the BI layer is solid, and most numbers already exist somewhere. You will not spend your first year digging yourself out of a data hole. What we don't have is enough hands to cover it all as deeply as we'd like. Your work splits in two:

Impacting company strategy - finding answers to questions nobody can answer yet. Should we scale? Where should we scale? At what unit economics? Why does one town work while the next one doesn't? These are “why?” and “what if?” questions, and they make up most of this role.

Freeing up time for the complex questions - making sure we don't have to answer the same questions over and over again. The knowledge mostly exists already, scattered across dashboards and people's heads. Your job is to pull it into the open so that people can answer the easy questions themselves and you can get to the more interesting ones.

Your main responsibilities are:

This role covers two domains that meet in the middle. The Commercial team asks where to expand and once we’re there, how to make it successful. Field Operations asks how we can run it well.

On the commercial side:

  • Find the root causes behind business trends to solve complex commercial problems and maximise volume. For example, why the order conversion rate dropped 20% at a site. High ETAs, payment gateway failures, dynamic pricing, school holidays, or an alien invasion?

  • Back our expansion decisions with evidence. Which grocery stores or restaurants in which towns should we go to next, weighing cost, drivability, routing efficiency, demographics, and store popularity. Should we prefer big cities or small towns?

  • Empower Commercial leaders by replacing static reports with dynamic tools, such as always-up-to-date partner dossiers, so the team negotiates with evidence rather than opinions.

On the operational side:

  • Be the analytical partner to Field Operations. Their days are full of concrete problems: robots idle in one hub while another misses deliveries, broken bots waiting for pickup, spare parts running out, fixes taking too long, spillages, etc. Your job is not to answer each one, but to help them frame the problem, put a number on it, set a target worth hitting, and check whether the fix worked. Most of these come back monthly with a different site attached, so building the logic once beats answering it eleven times.

  • Zoom out. Operations is, well, operational. Someone needs to step back and say what the biggest opportunities actually are - whether that is partner satisfaction, customer experience, cost per delivery, or revenue per robot - rather than waiting to be asked. That someone is you.

What’s in it for you?

  • A team worth joining. Small, senior, and self-aware. We ask for feedback, we take it, and we take pride in getting a lot done with limited resources, tackling problems nobody has solved before.

  • Real access, real influence. You will work with people at every level, from specialists to senior leadership across Commercial, Operations, Engineering and Product, as a partner rather than a service desk. Your analysis drives our decisions: whether we scale a market, where we go next, what we fix first. When the answer goes into a partner negotiation or a board discussion, you are the one who helps make sure it holds.

  • You are not starting from scratch. The platform is established: dbt, Databricks, semantic layer, Claude wired into our data stack, and pipelines that work. You inherit a foundation and build on top of it rather than rebuilding it.

  • The questions are unusually good. Because the product is physical and the business is multi-sided, an average question here needs several worlds joined together. Working out whether a town is worth entering means combining robot telemetry, partner order data, walking distances and terrain, human courier ETAs, and demographics. Working out why ETAs are drifting means separating autonomous driving behaviour from operational realities and weather conditions. There is no textbook and no playbook. You will connect datasets that were never designed to meet.

  • Room to grow. We are a fast-growing company where your contribution is visible, and there is plenty of room to grow - by deepening your expertise, taking on bigger challenges, or moving into new areas.

  • Flexible ways of working. The opportunity to work remotely or from our hub in Espoo, depending on your preference.

What we hope you’ll bring to the table:

  • Solid experience in an analytical role, with a track record of business, growth or product analysis rather than reporting: Data, Business, BI, Growth or Product Analyst, Data Scientist, Solutions Engineer or similar.

  • Strong SQL skills, working with complex datasets.

  • Experience driving complex topics end-to-end, from a rough idea to a proposed plan, to executing the solution, and presenting it so that it is understandable and useful to everyone.

  • Pragmatic can-do mindset. You focus on impact rather than the beauty of the method, and decide pragmatically when a spreadsheet is enough and when the answer is a dashboard, a pipeline or an ML model.

  • The ability to get your point across to anyone, whether it is the Autonomous Driving team, the Commercial team or senior management.

  • Judgement about what matters. You can tell urgent apart from important apart from impactful, and you know the most urgent thing is usually neither of the other two.

  • Fluent English, written and spoken.

  • Beneficial: dbt, Databricks, Python or R, and experience with semantic or metric layers.

Want to learn more about our robots and our people? Get in touch and let’s have a chat!

title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Loviisa
description:
Etsitkö sinä ihmisläheistä työtä, jossa pääset tärkeäksi osaksi toisen ihmisen arkea? Henkilökohtaisena avustajana pääset tukemaan asiakasta niissä tilanteissa, joissa hän tarvitsee toisen ihmisen apua esimerkiksi liikkumisessa, kodin askareissa tai vapaa-ajan toiminnassa. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan tarkoitus on tukea asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta ja mahdollisuutta elää omannäköistä elämää.

Henkilökohtaisen avustajan työ on maanläheistä ja tilanteisiin mukautuvaa. Päivät voivat vaihdella paljon, ja tehtävät suunnitellaan aina asiakkaan tarpeiden mukaan. Aiempaa kokemusta tehtävästä ei tarvita, sillä perehdytämme sinut työhön. Olemme työnantajana aina helposti tavoitettavissa ja tukenasi, jotta työ sujuu turvallisesti ja luontevasti.

Meille on tärkeää, että työ sopii yhtä hyvin avustajalle kuin avustaja asiakkaalle. Työvuorot suunnitellaan yhteisymmärryksessä, jotta arki pysyy kaikille toimivana ja selkeänä.

Etsimme nyt osa-aikaista henkilökohtaista avustajaa asiakkaallemme Loviisaan. Asiakas on nainen, joka tarvitsee apua vapaa ajalla. Avustajan on oltava vastuuntuntoinen ja luotettava.
Työtunteja on 10 tuntia/kuukausi ja työaika tulee olemaan yleensä 1-2 kertaa viikossa.

Työhön valitulta henkilöltä vaaditaan rikostaustaselvitys vammaisten henkilöiden kanssa työskentelyä varten (Laki sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta).

Toivomme, että olet:
- Oma-aloitteinen
- Luotettava
- Empaattinen

Työ alkaa mahdollisimman pian tai sopimuksen mukaan. Aloitamme haastattelut ennen hakuajan päättymistä ja tehtävä täytetään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Elämäsi Adato – Sinun elämäsi, sinä päätät
Elämäsi Adato Oy on suomalainen perheyritys, joka on täysin erikoistunut henkilökohtaisen avun järjestämiseen jo yli 15 vuoden ajan. Tavoitteenamme on auttaa jokaista asiakasta toimimaan arjen tilanteissa turvallisesti ja omien toiveidensa mukaisesti, niin että itsemääräämisoikeus säilyy kaikissa päivän kulkuun liittyvissä asioissa.

Haluamme olla asiakkaillemme luotettava kumppani heidän jokapäiväisessä elämässään ja työntekijöillemme välittävä ja joustava työnantaja. Meillä työskentely on konkreettista, ihmisläheistä ja merkityksellistä.

Työllistämme yli 300 henkilökohtaista avustajaa eri puolilla Suomea. Kasvamme vastuullisesti, ihmisten tarpeita kuunnellen.

title: Cluster Head - Dehradun
description:
About Stable Money
Stable Money is India’s leading fixed investment platform. It is a marketplace which helps customers discover and invest in high-quality fixed-income products such as Fixed Deposits (FDs), RD, Bonds, Credit Cards, Mutual Funds from trusted institutions. Stable Money has 30 lac+ trusted investors, 2000cr+ bookings since inception and is backed by marquee investors such as Z47, Lightspeed, Fundamentum, Matrix Partners, RTP Global to name a few.

The role in one line

Own a state. You build, coach and drive a team of 15–20 field RMs who meet customers in person across tier 3–4 cities, acquire and deepen investors, and run on-brand community activations. You are hands-on and on the ground — in societies, at clubhouses, and running events yourself — not a desk manager. Success is measured in retained AUM, RM productivity and a healthy, low-attrition team.

What you’ll do

Lead & grow the RM team

  • Manage 15–20 RMs day to day — run daily standups, weekly 1:1 coaching and fortnightly business reviews.

  • Coach the funnel, don’t just police numbers: diagnose each RM’s weakest link (meetings, pitch, referrals, AUM) and fix it — enable first, ride-along often.

  • Own team health: motivation, engagement, and keeping attrition below plan.

Own state sales & AUM

  • Deliver the state’s targets — new customers, retained AUM, referrals and activations — and the unit economics behind them.

  • Land marquee/anchor customers yourself (respected doctors, business owners, seniors) to unlock societies through social proof.

  • Sell hands-on: carry a bag, do meetings, close on-app in front of the RM — lead from the field.

Drive on-ground activations & events

  • Plan and personally run on-brand activations — Society Financial Health Camps, senior-citizen retirement clinics, festival stalls, wellness/“Little Savers” corners.

  • Build and maintain the state’s registers: major city activities, societies, clubs and malls; secure RWA and venue permissions.

  • Turn events into pipeline: lead capture, 24-hour follow-up, and referral waves.

Hire, onboard & retain

  • Partner with the hiring/vendor engine to source RMs who fit the persona; run final selection and the field bar.

  • Onboard every new RM with the complete day-one pack (territory, 30-day plan, kit, meeting-note discipline).

Quality, compliance & reporting

  • Enforce integrity: no cash, everything on-app, DPDP-safe data, no mis-selling; run QC and mystery-shopping in your state.

  • Keep registers, CRM and kit reconciliation current; report state performance to the central Programme Manager on a fixed cadence.

What success looks like (first 6 months)

Measure

What good looks like

Team live & productive

15–20 RMs deployed, ramped and hitting the meeting + activation floors

Retained AUM

State AUM built and retained to plan (the primary measure)

RM productivity

Median RM output rising month-on-month; top performers well above the floor

Activations

A steady rhythm of on-brand events feeding warm leads

Attrition

90-day survival at or above the 50% plan; a live replacement pipeline

Quality

Clean QC — real customers, no mis-sell, kit fully reconciled

Who we’re looking for

Must-have

  • 3–4 years managing people — has run a team and carried a number through them.

  • Strong sales background — ideally field / feet-on-street in BFSI, fintech, insurance, telecom, FMCG or similar; comfortable selling and closing in person.

  • Hands-on and on-ground — energised by being in the field, in societies and at events, not behind a desk.

  • No problem with travel anywhere — will move across the state as the work demands, at short notice; owns a means of travel and a smartphone.

  • Event organising — has planned and run on-ground activations / camps / community events end to end.

  • Local fluency — speaks the state’s primary language plus working Hindi/English; understands the local affluent market.

  • Data-comfortable — can run a review off a dashboard/CRM and coach to the funnel.

Good to have

  • Experience opening new markets / launching a territory from scratch.

  • Exposure to investments/savings products (FD, bonds, mutual funds) or wealth distribution.

  • Graduate; any stream.

The person

  • High-agency and hands-on — leads from the front and gets things done on the ground.

  • A coach at heart — grows people, not just chases them.

  • High integrity — sets the no-cash, no-mis-sell standard by example.

  • Resilient and mobile — thrives on the road and in ambiguity of a new build.

What we offer

  • Ownership of a state in a fast-scaling offline business, backed by a strong central team and tooling.

  • A build-from-scratch mandate with real autonomy and visible impact on the P&L.

  • Competitive fixed pay commensurate with experience, plus a performance-linked incentive (band finalised at offer).

Our beliefs: We hire for skills and potential. With 80+ nationalities, 45% women, of which 56% of women in our leadership team, diversity isn't a program; It's who we are. We've built a discrimination-free hiring process because the best teams are built on merit.

⭐️ Mission

Join our French AML team to tackle critical transaction monitoring backlogs and protect our business from Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing risks. You will work closely with your manager Amilcar, to refine our controls and shape a secure environment for our customers.

• Investigate complex alerts: Handle transaction monitoring and suspicious activity reports (processing around 25 alerts per day) with a high degree of autonomy.

• Drive continuous improvement: Autonomously challenge existing processes, identify gaps, and manage projects to improve our daily operational efficiency.

🤔 What you can expect:

• Market/Team Context: A fast-paced, hyper-growth environment where you will tackle a critical backlog on the French market alongside a wider European team of 40+ AML Officers.
• Methodologies, how we work, and what we value: A strong Lean and continuous improvement mindset where you are expected to autonomously challenge the status quo and improve processes.
• Exciting career opportunities: Real internal mobility prospects and a clear path for growth fueled by our upcoming banking license.
• Responsibilities and decision-making: The autonomy to handle complex cases involving tax returns, sanctions, and embargoes, actively mitigating risks for the company.


🏅 About You:

• Experience: You have 1 to 3 years of experience in transaction monitoring and AML/CFT, preferably in a traditional bank or a Fintech.
• Technical Expertise: You have a deep understanding of terrorism financing, sanctions, and embargoes, ideally with accounting knowledge
• Continuous Improvement Mindset: You are not just executing tasks; you know how to autonomously identify bottlenecks, challenge processes, and manage continuous improvement projects.
• Mentorship & Communication: You are comfortable sharing your knowledge to coach colleagues and interacting professionally with auditors and regulators.
• Languages: You are fluent in both French and English to communicate effectively with our international teams and local stakeholders.

title: Senior Network Automation Engineer
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Senior Network Automation Engineer based in the United States.

This role offers the opportunity to help enterprise organizations and managed service providers transform the way they operate complex networks through intelligent automation.
You will work directly with customers to uncover high-value automation opportunities and translate operational challenges into scalable technical solutions.
Using network engineering expertise alongside automation capabilities, you will design and implement solutions for troubleshooting, monitoring, incident response, and other critical workflows.
You will also empower customer engineering teams through hands-on training and knowledge transfer, enabling them to continue expanding automation independently.
The position combines technical architecture, network operations, customer engagement, problem-solving, and continuous improvement.
You will collaborate with technology partners and leverage industry knowledge to develop reliable automation content and integrations.
This is an impactful role for an experienced network professional who enjoys solving complex problems and helping organizations modernize their network operations.

Accountabilities

  • Identify high-impact opportunities to automate network operations by analyzing customer ITSM data, operational processes, and recurring incidents.
  • Assess customer network technologies, existing playbooks, design documentation, and operational workflows to determine effective automation strategies.
  • Architect and develop automation solutions using capabilities such as Runbooks, Qapps, Dataviews, integrations, and related automation technologies.
  • Help customers transform critical network operations processes, including diagnostic troubleshooting, incident management, monitoring, and operational workflows.
  • Work directly with customer engineering teams to understand requirements, design appropriate solutions, and ensure successful implementation.
  • Train and mentor customer engineers on network automation practices and platform capabilities so they can independently develop and maintain automation solutions.
  • Contribute to the evolution of network operations automation across enterprise and managed service provider environments.

title: Model Risk Management, Associate, RQA
description:
About this role

Business Overview

The Risk & Quantitative Analysis (RQA) group provides independent oversight of BlackRock’s fiduciary and enterprise risks. RQA’s mission is to advance the firm’s risk management practices and deliver independent risk advice and constructive challenge to drive better business and investment outcomes. RQA’s risk managers play a meaningful role in BlackRock’s investment process, using quantitative analysis and a multi-disciplinary skillset to tackle real-world problems and provide tangible solutions in the investment management process.

RQA is committed to investing in our people to promote both individual accomplishment and a strong collaborative environment. As a global group, our goal is to create a culture of inclusion which encourages teamwork, innovation, diversity and the development of future leaders. We actively engage in discussions on career growth and work with team members to understand how personal passions and strengths connect with our purpose.


Model Validation team in Model Risk Management

The Model Validation team is an integral part of the global Model Risk Management Team. The Global Model Risk Management function within the Enterprise Risk team is responsible for developing the firm-wide Model Risk Management framework and the implementation of the framework across BlackRock.

Key responsibility of the Model Validation team is performing independent reviews of models, primarily focusing on the models produced and owned by the Aladdin Financial Engineering (AFE) group. The team works with the model owners and other stakeholders (e.g. model users; governance representatives etc.), design and run independent testing of the models, and provide effective challenge to the model’s methodology and implementation, focusing on the usage cases of the models.

Responsibilities:

  • Evaluate conceptual soundness of models by assessing the model theory (incl. model assumptions, limitations), model construction and model testing in relation to the known model use cases.

  • Review adequacy of testing performed by model owners and design and execute efficient independent model testing both standardized and tailored to specifics of the model’s type, implementation and usage.

  • Document validation approach, observations, findings and conclusions in comprehensive validation reports.

  • Communicate results of model validation tests and observations within the team and to relevant stakeholders, where appropriate.

Knowledge/ Experience / Qualifications:

  • Advanced Degree (BS, MS) in a quantitative discipline, with strong Mathematics, Statistics and Analytical skills.

  • 4-7 years of experience in quantitative model development or validation in the areas is an advantage, in particular, practical knowledge in one of following types of models: derivatives analytics; structured products analytics; portfolio risk factor models; private/alt asset class modelling; liquidity modelling.

  • Strong technical background and practical application of one (or more) of programming languages is required (for example: Python; R; C++; Java; SQL; Hadoop; Linux applications; Advanced Excel modelling / VBA etc.). Experience in using AI for analytical work is an advantage.

  • Broad market and finance knowledge in certain asset class areas is an advantage (for example: Equity; FI; Beta; Derivatives; A(M)BS; Credit; Private; LDI; other).

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including ability to explain sophisticated technical concepts in clear way is required.

  • Detail oriented paying attention to details.

  • Enthusiasm and energy combined with a clear sense of how to “make it happen” through teamwork, engagement and commitment.

  • Fluent in spoken and written English.

Our benefits

To help you stay energized, engaged and inspired, we offer a wide range of benefits including a strong retirement plan, tuition reimbursement, comprehensive healthcare, support for working parents and Flexible Time Off (FTO) so you can relax, recharge and be there for the people you care about.

Our hybrid work model

BlackRock’s hybrid work model is designed to enable a culture of collaboration and apprenticeship that enriches the experience of our employees, while supporting flexibility for all. Employees are currently required to work at least 4 days in the office per week, with the flexibility to work from home 1 day a week. Some business groups may require more time in the office due to their roles and responsibilities. We remain focused on increasing the impactful moments that arise when we work together in person – aligned with our commitment to performance and innovation. As a new joiner, you can count on this hybrid model to accelerate your learning and onboarding experience here at BlackRock.


Guidance on AI use for candidates


At BlackRock, AI has long been part of how we work – enhancing decision-making, improving operations, and helping us deliver better outcomes for clients. We encourage candidates to use AI thoughtfully to learn, prepare, and work more effectively; but during our interview process, we want to focus on getting to know you through your own experiences, thinking, and judgment. To support you, we’ve provided guidance on when and how to use AI during our hiring process so you can approach each step with confidence and showcase your best self.


About BlackRock


At BlackRock, we are all connected by one mission: to help more and more people experience financial well-being. Our clients, and the people they serve, are saving for retirement, paying for their children’s educations, buying homes and starting businesses. Their investments also help to strengthen the global economy: support businesses small and large; finance infrastructure projects that connect and power cities; and facilitate innovations that drive progress.


This mission would not be possible without our smartest investment – the one we make in our employees. It’s why we’re dedicated to creating an environment where our colleagues feel welcomed, valued and supported with networks, benefits and development opportunities to help them thrive.


To learn more about BlackRock, please visit Careers.BlackRock.com. We also encourage you to get to know us on LinkedIn, Instagram, YouTube, X, and TikTok.

BlackRock is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to age, disability, family status, gender identity, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation and other protected attributes at law.

The 10-bed specialty Neuroscience Intensive Care Unit (NSICU) at Akron General houses a team of caregivers who support patients recovering from strokes, neuro traumas and various neuro surgeries. A caregiver in this position works nights from 7:00 p.m. – 7:30 a.m., including every other weekend and 3 holidays per year.

A caregiver who excels in this role will:

  • Assess, plan, implement and evaluate care for a given patient population.

  • Develop and update goals and involve patients and families in developing plans of care.

Preferred qualifications for the ideal future caregiver include:

title: Mejeritrainee, Nr. Vium mejeri,  gul ost
description:
Vil du lære et traditionsrigt håndværk fra bunden? Er du samtidig til IT og avanceret teknologi?

Som mejeritrainee i Arla bliver du ekspert i topmoderne mejeriudstyr og får hjemmebane i hele produktionsprocessen. Du kommer til at arbejde i en stor, international virksomhed, hvor moderne teknologi og kendte mærkevarer bliver en del af din dagligdag. Kickstart din karriere i en global og bæredygtig virksomhed, der bringer sundhed og inspiration ud i verden på naturlig vis, og vær med til at skabe fremtidens mejeri sammen med os.

Fra trainee til mejerist på godt 3 år

Uddannelsen til mejerist er en erhvervsuddannelse, der veksler mellem skoleophold og praktik. Der kommer fart på din hverdag, når du lærer om moderne mejeridrift. Dit uddannelsesforløb varer 3 år og 2 måneder, og du får løn fra første dag. Din elevtid vil veksle mellem skoleophold på Kold College i Odense og praktik på mindst to mejerier.

OBS. Jeg søger kun elever med mulighed for skolestart Januar 2027. Praktikstart muligt fra november.

I praktikken bliver du en del af holdet i produktionen og lærer at fremstille kvalitetsoste fra bunden

  • Du kommer med andre ord i nærkontakt med produkterne og får næse for kvalitet. Samtidig får du får et godt indblik i topmoderne mejeridrift og produktionsprocesser og bliver en del af en strømlinet produktion, hvor lean og optimeringsprojekter er en del af hverdagen
  • Den teoretiske del af uddannelsen består af ca. 59 ugers skoleophold på Kold College, hvor du får venskaber, oplevelser og læring for livet
  • Du lærer bl.a. om produktionsudstyr, produktkvalitet, logistik, miljøstyring, hygiejne, mikrobiologi, fysik og kemi. Uddannelsen afsluttes med en svendeprøve

En uddannelse der åbner døre

Mejeristuddannelsen giver gode jobmuligheder både i og uden for mejeriindustrien. Danske mejerister ligger klart i top inden for deres felt. Klarer du dig godt under din uddannelse, vil der også være gode muligheder for videre ansættelse hos Arla. Her vil vi naturligvis støtte op om din videre faglige udvikling og dygtiggørelse. Du kan også vælge at videreuddanne dig som f.eks. procesteknolog, levnedsmiddelingeniør eller mejeriingeniør.

Om Nr. Vium mejeri

Nr. Vium Mejeri ved Videbæk er et moderne mejeri, der beskæftiger 400 medarbejdere og har en af Danmarks største produktioner af gul ost, du kender måske den lille runde flødehavarti, eller vores gentagne gourmetvinder Gammelknas.

Som mejeritrainee kommer du rundt i hele produktionen og får et indgående kendskab til produktionen af gul ost. Du kommer til at indgå i en vagtplan, hvor der både indgår dags-, natte- og weekendvagter. Nr. Vium Mejeri ansætter 6 nye mejeritrainees om året.

Hvem er du?

For at blive mejeritrainee forventer vi, at du har bestået folkeskolens afgangsprøve og har interesse for naturvidenskabelige fag som matematik, fysik og kemi. Vi leder efter en person, der tager ansvar, trives i et team og har lyst til at lære et håndværk, der kombinerer tradition, teknologi og kvalitet.


Ansøgning og kontakt

Hvis denne stilling lyder som noget for dig, bedes du sende din ansøgning hurtigst muligt og gerne inden 21 sept, via nedenstående link, samtaler vil blive afholdt løbende dog senest slut oktober. Stillingsopslaget bliver taget ned, så snart de rigtige kandidater er fundet.

Har du spørgsmål, er du velkommen til at kontakte teamleder Ulla Funch på 91315623 mellem kl 6-14 eller på ulesk@arlafoods.com.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

title: Publishing Product Director
description:
As Publishing Product Director, you are the creative custodian of one of Crytek’s games, embedded inside the game team, accountable for protecting the creative vision and translating the promise of the game into work that the publishing team can execute with conviction. The success of a great game depends on the work that surrounds it landing as truthfully as the game itself, and closing that gap is what this role exists to do. You make sure that what reaches players is authentic, aspirational, tells the story the game deserves, and delights the players who play it.

The game in your remit is an unannounced project in the Crytek portfolio. The work focuses on shaping the project’s player promise from the inside out, defining the publishing narrative for its eventual reveal, and carrying its creative vision through to launch and into ongoing releases.

You sit inside the game team, working shoulder-to-shoulder with game leadership every day. You partner directly with the Chief Publishing Officer and Brand & Marketing Director to support both the game and the business as one connected effort. You are the direct line between the game team and the publishing organization, the person who protects the north star on both ends, and the person both sides trust to tell them the truth.

This role demands creative conviction, drive, and the kind of experience that only comes from working shoulder-to-shoulder with game teams. You will protect the team from noise so they can build the game, and you will give the publishing team the clarity, player insight, and creative truth they need to land it well. It is one of the most consequential seats at Crytek, and one of the most rewarding.

What You'll Do

  • Be the custodian of the game’s creative vision, tone, and player promise, and translate it into work that publishing can execute with conviction
  • Sit embedded inside the game team and act as the daily bridge between game leadership and the publishing organisation
  • Serve as the source of truth on what the game is, what is coming next, and what it means for players, across Marketing, Comms, Community, and Commercial
  • Brief and review every major marketing, comms, and community output for creative authenticity, ensuring it tells the right player story
  • Partner with the Chief Publishing Officer and Brand & Marketing Director to shape go-to-market plans that serve the game and the business in equal measure
  • Drive franchise narrative, player promise, and creative direction across reveals, beats, and post-launch moments
  • Protect the game team from operational noise so they can focus on building, while translating publishing priorities into work the team can act on
  • Keep the north star intact on both ends, keeping publishing grounded in the game’s vision, and the game team grounded in player and market reality

What You Bring

  • 8+ years working at the seam between game development and publishing or marketing, with significant time embedded inside game teams
  • Proven ability to translate creative vision into commercial activation without compromising either side, with strong creative judgement and editorial instinct you can defend under pressure
  • Fluency across business models (premium, live service, DLC, F2P) and multi-year roadmap strategy, and how the two shape the player promise
  • Cross-functional leadership and the ability to influence without authority across game and publishing teams
  • Strong player insight, audience segmentation, and community fluency
  • Drive and operating range, comfortable moving from creative critique in the morning to commercial trade-offs in the afternoon
  • Experience supporting or launching at least one major game or live-service title from inside the game team
  • Track record of being trusted by both game leadership and publishing leadership

What you can expect from us

Career Path
Your professional development is important to us, so we have laid out a career plan to help you progress towards your goals and objectives.
Relocation Support
We offer a relocation budget and full coverage of flights to Frankfurt for you and your family.
You can expect extensive assistance with visa, work permits, and communication with authorities during the relocation process, as well as help settling into Germany (e.g. setting up appointments with banks, government agencies, schools, landlords, finding apartments etc.).
Company Apartment
To help you get settled, we provide you with a fully furnished company apartment during your first three months in Frankfurt.
Public Transport Pass
Discover Frankfurt by bus, tram and metro – free of charge.
Gym Card
A healthy body is a healthy mind. We offer a membership at the premium gym chain Fitness First in Germany. Work out, join group fitness classes, or relax in the wellness facilities.
State-of-the-art Office
We’ve recently moved into a brand-new, modern office located in the heart of Frankfurt. Our new workspace is designed to inspire creativity and collaboration, with open areas, quiet zones, and top-tier facilities — all just steps away from public transport, restaurants, bars and cultural hotspots.
Hybrid Working
We believe in the value of in-person collaboration while also supporting flexibility. Our hybrid working model includes three days per week in the office and the option to work remotely up to two days per week, unless role-specific requirements or business needs require you to be on site.
Equal Opportunity & Inclusion
We’re building a workplace where everyone belongs. We welcome people of all backgrounds and identities and are proud to be a truly global team, with employees from over 42 countries contributing their ideas, cultures, and perspectives every day.
German Classes
Understanding the local culture will make your stay abroad more enjoyable, and Crytek supports that by offering German language courses for you and your family.
Events
Join us on our exciting company events, including new starter breakfasts, summer and winter parties, our annual trip to Gamescom in Cologne, and many more!
Vacation Days
At our Frankfurt office you can enjoy 24 days of vacation per year, and every 2 years you get 1 more (up to a maximum of 28 days). You will also have on average 10 public holidays on top of the days you take off.

title: Supervisor Manchester City F.C. - Stadium store
description:
The Job

With an exciting store expansion on the horizon, we're looking for three passionate Supervisors who are ready to lead from the front and help create an unforgettable shopping experience for every fan who walks through our doors.
As a Supervisor, you'll play a key role in bringing the energy of the game to life on the shop floor. You'll lead and inspire the team during your shifts, champion outstanding customer service, drive sales performance, and ensure the store is always fully stocked, well presented, and ready to welcome supporters. Working closely with the management team, you'll help create a positive, high-performing environment where both customers and colleagues thrive.
We're looking for someone with previous retail or supervisory experience, strong leadership skills, and a genuine passion for football and retail. If you're an energetic team player who loves motivating others, taking ownership, and making an impact, this is your chance to be part of an exciting new opening from day one and help shape its success.

Your Mission

  • Assisting in optimizing Customer Lead opportunities through strategic (personnel) planning in conjunction with the Retail Manager and Deputy Manager;
  • Ensuring set KPI’s, seasonal and yearly budget objectives are met;
  • Supporting in managing the Store’s embellishment, Click & Collects, Customer complaints and Cash control;
  • Supporting the financial operations of the Store through successful management of controllable costs;
  • Upholding the Company, Team/League values and standards;
  • Ensuring Visual Merchandising and Operational Store standards are consistently met;
  • Creating a rewarding and collaborative work environment in which employees are encouraged to grow;
  • Recruiting a qualified team of customer service assistants;
  • Ensuring all training is conducted on a timely basis, ensuring assigned mentors engage with new hires;
  • Providing feedback to store assistants in all areas of the business;
  • Performing ‘Manager on Duty responsibilities’;
  • Other occurring relevant activities and/or projects.

Your Talent

  • You bring a retail, hospitality or assisted sales experience (1–3 years), ideally in sportswear, footwear, or football-related products;
  • A winning mindset – you’re goal-oriented, thrive under pressure, and celebrate every sales victory like a match-day win;
  • A hands-on leader who energizes the team and leads by example on the shop floor;
  • Confident and proactive, with a sharp eye for commercial opportunities and a passion for delivering standout customer experiences;
  • A natural communicator who builds trust and team spirit with both customers and colleagues;
  • Excellent communication skills (Excellent standard of English speaking);
  • Football enthusiast – you speak the language of the game and stay up to date with the latest gear, trends, and fan culture;
  • Ambitious and positive, with a clear drive to grow take on more responsibility.

To apply for this role, you must already have the legal right to work in the UK. We will not apply for work or residence permits.

We Offer

• The role includes weekday and weekend shifts, flexibility on working hours is essential;
• This role offers a competitive base salary, reflecting your experience and contribution to the success of our store;
• Regular incentives, team socials, and recognition awards to celebrate your contributions;
• Tailored training programs designed to support your growth;
• Supportive, fun, and high-performing team culture that makes work rewarding.

About Us

We like to think of ourselves as a family of experts.

Ok, we know what you’re thinking: at over 700 members, that’s a pretty big family. But what we really mean is that, whatever our skills or our story, whatever the task or the time pressure, we’re in it together. Pushing each other, backing each other and believing in each other, always.

We’re one STICHD. And that matters, because this one company does a lot.

We partner with some of the world’s most iconic brands to create products that people love. From socks and underwear to swim and fanwear. From PUMA and Levi’s to Formula 1 and Manchester City. From design and logistics to retail and events. From our HQ in the Netherlands to sales offices and logistics centres all over the world. Like we said: a lot.

Why join us?

Because at STICHD, you get the best of both worlds. The buzz and exposure of working on a global scale with the world’s biggest brands. The freedom and flexibility to find your own passion and follow your own path. But most of all, because we care. We really care. About our brands and products. About each package and every fan’s experience. About one another.

We have some amazing people at STICHD. People with different backgrounds and skillsets, perspectives and personalities. Global leaders in their field who always stay curious, grounded and never stop learning.

Does this sound like it could be you? Click ‘apply’ and show us what you’ve got!

AQCUISITION AS A RESULT OF VACANIES IS NOT APPRECIATED

Equality for all is one of the core principles at STICHD and PUMA, and we do not tolerate any form of harassment or discrimination.

title: Senior Director, Revenue Enablement
description:

title: Social- og sundhedshjælper med hjerte for nærvær søges til aftenvagt
description:
Vil du gøre en forskel for ældre borgere og skabe tryghed om aftenen ?

Altiden Fribo Holte – beboernes hjem

At hver enkelt beboer føler nærvær og føler sig set, er vores højeste prioritet. Derfor har vi et særligt fokus på, at beboerne selv er med til at bestemme, hvordan dagens program ser ud. Vi vægter fællesskabet højt – men på beboernes præmisser. På Altiden Fribo Holte skal man føle sig godt tilpas, så snart man træder ind ad døren – hvad end man bliver mødt af plejepersonalet, ledelsen eller de frivillige.

Læs her interviewet med Britta på 97 år: "Jeg har stadig min egen vilje"

Hos os betyder fællesskab alt. Vi løfter i flok, støtter hinanden og gør hver dag vores bedste for at skabe trygge, gode stunder for de mennesker, der bor her. Som social- og sundhedshjælper bliver du en vigtig del af det – både fagligt og menneskeligt.

Læs mere om Altiden Fribo Holte her

Om stillingen

I aftenvagten får du stor variation i dine sundhedsfaglige opgaver, hvor du understøtter både beboere og kolleger. Hos os betyder tid meget – tid til tryghed, nærvær, praktisk hjælp, individuelt fokus og oplevelser, der gør hverdagen bedre for beboerne.

Du bruger din faglighed aktivt og er opmærksom på beboernes trivsel. Du reagerer hurtigt, hvis der sker ændringer i deres mentale eller fysiske tilstand – og sikrer, at de får den bedst mulige pleje.

Vi forestiller os, at du…

  • er uddannet social- og sundhedshjælper

  • måske er nyuddannet – det er fint, vi sørger for en grundig introduktion

  • trives med helhedspleje og tager ansvar for, at beboerne oplever høj og ensartet kvalitet

Det praktiske

  • Fast aftenvagtstilling på 28 timer i et 5/2 rul, rullet er mandag og tirsdag med weekendvagt i lige uge.

  • Mulighed for privat sundhedssikring for dig (og evt. dine børn)

  • Medarbejderfordele via Visma LogBuy

  • Overenskomst med FOA

Vi tilbyder en fleksibel arbejdsplan, der understøtter en sund balance mellem arbejde og privatliv. Og fordi din trivsel er vigtig for os, følger vi løbende op på den – så vi sammen kan sikre en god balance i din hverdag.

Hvis du vil høre nærmere om stillingen er du meget velkommen til at kontakte afdelingsleder Heidi Haure på telefon 2322 7044 eller Michelle Willems på telefon 5369 7107

Send gerne din ansøgning allerede i dag, da vi løbende inviterer til samtaler.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig.

Altiden er en del af Ambea, Skandinaviens førende leverandør af velfærdsydelser inden for social- og ældreområdet, hvor vi tilbyder ydelser inden for bl.a. plejecentre, botilbud, børne- og ungehjem, støtte i eget hjem samt skole og uddannelse.

Vores vision er at gøre verden lidt bedre ét menneske ad gangen. I det daglige betyder det, at hver enkelt borger – ung som ældre, lever et så godt liv som muligt og mødes med respekt og nærværende omsorg.
