title: Product Owner -Technology -VP
description:
Job Description

Purpose

The purpose of a Product Owner is to maximize the value of the product by defining a clear product vision (are they setting the vision or would this align to ), managing authoring, refining and prioritizing the Product Backlog balancing trade-offs across desirability, viability and feasibility – making sure the right thing is being ‘built’, and prioritising work based on business goals. They act as the primary liaison between stakeholders and delivery teams, ensuring the product meets user/customer needs and delivers optimal value. Product Owners are responsible for developing a roadmap and driving execution of their product area/sub-journey, applying continuous improvement principles and techniques.

Accountabilities

  • Ensure Product Alignment with Business Goals: Ensure that the product & its features are aligned with broader objectives, driving value and contributing to the organization’s overall strategy. Utilisation of market research, analysis of customer feedback and monitoring of industry trends to identify new products, features or enhancements.

  • Communicate Product Vision to Delivery Teams: Clearly articulate the product vision and goals to the delivery teams, ensuring they understand, align and are inspired to deliver the business value and purpose of each feature or user story.

  • Create and Refine User Stories: Write clear, concise user stories with detailed acceptance criteria, refining them as needed to ensure the development team has all the necessary information to implement features successfully.

  • Agile Events: Participate in key Agile events such as sprint planning, daily stand-ups, sprint reviews, and retrospectives to keep the team aligned and focused on delivering the product backlog.

  • Managing the Product Backlog: Responsible for creating, maintaining, and prioritising the product backlog, ensuring the highest value features are delivered first, based on business needs, customer requirements and organisational impacts, balancing risk migration and future proofing against the product strategy.

  • Act as the Voice of the Customer: Continuously gather feedback from customers and end-users to understand their pain points and ensure that the product meets their needs and improves their overall experience.

  • Acceptance Criteria Definition & Management: Review and accept or reject work completed by the development team during sprints, ensuring that all delivered features meet the agreed-upon acceptance criteria and deliver business value.

  • Collaborate with Stakeholders: Work closely with stakeholders (e.g., customers, business leaders, and marketing teams) to gather requirements, define product goals, and ensure that the product vision aligns with business objectives.

  • Monitor Product Performance and Iterate: Regularly assess product performance using KPIs and customer feedback, adjusting the product backlog and roadmap to improve functionality and meet evolving customer needs. Manage on-going readiness and 'run' activities of live products including monitoring, governance and approvals.

  • Risk and Control: Managing risk, including identification of potential risks, development of strategies to resolve or mitigate and escalate as necessary those risks, and alignment between the product management and control functions.

Vice President Expectations

  • To contribute or set strategy, drive requirements and make recommendations for change. Plan resources, budgets, and policies; manage and maintain policies/ processes; deliver continuous improvements and escalate breaches of policies/procedures..

  • If managing a team, they define jobs and responsibilities, planning for the department’s future needs and operations, counselling employees on performance and contributing to employee pay decisions/changes. They may also lead a number of specialists to influence the operations of a department, in alignment with strategic as well as tactical priorities, while balancing short and long term goals and ensuring that budgets and schedules meet corporate requirements..

  • If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others..

  • OR for an individual contributor, they will be a subject matter expert within own discipline and will guide technical direction. They will lead collaborative, multi-year assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will train, guide and coach less experienced specialists and provide information affecting long term profits, organisational risks and strategic decisions..

  • Advise key stakeholders, including functional leadership teams and senior management on functional and cross functional areas of impact and alignment.

  • Manage and mitigate risks through assessment, in support of the control and governance agenda.

  • Demonstrate leadership and accountability for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work your team does.

  • Demonstrate comprehensive understanding of the organisation functions to contribute to achieving the goals of the business.

  • Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategies.

  • Create solutions based on sophisticated analytical thought comparing and selecting complex alternatives. In-depth analysis with interpretative thinking will be required to define problems and develop innovative solutions.

  • Adopt and include the outcomes of extensive research in problem solving processes.

  • Seek out, build and maintain trusting relationships and partnerships with internal and external stakeholders in order to accomplish key business objectives, using influencing and negotiating skills to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

Join us as a Technical Product Owner. At Barclays, we don’t just adapt to the future, we create it. As a Technical Product Owner, you will support the organisation, achieve its strategic objectives by the identification of business requirements and solutions that address business problems and opportunities.

To be a successful Technical Product Owner you should have experience with:

  • Strong communication and stakeholder‑management skills, able to articulate vision and value clearly.
  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands‑on execution, prioritization, and problem‑solving.
  • Technical understanding of systems, dependencies, architecture constraints, and end‑to‑end flows.
  • Analytical mindset with ability to interpret data and make informed decisions.
  • Customer‑first approach with ability to translate insights into impactful product improvements.
  • Ability to influence, collaborate, and drive alignment across business, technology, and control functions.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field.
  • 16–20 years of experience as a Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role.
  • Hands‑on experience with product management tools (Jira, Trello, ADO).

Additional relevant skills given below are highly valued:

  • Strong hands-on experience with: Java 8/11/17+, Spring Framework, Spring Boot, Spring Cloud, RESTful APIs, Microservices Architecture, Maven / Gradle, Hibernate / JPA
  • API & Integration Technologies
  • Cloud & Container Technologies
  • Database Technologies
  • Devops & CI/CD
  • Architecture & Design
  • Observability & Monitoring
  • Security

You may be assessed on key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as risk and controls, change and transformation, business acumen, strategic thinking and digital and technology, as well as job-specific technical skills.

This role is based in Pune.

  • Ability to manage multiple orders and requests simultaneously without compromising service quality.

  • Familiarity with POS systems and software applications for order processing and reporting

What we offer:

  • Excellent Training and Development opportunities

  • Employee Discount for stays at any Four Seasons worldwide

  • Complimentary Dry Cleaning for Employee Uniforms

  • Complimentary Employee Meals

Schedule & Hours:

  • 48 Hours weekly

  • Work on shift

title: Jeugdbeschermer
description:
Ben jij klaar voor een waardevolle rol in de jeugdbescherming? Wil jij het verschil maken voor gezinnen met kinderen met een (verstandelijke) beperking of chronische ziekte en kinderen van ouders met een beperking? Wij zoeken een gedreven en betrokken jeugdbeschermer om ons team in Groningen te versterken!

Wat ga je doen?
Als jeugdbeschermer bij William Schrikker Jeugdbescherming & Jeugdreclassering heb je een cruciale regierol in het samenwerken met gezinnen, ketenpartners en andere belangrijke stakeholders. In deze betekenisvolle rol houd je in de gaten of de situatie stabiel blijft of verbetert. En als het verslechtert grijp je in, zodat de kinderen altijd zo veilig mogelijk kunnen opgroeien.

  • Begeleiden en regisseren: Je hebt oog voor wat gezinnen nodig hebben, voert stevige gesprekken en biedt duidelijke begeleiding. Complexe problematiek en andere pittige casussen zijn eerder regel dan uitzondering.

  • Balans: Jouw werkweek is balans zoeken tussen fysiek aanwezig zijn bij gezinnen, maar ook het bijwerken van dossiers. Je hebt direct contact met mensen en je zorgt dat alle informatie goed wordt gedocumenteerd voor een vervolg.

  • Samenwerken: Je schakelt veel met collega’s en ketenpartners zoals Gemeenten en andere hulpverleners. Samen zorg je voor een effectieve aanpak en dat iedereen vanuit zijn rol hier optimaal aan bij kan bijdragen.


Hoe ziet het team eruit?
Ons team in Groningen bestaat uit enthousiaste jeugdzorgwerkers en gedragswetenschappers die elke dag met veel betrokkenheid het werk uitvoeren. Geen dag is hetzelfde, en juist dat maakt ons werk zo divers. In ons team krijg je de kans om te groeien. Dankzij onze uitgebreide leerlijn voor nieuwe jeugdzorgwerkers word je goed ingewerkt, met volop ondersteuning van ervaren collega’s. Onze fijne samenwerking, lage verloop en bereidheid om elkaar te helpen, maken ons team uniek.

Wekelijks is het team een halve dag op kantoor voor inhoudelijk overleg. De andere dagen werk je ambulant in de gezinnen, afgewisseld met werken vanuit huis. Wil je de sfeer zelf ervaren? Je bent van harte welkom om een ochtend mee te lopen en ons gezellige en betrokken team te leren kennen.


Hoe starten we samen?
De eerste periode ga je samen met een inwerkmentor uit je team aan de slag. Aan elk team is tevens een praktijkcoach gekoppeld die je inhoudelijk ondersteunt in alle processtappen en reikt je verschillende tools aan om jou in je werk beter te maken. Je wordt goed begeleid en groeit stap voor stap naar een zelfstandige caseload. Je krijgt de tijd om je in te werken en mee te kijken bij collega’s. Na ongeveer 9-12 maanden ben je volwaardig jeugdbeschermer en kun je zelfstandig functioneren.


Wat vragen we van jou?

  • Een afgeronde Bachelor, zoals Social Work, MWD, Pedagogiek;

  • Registratie in het SKJ-register;

  • Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in het werken met gezinnen en/of jeugd (ervaring in een ander werkveld met complexe problematiek is een plus);

  • Energie, lef en doorzettingsvermogen: Je schrikt niet terug voor uitdagende situaties en haalt voldoening uit het behalen van kleine resultaten, zelfs in moeilijke omstandigheden;

  • Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden zowel mondeling als schriftelijk: Je kunt stevige gesprekken voeren, weet op de juiste momenten verbinding te maken en je bent in staat om heldere verzoekschriften en andere documenten te schrijven.


Zoals jij voor de jeugd zorgt, zorgen wij als Partners voor Jeugd voor jou. Daarom krijg je:

  • Een salaris van €3601,- tot € 5410,- o.b.v. 36 uur (conform CAO Jeugdzorg schaal 10);

  • Eindejaarsuitkering, pensioen en een budget voor de inrichting van jouw thuiswerkplek;

  • En nog veel meer: klik hier voor de andere arbeidsvoorwaarden;

  • Toegang tot ons eigen opleidingen- en expertisecentrum Expect Jeugd. Daar volg je bijvoorbeeld de leerlijn jeugdbescherming;

  • Een mentor, een ervaren jeugdbeschermer die je begeleidt


William Schrikker Jeugdbescherming & Jeugdreclassering
William Schrikker Jeugdbescherming & Jeugdreclassering (onderdeel van Partners voor Jeugd) zet zich in voor gezinnen die het op eigen kracht even niet redden. Wij bieden hulp en ondersteuning aan kinderen met een (verstandelijke) beperking of chronische ziekte en kinderen van ouders met een beperking. Bij veel van onze cliënten is er sprake van complexe problematiek. Een beperking is immers levenslang en heeft gevolgen op alle leefgebieden. Het gaat om thuissituaties waar ernstige opvoedproblemen zijn ontstaan. Of waar een jongere in aanraking is gekomen met het jeugdstrafrecht. De hulpvraag en de hulp vereisen maatwerk. Voor elke hulpvraag vanuit de cliënt en gemeenten willen we er zijn als het moet.


Solliciteren of vragen?

Diversity in our teams is an important element to build an effective and challenging working environment. Integrity, Intensity, Innovation and Involvement are key characteristics that we expect of all that are part of our community.

Apply now!

title: School of Engineering - Research Staff (Aquaculture Water Treatment)
description:
[What the role is]

Republic Polytechnic's School of Engineering (SEG), in collaboration with the School of Science (SAS), invites applications for a full-time Research Staff on a 12-month contract to support the DGF-funded project, "Smart Water Treatment in Recirculating Aquaculture Systems (RAS) for Land-based Fish Farms."

This applied R&D project focuses on developing an innovative smart water treatment system to improve water quality, reduce ammonia, pathogens, turbidity, biofilm, and algae, and enhance the sustainability of land-based aquaculture.

The project integrates two proprietary technologies:
• DuoBioSonic – Dual-frequency ultrasonic cavitation for controlling pathogens, algae, biofilm, and turbidity.
• AquAPEX – Multicellular graphite electrolysis for ammonia and nitrogen removal.

The successful candidate will contribute to prototype development, laboratory research, system integration, water quality analysis, field validation at commercial fish farms, and technology commercialisation.

[What you will be working on]

Key Responsibilities:

• Conduct applied research on smart water treatment technologies for recirculating aquaculture systems (RAS).
• Perform laboratory experiments, aquaculture field trials, water quality monitoring, microbiological testing, and data analysis.
• Develop, integrate, and evaluate prototype systems, sensors, and instrumentation.
• Collaborate with industry partners to support technology validation and deployment.
• Supervise final-year project students and interns involved in the project.
• Support intellectual property (IP) development, technology transfer, and commercialisation activities.
• Prepare technical reports, journal publications, presentations, and research grant proposals.
• Manage laboratory equipment & consumables, procurement, safety compliance, and research products.

[What we are looking for]

• Qualification in Environmental Engineering/Science, Water Engineering, Aquaculture Science, Marine/Ocean Engineering/Science, Chemical Engineering, Biotechnology, Applied Chemistry, Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Biomedical Science, Food Science, Systems Engineering, or a related field.
• Interest in water treatment, aquaculture, water quality monitoring, microbiology, and applied research.
• Knowledge of sensors, instrumentation, experimental design, data acquisition, and data analysis is an advantage.
• Experience in laboratory testing, microbiological analysis, aquaculture, or water quality assessment is preferred.
• Self-motivated, hands-on, and able to work independently and in multidisciplinary teams of researchers, engineers, scientists and students.
• Good report/technical writing skills.
• Entry-level candidates are encouraged to apply.

title: Senior Valuation Control Analyst
description:
About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Senior Valuation Control Analyst


In this role, you will:

  • Lead or participate in moderately complex initiatives related to daily profit and loss production, attribution, and commentary for trading and banking desks

  • Review and analyze valuation inputs, trade data, and reconciliation breaks to ensure accurate financial reporting and control

  • Independently resolve moderately complex valuation and reconciliation issues and contribute to control framework enhancements

  • Provide financial insight into profitability, risk-adjusted returns, and capital usage to support business decisions

  • Collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues, and mid-level managers across Finance, Risk, and Front Office to resolve issues and achieve goals

  • Identify and implement process improvements in reporting accuracy, control automation, and data governance and support regulatory reporting processes (e.g., Volcker, etc.) and maintain audit-ready documentation

  • Lead projects, mentor less experienced analysts, and coordinate cross-functional initiatives within the product and valuation control function

  • Expand understanding of systems and data flows across Front Office, Risk, and Finance to provide recommendations to fix issues at source


Required Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of product and valuation control experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education.

Desired Qualifications:

  • Bachelors/MBA in Finance, Accounting, Statistics, Economics or Business or CFA/FRM/CQF
  • Strong experience in one or a combination of the following: Valuations, analytics, financial modeling
  • Prior work experience; knowledge of capital markets products
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Advanced Microsoft Office skills
  • Strong analytical skills.
  • Ability to articulate complex concepts in a clear manner
  • Ability to organize and manage multiple priorities
  • Ability to work effectively in a team environment and across all organizational levels, where flexibility, collaboration, and adaptability are important.
  • Prior working knowledge of one or more of the following: Alteryx, Power BI, Tableau, SQL
  • Experience in trading, valuing or price validating capital market instruments
  • Previous experience with Model Risk Management practices including Model Governance and/or Model Validation
  • The ability to effectively manage multiple projects with challenging timelines
  • Ability to collaborate with internal and external partners
  • Excellent communication skills; ability to clearly communicate with business partners, peers and senior management
  • Strong conceptual and quantitative problem solving skills; ability to provide credible challenge


The role is a derivative valuation specialist responsible for ensuring accurate valuations of and performing validation processes for capital markets products. The team is responsible for the application of consistent price validation
policies throughout the corporate wide derivative and cash population including Equity, Credit, Interest Rate, FX, Commodity and CVA. The position requires an in-depth understanding of valuation techniques, models and valuation inputs. The ideal candidate will possess strong analytical and quantitative skill sets. Individual will be expected to assist with problem identification and solutions, and share best practices. This role will be required to frequently interact with senior management, business unit leaders, and other business partners. The successful candidate will be a highly motivated team player and a self-starter who is accustomed to working in complex organizations, partnering with a diverse group of stakeholders, and achieving results. title: Founding Engineer
description:
Muris is building the AI operating system for agricultural logistics, optimizing the process from field to factory. Our food supply chains are increasingly exposed to fluctuations, caused by factors such as weather, prices, and labor shortages. We are working to make our food supply chains more sustainable, resilient, and future-ready.

You are the first technical hire. Your job is to turn messy operations into a decidable problem and ship the result so that dispatchers actually use it. Everything in between is yours: data, model, system, interface.

What you do

  • Formalize dispatching problems: what is being decided, at what granularity, under which assumptions, against which objectives.
  • Choose the simplest model that carries the decision. Heuristic before solver, solver before learning.
  • Define the evaluation before you build. What would a better decision have been, and how would we know.
  • Ship end-to-end: from the data pipeline through the model to the interface the dispatcher looks at. A recommendation nobody understands doesn't count.
  • Sit at the plant and with the dispatchers to get rules that aren't in the data.

This is not for you if

  • you're looking for a narrowly scoped specialist role
  • you want to solve open research questions
  • you want to fit a given dataset instead of formulating the problem yourself
  • you're not willing to regularly visit factories

This is for you if

  • you've turned messy reality into a decision problem before (OR, dispatch, planning, pricing, allocation)
  • operators have used something you built
  • you're quantitatively strong and still prefer owning the whole over owning the method
  • you can explain models without hiding behind the method
  • you can work with incomplete data and hard constraints

We work in English. German is a big plus. Polish or Ukrainian helps too. We're based in Berlin. The plants are not.

What you get

Real ownership: as the first technical hire you get meaningful VSOP equity. You work directly with the founders, and every week you see whether your decisions hold up at the plant. We are transparent about salary and the full package in the first call.

How we hire

A short call, then a work sample on a real problem from our stock: formalize it, pick the granularity, propose two model classes, argue why the simpler one goes first, define how you evaluate. Then a day with us. References, offer.

You need an existing work permit for Germany.

title: Information Security Officer (ISO)
description:
Cello & Prisma slaan de handen ineen en zoeken samen een Information Security Officer (ISO). Durf jij deze uitdaging aan te gaan?

Als onze ISO ben je de aanjager van informatiebeveiliging binnen Cello en Prisma. Jij zorgt ervoor dat de strategische visie vertaald wordt naar praktisch, bruikbaar beleid op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging. De eisen en wensen van collega’s uit de zorg én onze ondersteunende diensten zijn in dit beleid - voor jou vanzelfsprekend - goed vertegenwoordigd. Ook eisen uit wet- en regelgeving worden niet vergeten. Verder zorg je ervoor dat jaarlijks terugkerende processen als risicomanagement en interne en externe audits op zo’n manier worden uitgevoerd dat ze maximaal waarde toevoegen.

Binnen jouw functie coördineer en adviseer je, gevraagd en ongevraagd. Je coacht collega’s waar dit kan en schrijft mee aan beleid wanneer dit nodig is. Hierdoor wordt het niveau van informatiebeveiliging binnen Cello & Prisma steeds hoger.

Natuurlijk sta je hier niet alleen in. Je wordt bijgestaan door onder andere een CISO, FG en privacy officer bij complexe vraagstukken. Daarnaast maak je deel uit van werkgroepen en stuurgroepen waarin alle geledingen van de organisatie goed vertegenwoordigd zijn. Uitdagingen zijn niet alleen jouw “probleem”, deze lossen we samen op!

Taken & verantwoordelijkheden

  • Aanjager voor informatiebeveiliging die zorgt dat alle collega’s (strategisch, tactisch, operationeel) betrokken zijn, en hun taken en verantwoordelijkheden ten aanzien van informatiebeveiliging begrijpen en (kunnen) uitvoeren;

  • Vertaler van strategische visie naar praktisch beleid;

  • Je zorgt ervoor dat beleid en maatregelen zoveel mogelijk worden uitgewerkt en geborgd binnen de vakgebieden waar ze thuishoren. Je ondersteunt en adviseert collega’s daarbij;

  • Binnen stuurgroepen en werkgroepen bevindingen uit de praktijk terugkoppelen;

  • Beheerder van het managementsysteem van informatiebeveiliging (ISMS), waarbij jij waarborgt dat taken tijdig worden uitgevoerd en beleid en processen blijven voldoen aan wet- en regelgeving, met de NEN 7510 en Cyberbeveiligingswet (CBW) als belangrijke kaders;

  • Waar collega’s vastlopen in hun proces, taken en verantwoordelijkheden ben je bereid te coachen en ondersteunen waar nodig;

  • Op de hoogte van ontwikkelingen in wet- en regelgeving en helpt deze te vertalen naar praktische acties binnen Cello & Prisma;

  • Je werkt nauw samen met de Privacy Officer en zorgt voor samenhang tussen informatiebeveiliging, privacy en risicomanagement;

  • Coördineren van de jaarlijkse risicoanalyses en bewaken van de opvolging van maatregelen;

  • Coördineren en begeleiden van interne en externe audits en bewaken van verbeteracties.

We vragen het volgende van je:

  • HBO/WO denkniveau;

  • je hebt ervaring met normen uit de NEN 7510 en ISO 27000-families, CBW en andere zorggerelateerde wet- en regelgeving (of bent bereid dit te leren);

  • je hebt relevante kennis en ervaring op het gebied van informatiebeveiliging. Certificeringen zoals CISM, CISSP of ISO 27001 Lead Implementer zijn een pré, of je bent bereid een passende certificering te behalen;

  • je bent goed in staat om abstracte strategische doelstellingen te vertalen naar praktische taken die de organisatie begrijpt;

  • de balans tussen pragmatiek, toegevoegde waarde en noodzaak bewaak je goed;

  • je werkt proactief en planmatig binnen een jaarlijkse PDCA-cyclus;

  • je bent communicatief sterk en weet collega’s te enthousiasmeren;

  • je kunt complexe wetgeving en technische eisen omzetten in begrijpbare taal;

  • bij voorkeur heb je ervaring in de zorgsector;

  • bij voorkeur heb je eerder een ISMS geïmplementeerd en onderhouden;

  • bij voorkeur heb je affiniteit met ICT en (zorg)technologie.

Wij bieden:

Naast een dynamische werkomgeving in een energiek team bieden wij jou:

  • Bruto salaris van minimaal €4.077- en maximaal €5.926,- per maand, op basis van een fulltime dienstverband (Schaal 60 CAO GHZ)

  • 8% vakantiegeld;

  • een eindejaarsuitkering van 8,33%;

  • naast je vakantie-uren heb je ook balansverlof en vitaliteitsuren;

  • vergoeding voor reiskosten, sport en een fiets;

  • uitgebreid aanbod aan workshops en ondersteuning om met energie en geïnspireerd aan het werk te blijven.

    Interne kandidaten en mensen met een afstand van tot de arbeidsmarkt (SROI) hebben bij gelijke geschiktheid voorrang. Het overleggen van een VOG is verplicht bij indiensttreding. Acquisitie naar aanleiding van deze vacature wordt niet op prijs gesteld.

title: Senior backend Java developer
description:
Project description

We're looking for a Front End Developer with Angular to design, build, low latency platform with strict reliability and auditability requirements. You'll own end to end delivery—from design to production—collaborating closely with Product, QA, and DevOps.

Responsibilities

  • Design and implement Front-End Angular in Java (preferably Java 17+).
  • Model and optimize User Experience and Data user flow
  • Build resilient, observable services on AWS (ECS/EKS/Lambda, S3, RDS/Aurora, MSK/Kinesis, IAM).
  • Ship with strong CI/CD practices (GitHub Actions) and leverage GitHub Copilot to accelerate high quality delivery.
  • Ensure reliability, scalability, and fault tolerance (circuit breakers, retries, idempotency, backpressure).
  • Implement security and compliance controls (authz/authn, secrets, IAM policies, encryption at rest/in transit).
  • Own production operations: monitoring, troubleshooting, and performance tuning.
  • Contribute to architecture decisions, code reviews, and engineering standards.

SKILLS

Must have

  • 7+ years of professional front-end angular experience with Java (Core Java, Angular).
  • Exposure to Python for tooling and automation.
  • Proven expertise with PostgreSQL: indexing strategies, query tuning (EXPLAIN/ANALYZE), transactions/locking, isolation levels.
  • Hands on AWS experience: deploying and operating production services (at least 3 of ECS/EKS/Lambda, RDS/Aurora, S3, SQS/SNS/MSK/Kinesis, CloudWatch, IAM).
  • Solid API design (REST/gRPC), versioning, pagination, and backward compatibility.
  • Production grade observability (logs, metrics, tracing; OpenTelemetry, Prometheus/Grafana, or similar).
  • CI/CD with GitHub and GitHub Actions (branching strategies, code reviews, trunk based or GitFlow).
  • Practical use of GitHub Copilot (or similar AI coding assistants) to boost productivity while maintaining code quality.
  • Experience building fault tolerant distributed systems (circuit breakers, bulkheads, rate limiting; resilience patterns).
  • Proficiency with containerization (Docker) and infrastructure as code (Terraform/CloudFormation—at least one).
  • Strong understanding of secure coding practices and common vulns (OWASP Top 10).
  • Excellent communication; ability to turn ambiguous requirements into actionable technical plans.

Nice to have

• Experience with Capital Markets, trading, market data, or financial analytics. • Event streaming & messaging: Kafka, MSK, Kinesis, RabbitMQ. • Data modeling for auditable workflows, SLAs, and multi party approval processes. • Experience with multi tenant architectures and row level security. • Knowledge of domain-driven design (DDD) and CQRS patterns. • Experience with performance profiling (JFR, async-profiler) and JVM tuning (GC, heap, thread pools). • Exposure to Python and Node.js for tooling and automation. • Familiarity with feature flags (e.g., LaunchDarkly) and blue/green or canary deployments. • Compliance/controls mindset (audit trails, data lineage, segregation of duties).

The automotive industry is in disruption. As a company, CARIAD is playing a part in multiple large trends at the same time: electrification, automation, and digitalization. title: Senior Application Specialist
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Position Summary

As a Senior Application Specialist at Roche Diagnostics, you will act as a scientific expert driving operational excellence across both Molecular Diagnostics and Core Laboratory divisions (Immunology & Clinical Chemistry). Based in Chandigarh, you will deliver customer support, facilitate assay validations, lead customer training programs, and drive commercial adoption of Roche’s assay portfolio across regional healthcare institutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Technical Problem Solving & Escalation: Investigate and resolve complex technical problems and customer complaints regarding instrumentation, reagent performance, and assay workflows.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Sales Account Managers, Field Technical Support Specialists, and Regional Service Teams to troubleshoot system issues and optimize lab workflows.
  • Method Validation & Correlation: Design, execute, and analyze assay correlation studies and verification/validation protocols alongside customer lab personnel to ensure international quality compliance.
  • Customer Enablement & Training: Develop and deliver end-user training programs on operational protocols, quality control measures, and diagnostic software platforms.
  • Client Engagement & Market Intelligence: Maintain a regular routine of on-site client visits, gathering field intelligence, operational feedback, and clinical insights to inform regional sales strategy.
  • Technical Communication: Participate actively in regional and national conference calls, documenting technical issues, tracking recurring escalations, and sharing best practices.
  • Commercial Assay Promotion: Support regional business development goals by demonstrating scientific menu expansion, workflow efficiency, and clinical utility of Roche assay lines.

Key Requirements

  • Education: Master’s degree or higher in Biotechnology, Life Sciences, Molecular Biology, Biochemistry, or a related discipline.
  • Professional Experience: Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in the In-Vitro Diagnostics (IVD) application sector, with demonstrated proficiency spanning Molecular Biology, Immunology, and Clinical Biochemistry.
  • Language Proficiency: Strong professional working fluency in spoken and written English.
  • Core Competencies: Strong analytical troubleshooting abilities, clear interpersonal communication skills, self-motivation, and a hard-working, customer-centric mindset.

Who we are

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.


Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Strategic Projects Lead - USA
description:
The role

Gridsight’s U.S. business has an ambitious regional growth plan. We are looking for a Strategic Projects Lead to turn the most important regional opportunities and constraints into measurable commercial and customer outcomes.

This is a hands-on regional operating role designed to create leverage for U.S. regional leadership by turning regional priorities into executed outcomes. You will report jointly to U.S. regional leadership, the Head of Sales, the Head of Partnerships and the Head of Delivery, and can be based in San Francisco or Austin. Your portfolio will be set against the U.S. plan: where we need to win, which customers and partners matter, and what must improve across sales and delivery to scale the region.

Your mandate

Own the highest-leverage strategic projects

  • Own a small portfolio of the U.S. region’s most important commercial and customer initiatives, from clearly framed problem to measurable result.
  • Turn regional leadership priorities into clear workstreams, owners, milestones, risks and decision points, then maintain momentum through delivery.
  • Structure ambiguous regional problems from first principles, form hypotheses, find the evidence and implement the answer.
  • Incubate new regional motions, prove them in market and transition them cleanly to the right Sales, Partnerships or Delivery owner.

Advance U.S. commercial and customer outcomes

  • Develop focused plans for priority U.S. segments and lighthouse accounts, grounded in customer evidence and regional economics.
  • Help Sales advance complex enterprise opportunities by resolving cross-functional blockers, strengthening commercial cases and driving clear next steps.
  • Turn partnerships into measurable U.S. market access, credibility, qualified pipeline or delivery capacity.
  • Help priority U.S. customers move from commercial commitment to realized value quickly, reliably and with a model that scales.
  • Turn wins, losses and customer patterns into concrete choices about where the U.S. team should focus, experiment or stop.

Connect Sales, Partnerships and Delivery

  • Create one shared view of regional priorities, commitments, owners and dependencies across Sales, Partnerships and Delivery.
  • Connect the teams before commitments are made so scope, responsibilities and customer outcomes are clear.
  • Step into regional delivery risks and customer escalations, find the constraint and stay accountable until the path is stable.
  • Use customer and implementation evidence to improve qualification, partner strategy, commercial decisions and expansion plans.
  • Turn successful customer journeys into repeatable handoffs, playbooks and proof that functional teams can own.

Build the operating system for repeatable execution

  • Create a focused regional cadence around pipeline, lighthouse accounts, partner performance, delivery risk and expansion.
  • Build the dashboards and analysis that give U.S. regional leadership one trusted view of performance and the decisions required.
  • Run cross-functional reviews that end with a decision, owner and next action—not another status update.
  • Use automation and AI to remove recurring regional work and give Sales, Partnerships and Delivery more time with customers.

What success looks like

  • Lighthouse customers are won, successfully delivered and converted into credible proof for the U.S. market.
  • Qualified pipeline, win rate and sales velocity improve in the U.S. segments where we have chosen to focus.
  • Strategic partners generate measurable pipeline, market access or delivery leverage.
  • Time-to-value and execution predictability improve across priority U.S. customer deployments.
  • U.S. regional leadership has more leverage because priority projects are fully owned, decisions move faster and successful work becomes playbooks operated by the right team.

What will make you phenomenal

  • You start with the regional constraint, not the org chart, and keep going until the outcome is visible.
  • You think from first principles, use data well and are willing to challenge an inherited answer.
  • You are a hands-on builder: equally comfortable with an executive customer and the model, CRM cleanup or playbook needed to move the work.
  • You bring high agency and low ego, and you measure your contribution in regional results rather than activity.
  • You stay close to customers, partners and frontline teams because the best regional decisions start with ground truth.
  • You have strong commercial judgment and can connect enterprise sales, partnerships, delivery economics and customer value.
  • You can lead complex work across functions without formal authority and make trade-offs clear when leaders disagree.
  • Experience in a high-growth startup, strategy and operations, consulting, enterprise go-to-market, partnerships or customer delivery is useful; evidence of ownership and regional execution matters more than a conventional pedigree.

title: Program Manager WEXMAC 2.0 - SBG
description:
SBG Technology Solutions, Inc. (SBG), a DSS, Inc. company, offers IT Governance, Systems Engineering, Enterprise Modernization, Artificial Intelligence, and Cyber Security innovation to federal and commercial clients nationwide.

Overview

We are seeking a dynamic, mission-driven Program Manager to lead full lifecycle execution of task orders under the WEXMAC 2.0 Indefinite Delivery, Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract — a Navy-managed, enterprise-level vehicle supporting worldwide expeditionary logistics, operational integration, and global contingency response. This is a high-visibility, revenue-generating leadership role that sits at the intersection of national defense priorities and complex program execution.

The Program Manager serves as the primary point of accountability for all assigned task order performance, financial outcomes, and stakeholder relationships. Operating in a rapid-response, mission-critical environment, this individual will drive program delivery from award through closeout, ensuring quality, compliance, schedule, and profitability targets are consistently met or exceeded.

This role demands a leader who thrives under operational tempo, communicates with authority to senior government customers and executive leadership, and brings a track record of P&L ownership within DoD contracting environments.

Project Title
AI-Enabled Yield Data Analysis Automation for Semiconductor Memory Testing

Project Description
The intern will undertake a structured project to develop an effective automation solution that improves the efficiency and accuracy of low-yield data analysis in a semiconductor memory test manufacturing environment.
The project will provide exposure to overall test strategy, test operations, manufacturing systems, test methodologies, and lot-disposition processes. The intern will apply programming, data analytics, and Artificial Intelligence tools to analyze engineering information, identify improvement opportunities, and develop a validated analytical workflow.

Objective of the Project

  • Develop an automated method that improves the efficiency, accuracy, and consistency of low-yield data analysis.

  • Build an understanding of semiconductor memory functionality, test strategy, test methodology, and lot-disposition processes.

  • Apply programming, analytics, and AI-Assisted tools to a defined engineering problem.

  • Evaluate the developed solution against agreed technical and project objectives.

Opportunities for Full Time Employment
Interns may be considered for future internship or full-time employment opportunities based on business requirements, role availability, and the applicable recruitment process.

Project Scope

  • Learn the overall test strategy, test operations, and manufacturing processes used in semiconductor memory testing.

  • Become familiar with the systems, applications, hardware, and data flows used within the test manufacturing environment.

  • Study test methodology and lot-disposition processes used for low-yield analysis.

  • Develop and evaluate an AI-Enabled automation solution that improves data-analysis efficiency and accuracy.

Learning Opportunities

  • Gain practical exposure to semiconductor memory devices, product testing, yield analysis, and test manufacturing processes.

  • Learn how engineering systems and applications are used to investigate low-yield conditions and inform lot-disposition decisions.

  • Develop experience in programming, data analytics, visualization, workflow automation, and AI-Assisted engineering analysis.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams and subject matter experts throughout the project lifecycle.

Deliverables

  • A documented analysis of the selected low-yield analysis workflow, including requirements, data inputs, process gaps, and improvement opportunities.

  • A functional automation or analytics solution that improves the efficiency and accuracy of the selected analysis process.

  • Validation results comparing the existing and proposed analytical approaches, including identified limitations and recommendations.

  • A final project report and presentation covering the problem statement, methodology, solution, results, learning outcomes, and potential future enhancements

Impact of the Project

  • Improve the efficiency, accuracy, and consistency of engineering data analysis.

  • Enable clearer identification and investigation of low-yield conditions.

  • Strengthen data-informed engineering decision-making through automation and visualization.

  • Contribute analytical insights relevant to next-generation storage applications used in data centres.

Skillsets Required

  • Familiarity with programming, scripting, or analytics tools such as Python, Perl, Tableau, Microsoft Power BI, or equivalent platforms.

  • Strong analytical, structured problem-solving, data-interpretation, and time-management skills.

  • Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to document and present technical findings.

  • Familiarity with Artificial Intelligence tools, AI Assistants, machine learning, or AI-Enabled workflows, with sound judgement regarding organizational and legal requirements.


Course of Interest
The ideal candidate should be pursuing a degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Microelectronics Engineering, Materials Engineering, Data Science, Computer Science, or a related field.

The ideal candidate should be able to commit to a full time internship period of[ t least 5 months from Jan to May 2027.

title: Merchant Success Specialist
description:

This work will be with our most important and exciting products: Foodics pay, CDS and, Foodics One which are all about enabling our customers to accept card and omnichannel digital payments. Pay products help shape the Food & Beverage industry’s payments experience in thousands of restaurants and stores across the Middle East.

What Are We Looking For❓

Anyone who has:

#High_Volume_of_Calls

Als hbo verpleegkundige GGZ begeleid en ondersteun je cliënten tijdens hun behandeling en herstel. Je creëert structuur en veiligheid op de afdeling en bent een belangrijk aanspreekpunt voor cliënten en collega’s.

title: Sailpoint Developer
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

As a SailPoint IIQ Developer, you will contribute to the implementation, enhancement, and support of enterprise IAM and IGA capabilities using SailPoint IdentityIQ. You will design and maintain workflows, rules, forms, tasks, connectors, provisioning logic, and integration components required to support Joiner, Mover, Leaver, access request, approval routing, birthright provisioning, deprovisioning, manual fulfillment, and periodic access review processes.
The role requires strong understanding of the SailPoint IIQ object model, workflow engine, Lifecycle Manager capabilities, application onboarding patterns, entitlement management, identity correlation, account aggregation, provisioning plans, and certification processes. You will support integrations with authoritative sources such as HR systems, directory services such as Active Directory or LDAP, databases, REST or SOAP APIs, flat files, and enterprise applications using out-of-the-box or custom integration approaches.
You will also troubleshoot and optimize IIQ workflows, aggregation tasks, provisioning failures, identity refresh tasks, certification campaigns, policy violations, and custom rules. The candidate should be able to analyze logs, review task results, validate XML objects, test configuration changes, create deployment evidence, and ensure all customizations align with IAM governance, security, compliance, and operational requirements.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, configure, and support SailPoint IdentityIQ solutions for enterprise IAM and IGA use cases.
  • Develop and customize IdentityIQ workflows for access requests, approvals, provisioning, deprovisioning, lifecycle events, escalation, rejection handling, manual fulfillment, and exception processing.
  • Configure and maintain application integrations using SailPoint out-of-the-box connectors, JDBC, LDAP, Active Directory, REST, SOAP, flat file, and custom integration patterns.
  • Support application onboarding activities including source analysis, account schema definition, entitlement model design, aggregation, correlation, manager mapping, provisioning policy configuration, and certification enablement.
  • Develop and maintain SailPoint IIQ rules such as BuildMap, Correlation, Customization, Before Provisioning, After Provisioning, Workflow, Certification, Policy, Validation, and Task rules.
  • Configure Lifecycle Manager capabilities including QuickLinks, access request forms, approval schemes, work items, provisioning workflows, birthright access, mover logic, and leaver deprovisioning.
  • Develop and maintain IdentityIQ objects including applications, identities, identity attributes, managed attributes, roles, policies, populations, workgroups, email templates, forms, workflows, tasks, and configuration objects.
  • Work with provisioning plans, account requests, attribute requests, entitlement requests, approval sets, work items, and manual fulfillment processes.
  • Troubleshoot IdentityIQ issues using application logs, task results, workflow cases, provisioning transactions, debug pages, aggregation results, identity refresh outcomes, and connector responses.
  • Validate and migrate IdentityIQ XML objects across development, test, UAT, pre-production, and production environments using approved change and release management processes.
  • Collaborate with architects and application owners to define connector requirements, entitlement models, approval routing, provisioning behavior, certification scope, and operational handover needs.
  • Support access certification campaigns, policy violation handling, role management, SoD controls, access review evidence, audit reporting, and compliance documentation.
  • Prepare technical documentation including design notes, configuration guides, test evidence, deployment instructions, troubleshooting steps, and support handover documents.

Your Future at Kyndryl
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.


Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise
  • 7+ Years of experience with SailPoint Identity IQ development, configuration, integration, deployment, and support.
  • Strong understanding of IAM and IGA concepts including identity lifecycle management, access governance, access request, access certification, provisioning, deprovisioning, role-based access control, and segregation of duties.
  • Experience developing or customizing Identity IQ workflows using Business Process Editor, workflow XML, process variables, approval steps, rules, scripts, subprocesses, forms, and workflow library methods.
  • Experience with application onboarding, account aggregation, entitlement aggregation, identity correlation, manager correlation, identity refresh, and provisioning configuration.
  • Experience developing Identity IQ rules using Java and Bean Shell.
  • Experience with rule types such as Build Map, Correlation, Customization, Before Provisioning, After Provisioning, Workflow, Certification, Policy, Validation, and Task rules.
  • Experience integrating Identity IQ with systems such as Active Directory, LDAP, JDBC databases, REST APIs, SOAP services, web services, flat files, HR systems, and enterprise applications.
  • Good understanding of provisioning plans, account requests, attribute requests, entitlement models, managed attributes, roles, policies, populations, workgroups, and access profiles.
  • Ability to troubleshoot IIQ issues using logs, task results, workflow cases, debug pages, application configuration, aggregation outputs, and provisioning transaction details.
  • Familiarity with Identity IQ XML object management, object export/import, environment promotion, release management, and rollback planning.
  • Understanding of access reviews, certification campaigns, policy violations, SoD controls, audit requirements, and compliance reporting.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, XML, JSON, REST APIs, Java, BeanShell, application servers, and basic Linux or Windows operational commands.
  • Ability to collaborate with IAM architects, application owners, business users, security teams, testing teams, and operations teams.
  • Ability to follow secure development, documentation, change management, testing, release, and production support practices.


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Clinical Research Assistant
description:
JOB SUMMARY

The Clinical Research Assistant supports the conduct of clinical trials under the direction of the Clinical Research Manager and Principal Investigator. This position rotates across three functions: participant and visit support, regulatory document management, and clinical data management.

All duties are performed in accordance with the approved protocol, ICH E6(R3) Good Clinical Practice, applicable FDA regulations, and site standard operating procedures. The incumbent performs only those study tasks formally assigned on the Delegation of Authority Log with training documented in advance.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Participant and Visit Support (approximately 50 percent)

  • Prescreen the clinic schedule and medical records against protocol eligibility criteria and maintain the prescreening log.
  • Prepare visit packets, room participants, and collect vital signs, medical history, concomitant medications, and adverse event information under supervision.
  • Perform protocol-specified study procedures consistent with training and certification and obtain required study certifications.
  • Present the informed consent form and route the discussion to the investigator or delegated coordinator. May obtain consent independently only after documented delegation and competency sign off.
  • Track visit windows, schedule visits, and conduct participant reminder and retention outreach.
  • Support investigational product accountability, including dispensing logs and storage temperature documentation.
  • Escalate any participant safety concern to the coordinator and investigator the same business day.

Regulatory and Compliance Support (approximately 25 percent)

  • Maintain the investigator site file, including filing, version control, and completeness checks.
  • Prepare IRB submissions, continuing reviews, amendments, and deviation reports for coordinator and investigator review.
  • Maintain the delegation log, training records, licensure, and financial disclosure documentation, and flag expiring documents in advance.
  • Support sponsor initiation, monitoring, and close out visits and track action items to closure.

Data and Documentation (approximately 25 percent)

  • Complete source documentation contemporaneously and accurately, consistent with ALCOA+ principles.
  • Enter data into the electronic data capture system within five business days of the visit and resolve assigned queries.
  • Reconcile laboratory, imaging, adverse event, and concomitant medication data against the case report form.
  • Process, label, store, and ship biological specimens per the laboratory manual and applicable shipping regulations.
  • Maintain enrollment, screen failure, and participant identification logs with strict confidentiality.

title: Project HSSE Supervisor
description:
APM Terminals

At APM Terminals, a global leader in port and terminal operations, we enable global trade and drive sustainable growth. What drives us forward is a mindset of always improving — observing how work happens, identifying what creates value, and removing what gets in the way. We constantly look for smarter, simpler, and safer ways of operating. If you thrive in environments where people value learning and are committed to continuously improve daily operations, join us and be a part of our journey.

The Port of Barcelona’s Muelle Sur Container Terminal is 100% owned by APM Terminals and is undergoing significant infrastructure and equipment upgrades to support future growth and larger vessel operations. As part of a multi-year project involving civil and electrical engineering works, we are looking for a Project HSSE Supervisor to help ensure the safe, compliant, and environmentally responsible execution of construction activities within a complex operating terminal environment.
In this role, you will provide strong field-based HSSE support across multiple construction interfaces, helping contractors and project teams maintain the highest standards of Health, Safety, Security, and Environmental performance.

What We Can Offer

At APM Terminals, we foster a dynamic learning and training culture that empowers our employees to excel. Our commitment to improvement means every team member has the opportunity to develop their skills and advance their careers by continuously refining how we work. Experience a diverse, multinational workplace where your operational insights directly influence how we work.
Additionally, you will benefit from:
  • Opportunities to build experience in project and construction management.
  • Exposure to large-scale infrastructure and terminal development projects.
  • In-depth learning within the container terminal and logistics industry.
  • Potential future career opportunities in larger, more complex project HSSE roles and broader regional or global HSSE positions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Maintain a visible field presence across the project site, conducting daily inspections and verifying compliance with HSSE requirements.
  • Monitor high-risk construction activities including excavations, drilling, dredging, diving operations, lifting activities, equipment assembly, maintenance, and demobilization activities.
  • Review and verify technical safety documentation including Risk Assessments, Method Statements, Job Safety Analyses, and Permit to Work requirements.
  • Support implementation of HSSE controls and technical standards throughout all phases of construction activities.
  • Identify HSSE improvement opportunities, propose corrective actions, and follow up on implementation to strengthen project performance.
  • Support emergency preparedness activities, drills, and verification of emergency response equipment and resources.
  • Assist with incident investigations, root cause analysis, reporting activities, and environmental compliance monitoring across the project.

What We Are Looking For

  • Continuous improvement mindset: we are looking for someone who brings a thoughtful improvement mindset—curious about how work gets done and motivated to make meaningful, sustainable improvements over time.
  • Legal accreditation to practice as a Técnico Superior de Prevención de Riesgos Laborales (PRL), supported by the required qualifications under Spanish legislation.
  • Mandatory accreditation in the Safety at Work (Seguridad en el Trabajo) specialty.
  • 3–5 years of experience in field safety supervision, ideally within construction, civil engineering, port infrastructure, or similar project environments.
  • Strong knowledge of the Spanish Occupational Risk Prevention framework, including Ley 31/1995, RD 1627/1997, and related regulatory requirements.
  • Experience overseeing implementation of Plan de Seguridad y Salud (PSS) and Coordinación de Actividades Empresariales (CAE) processes.
  • Ability to identify emerging risks, influence contractors, challenge unsafe practices constructively, and provide practical field-based guidance.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder engagement skills with the ability to work effectively across project teams, contractors, supervision teams, and terminal operations.
  • Native or bilingual Spanish and intermediate English proficiency.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office 365 and SharePoint.

Senior Engineer – FPGA Verification (VHLD & DO-254)

Required Skills:

Key Responsibilities:

Tool Mastery: Advanced user of Siemens-Questasim/Synopsys-VCS/Cadence-Xcelium/Rivera-PRO. Automation: Capable of developing Python/TCL scripts to optimize the verification flow. title: Deputy Engineer- Quality (Loco)
description:
Job Description Summary

The Deputy Engineer will oversee and ensure the quality of the entire product line, manage internal audits, and drive corrective actions. They will lead quality initiatives, mentor quality inspectors, and ensure compliance with the Quality Management System. Additionally, they will support digitization and lean initiatives to optimize manufacturing operations.

Job Description

Site Overview:

Our Multi-modal Manufacturing Facility (MMF) in Pune plays a crucial role in manufacturing key aerospace components, supporting not only India’s defense and commercial sectors but also global aviation supply chains. Our relationships with Indian suppliers, combined with our world-class local facilities and global reach, continue to shape India’s aerospace ecosystem.

Role Overview:

  • Quality Planning and Monitoring: Oversee and ensure the quality of the entire product line, including incoming, in-process, and final inspection of parts. Ensure on-time inspection to meet customer demand with a strong focus on quality objectives.
  • Production Approval: Approve in-process production by confirming required specifications, conducting visual and measurement tests, and communicating necessary adjustments to the production supervisor.
  • Finished Product Approval: Approve all finished products by confirming specifications and conducting required tests.
  • Documentation: Document and update inspection results by completing reports and logs.
  • Customer Complaints and Non-Conformance: Investigate customer complaints and non-conformance issues, develop, recommend, and monitor corrective and preventive actions.
  • Quality Assurance: Drive quality in products and processes, establish processes to meet customer expectations, and collect and compile statistical quality data.
  • Internal Audits: Document internal audits and other quality assurance activities, evaluate audit findings, and implement appropriate corrective actions.
  • Reporting: Maintain reports to communicate outcomes of quality activities.
  • Problem Identification and Rectification: Proactively identify areas of obstruction/breakdowns and take steps to rectify problems at an early stage.
  • Manufacturing Support: Assist manufacturing in investigations of process-related quality issues.
  • Rejection Control: Track and control rejections by raising alarms/NC with immediate effect and maintaining CoQ as per organizational requirements.
  • Process Improvement: Participate in Kaizen and other process improvements like suggestion activities.
  • Computer Skills: Proficient in computer skills, including MS Office.
  • Calibration Activity: Manage calibration activities of all measuring and testing instruments both in-house and subcontracting.
  • MRB & RTV Management: Manage MRB & RTV, ensure on-time disposition, drive supplier recovery as applicable, and maintain critical supplier scorecards.
  • Team Participation: Participate in HPT Team discussions, provide insights on quality, quality escapes, issue resolution, RCA, CAPA, etc.
  • Manufacturing Process Familiarity: Be familiar with manufacturing processes including assembly, torqueing, wiring harness assembly, electronic component handling, etc.
  • Quality Management System Compliance: Ensure total compliance with the Quality Management System, lead key initiatives, and align the function with business goals to support 2x growth of the business year-over-year.
  • Leadership and Mentorship: Use experience and expertise to perform assigned tasks, provide leadership to quality inspectors, mentor and train them, and ensure their continuous skill enhancement.
  • Quality Metrics Ownership: Own quality metrics including COQ, FPY, DPU, escaping defects, customer issue resolution, on-time qualification, etc. for the product line.
  • Digitization and Lean Initiatives: Work closely with the AME Team to manage digitization of key quality metrics, deployment of the Quality module in MES, and support lean initiatives (re-layout/resource optimization/automation, etc.).
  • Calibration Management: Manage calibration of all gauges/instruments/fixtures, deploy smart gauges (Bluetooth enabled) to help accelerate digitization of manufacturing operations.

The Ideal Candidate:

The Ideal candidate will ​ensure the quality of the entire product line, manage internal audits, and drive corrective actions. They will lead quality initiatives, mentor quality inspectors, and ensure compliance with the Quality Management System.

Required Qualification:

  • Diploma in in Mechanical or Production Engineering from a reputed college /university
  • 7 - 8 years hands on experience in Quality, Preferred NDT.
  • Shall be willing to work in shifts to meet the organizational goals.
  • The candidate shall be highly energetic and passionate with positive attitude. He shall be able to explain clearly business drivers and organizational objectives to team

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Ability to diverse activities simultaneously. Knowledge of 5S, Lean and Six Sigma Methodology.
  • Experience in Documenting internal audits and other quality assurance activities, evaluate audit findings, and implement appropriate corrective actions


Closing:

Whether we are manufacturing components for our engines, driving innovation in fuel and noise reduction, or unlocking new opportunities to grow and deliver more productivity, our GE Aerospace teams are dedicated and making a global impact. Join us and help move the aerospace industry forward

Relocation Assistance Provided: Yes

title: Automation Engineer
description:
At U.S. Bancorp India, we’re on a journey to do our best. We believe it takes all of us to bring our shared ambition to life, and each person is unique in their potential. Be a part of transformational change where integrity matters, success inspires and great teams collaborate and innovate. This position will be responsible for the analysis, design, testing, development and maintenance of best in class software experiences. - Takes feedback from code review and apply changes to meet standards

- Accountable for ensuring all aspects of product development follow compliance and security best practices

- Exhibits relentless focus in software reliability engineering standards embedded into development standards

Basic Qualifications

#LI-DNI #DNI

title: Electrical Engineering Internship or Co-Op (Fall 2027)
description:

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain Electrical Single Line Diagrams, Schematic/Interconnection Diagrams, Conduit/Cable Schedules, Plans for Lighting, Grounding, Power, Controls, Raceway, etc.

  • Effective communication skills in order to convey ideas is a must

  • Seeks feedback to improve performance
  • Experience with AutoCAD or other drafting software preferred

Potential Experiences

  • Observe and learn the application of electrical distribution concepts and systems such as protective schemes, device coordination, emergency power, motor control, hazardous area installation methods, etc.
  • Expand capabilities with drafting software such as AutoCAD, MicroStation, Plant 3D, Revit, Inventor, Navisworks, or others

title: Apukuljettajia keikkatyöhön
description:
Dobra on henkilöstöpalvelualan yritys, joka tarjoaa asiakkailleen räätälöityjä henkilöstöratkaisuja eri toimialoille. Palveluihimme kuuluvat muun muassa suorarekrytointi, henkilöstövuokraus sekä joustavat keikkatyöratkaisut.

Toimintamme perustuu huolelliseen tarpeiden kartoitukseen, osaamisen arviointiin sekä tiiviiseen yhteistyöhön asiakasyritysten kanssa. Etsimme ja valitsemme työntekijät aina tehtävän vaatimusten, osaamisen ja asiakkaan toiveiden mukaisesti.

Tavoitteenamme on varmistaa oikea osaaminen oikeaan tehtävään sekä rakentaa pitkäaikaisia ja luottamuksellisia yhteistyösuhteita.

Dobra - Hyvän työn puolesta

CASA DELIVERY

Tarjoamme kotiinkuljetuksia, kodinkoneiden sekä kalusteiden asennuksia. Anna meidän huolehtia kotiinkuljetuksistasi ja säästät itsellesi aikaa johonkin hyödyllisempään. Jos haluat noutaa tilauksesi tuotteet Pick-up-Point -pisteestä, sekin toimii yhtä vaivattomasti. Yrityksemme huolehtii myös muuttopalveluista kaikkialla Pohjoismaissa turvallisesti ja luotettavasti. Olemme asettaneet korkealaatuisille toimitusratkaisuillemme vastaavasti korkeat ympäristötavoitteet. Tämän ansiosta useat pohjoismaiset johtavat kodinsisustus- ja kodin elektroniikkayritykset ovat antaneet tehtäväksemme hoitaa heidän kotiinkuljetuksiaan.

Liity Casa Deliveryn dynaamiseen tiimiin – etsimme apukuljettajia ympäri Suomen!

Haluatko työn, jossa yhdistyvät asiakaspalvelu, liikkuvuus ja tiimityöskentely? Etsimme nyt Casa Deliverylle motivoituneita kuljettajia ja apukuljettajia vastaamaan laadukkaista kotiinkuljetuksista ja kodinkoneasennuksista. Casa Delivery toimii useilla paikkakunnilla Suomessa ja kasvaa vauhdilla – nyt sinulla on mahdollisuus liittyä osaksi tätä menestystarinaa!

Paikkakunnat

  • Pori

  • Tampere

  • Vaasa

  • Oulu

Työnkuva

Työssäsi pääset huolehtimaan auton kuormaamisesta, purkamisesta ja tavaroiden toimituksesta asiakkaille. Työskentely tapahtuu työpareittain ja työalue määräytyy paikkakunnan mukaan. Tämä on täydellinen tehtävä sinulle, joka haluat aktiivisen ja monipuolisen työn, jossa jokainen päivä on erilainen!

Odotamme sinulta

Edellytämme sinulta erinomaisia asiakaspalvelutaitoja, sillä olet yrityksen käyntikortti asiakkaiden suuntaan ja varmistat, että jokainen toimitus sujuu ammattimaisesti ja asiakaslähtöisesti. Työ vaatii myös hyvää fyysistä kuntoa, sillä tehtävä sisältää tavaroiden nostelua ja kantamista.

Olet joustava ja reipas, ja sopeudut vaihteleviin työpäiviin ja keikkaluonteiseen työhön. Sinulla on vähintään B-ajokortti, mutta C-ajokortti katsotaan eduksi. Lisäksi arvostamme itseohjautuvuutta ja vastuullisuutta, sillä työssä menestyminen edellyttää tehokasta ja itsenäistä työskentelyä.

Koska tehtävä sisältää asiakaspalvelua, sinulla tulee olla hyvä suomen ja/tai englannin kielen taito, jotta pystyt kommunikoimaan sujuvasti sekä asiakkaiden että tiimin kanssa.

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

Tarjoamme sinulle dynaamisen ja nuorekkaan työympäristön, jossa arvostetaan nykyaikaista ja asiakaslähtöistä ajattelua. Saat mahdollisuuden kehittyä, sillä pääset oppimaan uutta ja kehittämään taitojasi käytännön työssä. Palkka määräytyy osaamisesi ja kokemuksesi mukaan, ja tarjoamme kilpailukykyisen palkan. Työ sopii monenlaisiin elämäntilanteisiin, sillä se on joustavaa keikkatyötä (keikkatyö on tilapäistä, lyhytkestoista työtä, jota tehdään tarpeen mukaan), joka sijoittuu pääasiassa arkipäiville klo 8.00–16.00 välillä. Lisäksi pääset työskentelemään osana ammattitaitoista ja kannustavaa tiimiä, jossa yhteistyö ja hyvä henki ovat keskiössä

Työsuhde solmitaan Dobra Finland Oy:n kanssa.

Hae mukaan ja liity tiimiimme, jossa asiakaspalvelu ja laadukas työnjälki ovat kaiken keskiössä!

title: LEAD, PARTNERSHIPS - CET ACADEMY
description:
[What the role is]

This is a 2-year contract position as a Lead in the CET Academy.

Ngee Ann Polytechnic’s Continuing Education and Training Academy (CETA) is seeking a strategic and driven individual to join our team as Lead (Partnerships). In this role, you will support the Assistant Director(s) and Deputy Director in shaping and executing strategies that drive product innovation, strategic partnerships, and B2B client engagement to advance the national SkillsFuture movement and lifelong learning.

Your responsibilities will include, but are not limited to, the following:

  • Collaborate with academic schools and programme teams to design customised training solutions aligned with client needs and funding requirements.

  • Provide administrative, coordination, and operational support to schools and internal stakeholders as required.

[What we are looking for]

  • Strong analytical, organisational and stakeholder engagement skills.

  • Experience in business development, adult education, corporate training, or partnerships management.

  • Prior exposure to educational programme management, SkillsFuture initiatives, CET frameworks, and/or business or commercial partnerships is an advantage.

  • Ability to work collaboratively across internal teams and with external partners.

  • Comfortable operating in a dynamic and cross-functional environment.

  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage multiple stakeholders effectively.

  • Familiarity with CET funding mechanisms and government-supported training frameworks is an added advantage.
