title: Tandartsassistente Centrum voor Bijzondere Tandheelkunde
description:
Dit ga je doen

Als tandartsassistent bij het Centrum voor Bijzondere Tandheelkunde (CBT) krijg je een veelzijdige en afwisselende functie. Je ondersteunt de tandarts bij de dagelijkse behandelingen en draagt zorg voor een goede voorbereiding van de behandelingen. Daarnaast verricht je zelfstandig OPT’s en maak je, indien nodig, röntgenfoto’s.

Naast je werkzaamheden aan de stoel, draai je ook mee op het secretariaat in zowel de front- als backoffice. Denk hierbij aan patiëntcontact, planning en administratieve ondersteuning. Jij bent een onmisbare schakel in het zorgproces en zorgt ervoor dat alles op rolletjes loopt – voor zowel je collega’s als onze patiënten.

Hier kom je te werken

Bij ons op de polikliniek van het CBT is geen dag het zelfde en vind je veel afwisseling in de werkzaamheden.

Binnen ons hechte en multidisciplinaire team staan we samen klaar voor een bijzondere patiëntengroep. We behandelen mensen die vanwege medische, psychische of fysieke kwetsbaarheid niet in een reguliere tandartspraktijk geholpen kunnen worden.

Ons team bestaat uit tandartsen en tandartsassistenten en wordt versterkt door mondhygiënisten, een preventie-assistente, een tandprotheticus, een psycholoog en polikliniekassistenten. Samen zorgen we voor kwalitatieve en patiëntgerichte mondzorg aan mensen uit Twente en de Achterhoek.

De sfeer binnen het team is open en collegiaal. We werken goed samen met oog voor de patiënt én elkaar.

Dit breng je mee

Jij bent een enthousiaste, daadkrachtige tandartsassistent met hart voor de zorg. Je houdt van afwisseling, bent communicatief sterk en weet hoe je patiënten – vaak met een bijzondere zorgvraag – op hun gemak stelt.

Daarnaast breng je het volgende mee:

  • een afgeronde mbo-opleiding tandartsassistent (niveau 4);

  • minimaal twee jaar relevante werkervaring;

  • ervaring met het zelfstandig maken van OPT’s en röntgenfoto’s;

  • flexibiliteit in werkdagen;

  • een proactieve werkhouding: je ziet werk liggen en pakt het op;

  • goede communicatieve vaardigheden en inlevingsvermogen;

  • nauwkeurigheid, klantgerichtheid en een echte teamplayer.


Wil je weten of deze functie bij jou past? Of wil je meer informatie over de inhoud van de functie?

Neem dan vrijblijvend contact op met Bert Klein Rot, afdelingsmanager Tandheelkunde, via telefoonnummer 06-31751173.

Werken bij MST

MST is één van de grootste topklinische ziekenhuizen van Nederland. Wij bieden vrijwel alle vormen van zorg en zijn een belangrijke spil in de gezondheidszorg van Twente. We werken nauw samen met regionale partners, leiden zorgprofessionals op en doen onderzoek voor de zorg van morgen.

Goede zorg begint bij bevlogen medewerkers. Daarom investeren we in een veilige, inclusieve en inspirerende werkomgeving waarin jij je kunt ontwikkelen en het beste uit jezelf haalt, waar je ook werkt in het ziekenhuis.

title: Lead Scrum Master - Agile & AI enabled
description:
About this role:

Wells Fargo is seeking a Lead Scrum Master to serve as a Technology Release Delivery Lead within the Core Banking Platform team, part of Enterprise Data & Platforms in Consumer Technology. The team is advancing Wells Fargo’s Core Banking Modernization strategy by building a modern, resilient, and scalable foundation that simplifies legacy complexity, accelerates product innovation, and supports improved customer and employee experiences. In this role, you will work at the center of this strategic transformation, bringing together product, technology, testing, and partner teams to align priorities, manage dependencies and risks, strengthen execution readiness, and deliver complex changes safely and predictably. You will also help teams adopt modern engineering, Agile, and AI-enabled ways of working to improve delivery outcomes.


In this role, you will:

  • Manage and develop Scaled Agile portfolios of the highest complexity
  • Guide the teams to follow Agile and Scrum practices to promote prioritization, team readiness, and commitment for each Sprint
  • Optimize scrum team velocity to identify improvement opportunities to achieve higher levels of team performance
  • Oversee systemic impediments to team agility and guide the teams on methods to escalate
  • Deliver capabilities using agile practices while following the Software Development Lifecycle, business process mapping, and various release processes to ensure all risk, security, and development requirements are met
  • Partner with discipline managers to convey their concerns to scrum teams about governance policies and adherence to corporate standards
  • Collaborate with product owners, program or project managers to communicate delivery of work product from the teams and escalate key risks and issues impeding scrum team effectiveness
  • Collaborate and consult with peers, colleagues and managers to resolve issues and achieve goals
  • Interact with internal customers
  • Receive direction from leaders and exercise independent judgment while developing the knowledge to understand function, policies, procedures, and compliance requirements
  • Train other Scrum Masters and serve as a mentor to less experienced staff.


Required Qualifications:

  • 5+ years of Agile Scrum Master experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education


Desired Qualifications:

  • Experience leading Agile delivery across multiple technology teams, products, or workstreams within a large-scale, highly regulated environment.
  • Demonstrated ability to facilitate PI Planning, Scrum of Scrums, dependency management, feature readiness, and cross-team release coordination for complex technology initiatives.
  • Strong knowledge of Agile and Scaled Agile practices, software development lifecycle controls, release management, testing governance, and production-readiness processes.
  • Proven ability to influence product, technology, architecture, testing, operations, risk, and partner teams to resolve impediments, manage competing priorities, and achieve shared delivery outcomes.
  • Experience using delivery metrics, automation, and approved AI-enabled tools to improve planning, transparency, quality, predictability, and continuous improvement


Job Expectations:

  • Lead planning and delivery coordination across globally distributed teams supporting the Core Banking Platform and broader Core Banking Modernization objectives.
  • Facilitate cross-team planning and execution forums to maintain alignment on priorities, commitments, capacity, dependencies, risks, and release timelines.
  • Ensure disciplined testing and release readiness, including compliance with SDLC requirements, defect management, operational readiness, required approvals, and Go/No-Go criteria.
  • Communicate delivery status, risks, dependencies, decisions, and required actions clearly and proactively to technology, product, and senior leadership stakeholders.
  • Champion Agile, product, modern-engineering, and responsible AI-enabled ways of working while coaching teams to improve delivery flow, quality, collaboration, and predictability.
  • Lead cross-product area planning and delivery forums, including PI Planning and Scrum of Scrums, to align teams on priorities, commitments, capacity, dependencies, risks, and delivery timelines.
  • Coordinate feature readiness and execution across product, technology, testing, operations, and partner teams, ensuring work is sufficiently refined and prepared for planning and delivery.
  • Drive end-to-end testing and release readiness by aligning test execution, environments, data, defect management, production support, change records, runbooks, rollback plans, required approvals, and Go/No-Go decisions.
  • Promote transparency and continuous improvement through cross-team demonstrations, product-area retrospectives, delivery metrics, and Communities of Practice, while advancing Agile, modern-engineering, and approved AI-enabled ways of working

description:
Prysmian is the world leader in solutions for energy and digital connections, developing resilient, high-performing, sustainable, and innovative cable systems for the transmission, power grid, electricity and digital solutions. From underground and submarine cables and systems for power transmission and distribution, to medium low voltage cables for the construction and infrastructure sectors, we keep the lights on. We also produce a comprehensive range of optical fibers, copper cables and connectivity for voice, video, and data transmission connecting the world.

Our North American footprint expanded in 2024 with the acquisition of McKinney, Texas-based Encore Wire operating one of Prysmian’s most advanced single-campus manufacturing operations.

With 9,000 dedicated team members in North America and 35,000 globally, Prysmian brings unmatched scale, innovation, and expertise to the energy and telecommunications industries.

At Prysmian, your work matters. Wherever you’re based and whatever you do, you’ll have the opportunity to make an impact as part of a global team committed to excellence and transforming the world around us.

Comprehensive Benefit Package including Medical, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance. 401K Savings Plan with Company Matching Contributions, Paid Holidays and Vacation.

Starting Pay: $31/hr

Schedule: Mon-Fri (7am - 5pm)

The Maintenance Planner is a key member of the Maintenance Support team responsible for maintaining, improving, and standardizing maintenance procedures that drive equipment reliability and operational efficiency. This role leads the planning, scheduling, and coordination of preventive and predictive maintenance activities while continuously evaluating and enhancing maintenance processes, documentation, and controls. The successful candidate will work closely with Maintenance and Operations teams to optimize workforce productivity, reduce maintenance costs, improve equipment uptime, and ensure maintenance procedures are accurate, consistent, and aligned with best practices. Strong CMMS experience, analytical problem-solving skills, and a hands-on approach are essential.

Maintenance Planner Responsibilities:

  • Maintain, review, and continuously improve preventive and predictive maintenance procedures to ensure consistency, efficiency, and equipment reliability.

  • Collaborate with Maintenance, Operations, and Reliability teams to identify process improvements and implement standardized maintenance practices.

  • Review equipment documentation, including manuals, drawings, and technical specifications, to develop, update, and improve preventive maintenance procedures, standard operating procedures (SOPs), and planned maintenance jobs.

  • Develop, maintain, and optimize the preventive maintenance program to support reliability and continuous improvement initiatives.

  • Plan, prioritize, and schedule preventive and predictive maintenance activities to maximize labor utilization while minimizing equipment downtime.

  • Coordinate and maintain parts kitting processes to ensure maintenance personnel have the necessary materials available prior to scheduled work.

  • Conduct weekly maintenance tool room audits to ensure organization, inventory accuracy, and compliance with maintenance standards.

  • Monitor maintenance planning metrics and recommend procedural improvements that increase efficiency, reduce costs, and support long-term equipment performance.

  • Support continuous improvement initiatives by identifying opportunities to streamline maintenance workflows and enhance overall maintenance effectiveness.

Basic Qualifications:

  • 2+ years of recent experience with Microsoft Office, including Excel and/or Smartsheet.

  • 1–3 years of maintenance planning and scheduling experience.

  • Experience working in an industrial, manufacturing, or warehouse environment.

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Experience with Computerized Maintenance Management Systems (CMMS).

  • Electrical and/or mechanical aptitude.

  • Associate degree in a technical field, or 4+ years of experience as a machine repair technician, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

  • Experience using HTML.

  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently and drive continuous process improvements with minimal supervision.

title: Employer Brand Lead
description:
Craft:

Job Description:

As Employer Brand Lead, you will bring King’s culture, people and games to life for current and future talent. You will lead high-impact employer brand programmes that strengthen King’s reputation as an employer of choice, connecting talent-attraction priorities with compelling stories, content and candidate experiences.

This is a hands-on, highly collaborative opportunity to shape how King appears across candidate-facing channels. You will partner with Talent Acquisition, Communications, HR, Events and studio teams to develop creative, insight-led initiatives that engage priority talent audiences.

While primarily focused on King, the role may also support select initiatives across Activision and Blizzard as business priorities and team needs arise.

About the Team

The Employer Brand team helps people understand what it is like to build games at King. We combine talent insight, storytelling, content and candidate experience to connect talent with King and our mission of Making the World Playful.

Working closely with Talent Acquisition and partners across the business, we bring our employer brand to life across our careers site, social channels, early careers programs, recruitment campaigns and events. Together, these experiences help talent discover King, understand our culture and explore opportunities to build their careers with us.

Your Role Within the Kingdom

You’ll lead employer brand activity that connects King’s hiring priorities with the talent we want to reach. Working across teams and channels, you’ll combine strategic partnership with hands-on creative delivery, shaping how candidates discover and experience King.

Stakeholder Partnership & Strategy

  • Serve as King’s primary partner for employer brand initiatives across Talent Acquisition, Communications, HR, Events and business teams, collaborating with Activision and Blizzard partners as needed.
  • Build trusted relationships and act as a strategic advisor on talent-attraction priorities, aligning stakeholders around shared goals and successful outcomes.
  • Translate business objectives and hiring needs into programmes, campaigns and content strategies.
  • Represent Employer Brand in planning discussions and cross-functional initiatives, managing multiple projects and priorities while maintaining alignment with business goals.

Content Strategy & Activation

  • Develop and execute content strategies that support hiring priorities, owning content planning and activation across LinkedIn, King’s careers site, Life at King and other candidate-facing channels.
  • Create high-quality written, visual and multimedia content, including employee stories, social campaigns, photography and video.
  • Turn employee, leader and studio stories into compelling content through strong writing, creative direction and visual storytelling, independently creating and editing content using relevant design and content-creation tools to a high creative standard.

Candidate Experience & Talent Attraction

  • Enhance candidate experiences across King’s careers site and broader talent ecosystem, partnering with recruiters, hiring teams and business leaders to translate hiring needs into attraction strategies and campaigns.
  • Improve the visibility, accessibility and discoverability of content through audience insights and cross-business-unit best practices.
  • Lead awareness strategy and execution for King’s internship programmes, strengthening King’s reputation among STEM students, graduates and gaming communities across Europe.
  • Support recruiting events and targeted attraction campaigns across King and, where needed, broader Activision Blizzard priorities.

Measurement & Insights

  • Monitor and report on performance, including engagement, audience growth, reach, sentiment and talent-discovery metrics.
  • Present data-driven insights, success measures and recommendations to business leaders to optimise strategy, content performance and attraction outcomes.
  • Establish benchmarks and performance measures that inform future growth and investment decisions.

Skills to Create Thrills

You’ll bring a strong mix of employer brand expertise, creative capability and stakeholder influence, with the confidence to move between strategic thinking and hands-on delivery.

Experience

  • Demonstrated success developing and executing employer branding, recruitment marketing, and talent attraction strategies, campaigns, and content.
  • Experience working in gaming, technology, entertainment or another fast-paced, creative industry.
  • Experience managing projects involving multiple stakeholders, competing priorities, and changing business needs.
  • Demonstrated experience producing communications, marketing, editorial, or talent brand content, supported by a portfolio showcasing both strategic thinking and creative execution across written, visual, and multimedia formats.

Knowledge & Skills

  • Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to build relationships across teams and levels and navigate complex stakeholder environments.
  • Exceptional writing, editing, and storytelling skills, with experience creating content across social, web, campaign, editorial, and executive-facing formats.
  • Experience creating, directing, capturing, or editing photo and video content for digital audiences. Proficiency with tools such as Canva, Adobe Creative Suite, or similar platforms.
  • Familiarity with LinkedIn, employer review platforms, career site content management, and recruitment marketing best practices.
  • Ability to use performance data to define success measures, assess campaign effectiveness and recommend improvements to content, candidate engagement and talent-attraction outcomes.

Key Attributes

  • Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on execution in a fast-paced and evolving environment.
  • A collaborative and influential partner who can work effectively across functions and levels.

title: Automation IT Engineer
description:
We are seeking an experienced Automation IT Specialist to join our global Automation team. This role sits at the intersection of industrial automation (PLC/SCADA) and IT software development, responsible for maintaining and evolving our automation code standards while building next-generation software tools that support automation activities worldwide. The ideal candidate combines strong industrial controls knowledge with modern software development skills, including the application of AI to accelerate automation development.

How you’ll make an impact:

  • PLC Standards & Libraries: Understand, maintain, and extend the company's PLC libraries and coding standards, ensuring consistency and quality across automation projects.

  • Tool Development: Design and develop new software productivity tools for automation engineering teams, primarily using common IT languages and frameworks.
  • Legacy Application Maintenance: Maintain and enhance existing internal software tools built on the .NET framework.
  • Industrial Protocols: Apply hands-on experience with industrial communication protocols (e.g., OPC UA, Modbus, Profinet, Ethernet/IP, MQTT) to support integration between automation systems and IT tools.
  • AI-Enabled Development: Leverage AI tools and techniques (e.g., code generation, implementation acceleration) to improve efficiency and quality of automation software development.
  • Global Tool Strategy: Develop the next generation of IT tools supporting Automation team activities worldwide, in close collaboration with the Digitalization team.

Technical Skills

  • Solid understanding of PLC programming concepts, libraries, and coding standards

title: Co-Founder & CEO - AI-Native Mortgage Origination
description:
The Opportunity

FutureSight is seeking a Co-Founder & CEO to lead Closeline, an AI-native mortgage origination venture. This is a co-founder partnership with meaningful founder equity, not a salaried executive role.

Closeline is building the AI-native infrastructure for mortgage origination, purpose-built for brokers and mid-market IMBs. The agent owns the full loan file lifecycle: reading documents, checking them against investor and agency guidelines, and routing each loan through to a decision, acting rather than waiting on a human, and earning more autonomy as trust builds loan by loan. Customer discovery validates a real, recurring cost problem in this segment: lenders spend thousands of dollars to originate a single loan today, a cost that's climbed roughly 35% over the past three years, with up to 80% of that time spent on manual document review.

The US mortgage market processes roughly 6.5 million loans a year across close to 5,000 lending institutions, an estimated $3.25B in addressable software spend at Closeline's pricing. Brokers and mid-market IMBs alone originate about 5.3 million loans a year, representing a $2.65B segment, our initial target market. At target pricing, firms see an estimated 8 to 10x return on what they're currently paying to originate a loan.

About FutureSight

FutureSight is a leading venture builder that co-creates world-class software companies with values-driven entrepreneurs from inception to exit. We are a team of founders, operators and designers with experience successfully bringing software to market at scale.

You’ll co-create with a proven venture building team, led by John Carbrey (4x entrepreneur, $100M ARR), Krista LaRiviere (3x exited, E&Y Top Women Entrepreneur), Alan Smith (Strategyzer co-founder, $120M in products built), Prathna Ramesh (former MD of Maple Leaf Angels, $275M in follow-on capital), and Johnny Tong (0-to-1 builder, acquired by SAP and Stripe) bring a rare combination of operator exits, institutional investing, and AI product depth.

The Partnership

  • Founder equity with meaningful ownership from inception
  • Pre-seed capital committed by FutureSight for early hires and MVP development, with potential for follow-on funding
  • Venture building resources, including embedded design, engineering, growth, and fundraising support from day one
  • Investor and advisor network across fintech and early-stage capital markets
  • A true co-creation model in which you operate as CEO with FutureSight’s cross-functional team as your partner

What You’ll Own

As Co-Founder & CEO, you will set the venture's direction and lead its execution.

  • Strategy — Refine the ICP, pricing model, and product positioning
  • Customer Development — Lead pilots with underwriters, processors, and operations leads, convert them to paid engagements, and build the go-to-market motion
  • Product — Partner with the FutureSight product and engineering team to ship V1 and iterate on user feedback
  • Capital — Lead the seed raise, supported by FutureSight's network and traction
  • Team — Recruit and lead the founding team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

  • Previous founding experience at a venture-backed company
  • Demonstrated success in B2B SaaS go-to-market, including sales and customer engagement
  • Fundraising fluency, with the ability to develop investor narratives and close capital
  • Proven ability to attract, develop, and retain top talent
  • Clear-eyed understanding of the risks and demands of co-founding a venture-backed company
  • Direct exposure to mortgage origination and lending operations

How to Apply

Please submit your resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on why this venture aligns with your goals as a founder. We will move quickly for the right candidate.

FutureSight is committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and experiences.

🌞Solare, eolico e accumulo - Progettiamo e gestiamo progetti fotovoltaici, integrando tecnologie ibride e batterie, per garantire una transizione energetica efficiente ed economica.

Presenza globale, impatto locale - Siamo presenti in 12 Paesi, con attività chiave in Europa, America centrale e meridionale, Giappone e Australia, gestendo oltre 10 GW di asset e una pipeline di progetti in espansione di oltre 20 GW.

💡 Innovazione, sostenibilità e talento - Il nostro team di oltre 1.500 professionisti è la forza trainante del nostro successo e la certificazione Great Place to Work riflette il nostro impegno per il loro sviluppo e benessere.

🚀 Unisciti alla nostra crescita! Siamo in continua espansione e cerchiamo persone che condividano il nostro obiettivo e che vogliano aggiungere valore come Tecnico di manutenzione senior presso impianti fotovoltaici in provincia di Viterbo.

Tra le funzioni che svolgerete con noi, le principali sono:

  • Eseguire gli ordini di lavoro per la manutenzione correttiva e preventiva dell’attrezzatura dell'impianto fotovoltaico secondo i tempi e le pianificazioni stabilite.

  • Registrare le informazioni associate a tali ordini di lavoro di manutenzione correttiva e preventiva in un GMAO (la piattaforma digitale Custodian o equivalente).

  • Rispettare le procedure in materia di salute e sicurezza, qualità, ambiente, così come con le istruzioni tecniche dell'attrezzatura e degli strumenti, ecc.

  • Rispettare le linee guida e le misure di controllo della salute e della sicurezza stabilite per il luogo di lavoro, garantendo che vengano sempre utilizzati i DPI appropriati e che siano in buone condizioni per le attività svolte e segnalando qualsiasi incidente o situazione di rischio che si verifichi sul posto di lavoro.

title: Operating Partner
description:
Full-Time. Salaried.

Starting salary is $75k with additional earning opportunities.

Schedule: Monday-Friday: 8:00am to 5:00pm, with availability as needed in the evenings and weekends, for emergencies.

At National Fitness Partners, we don’t just work in fitness— we TRANSFORM LIVES through affordable fitness. As the largest Planet Fitness franchise, we serve over one million members across 200+ clubs nationwide, creating a Judgement Free fitness experience.

  • We Are Accountable – Self-starters who pursue excellence.
  • We Are Driven – Problem solvers who deliver results.
  • We Are Passionate – Positive energy with a real desire to help others.
  • We Are Ambitious – Always learning and growing toward success.

We believe in the power of our people to make a difference. If you’re looking for a career where your passion meets purpose, we want YOU on our team!

Operating Partner Benefits:

  • Growth Opportunities over 90% of our management team started as an entry level team member!
  • PTO for all employees
  • 401K Retirement Fund (Employer match up to 4%!)
  • Health Insurance Options including Health, Dental, Vision, family life insurance, and more
  • Basic Life Insurance & Short-Term Disability I00% Company Paid!
  • Employee Assistance Program
  • Free employee Black Card Membership

Job Summary:

The Operating Partner is responsible for driving operational excellence, revenue growth, and brand consistency across 1–3 National Fitness Partners locations. This position ensures the highest standards of cleanliness, compliance, and member experience while leading teams to exceed key performance indicators (KPIs) and achieve company goals. The Operating Partner is both a strategic and hands-on leader, certified to repair Life Fitness/ Matrix equipment and hold a Fitness Trainer Certification to model best practices in fitness and member engagement.

Key Responsibilities:

Operational Leadership & Performance

  • Partner with the Regional Director to formulate and implement strategic plans that achieve revenue and operational goals at the club level.
  • Work closely with the Regional Director to ensure clubs operate in alignment with approved expense budgets and financial targets.
  • Maintain consistent focus on KPIs including closing %, Black Card %, secondary billing, PE@PF utilization, and YoY Black Card Membership growth.
  • Maintain at least a passing Club BER inspection score monthly, demonstrating adherence to operational excellence and brand standards.
  • Monitor daily performance metrics and coach staff to meet or exceed NFP standards for revenue, service delivery, and compliance.

Team Development & Leadership

  • Hire, train, and develop competent, motivated team members focused on delivering the Ultimate Member Experience.
  • Decrease club turnover through intentional leadership, coaching, and recognition.
  • Conduct One-on-Ones regularly, setting clear development goals and measurable objectives for all staff.
  • Model Servant Leadership through daily interactions, setting the tone for professionalism, teamwork, and accountability.
  • Hold staff accountable to policies, procedures, and performance expectations, providing timely and constructive feedback.

Brand Excellence & Member Experience

  • Ensure clubs reflect the Planet Fitness brand promise through exceptional cleanliness, friendliness, and consistency in service.
  • Personally model and monitor front desk activities, including info call scripting, giving engaging member tours, enrolling or managing memberships via DataTrak, and resolving member issues courteously and promptly.
  • Maintain immaculate club cleanliness, ensuring all areas meet NFP and Planet Fitness standards at all times.
  • Drive a culture of Raving Fans by ensuring every member feels welcome, valued, and supported.
  • Oversee marketing initiatives, ensuring staff are fully trained and actively promoting all campaigns and promotions.

Safety, Compliance, & Equipment Maintenance

  • Ensure all clubs maintain strict compliance with OSHA, ADA, and company safety standards.
  • Actively promote and maintain a safe and healthy club environment for members and staff.
  • Respond to and report all member or employee accidents promptly and accurately using NFP protocols.
  • Certified by Life Fitness/Matrix to perform and oversee basic equipment repairs and maintenance, minimizing downtime and ensuring equipment reliability.
  • Ensure accurate documentation and timely resolution of safety and maintenance issues.

Financial Management

  • Ensure payroll hours remain within budgeted allotments through strategic scheduling and active management of labor costs.
  • Approve staff timecards prior to payroll deadlines, ensuring accuracy and compliance with timekeeping policies.
  • Support the Regional Director in achieving cost control and profit margin objectives across all assigned clubs.

Additional Responsibilities

  • Provide back-up coverage and operational support for staff when necessary.
  • Lead by example in all aspects of operations, demonstrating integrity, professionalism, and a deep commitment to NFP’s Core Values: Accountable, Driven, Passionate, Ambitious.
  • Participate in company-wide initiatives, meetings, and trainings as required.
  • Other duties as assigned.

title: Processoperatör Helg - Arla Jönköping
description:
Brinner du för att producera livsmedel av hög kvalitet? Trivs du i en varierad arbetsvardag där ansvarstagande, initiativförmåga och kvalitet står i fokus? Då kan detta vara rollen för dig.

Till vårt mejeri i Jönköping söker vi nu en processoperatör för helganställning som vill vara med och bidra till vår fortsatta utveckling. I rollen arbetar du främst inom mjölkmottagning och processavdelning, där du får varierande arbetsuppgifter i en dynamisk miljö. Tjänsten ställer krav på servicekänsla, noggrannhet, ordningssinne och ett positivt förhållningssätt.

Vad innebär rollen?

Som processoperatör inom process- och mottagningsavdelningen arbetar du varannan helg på skift som kan vara förlagda till dag-, kvälls- och nattetid. Rollen kräver att du är noggrann, ansvarstagande och pålitlig samt har förmåga att både samarbeta i team och arbeta självständigt. Tjänsten inleds med en provanställning.

Dina huvudsakliga arbetsuppgifter är att

Ta emot mjölk i mjölkmottagningen.

Hantera utlastning av produkter i bulk.

Styra och övervaka produktionsprocessen via datoriserade styrsystem.

Utföra kvalitets- och kvantitetskontroller av råvaror och pågående produktion.

Ansvara för disk, rengöring och hygienarbete av processutrustning och lokaler.

Vem är du?

För att lyckas i rollen ser vi att du är en positiv och samarbetsinriktad person som trivs med att arbeta tillsammans med andra. Du är noggrann, engagerad och tar ansvar för dina arbetsuppgifter. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet och värdesätter medarbetare som bidrar till en trygg, inkluderande och trivsam arbetsmiljö.

Vi söker dig som har

Goda kunskaper i svenska, både i tal och skrift.

God IT-vana och erfarenhet av att arbeta med datorbaserade system.

Ett intresse för teknik och processtyrning.

Intresse för naturvetenskapliga områden såsom fysik, kemi och biologi.

Erfarenhet från livsmedelsproduktion eller processindustri är meriterande, men inte ett krav.

Vad erbjuder vi?

Arla är ett globalt bondeägt företag som arbetar hela vägen från gård till bord. Som marknadsledare inom mejeribranschen är vi stolta över att leverera naturliga och hållbara produkter av hög kvalitet till konsumenter världen över.

Hos oss blir du en del av en välkomnande företagskultur där samarbete, utveckling och arbetsglädje står i centrum. Vi erbjuder utmanande arbetsuppgifter, goda utvecklingsmöjligheter och en arbetsplats där säkerhet och arbetsmiljö alltid prioriteras högt. Som en del av vårt säkerhetsarbete genomför vi slumpmässiga drog- och alkoholtester.

Ansökan

Vill du bli en del av Arla och bidra till framtidens livsmedelsproduktion?

Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-09-18. Vi arbetar med löpande urval och rekommenderar därför att du skickar in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Kontaktperson
Magnus Johansson, Team Leader Process/Mottagning
armajoa@arlafoods.com

Facklig kontaktperson
Tony Hertzberg
artoher@arlafoods.com

Observera att vi inte tar emot ansökningar via e-post. Skicka istället din ansökan via Arla Career och sök på Processoperatör Helg.

Shape the Future of Dairy

Arla is a global leader in the dairy industry, committed to enabling good food choices that make life better, providing people with nourishment, while taking care at every step to ensure Arla is a choice they can feel good about. If you are looking to shape the future with an ambitious global cooperative that truly cares about your growth, where everyone feels valued and empowered, and collaboration is the core of culture, Arla is a choice you can feel good about.

title: Sailpoint Developer
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

As a SailPoint IIQ Developer, you will contribute to the implementation, enhancement, and support of enterprise IAM and IGA capabilities using SailPoint IdentityIQ. You will design and maintain workflows, rules, forms, tasks, connectors, provisioning logic, and integration components required to support Joiner, Mover, Leaver, access request, approval routing, birthright provisioning, deprovisioning, manual fulfillment, and periodic access review processes.
The role requires strong understanding of the SailPoint IIQ object model, workflow engine, Lifecycle Manager capabilities, application onboarding patterns, entitlement management, identity correlation, account aggregation, provisioning plans, and certification processes. You will support integrations with authoritative sources such as HR systems, directory services such as Active Directory or LDAP, databases, REST or SOAP APIs, flat files, and enterprise applications using out-of-the-box or custom integration approaches.
You will also troubleshoot and optimize IIQ workflows, aggregation tasks, provisioning failures, identity refresh tasks, certification campaigns, policy violations, and custom rules. The candidate should be able to analyze logs, review task results, validate XML objects, test configuration changes, create deployment evidence, and ensure all customizations align with IAM governance, security, compliance, and operational requirements.

Key Responsibilities
  • Design, develop, configure, and support SailPoint IdentityIQ solutions for enterprise IAM and IGA use cases.
  • Develop and customize IdentityIQ workflows for access requests, approvals, provisioning, deprovisioning, lifecycle events, escalation, rejection handling, manual fulfillment, and exception processing.
  • Configure and maintain application integrations using SailPoint out-of-the-box connectors, JDBC, LDAP, Active Directory, REST, SOAP, flat file, and custom integration patterns.
  • Support application onboarding activities including source analysis, account schema definition, entitlement model design, aggregation, correlation, manager mapping, provisioning policy configuration, and certification enablement.
  • Develop and maintain SailPoint IIQ rules such as BuildMap, Correlation, Customization, Before Provisioning, After Provisioning, Workflow, Certification, Policy, Validation, and Task rules.
  • Configure Lifecycle Manager capabilities including QuickLinks, access request forms, approval schemes, work items, provisioning workflows, birthright access, mover logic, and leaver deprovisioning.
  • Develop and maintain IdentityIQ objects including applications, identities, identity attributes, managed attributes, roles, policies, populations, workgroups, email templates, forms, workflows, tasks, and configuration objects.
  • Work with provisioning plans, account requests, attribute requests, entitlement requests, approval sets, work items, and manual fulfillment processes.
  • Troubleshoot IdentityIQ issues using application logs, task results, workflow cases, provisioning transactions, debug pages, aggregation results, identity refresh outcomes, and connector responses.
  • Validate and migrate IdentityIQ XML objects across development, test, UAT, pre-production, and production environments using approved change and release management processes.
  • Collaborate with architects and application owners to define connector requirements, entitlement models, approval routing, provisioning behavior, certification scope, and operational handover needs.
  • Support access certification campaigns, policy violation handling, role management, SoD controls, access review evidence, audit reporting, and compliance documentation.
  • Prepare technical documentation including design notes, configuration guides, test evidence, deployment instructions, troubleshooting steps, and support handover documents.

Your Future at Kyndryl
Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career. We have opportunities that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.


Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Technical and Professional Expertise
  • 7+ Years of experience Hands-on experience with SailPoint Identity IQ development, configuration, integration, deployment, and support.
  • Strong understanding of IAM and IGA concepts including identity lifecycle management, access governance, access request, access certification, provisioning, deprovisioning, role-based access control, and segregation of duties.
  • Experience developing or customizing IdentityIQ workflows using Business Process Editor, workflow XML, process variables, approval steps, rules, scripts, subprocesses, forms, and workflow library methods.
  • Experience with application onboarding, account aggregation, entitlement aggregation, identity correlation, manager correlation, identity refresh, and provisioning configuration.
  • Experience developing IdentityIQ rules using Java and BeanShell.
  • Experience with rule types such as BuildMap, Correlation, Customization, Before Provisioning, After Provisioning, Workflow, Certification, Policy, Validation, and Task rules.
  • Experience integrating IdentityIQ with systems such as Active Directory, LDAP, JDBC databases, REST APIs, SOAP services, web services, flat files, HR systems, and enterprise applications.
  • Good understanding of provisioning plans, account requests, attribute requests, entitlement models, managed attributes, roles, policies, populations, workgroups, and access profiles.
  • Ability to troubleshoot IIQ issues using logs, task results, workflow cases, debug pages, application configuration, aggregation outputs, and provisioning transaction details.
  • Familiarity with IdentityIQ XML object management, object export/import, environment promotion, release management, and rollback planning.
  • Understanding of access reviews, certification campaigns, policy violations, SoD controls, audit requirements, and compliance reporting.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, XML, JSON, REST APIs, Java, BeanShell, application servers, and basic Linux or Windows operational commands.
  • Ability to collaborate with IAM architects, application owners, business users, security teams, testing teams, and operations teams.
  • Ability to follow secure development, documentation, change management, testing, release, and production support practices.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Experience with SailPoint IdentityIQ upgrade, patching, environment support, or performance tuning.
  • Experience with custom connector development, advanced connector customization, or web service connector implementation.
  • Experience with Lifecycle Manager configuration, access request customization, dynamic approval routing, and complex fulfillment patterns.
  • Experience integrating with Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID, LDAP, ServiceNow, HRMS platforms, database applications, cloud applications, and ticketing systems.
  • Experience with workflow monitoring, task optimization, aggregation tuning, provisioning failure analysis, and operational reporting.
  • Experience with certification campaign design, role mining, role modeling, policy configuration, SoD control implementation, and compliance reporting.
  • Experience with source control and deployment tools for IdentityIQ XML objects, workflows, forms, rules, and configuration artifacts.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity and compliance frameworks such as ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR, audit control requirements, and evidence management.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • SailPoint IdentityIQ certification or relevant IAM/IGA certification is required.


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

    4. Your role

    We're building a new team dedicated to AI-driven products and platform infrastructure. This is a dedicated engineering group, not a support function, you'll be building the AI tooling, agent infrastructure, and integration layers that other teams rely on.

What Do We Offer?

​

Health & Well-being

Work & Growth

Additional Perks

Requirements

title: Associate Director, Global Medical Affairs Lead
description:

The promise of genetic medicine has arrived, and Sarepta is at the forefront. We hold a leadership position in Duchenne muscular dystrophy (Duchenne) and are building a robust portfolio of programs across muscle, central nervous system, and cardiac diseases. In 2023, we launched our fourth therapy and the first ever gene therapy to treat Duchenne.

We’re looking for people who see unlimited potential in themselves and who are motivated by an unwavering commitment to patients.

What Sarepta Offers

For a full list of our comprehensive benefits, see our website:

The Importance of the Role

The Associate Director, Global Medical Affairs Lead (GMAL) is a key contributor to the GMAL team within Global Medical Affairs (GMA) department. As GMALs, we drive medical strategy and tactics to establish and elevate the impact of Sarepta’s science and therapies. This role will contribute to our mission through strategic and tactical scientific support of Sarepta’s gene therapy for Duchenne Muscular Dystrophy (DMD). This role will report to the Global Medical Affairs Lead for DMD Gene Therapy.

The Opportunity to Make a Difference

Primary Responsibilities Include:

  • Contribute to the development and execution of GMA strategy for product launch and life-cycle management to bring alignment on key initiatives for the therapeutic area in line with overall Corporate and Medical priorities
  • Develop medical materials (including slides and talking points) for gene therapy and DMD, ensure cross-functional program alignment, and participate in review processes
  • Act as SME to review and approve medical and promotional material including congress materials and symposia
  • Build strong relationships that foster working effectively in close collaboration with cross-functional partners to plan and execute tactics

More about You

  • Analytical, with a track record of delivering goals while working in high performing diverse teams
  • Demonstrated success in operating effectively in highly matrixed organizations where influencing skills are critical to day to day success
  • Experience in building strong and effective relationships with thought leaders and healthcare professionals

We’re always looking for solution-oriented, critical thinkers.

So, if you’re comfortable with ambiguity and candor, relish challenging yourself, and place kindness and integrity at the forefront of how you approach your peers and work, then we encourage you to apply.

title: Head of Global Resource Management
description:
Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

Job Description:

The Head of Global Resource Management reports to the Chief Operating Officer and will lead the assessment, design, implementation, and ongoing evolution of Crowe’s future-state resource management operating model. This leader will build on strong capabilities across the firm to help bring the right people, skills, and delivery locations to each engagement; improve utilization, global delivery adoption, workforce economics, and client service; and give leaders better visibility into demand and capacity. The role will partner with executive leadership, business unit (BU) and delivery unit (DU) leaders, Human Resources (HR), Talent, Finance, Information Technology (IT), Revenue Operations (RevOps), India leadership, and operations teams to advance coordinated approaches that support Crowe’s strategy, culture, and growth.

Roles & Responsibilities:

  • Advance Crowe’s resource management operating model: Assess current capabilities and work with executive, practice, and operations leaders to design and implement a future-state model that builds on existing strengths. Define clear governance, roles, decision rights, shared standards, priorities, and ways of working while coordinating enterprise, BU-, DU-, and geography-based resource management teams.
  • Lead forward-looking demand and capacity planning: Combine current revenue, demand, and utilization against budget with the best available forecasts of backlog, pipeline, and expected work. Partner with BU and DU leaders, RevOps, and Finance to give leaders timely views of capacity, emerging gaps, and required people decisions, and adjust staffing plans as conditions change.
  • Improve utilization and delivery economics: Establish clear utilization measures and differentiated expectations by role, level, BU, and DU. Improve deployment, leverage, staffing mix, and cross-staffing while balancing client quality, employee development, sustainable workloads, and gross-margin improvement.
  • Use staffing to expand high-quality global delivery: Use staffing, scheduling, and demand planning to integrate India talent into engagements, improve utilization of Crowe’s global delivery capabilities, increase end-to-end and higher-value work, and remove barriers to effective collaboration between United States (US) and India teams.
  • Further reinforce One Crowe in delivery: Promote collaboration and talent mobility across BUs, DUs, and geographies so Crowe can bring the best available expertise to each engagement and respond flexibly to changing demand. Establish clear enterprise principles for prioritizing resources across opportunities while balancing client needs, strategic importance, economics, professional development, and firmwide priorities.
  • Build an integrated workforce and recruiting plan: Partner with Financial Planning and Analysis (FP&A), Finance, HR, Talent, Recruiting, RevOps, India leadership, and BU leaders to translate revenue forecasts into short- and long-term resource requirements. Incorporate productivity, utilization, promotion, attrition, skills, global delivery, and automation into recruiting decisions and the evolution of Crowe’s workforce pyramid.
  • Use staffing to support development and sustainable careers: Partner with HR, Talent, and business leaders to translate development needs into assignments, rotations, global experiences, and exposure to new offerings. Use capacity and workload insights to balance short-term delivery needs with sustainable workloads, broad development opportunities, and long-term career growth.
  • Modernize resource management processes, data, and technology: Partner with IT to maintain useful skill profiles, define engagement requirements, and rapidly match required skills with available talent. Apply Lean practices, artificial intelligence (AI), and automation to reduce manual coordination, improve data quality and decisions, and provide real-time visibility into demand, capacity, utilization, skills, and availability.
  • Manage flexible capacity: Establish a practical approach for using internal US talent, India talent, cross-BU staffing, and independent contractors (1099 resources). Improve the speed and consistency of external-resource decisions while balancing quality, cost, skill availability, development, delivery risk, and gross margin.
  • Build alignment and continuously improve performance: Establish enterprise metrics, dashboards, forecasting routines, staffing meetings, and executive reporting to improve visibility and decision-making. Build executive and practice-leader alignment, facilitate decisions, share effective practices across the firm, and encourage adoption through useful tools, strong support, and demonstrated value.

Ideal Experience and Qualifications:

  • Resource Management leadership: 15+ years of experience in resource management, workforce planning, professional-services operations, or a closely related field, including meaningful experience leading and scaling a resource management function.
  • High-performing global professional-services experience: Direct experience leading or holding a senior role in resource management within a high-performing global professional-services firm, including multiple businesses, geographies, and meaningful offshore or global-delivery capabilities.
  • Operating-model build and transformation experience: Proven track record assessing, designing, and implementing enterprise resource management operating models, including governance, roles, processes, technology, reporting, change management, and continuous improvement.
  • Commercial, analytical, and forecasting judgment: Strong demand and capacity planning, scenario analysis, workforce modeling, utilization management, and commercial judgment, with a practical understanding of leverage, staffing mix, engagement profitability, and gross margin.
  • Global delivery and India experience: Experience using staffing and scheduling to integrate offshore talent into onshore-led engagements, increase ownership and utilization, and maintain quality and effective collaboration.
  • Resource management systems, data, and AI: Experience with skills taxonomies, staffing or workforce platforms, dashboards, data governance, workflow design, automation, and practical applications of AI to resource matching, planning, and administration.
  • Executive influence and cross-functional partnership: Demonstrated ability to influence senior executives, highly independent partners, BU and DU leaders, HR, Talent, Finance, IT, RevOps, and local resource managers without relying primarily on formal authority.
  • Education: Bachelor’s degree required; a Master of Business Administration (MBA) or advanced degree in business, finance, analytics, human capital, operations, or a related field is preferred but not required.
  • Travel requirements: Travel will include regular domestic travel and periodic travel to India, based on business needs.

What you Bring:

  • Hands-on, action-oriented operator who is willing to work directly in workforce models, staffing processes, dashboards, skill definitions, and allocation decisions rather than managing only from a distance
  • Enterprise-minded One Crowe leader who places client and firmwide outcomes ahead of local ownership and models Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship
  • Objective and fair decision-maker who can create transparent allocation rules, resolve competing demands, and use judgment when circumstances require exceptions
  • Development-minded staffing leader who understands how assignments shape skills, careers, engagement, and sustainable workloads
  • Process-oriented continuous improver who applies Lean thinking, shares best practices, and strengthens coordination without losing necessary nuance
  • Long-term steward who balances immediate utilization and financial results with the workforce pyramid, capabilities, leadership pipeline, and adaptability Crowe needs for the next 80 years and beyond
  • Trusted influencer with the presence and emotional intelligence to build alignment among senior executives, partners, business leaders, and resource managers
  • Clear communicator who turns complex demand, capacity, and workforce information into practical recommendations and timely decisions
  • Low-ego, high-energy player / coach who thrives at the pace of a private-equity-backed value-creation environment and moves quickly from diagnosis to measurable results

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Crowe, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $183,400.00 - $386,600.00 per year.

Our Benefits:
Your exceptional people experience starts here. At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We care about our people and offer employees a comprehensive total rewards package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!

How You Can Grow:
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!

More about Crowe:
Crowe provides professional services through two separate entities: Crowe LLP delivers audit and attest services, and Crowe Advisory LLC provides tax, advisory, consulting, and other nonattest services.


The Crowe Global network consists of more than 300 independent accounting and advisory services firms in more than 150 countries around the globe, making it one of the largest accounting networks in the world.* As independent members of Crowe Global, Crowe LLP and Crowe Advisory LLC serve clients worldwide.

Crowe LLP and Crowe Advisory LLC (and their respective subsidiary entities) does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.


Crowe will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws.

Please visit our webpage to see notices of the various state and local Ban-the-Box laws and Fair Chance Ordinances, where applicable.

We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

title: Group Manager, Product Design - Back Office
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Group Manager, Product Design - Back Office based in United States.

This is a hands-on product design leadership role focused on solving complex problems across back-office experiences within a fast-moving SaaS environment.
You will lead a talented design team while remaining deeply involved in product vision, strategy, research, interaction design, and prototyping.
Working closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, and Data Science, you will shape experiences that create measurable value for customers and the business.
The role combines strategic thinking with detailed execution, requiring strong judgment in ambiguous and evolving environments.
You will establish lean design standards and processes that balance quality, speed, consistency, and team capability.
You will also help modernize the design practice by using AI as a creative and strategic accelerator throughout discovery and delivery.
This is an opportunity to build a high-performing design culture while influencing products used across a large and complex industry.

Accountabilities:

  • Hire, develop, coach, and mentor a high-performing product design team, establishing clear expectations and supporting individual and collective growth.
  • Lead significant design initiatives from vision and strategy through execution, ensuring solutions address meaningful customer and business needs.
  • Contribute to product strategy and roadmap development by bringing strong design perspectives, user insights, and data-driven recommendations.
  • Establish lean design standards, processes, and practices that enable teams to move quickly without compromising quality or user experience.
  • Remain hands-on across research, interface design, prototyping, user journeys, personas, UX measurement, and other key design artifacts.
  • Use quantitative and qualitative insights to evaluate design effectiveness, identify opportunities, and measure product impact.
  • Integrate AI-assisted design tools into everyday workflows, using generative exploration, rapid prototyping, and emerging technologies to accelerate high-quality outcomes.
  • Partner closely with Product, Engineering, Marketing, Data Science, and other cross-functional teams to deliver cohesive and inclusive user experiences.
  • Build strong relationships with stakeholders across the organization and effectively communicate design rationale, trade-offs, priorities, and recommendations.
  • Support distributed teams through strong asynchronous communication, collaboration, and effective coordination across time zones.
  • Drive accessibility and inclusive design practices, ensuring diverse user needs are considered throughout the product development lifecycle.
  • Foster a healthy, collaborative, low-ego design culture built around experimentation, thoughtful decision-making, continuous learning, and measurable customer impact.

    • Requirements

    • 5+ years of product design experience within a SaaS, enterprise software, or similarly complex technology environment.
    • Demonstrated experience managing a product design team of approximately 3–10 designers or leading multiple design groups.
    • Strong hands-on capabilities across user research, interaction and interface design, prototyping, UX strategy, and design systems or processes.
    • Proven ability to lead complex design projects from strategic vision through detailed execution and delivery.
    • Experience producing high-quality design outcomes at scale and evaluating impact through both quantitative and qualitative methods.
    • Familiarity with AI-assisted design tools such as Figma Make, Claude, Cursor, or comparable technologies, together with genuine curiosity about emerging AI-enabled design practices.
    • Strong strategic thinking and the ability to connect detailed design decisions with broader product and business objectives.
    • Excellent coaching and people-leadership skills, including the ability to provide direct, constructive feedback and create meaningful development opportunities.
    • Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders and collaborate effectively across multidisciplinary teams.
    • Experience working successfully with globally distributed teams and across multiple time zones, with strong asynchronous communication habits.
    • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-changing environments while maintaining focus, design rigor, and delivery momentum.
    • Commitment to accessibility, inclusive design, and creating experiences that serve diverse user needs.
    • A collaborative, low-ego approach combined with sound judgment, curiosity, creativity, and a bias toward measurable impact.

title: Project Manager
description:
FCX Performance is an Applied Industrial Technologies Company and a leading process flow control company. We are seeking an experienced Heat Trace Designer/Project Manager to manage/perform the design, estimating, procurement, coordination, and execution of commercial and industrial electric heat-tracing projects.

In addition to competitive pay and all the benefits you’d expect from an industry leader (401K with company match, insurance, time off, employee assistance, tuition reimbursement, etc.) you will also enjoy:

  • A LASTING CAREER – Career paths are available in sales, management, and operations throughout the country
  • Professional development and training
  • Team oriented company culture where it’s called work for a reason but have fun in the process
  • Join a local team with company backing

This position requires strong technical design ability combined with practical construction and project-management experience. The successful candidate will manage projects from initial review and proposal development through material procurement, field installation, testing, documentation, and final closeout.

Primary Responsibilities

Heat-Trace Design

  • Review construction drawings, specifications, piping schedules, equipment data, and project requirements.
  • Identify piping, vessels, equipment, and systems requiring electric heat tracing.
  • Perform heat-loss calculations and select appropriate heating cable, controls, connection kits, and accessories.
  • Design freeze-protection, process-temperature-maintenance, and snow-melting systems.
  • Develop heat-trace circuit schedules, cable schedules, load summaries, bills of material, and installation details.
  • Determine circuit lengths, power requirements, breaker sizes, control methods, and electrical distribution requirements.
  • Prepare design drawings and heat-trace layouts using AutoCAD, AutoCAD Plant 3D, Bluebeam Revu, or similar software.
  • Coordinate heat-trace designs with piping, mechanical, electrical, plumbing, fire protection, and instrumentation systems.
  • Review manufacturer requirements and ensure designs comply with applicable codes, specifications, and project standards.
  • Prepare design revisions, redlines, as-built drawings, and final turnover documentation.

Estimating and Proposal Development

  • Review bid documents and define the complete project scope.
  • Perform material and labor takeoffs for heat-trace installation projects.
  • Develop lump-sum estimates covering engineering/design, materials, labor, equipment, supervision, testing, documentation, and subcontracted work.
  • Obtain and evaluate supplier and subcontractor quotations.
  • Identify and/or define project inclusions, exclusions, qualifications, assumptions, schedule risks, and potential scope gaps.
  • Prepare professional proposals and scope-of-work documents.

title: Global Commercial Finance and Transformation Lead (F, M, X)
description:
Location: Neuilly-sur-Seine, France, or Frankfurt, Germany, or working remotely

Our Team:

Business Analysis & Controlling (BA&C) team monitors Opella financial performance and trajectory, drives finance planning and forecasting processes, provides support to global and regional management on financial assessment of the business performance & making informed business decisions, as well as promotes simplification, harmonization, and automation across Opella Finance organization.

About the Job:

This role oversees global Commercial Finance and Promotion Expenses at Opella with respect to reporting, analysis, and performance insights. The role also actively supports the transformation of Commercial Finance capabilities. Working closely with the Opella Transformation Office and global and regional stakeholders, the role helps to drive the design, development, and deployment of future-state reporting & analytics capabilities while facilitating their end-to-end adoption across countries.

Beyond Commercial Finance stakes, the position shall contribute to broader Global Finance initiatives and supports coordination of Business Analysis & Controlling (BA&C) roadmap implementation across regional Global Capability Centers (GCCs).

The role operates in a matrixed environment, influencing cross-functional teams and global stakeholders without direct line management responsibility. The Global Commercial Finance & Transformation Lead position will directly report to the Global Head for Financial Analysis Planning & Reporting based in Neuilly-sur-Seine, France.

Main Responsibilities:

This role combines accountability for reporting & analysis of key business drivers (GtN and A&P) with leadership of strategic Finance transformation initiatives.

Acting as the key liaison for the EULA region within the Bedrock Transformation Program, the role aligns local, regional, and global stakeholders to drive transformation of Trade Investment (Gross-to-Net) and Customer Profitability reporting, including the design and rollout of standardized reporting, analytics, governance, and performance management capabilities across Opella.

The role also leads and coordinates other global initiatives, including implementation of the BA&C Target Operating Model (TOM), enhancement of Finance data quality and accessibility, and adoption of AI-enabled capabilities to improve automation and analytical efficiency.

Global Commercial Finance & Transformation Lead has the following key responsibilities:

  • Lead Commercial Finance and Promotion Expense reporting and performance analysis cycles for Actuals and Forecasts at global level, ensuring timely delivery of insights while serving as a global contact point for operational Commercial Finance and A&P matters (PVM, Gross-to-Net, customer sales performance, working & non-working media, etc.).
  • Collaborate with Commercial, Finance, Digital, & Country teams to drive commercial finance data integrity, trade investment system harmonization, and adoption of standardized processes, while ensuring the central Commercial Finance framework is effectively adapted to different go-to-market models.
  • Co-lead the design and standardization of customer profitability methodologies, leveraging ERP data together with off-system enhancements for specific expense types that require allocation rules, to ensure consistent Customer P&L reporting across markets.
  • undefined
  • Drive change management activities, including stakeholder engagement, training, and communication to support successful implementation. Monitor activity progress and report on key milestones, risks, and dependencies to senior leadership.
  • Identify opportunities for continuous improvement in financial processes and tools to enhance efficiency and insight generation.

About You:

  • Experience: at least 5 years of experience in Finance (Finance Business Partnering, Business Analysis & Controlling, etc.). Global project experience is a plus.
  • Soft skills: demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders in a complex, matrixed organization; strong analytical, problem-solving, & communication skills; proven experience leading cross-functional transformation initiatives; high degree of autonomy, adaptability, and project management capability.
  • Technical skills: Business Planning and Forecasting; high acumen in managing different systems (TM1, expert Excel, Power BI, etc.)
  • Education: degree qualified in finance, business, or accounting.
  • Languages: Fluent in English.


About Us:

Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over The Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.

Our mission is to bring health in people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be. For half a billion consumers worldwide – and counting.

At the core of this mission is our 100 loved brands, our 11,000-strong global team, our 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most loved brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale and Mucosolvan.

As a globally certified B Corp company, we are active players in the journey towards healthier people and planet. Find out more about our mission at .
