title: Akkordlønnet pakkeomdeler til PostNord Danmark Holstebro
description:
Vi har brug for dig til vores professionelle pakkeomdeling!

PostNord – den fortrukne leverandør i Norden

I PostNord forbinder vi e-handlerne med forbrugere over hele verden og gør hverdagen lettere for vores kunder. Vi er omkring 24.500 medarbejdere, der hver dag arbejder for at forbinde virksomheder, myndigheder og privatpersoner i hele Norden.

Vi er førende inden for bæredygtig pakkelevering og med vores ekspertise og et veludviklet distributionsnetværk, skaber vi forudsætningerne for fremtidens e-handel og pakkedistribution i de nordiske lande.

Vi arbejder i et spændende marked, der hele tiden udvikler sig og vi ser kompetente og engagerede medarbejdere som vores vigtigste ressource til hurtigt at omstille os og gøre en forskel for vores kunder.

Om jobbet

  • PostNord Holstebro depot ligger på Mads Bjerres Vej 5B, 7500 Holstebro
  • Arbejdet består af pakkeomdeling
  • Arbejdstiden ligger i tidsrummet kl. 07:00 - 15:15
  • Du skal kunne arbejde 3-5 dage om ugen, samt påregne at arbejde lørdage i hver anden uge

Jo flere pakker, des større fortjeneste for dig

Din løn afgøres af det antal pakker, du får ankomstscannet og afleveret.

Kort sagt betyder det, at jo flere pakker, du får i hus, jo mere stiger din fortjeneste.

Uanset, vil du dog være sikret en minimumsløn på 153,10 kr. i timen.

Færdigheder

Vi lægger vægt på, at du er pligtopfyldende og energisk samt trives med højt tempo, ansvar, forandring og nye opgaver. Du brænder for at give vores kunder den aftalte service og kvalitet og er en teamplayer, der værner om respekt og hjælpsomhed i samarbejdet. Det er vigtigt, at du læser, skriver og taler dansk, og har en tilfredsstillende straffeattest. Du skal som minimum være i besiddelse af kørekort B og gerne et varebilschaufføruddannelsesbevis (VUB).

Det tilbyder vi dig

  • Du får ordnede arbejdsforhold og en grundig introduktion, så du kan udføre dit arbejde professionelt.
  • Mennesker med forskellige baggrunde arbejder hos os, så du bliver del af en mangfoldig arbejdsplads.
  • Din ansættelse sker efter Industriens Overenskomst og lokalaftaler med 3F for postarbejdere.
  • Timelønnen er 153,10 kr.
  • Derudover optjenes der en særlig opsparing (Fritvalgspulje) på 10,00 % af den ferieberettigede løn.
  • Pensionen er efter ca. 2 måneders ansættelse på 13 % (arbejdsgiverbetalt pension på 11 % og medarbejderbetalt på 2 %).

Sådan søger du

Udfyld ansøgningen nedenfor.

Har du spørgsmål, så kontakt vores Rekrutteringscenter på tlf. 52 29 18 60. Du kan også læse mere om f.eks. det at arbejde hos PostNord på linket her.

Vi ansætter løbende, så send gerne din ansøgning allerede i dag.

title: Strategic Data & Analytics Engineer (Cloud Data & Agentic Infrastructure)
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Strategic Data & Analytics Engineer (Cloud Data & Agentic Infrastructure) based in United States .

This role sits at the intersection of data engineering, analytics, enterprise architecture, and emerging AI capabilities.
You will design scalable marketing data models, semantic layers, and cloud-native infrastructure that turn complex business needs into actionable systems.
Working directly with clients and business stakeholders, you will translate strategic objectives into robust technical architectures and data solutions.
You will also help organizations prepare their data ecosystems for agentic AI, LLM-driven applications, and autonomous workflows.
The role spans modern cloud platforms, MarTech ecosystems, identity resolution, data integration, governance, and semantic modeling.
You will operate in a consultative, client-facing environment where technical expertise and business understanding are equally important.
This is an opportunity to shape intelligent data infrastructure for major organizations while contributing to the evolution of AI-ready enterprise architectures.

Accountabilities:

  • Partner with business leaders and stakeholders to understand strategic objectives, uncover complex domain requirements, and translate them into scalable data engineering and architecture solutions.
  • Design and maintain enterprise marketing data models, semantic layers, ontologies, and warehouse-native architectures that support analytics, activation, and AI use cases.
  • Architect semantic context layers and data models designed to support LLM-powered applications, autonomous AI agents, tool use, context retrieval, and agentic workflows.
  • Build scalable multi-layer data architectures, including controlled taxonomies, classification hierarchies, standardized metadata, asset tags, and enterprise business glossaries.
  • Develop deterministic and probabilistic identity resolution models and graph-oriented structures to connect customer identities across CRM records, devices, digital touchpoints, and other data sources.
  • Lead cross-system integrations and develop high-performance ingestion and transformation pipelines connecting cloud warehouses, CDPs, MarTech platforms, DAM systems, activation tools, and real-time telemetry.
  • Work with platforms such as Databricks, Snowflake, Salesforce, and Hightouch to create reliable data foundations for analytics and marketing activation.
  • Implement data governance, access controls, cataloging, metadata management, and data-quality practices to support secure self-service analytics and dependable AI execution.
  • Communicate architectural decisions, technical trade-offs, and recommended solutions clearly to executives, business stakeholders, and cross-functional technical teams.
  • Independently manage complex client deliverables within a distributed, fast-paced consulting environment.
  • Stay current with developments in cloud data platforms, modern data stacks, MarTech, semantic technologies, and agentic AI, identifying opportunities to improve client solutions.

    • Requirements:

    • 5+ years of hands-on experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or data architecture, with a track record of building production-grade data pipelines and semantic models.
    • 2+ years of experience in a client-facing, consultative, or strategic leadership capacity, including discovery, requirements gathering, solution design, and stakeholder presentations.
    • Strong consultative and business-oriented mindset, with the ability to translate ambiguous business strategies into clear technical requirements and architectures.
    • Hands-on expertise with modern cloud data platforms, particularly Databricks, Snowflake, or equivalent technologies.
    • Advanced proficiency in SQL, Python/PySpark, data pipeline orchestration, and modern data stack tools such as dbt.
    • Strong understanding of data modeling, including dimensional models, multi-layer or Medallion architectures, identity resolution, hierarchical and graph-like structures, and nested JSON/REST API payloads.
    • Experience with MarTech, Customer Data Platforms, reverse ETL technologies such as Hightouch or Census, CRM ecosystems, and enterprise marketing platforms.
    • Practical understanding of agentic AI, LLM context retrieval, tool use, autonomous workflows, and the implications of AI on data modeling and semantic infrastructure.
    • Strong knowledge of data governance, metadata management, business glossaries, data cataloging, access controls, and enterprise data quality practices.
    • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts and trade-offs to both technical and non-technical audiences.
    • Ability to work autonomously, prioritize effectively, and deliver high-quality results in a remote and distributed environment.
    • Professional Data Engineer or Analytics Engineer certifications in Databricks or Snowflake are preferred.
    • Relevant certifications such as Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional, Databricks Certified Analytics Engineer, SnowPro Core, SnowPro Advanced Architect, or dbt Cloud Developer Certification are advantageous.
    • Current authorization to work in Canada is required.

      • Benefits:

      • Competitive compensation aligned with experience, skills, certifications, and scope of responsibilities.
      • For reference, the published U.S. compensation range for the role is US$120,000–$140,000 per year; Canadian compensation may vary based on location and applicable employment terms.
      • Fully remote work flexibility.
      • Medical, dental, and vision benefits, where applicable.
      • Short-term and long-term disability coverage.
      • Life and AD&D insurance.
      • Flexible Paid Time Off.
      • Additional ancillary benefits and employee perks.
      • Collaborative culture that values diverse perspectives, innovation, and forward-thinking ideas.
      • Opportunity to work on high-impact data, marketing technology, cloud, and AI initiatives for enterprise clients.
      • Exposure to emerging agentic AI and modern cloud data architectures.
      • Professional environment that encourages autonomy, strategic thinking, and measurable client impact.
      • Accessibility accommodations are available throughout the selection process upon request.
      • No relocation assistance is currently available.

title: Studio Coordinator - Adams Morgan
description:
OUR PEOPLE POWER OUR PURPOSE

The CorePower team is the heartbeat of the company. We prioritize our people first, and we are invested the employee experience so that together we can create an experience powerful enough to transform lives, including our own. We believe in the power of human connection, community, and going beyond the transactional to make a positive difference in people’s lives. Join our team and discover what happens when you ignite your intention to make a difference.

HOW WE SHOW UP

We are fiercely committed to our core values of empowering everyone, practicing gratitude, building community, growing forward and laughing together. These core values align us in service of CorePower’s higher purpose – to power love from the inside out. They are our guiding principles; internal agreements we make as a CorePower team about how we interact with each other and our students. Living our core values means they guide all our activities, define our workplace culture, and ensure there are no missed opportunities to fulfill our higher purpose.

We embrace our differences and foster an inclusive space where everyone can reach their full potential. We uplift, inspire and guide one another. We make time to share the power of yoga together, celebrate milestones and find joy in the present moment.

ROLE SUMMARY

As a Studio Coordinator (SC), you live your power by supporting the world class CorePower Yoga studio experience including coordinating studio operations and holding the studio to the highest health and safety standards. In alignment with our Core Values, you work alongside the Studio Manager to deliver results and sustained growth towards all current company and studio-level goals. In the SC role, you will learn the business and develop the skillset to operate a studio.

Studio Presence and Guiding the Student Experience

  • Act as an ambassador of the CorePower Yoga Core Values at all times and consistently inspire these values in others

  • Support the Studio Manager in achieving company and studio level goals, including membership growth, retail sales, community outreach, teacher and SET recruitment, and programming enrollment

  • Commit to flexible schedule of 18-29 hours per week in studio in support of operations coordination and teaching (if certified), include health and safety protocol execution, front desk guidance, and team support

  • Must be flexible with schedule availability within the hourly commitment in service of the studio and team

  • Responsibly run the studio, including by acting as the point of contact for students and staff when Studio Manager is not present, up to 20 hours per week

  • Support maintaining an appropriate level of studio supply inventory so that all provisions and amenities are available for students at all times including cleanliness inventory, locker room amenities, towels, programming materials, etc.

  • Engage and know your studio community consistently; greet students by name, serve as an ambassador of yoga both inside and outside of the studio, and spend quality time at the front desk fostering community

  • Support our teachers learning experience of working the POS and other pre/post class duties

Coordinate and Execute Health, Safety and Cleanliness Protocol in the Studio​

  • Uphold high standards for the studio and when on duty, ensure that the physical studio space meets the high CPY standards of cleanliness and functionality including a safe environment, optimum heat and humidity, inspiring music, and clean and clutter-free surroundings in all areas of the studio

  • Support communication around Smart Health Protocol to students upon entry and throughout their visit at CPY ​

  • Act as an extension of the Studio Experience Team (SET) including cleaning the studio, stocking amenities, and ensuring the CPY cleanliness protocol is always followed while on duty in the studio

  • Support the SET team by interviewing SET applicants, hiring SET employees, scheduling SET employee's shifts, stepping in for no call/no shows, training, and disciplining/terminating SET employees who have violated CPY's policies and standards

  • Lead Orientation for new Studio Experience Team members and train them on cleanliness protocol and role expectations

Coordinate Studio Systems

  • Act as a liaison between the Studio Manager and the teaching and SET teams in training, communicating, and coordinating studio operational systems including but not limited to:

  • Point of Sales System (POS); understand and efficiently navigate POS to sign students in, sell packages and memberships, and explore and correct problems with student accounts when at the desk

  • Online Reservation System; support administrative follow up of late cancel fees, waitlist, student support, etc

  • Subbing Application; support training and usage for teaching team

  • HRIS Application; support training and usage for teaching and SET team

  • Help Desk; Submit facilities tickets when on duty ​and communicate follow up needs to Studio Manager

Teaching Schedule

  • Support the studio class schedule by teaching a minimum of 6 classes per week of branded CorePower Yoga classes and support the studio through subbing additional classes as needed

SKILLS & EXPERIENCE

  • Must demonstrate CorePower Yoga Core Value

  • Excellent oral communication skills, professionalism and exceptional interpersonal skills are required

  • Experience in Customer Service required

  • Completion of a Yoga Alliance certified 200-hour program is preferred

  • Yoga Sculpt teacher training is preferred

  • Familiar and comfortable in studio systems such as the HRIS, intranet, point of sale systems, company scheduling and payroll systems, etc.

  • Ability to build relationships with individuals with diverse personalities and styles and at different levels of seniority

  • Thrives in a fast-paced environment and can prioritize while working under multiple deadlines

  • Proven self-starter with ability to take on new projects with enthusiasm

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office products: Outlook, Word, PowerPoint, Excel

  • Excellent Time Management skills

  • Ability to take initiative and prioritize

  • College (BA/BS) preferred

THE FINE PRINT

  • Availability must match the needs of the business and leadership zig-zag schedules – morning, evening, weekend and some holiday availability and flexibility required

  • Must be able to move around the studio space, crouch, reach, and lift up to 25 lbs.

  • If certified to teach, must be able to step in to teach class with little to no notice while scheduled in the studio

COMPENSATION

  • $25.00 per hour

THE PERKS

  • Free All Access Membership - use anytime, in studio or online

  • Free All Access Membership for a Plus One - bring someone along!

  • Retail Discounts

  • Continued Education Offerings

  • Access to Employee Assistance Program (EAP)

  • 1.5x Holiday Pay: Earn time-and-a-half pay for hours worked on New Year’s Day, Thanksgiving Day, and Christmas Day.

WHO WE ARE

At CorePower Yoga, we live our power by showing the world the incredible life-changing things that happen when you root an intensely physical workout in the mindfulness of yoga. This is our promise. We are the nation’s largest yoga studio brand with over 200 locations across the country, digital livestream and on-demand classes, and thousands of passionate yoga teachers sharing the transformative power of our practice.

As a team, we love seeing the magic that happens in a CorePower Yoga class when physical meets mindful and strive to create a work environment that mirrors the balance, empowerment and community experienced in our yoga studios.

This job description is not necessarily an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, skills, duties, requirements, efforts, or working conditions associated with the job. While this is intended to be an accurate reflection of the current job, we reserve the right to revise the job or to require that other or different tasks be performed. CorePower Yoga is an equal opportunity employer of all qualified individuals, including minorities, BIPOC, LGBTQ+, veterans & individuals with disabilities.

CorePower Yoga provides reasonable accommodation and/or modification to disabled individuals to assist in the application process. Any individual requiring accommodation/modification to complete this application should contact Human Resources at help.corepoweryoga.com.

title: Medical Science Liaison/Senior Medical Science Liaison
description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Medical Science Liaison/Senior Medical Science Liaison based in United States.

This field-based Medical Affairs role offers the opportunity to serve as a trusted scientific partner across the autoimmune disease and cell therapy landscape.
You will build meaningful relationships with healthcare professionals, investigators, treatment centers, and key opinion leaders across an assigned territory.
The role combines scientific exchange, territory strategy, clinical trial support, and the collection of actionable medical insights.
You will help communicate complex clinical and scientific information while supporting evidence generation and clinical development activities.
Working closely with Medical Affairs, Clinical Development, Clinical Operations, and other cross-functional teams, you will help translate field insights into strategic action.
The position is particularly suited to a scientifically driven professional who thrives in a fast-paced biotechnology environment and enjoys working independently in the field.
The role is ideally based in Southern California, Arizona, Nevada, or Utah and involves approximately 50–70% travel.

Accountabilities:

  • Build and maintain high-quality scientific relationships with KOLs, investigators, academic medical centers, community physicians, pharmacists, nurses, and specialty treatment centers within the assigned territory.
  • Provide fair-balanced, accurate, and compliant scientific exchange on autoimmune diseases, treatment landscapes, cell therapy, and emerging clinical data.
  • Serve as a scientific resource for investigators and support discussions related to clinical research collaborations and investigator-initiated research in accordance with applicable policies.
  • Develop and execute territory-specific Medical Affairs and KOL engagement strategies, including stakeholder mapping, prioritization, and proactive engagement planning.
  • Collaborate with Clinical Development and Clinical Operations to support clinical trials, including identifying potential sites, engaging investigators, supporting trial awareness, and contributing to enrollment and feasibility efforts.
  • Capture, synthesize, and communicate high-quality medical insights that can inform medical strategy, evidence planning, clinical development, and other business decisions.
  • Partner effectively with Medical Affairs and cross-functional teams, including Regulatory Affairs, Commercial, Market Access, Patient Services, Clinical Development, and Clinical Operations, while maintaining appropriate non-promotional boundaries.
  • Represent the organization at congresses, advisory boards, investigator meetings, medical education forums, and other scientific events.
  • Respond appropriately to unsolicited medical information requests and remain current on therapeutic developments, treatment guidelines, clinical research, and cell therapy operations.
  • Complete CRM documentation, administrative activities, required training, and pharmacovigilance responsibilities, including adverse event and product complaint reporting.
  • Ensure all field activities are conducted in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, ethical standards, and organizational policies.

    • Requirements:

    • Advanced scientific or clinical degree required, such as MD, PharmD, PhD, DNP, NP, PA, or equivalent.
    • For the MSL level, a doctorate degree or a master’s degree combined with at least 3 years of Medical Affairs experience is required.
    • For the Senior MSL level, a doctorate degree plus at least 2 years of Medical Affairs experience, or a master’s degree plus at least 6 years of Medical Affairs experience, is required.
    • Prior experience in cell therapy, CAR-T, immunology, rheumatology, nephrology, neurology, hematology/oncology, rare diseases, or another closely related specialty is strongly preferred.
    • Strong understanding of clinical trial design, clinical development, Medical Affairs functions, and the broader healthcare ecosystem.
    • Experience engaging academic medical centers, specialty treatment centers, infusion centers, investigators, or other complex healthcare stakeholders is preferred.
    • Ability to interpret and communicate sophisticated scientific and clinical information effectively to diverse audiences.
    • Excellent presentation, written, verbal, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills.
    • Demonstrated ability to collaborate across functions while exercising sound scientific judgment and maintaining appropriate compliance boundaries.
    • Experience supporting pre-commercial or launch-stage biotechnology organizations is highly valued.
    • Knowledge of autoimmune disease treatment landscapes and emerging cell therapy approaches is preferred.
    • Experience supporting investigator-sponsored research, clinical trial recruitment, or site engagement initiatives is beneficial.
    • Familiarity with cell therapy operational concepts, including chain of identity, chain of custody, and treatment center workflows, is advantageous.
    • Comfortable working independently in a dynamic, high-growth environment and managing priorities across a broad geographic territory.
    • Willingness and ability to travel extensively, with approximately 50–70% travel expected.

      • Benefits:

      • MSL salary range: $170,000–$185,000 USD annually.
      • Senior MSL salary range: $190,000–$210,000 USD annually.
      • Actual compensation may vary based on education, experience, tenure, skills, abilities, internal equity, and relevant market data.
      • Eligibility for a performance-based bonus.
      • Participation in a company stock plan.
      • Comprehensive employee benefits.
      • Remote, field-based work arrangement.
      • Opportunity to contribute to innovative clinical-stage cell therapy programs addressing significant unmet needs in autoimmune disease.
      • High-impact role with exposure to Medical Affairs, clinical development, research, and cross-functional strategic initiatives.

title: Myyjä 10h/vko, Joensuu
description:
Myyjä Joensuun Mustiin ja Mirriin 10 h/vko

Musti Group on Pohjoismaiden johtava lemmikkieläinhoidon asiantuntija, joka toimii Suomessa, Ruotsissa ja Norjassa, sekä vuodesta 2024 lähtien myös Baltiassa. Missiomme on tehdä lemmikkien ja lemmikkivanhempien elämästä hauskempaa, turvallisempaa ja vaivattomampaa läpi lemmikin elämän. Haluamme olla asiakkaillemme täyden palvelun tuotetarjoaja ja toimija – sekä fyysisesti että digitaalisesti. Uskomme, että täyden palvelun ekosysteemi tarjoaa ainutlaatuisen arvolupauksen, joka parantaa ja vahvistaa hyviä asiakassuhteita ja erottaa meidät kilpailijoista.

Musti-konsernin liikevaihto oli 561 miljoonaa euroa tilikaudella 2024 (15 kk).
Yhtiöllä oli tilikauden 2024 lopussa 2 178 työntekijää, 1,9 miljoonaa asiakasta ja 415 myymälää.

Millaista on myyjän työ Mustissa ja Mirrissä?

"Musti ja Mirri ei ole kuin mikä tahansa kauppa, vaan eläinihmisten kohtaamispaikka. Asiakkaiden pulmien ratkominen on äärimmäisen palkitsevaa. Minulla on ilo ja kunnia olla tukena nelijalkaisten asiakkaideni arjessa – sillä jokainen kuono on loistavan palvelun arvoinen.

Voin päästää luovuuteni valloilleen luomalla uusia esillepanoja tai päivittämällä myymälän sometilejä. Mikäli haluan skipata kuntosalin tällä(kin) viikolla, nappaan vastuun isoimpien ruokasäkkien hyllyttämisestä. Kun haluan haastaa itseäni, otan hoitaakseni myymälätapahtuman järjestämisen. Mustissa ja Mirrissä mahdollisuudet ovat rajattomat ja jokainen idea on esittämisen arvoinen. "

- Manta, Mustin ja Mirrin myyjä

Lue lisää myymälätyöstä täältä

Mustilla ja Mirrillä myyjän työhön kuuluu muun muassa

  • Asiakaslähtöinen ja myyntihenkinen asiakaspalvelu

  • Myymälän siisteydestä ja konseptin noudattamisesta huolehtiminen

  • Kuormien vastaanottaminen ja tuotteiden hyllytys

  • Esillepanojen rakentaminen

  • Myymäläpalveluiden (mm. kynnenleikkuu, pentutreffit ja MustiEskari) vetäminen

Odotamme sinulta

  • Iloista asiakaspalveluasennetta

  • Itsenäistä työotetta ja organisointikykyä

  • Kiinnostusta kaupan alaa ja asiakaspalvelua kohtaan

  • Kykyä tarttua myös myymälän fyysisiin työtehtäviin

  • Joustavuutta työskennellä myymälän kaikkina aukioloaikoina, myös iltaisin ja viikonloppuisin

  • Joustavuutta työskennellä seudun kaikissa myymälöissä tarvittaessa

Myyjänä haluat omalta osaltasi edistää iloista ja kannustavaa työilmapiiriä. Omakohtainen kokemus lemmikkien kanssa harrastamisesta katsotaan eduksi, mutta meillä asenne ratkaisee! Aikaisempi työkokemus myynnistä ja asiakaspalvelusta katsotaan eduksi.

Edellytämme myyjiltämme vähintään 18 vuoden ikää.

Miksi kannattaa liittyä Mustilaumaan?

Vastassa sinulla on motivoitunut, positiivinen ja huippuhauska työyhteisö. Tarjoamme sinulle kattavat henkilöstöedut, muun muassa

  • Kulttuuri- ja liikuntaetu

  • Kilpailukykyiset henkilökunta-alennukset

  • Palkallinen pentuvapaa

  • Kaupan- ja lemmikkialan koulutusta

  • Laadukas työterveyshuolto

Lisäksi heilutamme häntää urapoluille – Musti ja Mirri tarjoaa mielenkiintoisia kehittymismahdollisuuksia organisaation sisällä (katso uratarinoita). Meillä kohtaat työssäsi paljon karvaisia asiakkaita ja lähes kaikkiin toimipisteisiimme voit tuoda oman nelijalkaisesi mukaan töihin.

Kaikissa toimipisteissämme on päivittäin lemmikkejä, joten työ ei välttämättä sovi lemmikkiallergiselle. Työsuhteeseen sovelletaan kaupan työehtosopimusta.

Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan. Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa myymäläpäällikkö Julia Kuivalainen, soittoajat to 3.9. klo 15-16 ja to 10.9. klo 15-16 / puh. 050 388 2503

title: 2027 Oliver Wyman – Entry-level Consultant - Portuguese speaker (m/f/d) – Madrid
description:
Company:

Oliver Wyman

Description:

Who we are

Oliver Wyman is a global management consulting firm. We work with clients through their most defining moments, combining deep industry knowledge, specialized expertise, and the power of perspective to help them adapt, grow, and thrive.

We believe diverse perspectives make the work stronger. Our consultants bring different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of thinking to help solve complex problems and create lasting impact for clients, colleagues, and communities.

At Oliver Wyman, we are proud of the values that we aspire to live by. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment where everyone can thrive and reach their full potential.

What you will do

  • As a member of your project team you’ll work alongside colleagues of all levels and clients worldwide to solve complex problems and drive meaningful change.

  • You’ll have the opportunity to work across our industries and capabilities, with the flexibility to specialize early or explore different areas before choosing a path.

  • You’ll build core consulting skills from the start, including how to structure your work, communicate clearly, contribute to team problem-solving, and manage your priorities.

Why join us?

You can be your best here. At Oliver Wyman, you will find meaningful work, talented people, and a culture built on trust, support, and growth.

Create solutions that have impact

  • Work on challenging projects that help clients solve complex problems, make better decisions, and create meaningful impact.

  • Have the opportunity to work across different industries, capabilities, and cultures, contributing to work that has lasting impact for clients, industries, and society.

  • Be part of teams that measure success not just by deliverables, but by the difference created together.

Develop as a leader

  • From day one, be encouraged to take initiative, ask questions, and bring your perspective to the work.

  • Learn how to structure problems, communicate clearly, and contribute to team discussions and client conversations.

  • As you grow, you’ll have opportunities to build confidence, take on more responsibility, and develop the skills to unlock the potential of others.

Learn and grow without limits

  • Learn on the job and through formal training, developing core skills in communication, presentation, analytics, problem-solving, and client management.

  • Each project will give you new opportunities to learn from specialists, broaden your perspective, and build momentum in your career.

  • You’ll have support around you as you grow, including a dedicated buddy, a career advisor, your talent manager, and communities that help you find your place.

Thrive in a vibrant and inclusive culture

  • Work with genuine colleagues who stand by their beliefs, collaborate across differences, and support one another.

  • Be part of an open, inclusive, and down-to-earth culture where diverse perspectives strengthen the work.

  • Connect with colleagues through employee resource groups, office communities, and social activities.

Experience rewards that work for you

  • We believe in flexibility, including hybrid working, and in helping colleagues build sustainable careers.

Who can apply?

We do not require specific academic majors or industry experience; we value diversity of experience and skills, extracurricular activities, and evidence of leading an interesting and impactful life outside of your studies.

  • Language skills: Portuguese and English (native/fluent).

How to apply?

Please submit your CV, cover letter and transcripts. If you would like to find out more information about Oliver Wyman, please visit our website or alternatively, apply to attend one of our events, details of which can be found here.

What to expect during the interviews process?

At Oliver Wyman, we want you to shine in your interview. Our process is designed like our work environment — it’s challenging, exciting, and fun.

With a mix of conversational and case interviews, our approach not only helps us to get to know you better, understanding your strengths and interests, but it also enables you to learn more about our people and our business.

If you want to learn more about consulting interviews and start your preparation, please visit our careers page:

Oliver Wyman is a business of Marsh (NYSE: MRSH), a global leader in risk, reinsurance and capital, people and investments, and management consulting, advising clients in 130 countries. title: Professional Coding Supervisor
description:
When you join the growing BILH team, you're not just taking a job, you’re making a difference in people’s lives.

Under the direction of the Director/Associate Director of Coding and the Manager of Coding, the Supervisor of Coding and Education will manage the Coding staff for daily workflow, communication, and education of coding guidelines. The Supervisor will monitor and report on coding work for quality, productivity, and compliance. The Coding Manager will work to ensure proper coding following CMS and appropriate regulatory coding guidelines for quality and compliance. Provides orientation and training to staff and performs a variety of tasks associated with the day-to-day supervision.

Job Description:

Essential Duties & Responsibilities including but not limited to:

1. Assist the manager in working with staff to ensure compliance of, and proper coding technique as defined by CMS regulations, Local Medicare Review Policies (LMRPs), Local Carrier Determinations (LCDs), the AMA, and any applicable Beth Israel Lahey Health (BILH) compliance policies, and/or any relevant accrediting organizations. Provides ongoing coding education as well as new coder education on proper coding and documentation.
2. Supervise coding staff for the coding division on day-to-day operations, under the guidance of the manager and the director/associate director department policies enforces policies and procedures.
3. Works with the manager to review all revenue cycle relevant workflows, including coding, charge review, internal and external audits, as well as denials.
4. Provides analysis on productivity and impact of coding activities.
5. Provides and organizes training for staff and new hires.
6. Assists management in departmental reporting requirements.
7. Assists management with special projects as needed.
8. Works with the Manager to analyze coding denials and patient inquiries and works in conjunction with coding staff and PFS to implement recommended corrections.
9. Assists the Manager in ensuring that the Coding staff conducts physician-coding audits and assists in communicating results and recommendations.
10. Assists the Manager in ensuring that the Coding staff conducts new physician orientation and ongoing physician training and documentation improvement as needed.
11. Maintains and reviews department workflow documentation and training materials.
12. Consults with the Director/Associate Director and/or other leaders to resolve problems, such as equipment performance, output quality, and work schedules.
13. Participates in a broad range of human resources functions as they relate to assigned staff, including interviewing, selection, training, performance appraisal, competence assessment, documentation, and employee relations.
14. Evaluates the job performance of assigned staff and recommends appropriate personnel action where needed.

Minimum Qualifications:

Education:

High School Diploma or equivalent

Licensure, Certification & Registration:

Coding Certificate from College Level Coding Program (or equivalent), and CPC, CCS-P, COC, or CCS required.

Experience:

  • Minimum of three (3) years of coding experience or related revenue cycle field in a high-volume practice/hospital/system setting.

Skills, Knowledge & Abilities:

  • Demonstrated thorough knowledge of professional or hospital coding standards, including CPT and ICD-10 CM coding.
  • Excellent customer service skills.
  • Excellent written and oral communication and interpersonal skills required.
  • Ability to utilize tact, diplomacy, and discretion at all times.

  • Practical knowledge of EHR and billing systems.

$77,938.00 USD - $104,894.00 USD

The work you’ll do at GDIT will be impactful to the mission of US Strategic Command (USSTRATCOM). title: Product Manager
description:
Do you get energy from turning customer problems into a roadmap and measuring the impact together with a team full of motivation that remembers to have fun?

If you're a proactive, pragmatic Product Manager who thinks a few steps ahead, works fluently with designers and engineers, and brings a bit of fun to the work along the way, the Product Manager role at TBAuctions might be for you.

About the role

You will join the buyer-facing (B2B and B2C) side of our auction platforms, e.g. . Our goal is to create a great customer experience across the full buyer journey, from discovering an item to placing a bid, to winning and paying. You'll own product work that spans multiple brands and regions across Europe.

What you will do

• Own and shape parts of the Storefront product roadmap across Troostwijk, Vavato and Surplex, and decide where to invest based on data and what customers actually need

• Think in journeys, not features: follow the buyer from finding an item through bidding, winning and paying, and improve the moments that matter most

• Work hand in hand with design and engineering across discovery, definition, delivery and validation — you co-create, you don't hand off

• Run discovery to understand the real problem before jumping to solutions, and turn what you learn into a clear, sequenced plan

• Partner with data, marketing, CRM and commercial teams to align on direction and keep everyone in the loop on priorities

• Balance new improvements against keeping platforms already live across multiple brands and regions stable and fast

What you bring

You're proactive in thinking ahead and act early, you see what's coming for the customer and start moving before anyone asks you to. You're pragmatic about it, too: you know the difference between what moves the needle now and what can wait, and you're happy to make that call with data and customer input rather than waiting for perfect certainty. You bring energy and a bit of fun to the team, and you do your best work with people, design and engineering are your partners from day one, not a team you hand tasks to.

title: Elektromonteur Zwembadinstallaties
description:
Groei mee met Lotec – specialist in zwembadtechniek

Bij Lotec Zwembadtechniek werken we dagelijks aan innovatieve en duurzame waterbehandelingsinstallaties voor zwembaden. Met meer dan 350 tevreden klanten in de Benelux zijn onze installaties en service niet meer weg te denken uit de wereld van professionele zwembaden. Wat begon als een kleinschalig loodgietersbedrijf is uitgegroeid tot een stabiel en ambitieus bedrijf met ruim 80 collega’s, verdeeld over drie vestigingen in Nederland en België. En we blijven groeien!

Daarom zoeken we een gedreven Elektromonteur Zwembadinstallaties die verantwoordelijk wordt voor het installeren, inbedrijfstellen én onderhouden van onze elektrotechnische installaties.

Wat we je bieden:

  • Een basissalaris tussen €3.500,- en €4.600,- bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur per week. Uiteraard wordt jouw exacte salaris afgestemd op jouw kennis, achtergrond en ervaring;

  • Secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens de cao Technisch Installatiebedrijf. Denk hierbij aan 25 verlofdagen, 13 ADV-dagen, pensioenopbouw bij het pensioenfonds PMT;

  • Een jaarcontract met de intentie die om te zetten naar een vaste aanstelling;

  • Alle basisvoorwaarden die je nodig hebt om jouw werk succesvol te kunnen doen, zoals een laptop, telefoon en werkbus;

  • De mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Zowel binnen Lotec, maar ook breder binnen (de bedrijven van) de VDK Groep;

  • Een informele, gezellige werksfeer met regelmatig leuke uitjes, zoals het VDK familiefeest in Phantasialand en diverse personeelsfeesten.

Wat je gaat doen:

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het installeren, inbedrijfstellen en onderhouden van onze besturingssystemen op klantlocatie. Dit zijn voornamelijk gemeentelijke of publiekstoegankelijke zwembaden.

Naast het inbedrijfstellen zorg je voor service en onderhoud, zodat de goede werking van onze installaties gegarandeerd blijft. Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor onze klant op het gebied van (complexe) storingen en instrueert hen over het juiste gebruik van de systemen en installaties.

Je hebt regelmatig contact met onze toeleveranciers van besturingstechniek en adviseert hen over de toepassing van de software in de praktijk.

Wat neem je mee?

Als Elektromonteur Zwembadinstallaties heb je werkervaring met industriële elektrotechnische installaties en ben je gemotiveerd om jezelf verder te verdiepen in de installatietechniek. Je beschikt over mbo werk- en denkniveau. Bij voorkeur heb je een technische opleiding afgerond, in de richting van mechatronica, industriële automatisering of elektrotechniek. Affiniteit met GBS-systemen, Siemens-apparatuur en Siemens programeeromgevingen is een pré.

Omdat je veel op projectlocaties werkt, beschik je over een rijbewijs. Je bent klantgericht, oplossingsgericht en flexibel ingesteld, ook als dat betekent dat je soms buiten reguliere werktijden moet bijspringen.

Verder ben je representatief, servicegericht en communicatief vaardig. Eigenschappen die jou tot een uitstekend visitekaartje van Lotec maken.


Waar je het gaat doen:

Lotec is al jarenlang dé specialist op het gebied van zwembadtechniek. Wat in 1843 begon als traditioneel loodgietersbedrijf, is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een Europees speler van formaat, met drie vestigingen in twee landen. We beschikken over een team van zo’n 80 specialisten, verdeeld over de vestigingen in Eindhoven, Twello en Heverlee (België).

Als onderdeel van de snelgroeiende VDK Groep (150 bedrijven, 7.000 medewerkers) bieden we een unieke combinatie, die je nergens anders vindt. Zo combineren we de voordelen van een hecht team met de expertise en doorgroeimogelijkheden van een grote, landelijke organisatie.

Heb je interesse?

Aarzel niet en neem direct contact op met Bart Bongers, Recruitment Business Partner van de VDK Groep. Dit kan door te bellen of te appen naar 06-83072445 of te mailen naar b.bongers@vdkinstallatiegroep.nl.

#VDKGROEPElektrotechniek

title: Product Manager
description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.


The Role

Your role
As a Product Manager, you will own the direction and success of a product from strategy through delivery and ongoing evolution. Your focus will be on translating customer needs and business priorities into a clear roadmap, aligning teams around outcomes, and ensuring the product delivers measurable value. Your work will balance strategic planning with hands-on collaboration across design, engineering, delivery, sales, and marketing.

What you will do
•Define and maintain the product strategy, vision, and roadmap aligned to customer needs and business goals
•Gather, analyze, and prioritize product requirements using customer feedback, data, and market insights
•Translate requirements into clear user stories and backlog items that teams can deliver against
•Partner closely with UX, engineering, delivery, sales, and marketing to ensure shared understanding and execution
•Make trade-off decisions on scope, timing, and priorities based on value, risk, and dependencies
•Track product performance using agreed metrics and use insights to inform continuous improvement
•Support product launches and lifecycle activities, ensuring readiness across stakeholders
•Communicate product direction, progress, and outcomes to internal stakeholders in a clear and consistent way


Who You Are

Required skills and experience

•Experience owning or contributing to product strategy, roadmaps, and feature prioritization
•Hands-on experience gathering, documenting, and prioritizing product requirements
•Experience working with cross-functional teams including design, engineering, and delivery
•Ability to use data, customer feedback, and market signals to inform product decisions
•Experience working in Agile or iterative delivery environments
•Clear written and verbal communication skills focused on product outcomes and decisions

Preferred skills and experience

•Experience managing products across the full lifecycle from concept to launch and optimization
•Familiarity with UX research and usability practices
•Experience supporting go-to-market or product launch activities
•Background in technology-enabled products or services
•Experience working with enterprise or B2B customers


Being You

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.


What You Can Expect

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

From your very first day, you’ll dive into impactful work that powers the systems our customers rely on every day. You won’t just contribute—you’ll make a difference, tackling meaningful projects that sharpen your skills and fuel your growth.

We’re here to champion your journey. With powerful tools to chart your career path, personalized development goals aligned with your ambitions, and continuous feedback to keep you inspired and on track, you’ll have everything you need to thrive and evolve. You’ll develop in-demand skills to grow your career and achieve your ambitions with access to cutting-edge learning opportunities—from certifications with Microsoft, Google, and Amazon to coaching and hands-on experiences. And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.

Get Referred!

If you know someone that works at Kyndryl, when asked ‘How Did You Hear About Us’ during the application process, select ‘Employee Referral’ and enter your contact's Kyndryl email address.

title: Equity Research Associate Intern Summer 2027 -Tokyo
description:
Job Description:

The Role

Looking for a best-in-class opportunity to obtain hands-on experience with fundamental analysis and the investment research process? The Equity Research Associate internship program gives interns the chance to obtain and develop the core research skills needed to jumpstart a successful and lucrative career in investment management. The program is led by our director of research, and each intern will be paired with a peer in the research department who will mentor them throughout the summer.

Throughout the 10-week program, interns will support real investment decisions by:

  • Conducting autonomous research on three stocks across different sub-sectors.

  • Building financial models, completing financial analysis, and conducting proprietary research.

  • Communicating with corporate management teams, industry experts, and Wall Street analysts, to develop investment recommendations for our funds.

  • Collaborating with fellow interns and utilizing the vast network of Fidelity managing directors of research, analysts and portfolio managers.

  • Pitching stock recommendations to internal portfolio managers.

The Expertise and Skills You Bring

We are seeking candidates who have the following characteristics:

  • Class of 2028 Bachelor’s degree candidates

  • Proven academic success with a preferred GPA of 3.2 or higher

  • Conversational Japanese preferred

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills

  • Proactive, seeks additional responsibilities and learning opportunities

  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills

  • Demonstrated expertise using Excel

  • Highly motivated independent problem solvers, ability to think outside of the box and bring a unique perspective

  • High levels of integrity

  • Demonstrated initiative and intellectual interest in studies/extracurricular activities related to the financial markets

  • Ability to work well under pressure and time constraints

The Team

Fidelity Investments has long been a leader in managing equity portfolios, with roots dating back to the 1940s. Fidelity’s Equity division is responsible for managing diversified and industry-specific funds for millions of investors. The division consists of portfolio managers, research analysts, research associates, sector specialists, and traders who work together to deliver exceptional investment outcomes. Over the years, its capabilities have grown substantially, with investment strategies designed across style, capitalization, sector, and geography.

The Equity team relies on its proprietary research, disciplined portfolio management, and sophisticated trading process to evaluate, construct, and manage investment portfolios and deliver superior long-term results.

Fidelity’s Asset Management Internship Program

As a participant in Fidelity’s Asset Management internship program, you will gain hands-on training, receive mentorship from investment professionals, and contribute to meaningful projects and key deliverables. High-performing interns may be considered for a full-time opportunity upon graduation in our Tokyo office.

June 7, 2027 - August 13, 2027

Language Requirement

English & Japanese (preferred)

Location

Tokyo

Application Deadline

September 11, 2026

title: Verpleegkundige GGZ, Heesch
description:
Heesch 24 uur €3.180 - €4.273 per maand Ouderenpsychiatrie Op locatie

Werken met ouderen in de GGZ, in een combinatie van begeleid wonen en ambulante zorg.
Met regelmatige werktijden, geen reguliere nachtdiensten en vooral: ruimte om echt aandacht te hebben voor de cliënt.

Dit maakt werken als verpleegkundige bij GGZ Oost Brabant bijzonder

  • Je combineert begeleid wonen en ambulant werken binnen één functie

  • Je werkt met een kleinschalige groep ouderen met psychiatrische problematiek

  • Je hebt regelmatige werktijden en draait geen reguliere nachtdiensten

  • Je ondersteunt cliënten bij zoveel mogelijk zelfstandigheid, structuur en kwaliteit van leven

Je kunt rekenen op:

  • Direct een dienstverband voor onbepaalde tijd

  • Een bruto maandsalaris tussen de € 3.180,- en € 4.273,- o.b.v. 36 uur (cao GGZ, FWG 45)

  • Tegemoetkoming in de reiskosten woon-werkverkeer. Voor dienstreizen ontvang je € 0,50 per kilometer!

  • Een volledige 13e maand (8,33% van je bruto jaarsalaris) en jaarlijks €1000 balansbudget om in te zetten voor opleiden, extra verlof of extra salaris

  • Een goede pensioenregeling via PFZW (Pensioenfonds Zorg & Welzijn), FiscFree, TicketsforGood en meer! Lees hier meer over onze aantrekkelijke arbeidsvoorwaarden!

Jouw rol als verpleegkundige

Als verpleegkundige binnen team Heelwijk begeleid je ouderen met psychiatrische problematiek in hun dagelijks leven. Je werkt deels vanuit onze begeleide woonvorm in Heesch en deels ambulant bij cliënten thuis in de regio.

Je bent er op de momenten die ertoe doen. Je voert gesprekken, ondersteunt waar nodig en houdt goed in de gaten hoe het met iemand gaat. Verandert gedrag of stemming? Dan signaleer je dit en stem je af met je collega's en andere betrokken disciplines.

Je werkt herstelgericht en kijkt steeds naar wat iemand zelf kan en wil blijven doen. Niet overnemen als dat niet nodig is, maar ondersteunen waar dat wél helpt. Je werkt op regelmatige tijden: doordeweeks van 08.00 tot 16.30 uur en roulerend in het weekend van 08.00 tot 12.00 uur.

Jouw taken op een rij

  • Je begeleidt cliënten bij het dagelijks leven en ondersteunt waar nodig

  • Je voert begeleidings- en verpleegkundige gesprekken

  • Je signaleert veranderingen in gedrag, stemming en functioneren

  • Je werkt herstelgericht, onder andere vanuit de IRB-methodiek

  • Je hebt contact met cliënten op de woonlocatie én bij hen thuis

  • Je stemt af met collega's en andere betrokken disciplines

  • Je draagt bij aan structuur, zelfstandigheid en kwaliteit van leven

  • Je werk is afwisselend: de ene dag werk je vooral vanuit Heelwijk, de andere dag ben je onderweg naar cliënten in de regio.

Samen sterk, maak kennis met je werkplek en het team

Je werkt vanuit Heelwijk in Heesch, een kleinschalige begeleide woonvorm waar 10 cliënten van 55 jaar en ouder zelfstandig wonen. Daarnaast begeleidt het team cliënten ambulant binnen een straal van ongeveer 15 tot 20 kilometer rondom Heesch.

De doelgroep bestaat uit ouderen met psychiatrische problematiek, waaronder ernstige psychiatrische aandoeningen (EPA). De nadruk ligt niet alleen op klachten, maar juist op wat iemand nodig heeft om zo zelfstandig mogelijk te leven en kwaliteit van leven te behouden of te versterken.

Je werkt samen met verpleegkundigen, agogisch opgeleide collega's en een zorgassistent. Daarnaast is er ondersteuning vanuit onder andere een psychiater, SPV en huisarts.

De samenwerking is open, praktisch en betrokken. We kennen onze cliënten goed, zoeken elkaar gemakkelijk op en kijken samen wat er nodig is.

Op weg naar een mentaal sterke samenleving. Lees hier meer over de missie, visie en koers van GGZ Oost Brabant.

Dit breng je mee

  • Een diploma Verpleegkunde niveau 4 en BIG-geregistreerd

  • Ervaring met of affiniteit met psychiatrie; ervaring met EPA is een pre

  • Interesse in herstelgericht werken

  • Een rijbewijs en eigen vervoer vanwege het ambulante deel van je werk

  • Beschikbaar om op maandag, dinsdag en woensdag te werken

Zo werk jij: je bent nieuwsgierig en hebt de moed om (de juiste) keuzes te maken. Met je daadkracht bereik je resultaten. En je bent steeds verbindend omdat we het samen doen.

Goed om te weten

Je werkt op regelmatige tijden (ma/di/wo): doordeweeks van 08.00 tot 16.30 uur en roulerend in het weekend van 08.00 tot 12.00 uur. Naast je reguliere diensten draai je ongeveer vier keer per jaar een bereikbaarheidsdienstweek. Hiervoor werk je samen met teams in Uden en Veghel.

Heb je interesse of wil je eerst meer weten?

Reageren kan tot uiterlijk zolang de vacature online staat. Gesprekken worden gepland in de week van 7 september t/m 13 september. Solliciteer direct of neem voor meer informatie of een oriënterend gesprek contact op met:

Bianca Schouten Recruitment Adviseur b.schouten@ggzoostbrabant.nl 088-8461820 Stuur een Whatsapp bericht

Vragen over de functie? Debby Jacobs Teamleider 088-8462261 Bel gerust als je meer wilt weten

title: Senior Team Lead, Billing and Collections
description:
Make an impact with NTT DATA
Join a company that is pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We are renowned for our technical excellence and leading innovations, and for making a difference to our clients and society. Our workplace embraces diversity and inclusion – it’s a place where you can grow, belong and thrive.

Your day at NTT DATA
The Senior Team Lead, Credit and Collections is a developing management role, responsible for ensuring the implementation of policies, processes and procedures related to Credit and Collections.

This role can operate at a regional or divisional level and is responsible for overseeing directing and managing the activities of a credit and collections team, fostering a collaborative and innovative team culture focused on operational excellence.

Key responsibilities:
  • Manages a credit and collections team, providing guidance, training, and performance feedback to ensure high-quality work and adherence to established processes.
  • Oversees the assessment of client creditworthiness, analyzing financial data, credit reports, and other relevant information.
  • Assists in setting appropriate credit limits for clients based on risk assessment and established credit policies.
  • Monitors collections activities, including tracking accounts receivable and proactively contacting clients for outstanding payments.
  • Ensures positive and professional communication with clients to address billing inquiries, resolve disputes, and negotiate payment arrangements.
  • Collaborates with the credit team and other stakeholders to identify and mitigate potential credit risks.
  • Prepares and presents regular collections performance reports and key performance indicators (KPIs) to relevant business stakeholders.
  • Identifies opportunities for process improvements in credit evaluation and collections procedures to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Collaborates with relevant cross functional teams to address credit and collections-related issues and improve overall business processes.
  • Ensures accurate and up-to-date credit and collections records and documentation are maintained for auditing purposes.
  • Builds and maintains positive relationships with clients to facilitate collections efforts and foster client loyalty.
  • Ensures compliance with credit reporting requirements, financial regulations, and industry standards.

To thrive in this role, you need to have:
  • Solid relevant understanding of credit analysis, collections processes, and risk assessment methodologies within the context of IT services and products.
  • Familiarity with credit reporting agencies and credit scoring models used in the IT industry.
  • Proficiency in financial analysis tools, collections software, and Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel).
  • Excellent communication, and negotiation skills with the ability to motivate and guide the team effectively.
  • Excellent attention to detail and ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Knowledge of relevant industry regulations and compliance requirements.
  • Excellent attention to detail with the ability to produce high quality work.

Academic qualifications and certifications:
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent in Finance, Financial Accounting or Business Administration or related field.

Required experience:

title: Product Lead, Devices
description:
About the role

We’re hiring a Product Lead to help build and scale Rippling’s Device Management business. This is a senior role for someone who wants to own ambitious product problems, work deeply with engineering and design, and ship products that change how companies manage IT.


The world of IT has changed. Employees now work across a sprawling set of devices, apps, permissions, data, AI tools, and automated agents. The old IT stack (device management, identity, ticketing, inventory, compliance, and access governance as separate systems) creates fragmentation exactly where companies need control.


Rippling IT is the IT infrastructure for the AI era: one platform that unifies identity, devices, inventory, support, AI governance, and compliance on a single data graph, so policy can be set once and enforced everywhere. Within that platform, Device Management is a broad and technical product area spanning device administration, software, reporting, and the workflows IT teams use to keep their fleets secure, reliable, and productive.


We’re looking for a product leader who can go deep without losing sight of the broader system, learn complex domains quickly, and turn technical complexity into simple, powerful, and intuitive experiences for IT teams and employees. AI is not a bolt-on to this role: you will help rethink how modern IT teams use automation and agents to manage devices and resolve problems at scale.

What you will do

  • Own product strategy and execution for a meaningful area within Device Management, from customer discovery and technical exploration through launch, adoption, and iteration.
  • Set the roadmap for a broad, technical surface spanning core device management workflows, software, reporting, reliability, and scale.
  • Build for the AI era by developing a clear point of view on how AI, automation, and agents should change how IT teams configure, manage, and troubleshoot devices.
  • Work side by side with engineering and design to reason through systems, platform dependencies, edge cases, and tradeoffs, then turn them into intuitive customer experiences.
  • Stay close to customers including IT admins, security teams, and the employees who rely on managed devices to identify their biggest problems.
  • Exercise strong product judgment by combining customer feedback, data, technical context, and business priorities to decide what to build, what not to build, and how to sequence the roadmap.
  • Partner across the business with sales, marketing, support, implementation, and customer success to sharpen positioning, drive adoption, and improve the end-to-end customer experience.
  • Operate as a senior product owner in a fast-moving environment: write clearly, make crisp decisions, raise the bar for product craft, and align cross-functional teams around ambitious goals.

What you will need

  • A track record of building complex, technical products.
  • Strong technical depth and curiosity, with the ability to reason credibly with engineers about architecture, platform constraints, edge cases, and tradeoffs.
  • Demonstrated learning velocity and willingness to go deep in unfamiliar domains. Prior IT or device management experience is not required.
  • Strong product judgment and taste, with a track record of turning complex systems into simple, elegant user experiences.
  • Deep customer empathy and experience building products for real end users, not only internal infrastructure or backend systems.
  • High clock speed, strong ownership, and a bias toward action in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to influence without authority and align teams around difficult decisions.
  • Strong alignment with Rippling’s leadership principles, especially Push the Limits of Possible, Challenge Each Other, and Go and See.

If you don’t meet every qualification listed, we still encourage you to apply. Skills and experiences can show up in many forms, and we value diverse perspectives and backgrounds.

title: Specialist – Finance (Collections)
description:
Specialist – Finance (Collections)

Job Location: Mumbai

In this role you will be responsible for the collection tasks and maintaining customer relations. You will have proactive outreach, diligent follow-up on
overdue accounts, and efficient dispute resolution. Also, you will maintain accurate records, perform regular account reconciliations, and collaborate
with internal teams. Contribute to streamline the collections process while supporting customers in meeting their payment commitments, thus
reinforcing the company's commitment to operational excellence and partnership.

Key Responsibilities:


· Customer Engagement: Reach out to end customers through voice and non-voice processes to share Statements of Accounts (SOAs) within
the defined turnaround time (TAT).


· Dunning: Ensure timely follow-up on payments and manage the dunning process for overdue payments by sending reminders as per the
standard operating procedures.


· Collection Management: Capture and update the Promise-to-Pay (PTP) dates in the Collection Tool (MA!N) after customer interactions. Shall
be responsible for follow up on any payment advice not received on time from the customer.


· Dispute Management: Document and investigate customer disputes regarding non-payment or partial payment of invoices. Collaborate with
internal teams to resolve issues.

management or relevant teams for timely resolution. The goal is to ensure payments are collected as per the agreed terms.


· Bookkeeping: Send the payment details for posting and allocation, as outlined in the payment advice, to the CashApps Team for processing
in the accounting system.


· Account Reconciliation: Conduct regular account reconciliations with customers to address any discrepancies between their records and
internal system balances and obtain balance confirmations as needed.


· Reporting: Maintain detailed records of customer interactions, payment statuses, and disputes, generate regular reports to assess payment
performance and outstanding balances, and report any issues, trends, or anomalies related to collections and disputes.


· Database Upkeep: Ensure the customer database is kept up to date by collaborating with relevant teams to update contact details, such as
changes in the contact person, and maintain accurate records.


· Professionalism: Maintain a calm, patient, and respectful attitude during all customer interactions, always uphold a professional appearance
and demeanour, and ensure a positive experience, even in challenging situations.


· Ad hoc Task: Any additional tasks assigned based on specific circumstances and requirements.


Required Skills/Abilities:

· Bachelor’s Degree in Commerce, Finance, Business Administration, or equivalent field.


· Minimum 3 years of experience in Order-to-Cash processes or a related financial operation.


· Strong knowledge of collections processes, including payment follow-up and dunning.


· Proficient in utilizing financial software and systems (e.g., Oracle, Basware), with ability to quickly adapt to new technology.


· Ability to record, track, and resolve disputes efficiently while collaborating with internal teams.


· Possessing excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain complex issues clearly and professionally, while
maintaining a presentable appearance and interacting effectively with customers and internal stakeholders.


· Possess the ability to independently manage account reconciliations and resolve discrepancies with customers.


· Proficient in maintaining accurate customer records and collaborating with relevant teams to ensure contact and account information is
consistently updated.

title: Associate - Trust & Safety (Tamil) (Eaze)
description:
Role : Associate Trust & Safety - Eaze

Work Location : Work From Home

Department : Eaze

Employment Type : 12 Months Contract

About Lokal :

In 2018, we began with a WhatsApp group with a simple hypothesis: people in tier-2/3 towns weren’t really using the internet meaningfully yet. We believed that if we started with local content in their own language, they’d come back every day; once there was a habit and trust, that same space could naturally grow into classifieds and, eventually, something they used for almost everything online.

This spark became Lokal. Our first instinct was to put everything in one place & one app - local updates, classifieds, jobs, matrimony and more. It worked, till it stopped working. Users gave us the insight - when one use case outweighs the others, everything else seems like noise. We listened. Like how Craigslist quietly seeded a generation of focused companies & marketplaces, we began unbundling and verticalising.

Today, Lokal is a house of focused apps, many products, one mission:
to connect Tier-2/3+ India to the Knowledge, opportunities, tools and experts they’ve always deserved.

We now operate dozens of live apps across categories like:

  • Edutainment & Skill Learning – practical skills and learning in regional languages (GyanTV)
  • Matrimonial Matchmaking – hyperlocal, compatibility-first partner search (Lokal Matrimony)
  • Agri Consulting – farmer-first advisory in local languages (AgriLokal)
  • Local Jobs – blue- and grey-collar opportunities close to home (Lokal Jobs, Sahi Jobs)
  • Social & Community – Place to find & post social updates (Lokal app)
  • Emotional Well-being & Peer Support – safe spaces to talk and feel heard (Dostt & Eaze)
  • Astrology & Guidance – instant access to trusted Astrologers via chat and voice (AstroLokal)
  • Advisory Services – early bets in legal help, financial guidance, career counselling, and more

Under the hood, Lokal is a discovery and access platform: local-language internet + deep Bharat insight+ AI. When someone opens a product we’ve built, they don’t wade through clutter; they get a straight line to what they came for.

This is the story new teammates walk into:
a company that started as a whatsapp group, became a family of focused apps, and kept one belief at the centre — access changes lives.

We ship fast. We learn fast. We build for Bharat.

We are backed by leading global and domestic investors including Y Combinator, Sony, Global Brain, India Quotient, and 3one4 Capital.

Associate – Trust & Safety (Eaze)

About Eaze :

Eaze is a platform dedicated to creating a safe, supportive, and judgment-free space where users can engage in meaningful conversations and build genuine human connections. Through voice and chat experiences, Eaze prioritizes user well-being by fostering a trusted, respectful, and secure community.

About the Role

We are looking for a detail-oriented and responsible Associate – Trust & Safety to help maintain a safe and trusted experience for our users. In this role, you will review and moderate user interactions, enforce community guidelines, identify policy violations, and ensure a high standard of platform safety and quality.

Working closely with the Trust & Safety team, you will play a key role in protecting users, improving moderation processes, and upholding the integrity of the Eaze community.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review and moderate audio, chat, and user interactions in line with Eaze's community guidelines and safety policies.
  • Identify, investigate, and take appropriate action on abusive, harmful, fraudulent, or policy-violating content and behavior.
  • Escalate high-risk or sensitive cases to the relevant internal teams for timely resolution.
  • Review user reports, appeals, and flagged conversations to ensure fair and consistent moderation decisions.
  • Conduct quality audits of moderated conversations and maintain accurate moderation records.
  • Monitor moderation trends and provide insights to improve platform safety, policies, and user experience.
  • Collaborate with Product, Operations, Quality, and Trust & Safety teams to strengthen moderation processes.
  • Handle sensitive content with professionalism, empathy, and confidentiality while adhering to platform standards.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in any discipline.
  • 1–2 years of experience in Trust & Safety, Content Moderation, Community Moderation, Quality Audit, Customer Support, or similar roles.
  • Strong understanding of online safety, community guidelines, and content moderation practices.
  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Proficiency in English and Tamil (Read, Write & Speak mandatory).
  • Comfortable reviewing sensitive or emotionally challenging content while maintaining objectivity and professionalism.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft Excel, CRM tools, and moderation or ticketing platforms.
  • High attention to detail with the ability to make consistent moderation decisions in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred Skills

  • Experience with Trust & Safety operations for social, chat, voice, or community-based platforms.
  • Familiarity with moderation dashboards, QA tools, or ticketing systems.
  • Understanding of abuse detection, fraud prevention, and policy enforcement.
  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to handle sensitive situations with empathy and discretion.

Why Join Eaze?

  • Build a safer and more trusted digital community with meaningful user impact.
  • Work on large-scale Trust & Safety operations and help shape platform safety standards.
  • Gain hands-on experience in content moderation, policy enforcement, and community operations.
  • Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced startup environment with significant learning and growth opportunities.
  • Make a meaningful difference by fostering healthier, safer, and more respectful online interactions.

title: Elektromonteur Zwembadinstallaties
description:
Groei mee met Lotec – specialist in zwembadtechniek

Bij Lotec Zwembadtechniek werken we dagelijks aan innovatieve en duurzame waterbehandelingsinstallaties voor zwembaden. Met meer dan 350 tevreden klanten in de Benelux zijn onze installaties en service niet meer weg te denken uit de wereld van professionele zwembaden. Wat begon als een kleinschalig loodgietersbedrijf is uitgegroeid tot een stabiel en ambitieus bedrijf met ruim 80 collega’s, verdeeld over drie vestigingen in Nederland en België. En we blijven groeien!

Daarom zoeken we een gedreven Elektromonteur Zwembadinstallaties die verantwoordelijk wordt voor het installeren, inbedrijfstellen én onderhouden van onze elektrotechnische installaties.

Wat we je bieden:

  • Een basissalaris tussen €3.500,- en €4.600,- bruto per maand op basis van 40 uur per week. Uiteraard wordt jouw exacte salaris afgestemd op jouw kennis, achtergrond en ervaring;

  • Secundaire arbeidsvoorwaarden volgens de cao Technisch Installatiebedrijf. Denk hierbij aan 25 verlofdagen, 13 ADV-dagen, pensioenopbouw bij het pensioenfonds PMT;

  • Een jaarcontract met de intentie die om te zetten naar een vaste aanstelling;

  • Alle basisvoorwaarden die je nodig hebt om jouw werk succesvol te kunnen doen, zoals een laptop, telefoon en werkbus;

  • De mogelijkheid om jezelf te ontwikkelen. Zowel binnen Lotec, maar ook breder binnen (de bedrijven van) de VDK Groep;

  • Een informele, gezellige werksfeer met regelmatig leuke uitjes, zoals het VDK familiefeest in Phantasialand en diverse personeelsfeesten.

Wat je gaat doen:

Je bent verantwoordelijk voor het installeren, inbedrijfstellen en onderhouden van onze besturingssystemen op klantlocatie. Dit zijn voornamelijk gemeentelijke of publiekstoegankelijke zwembaden.

Naast het inbedrijfstellen zorg je voor service en onderhoud, zodat de goede werking van onze installaties gegarandeerd blijft. Je bent het aanspreekpunt voor onze klant op het gebied van (complexe) storingen en instrueert hen over het juiste gebruik van de systemen en installaties.

Je hebt regelmatig contact met onze toeleveranciers van besturingstechniek en adviseert hen over de toepassing van de software in de praktijk.

Wat neem je mee?

Als Elektromonteur Zwembadinstallaties heb je werkervaring met industriële elektrotechnische installaties en ben je gemotiveerd om jezelf verder te verdiepen in de installatietechniek. Je beschikt over mbo werk- en denkniveau. Bij voorkeur heb je een technische opleiding afgerond, in de richting van mechatronica, industriële automatisering of elektrotechniek. Affiniteit met GBS-systemen, Siemens-apparatuur en Siemens programeeromgevingen is een pré.

Omdat je veel op projectlocaties werkt, beschik je over een rijbewijs. Je bent klantgericht, oplossingsgericht en flexibel ingesteld, ook als dat betekent dat je soms buiten reguliere werktijden moet bijspringen.

Verder ben je representatief, servicegericht en communicatief vaardig. Eigenschappen die jou tot een uitstekend visitekaartje van Lotec maken.


Waar je het gaat doen:

Lotec is al jarenlang dé specialist op het gebied van zwembadtechniek. Wat in 1843 begon als traditioneel loodgietersbedrijf, is inmiddels uitgegroeid tot een Europees speler van formaat, met drie vestigingen in twee landen. We beschikken over een team van zo’n 80 specialisten, verdeeld over de vestigingen in Eindhoven, Twello en Heverlee (België).

Als onderdeel van de snelgroeiende VDK Groep (150 bedrijven, 7.000 medewerkers) bieden we een unieke combinatie, die je nergens anders vindt. Zo combineren we de voordelen van een hecht team met de expertise en doorgroeimogelijkheden van een grote, landelijke organisatie.

Heb je interesse?

Aarzel niet en neem direct contact op met Bart Bongers, Recruitment Business Partner van de VDK Groep. Dit kan door te bellen of te appen naar 06-83072445 of te mailen naar b.bongers@vdkinstallatiegroep.nl.
